meaning: n. (biology) the process of an individual organism growing organically; a purely biological unfolding of events involved in an organism changing gradually from a simple to a more complex level; n. a progression from simpler to more complex forms; n. vegetation that has grown; n. (pathology) an abnormal proliferation of tissue (as in a tumor)

example: 这个生长为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

translation_zh: n. 担保, 抵押品, 保证书；vt. 保证, 担保
example: 这个保证为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

translation_zh: n. 指导, 领导；[医] 导

translation_zh: n. 罪行, 内疚；[法] 罪, 犯罪, 罪行
example: 这个有罪为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

translation_zh: a. 犯罪的, 有过失的, 自觉有错的, 心虚的；[法] 有罪的, 犯罪的, 自觉有罪的

meaning: n. a musician who plays the guitar
translation_zh: n. 吉他弹奏者

translation_zh: n. +体育馆, 体育训练, 体育课, 体操
example: 这个<非正>健身房为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a sport that involves exercises intended to display strength and balance and agility
translation_zh: n. 体操, 体育；[医] 体操, 体育
example: 这个体操为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. the type of environment in which an organism or group normally lives or occurs
translation_zh: n. 栖息地, 居留地, 自生地, 聚集处；[医] 习生地, 产地, 生境, 栖所
example: 这个[生态] 栖息地为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. someone who cuts or beautifies hair
translation_zh: n. 美发师, 理发师

translation_zh: n. 一半, 半场, 不完全；a. 一半的, 不完全的, 部分的, 半场的；adv. 一半地, 部分地, 在某种程度上地, 几乎
example: 他一半地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: n. the part of a gunlock that strikes the percussion cap when the trigger is pulled; n. a hand tool with a heavy rigid head and a handle; used to deliver an impulsive force by striking; n. a heavy metal sphere attached to a flexible wire; used in the hammer throw; n. a striker that is covered in felt and that causes the piano strings to vibrate
translation_zh: n. 锤, 铁锤, 钉锤；vt. 锤打, 敲打, 钉；vi. 连续锤打；[计] 锤头
example: 这个敲打为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a small rubber ball used in playing the game of handball; n. a game played in a walled court or against a single wall by two or four players who strike a rubber ball with their hands
translation_zh: n. 墙手球, 墙手球运动
example: She plays handball every Tuesday evening.

meaning: n. a square piece of cloth used for wiping the eyes or nose or as a costume accessory
translation_zh: n. 手帕, 头巾, 围巾
example: He pulled a clean handkerchief from his pocket.

meaning: n. grasping and shaking a person's hand (as to acknowledge an introduction or to agree on a contract)
translation_zh: n. 握手

meaning: n. something written by hand; n. the activity of writing by hand
translation_zh: n. 笔迹
example: 这个笔迹为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. United States blues musician who transcribed and published traditional blues music (1873-1958); s. easy to reach; s. easy to use; s. skillful with the hands
translation_zh: a. 便利的, 敏捷的, 容易取得的；[化] 便于使用的; 易操作的
example: It's handy to have a map with you.

meaning: n. decoration that is hung (as a tapestry) on a wall or over a window; n. a form of capital punishment; victim is suspended by the neck from a gallows or gibbet until dead
translation_zh: n. 绞死, 绞杀, 悬挂；[法] 绞刑, 绞死
example: The hanging of the new curtains transformed the room.

meaning: n. something that causes or entails suffering
translation_zh: n. 艰难, 辛苦, 苦难；[法] 受苦, 吃苦, 苦难
example: 这个艰难为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a support consisting of an arrangement of straps for holding something to the body (especially one supporting a person suspended from a parachute); n. stable gear consisting of an arrangement of leather straps fitted to a draft animal so that it can be attached to and pull a cart; v. put a harness; v. exploit the power of
translation_zh: n. 马具, 挽具状带子, 甲胄；vt. 给...上挽具, 驾驭, 披上甲胄, 利用...以产生动力
example: 这个控制并利用为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: s. excessively quick; s. done with very great haste and without due deliberation
translation_zh: a. 匆匆的, 轻率的, 性怠的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常轻率的的解释。

meaning: n. the production of young from an egg; n. shading consisting of multiple crossing lines; n. a movable barrier covering a hatchway; v. emerge from the eggs
translation_zh: n. 孵化, 舱口；vt. 孵, 孵出, 策划；vi. 孵化
example: The crew opened the escape hatch.

meaning: n. the emotion of intense dislike; a feeling of dislike so strong that it demands action; v. dislike intensely; feel antipathy or aversion towards
translation_zh: n. 憎恨, 恨, 厌恶；vt. 憎恨, 憎恶；vi. 仇恨
example: He felt a strong hate for injustice.

meaning: n the emotion of intense dislike; a feeling of dislike so strong that it demands action
translation_zh: n. 憎恨, 仇恨, 憎恶；[法] 敌意, 憎恨, 憎恶
example: 这个仇恨为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a frequently visited place; v. follow stealthily or recur constantly and spontaneously to; v. haunt like a ghost; pursue
translation_zh: n. 常到的地方, 生息地；vt. 常到, 出没于, 萦绕于；vi. 出没, 作祟
example: 这个时常萦绕心头为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a shelter serving as a place of safety or sanctuary
translation_zh: n. 港, 避难所, 安息所；vt. 安置...于港中, 庇护, 入港
example: 这个港口为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a source of danger; a possibility of incurring loss or misfortune; n. an obstacle on a golf course
translation_zh: n. 冒险, 危险, 机会；vt. 冒...的危险, 赌运气, 使冒危险；[计] 相关危险; 冒险
example: 这个危险为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. the heading or caption of a newspaper article; v. publicize widely or highly, as if with a headline; v. provide (a newspaper page or a story) with a headline
translation_zh: n. 大标题, 新闻摘要；vt. 为...做标题, 写标题
example: The headline on the newspaper caught my attention.

meaning: v. get healthy again
translation_zh: vi. 痊愈；vt. 使复原, 使和解, 治愈
example: It will take time for the wound to heal.

meaning: n. the natural process by which the body repairs itself
translation_zh: a. 治愈的, 恢复健康的；[计] 修复, 恢复
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常康复的解释。

meaning: n. (law) a proceeding (usually by a court) where evidence is taken for the purpose of determining an issue of fact and reaching a decision based on that evidence; n. an opportunity to state your case and be heard; n. a session (of a committee or grand jury) in which witnesses are called and testimony is taken; n. the ability to hear; the auditory faculty
translation_zh: n. 听, 听觉, 听讯；[医] 听, 听觉
example: Her hearing is excellent.

meaning: a. Having a heart; having (such) a heart (regarded as the; seat of the affections, disposition, or character).; a. Shaped like a heart; cordate.; a. Seated or laid up in the heart.
translation_zh: a. 有...心(肠)的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常心脏的解释。

meaning: s. showing warm and heartfelt friendliness; s. providing abundant nourishment; s. endowed with or exhibiting great bodily or mental health; s. consuming abundantly and with gusto
translation_zh: a. 诚恳的, 健壮的, 热烈的, 丰盛的

meaning: n. device that heats water or supplies warmth to a room
translation_zh: n. 加热器, 灯丝, 加热工；[化] 加热器
example: 这个加热器为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. the abode of God and the angels
translation_zh: n. 天堂, 上帝, 天空

meaning: a. of or belonging to heaven or god
translation_zh: a. 天上的, 神圣的, 天国似的
example: The cake tasted heavenly.

meaning: n. the bottom of a shoe or boot; the back part of a shoe or boot that touches the ground and provides elevation; n. the back part of the human foot; n. one of the crusty ends of a loaf of bread; n. the lower end of a ship's mast
translation_zh: n. 脚后跟, 踵, 后部, 倾侧；vt. 尾随, 装以鞋跟, 倾侧, 追赶；vi. 紧随, 用脚后跟传球
example: 这个脚后跟为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. armor plate that protects the head; n. a protective headgear made of hard material to resist blows
translation_zh: n. 钢盔, 盔, 防护帽；vt. 给...戴头盔
example: Always wear a helmet when riding your bicycle.

meaning: s. lacking in or deprived of strength or power; s. unable to function; without help; s. unable to manage independently
translation_zh: a. 无助的, 无能为力的, 无依无靠的
example: He felt helpless watching the situation unfold.

meaning: n. a group of cattle or sheep or other domestic mammals all of the same kind that are herded by humans; n. a group of wild mammals of one species that remain together: antelope or elephants or seals or whales or zebra; v. cause to herd, drive, or crowd together; v. move together, like a herd
translation_zh: n. 兽群, 人群, 牧人；vt. 群集, 使成群, 放牧；vi. 聚在一起
example: A large herd of cattle grazed in the field.

meaning: v. pause or hold back in uncertainty or unwillingness; v. interrupt temporarily an activity before continuing
translation_zh: vi. 犹豫, 迟疑, 踌躇, 支吾, 停顿
example: Don't hesitate to ask if you have any questions.

meaning: s. designed to elude detection; s. difficult to find
translation_zh: a. 隐藏的；hide的过去分词；[计] 隐藏的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常隐藏的 v. 隐藏的解释。

meaning: r. to a high degree or extent; favorably or with much respect; r. at a high rate or wage; r. in a high position or level or rank
translation_zh: adv. 非常, 非常赞许地；[电] 大大地
example: 他ad地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: n. either side of the body below the waist and above the thigh; n. the ball-and-socket joint between the head of the femur and the acetabulum; n. (architecture) the exterior angle formed by the junction of a sloping side and a sloping end of a roof; n. the fruit of a rose plant
translation_zh: n. 臀部, 蔷薇果, 忧郁；a. 熟悉内情的；vt. 使忧郁, 给(屋顶)造屋脊；interj. 喝彩声
example: 这个臀部为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a newly hired employee; n. the act of hiring something or someone; v. engage or hire for work
translation_zh: n. 租金, 租用, 雇用；vt. 雇请, 出租；vi. 受雇
example: The company decided to hire a new manager.

meaning: n. a person who is an authority on history and who studies it and writes about it
translation_zh: n. 历史学家, 记事者
example: 这个历史学家为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: s. belonging to the past; of what is important or famous in the past; s. important in history
translation_zh: a. 历史上著名的, 有历史性的
example: The city has many historic buildings.

meaning: a. of or relating to the study of history; s. having once lived or existed or taken place in the real world as distinct from being legendary
translation_zh: a. 历史的, 史实的, 历史上的；[法] 历史性的
example: The city has many historical buildings.

meaning: n. (baseball) a successful stroke in an athletic contest (especially in baseball); n. the act of contacting one thing with another; n. a conspicuous success; n. a dose of a narcotic drug
translation_zh: n. 打击, 打, 冲撞, 讽刺；vt. 打, 打击, 碰撞, 打中, 袭击, 偶然碰上；vi. 打, 打中, 打击, 碰撞, 偶然碰上；[计] 击中; 找到; 瞬时打扰
example: 这个& vi.打为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. infection by the human immunodeficiency virus
translation_zh: abbr. 艾滋病病毒（human immunodeficiency virus）
example: 这个艾滋病病毒（human immunodeficiency virus）为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: a. belonging to or derived from or associated with a divine power
translation_zh: a. 神圣的, 圣洁的, 至善的；n. 神圣的东西
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常神圣的的解释。

meaning: n. someone unfortunate without housing; n. poor people who unfortunately do not have a home to live in; s. without nationality or citizenship
translation_zh: a. 无家的, 无养主的
example: Many people become homeless due to economic hardship.

meaning: r. (used as intensives reflecting the speaker's attitude) it is sincerely the case that; r. in an honest manner
translation_zh: adv. 真诚地, 公正地
example: Honestly, I don't know the answer.

meaning: n. the quality of being honest; n. southeastern European plant cultivated for its fragrant purplish flowers and round flat papery silver-white seedpods that are used for indoor decoration
translation_zh: n. 诚实, 公正, 正直
example: 这个诚实为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a holiday taken by a newly married couple; n. the early (usually calm and harmonious) period of a relationship; business or political; v. spend a holiday after one's marriage
translation_zh: n. 蜜月, 蜜月假期；vi. 渡蜜月
example: They went to Paris for their honeymoon.

meaning: n. the act of hopping; jumping upward or forward (especially on one foot); n. twining perennials having cordate leaves and flowers arranged in conelike spikes; the dried flowers of this plant are used in brewing to add the characteristic bitter taste to beer; n. an informal dance where popular music is played; v. jump lightly
translation_zh: n. 单脚跳, 跳跃, 舞会, 飞行；vi. 单脚跳, 跳跃；vt. 跃过, 跳上, 加蛇麻子于, 服麻醉药；[计] 跳跃式传输
example: 这个跳上下为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: a. having or manifesting hope
translation_zh: n. 有希望之人, 有前途之人；a. 有希望的, 怀抱希望的, 保持乐观的
example: She was hopeful about her chances of getting the job.

meaning: r. with hope; in a hopeful manner; r. it is hoped
translation_zh: adv. 有希望地, 如果希望能实现的话
example: Hopefully, the weather will be good tomorrow.

meaning: a. without hope because there seems to be no possibility of comfort or success; s. of a person unable to do something skillfully; s. certain to fail; s. (informal to emphasize how bad it is) beyond hope of management or reform
translation_zh: a. 无希望的, 绝望的, 不可救药的
example: The situation seemed hopeless, but they kept trying.

meaning: n. the line at which the sky and Earth appear to meet; n. the range of interest or activity that can be anticipated; n. a specific layer or stratum of soil or subsoil in a vertical cross section of land; n. the great circle on the celestial sphere whose plane passes through the sensible horizon and the center of the Earth
translation_zh: n. 地平线, 眼界, (天)视地平
example: The sun dipped below the horizon.

meaning: n. a noisemaker (as at parties or games) that makes a loud noise when you blow through it; n. one of the bony outgrowths on the heads of certain ungulates; n. a noise made by the driver of an automobile to give warning;; n. a high pommel of a Western saddle (usually metal covered with leather)
translation_zh: n. 角, 角质, 喇叭, 号角；a. 角制的；vt. 用角触, 长角于
example: The car driver honked the horn.

meaning: s provoking horror
translation_zh: a. 可怕的, 遭透的, 极讨厌的
example: The weather was absolutely horrible yesterday.

meaning: v fill with apprehension or alarm; cause to be unpleasantly surprised
translation_zh: vt. 使恐惧, 使震惊
example: 我们需要逐步horrify这个方案。

meaning: n. a hotel providing overnight lodging for travelers; n. inexpensive supervised lodging (especially for youths on bicycling trips)
translation_zh: n. 青年招待所, 宿舍, 旅店
example: We stayed in a youth hostel during our trip to Europe.

meaning: n a social unit living together
translation_zh: n. 一家人, 家庭, 家族, 王室；a. 家庭的, 家常的, 王室的
example: Most households now have internet access.

meaning: n. the work of cleaning and running a house
translation_zh: n. 家事, 家务
example: 这个家务 (n.) - 家务劳动为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. the quality of being humane
translation_zh: n. 人性, 人类, 博爱
example: 这个人类为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: s. containing or characterized by a great deal of water vapor
translation_zh: a. 潮湿的, 湿润的, 多湿气的
example: The air was very humid before the storm.

meaning: a. full of or characterized by humor
translation_zh: a. 富幽默感的, 滑稽的, 诙谐的
example: He told a very humorous story.

meaning: n. a physiological need for food; the consequence of food deprivation; n. strong desire for something (not food or drink); v. feel the need to eat
translation_zh: n. 饥饿, 渴望, 饥荒；vt. 使挨饿；vi. 挨饿, 渴望
example: 这个饿为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: r. in a hurried or hasty manner
translation_zh: adv. 仓促地；匆忙地
example: 他仓促地地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: n. temporary military shelter
translation_zh: n. 小屋, 茅舍, 临时军营；v. (使)住在茅舍
example: 这个小屋为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. the distinct personality of an individual regarded as a persisting entity; n. the individual characteristics by which a thing or person is recognized or known; n. an operator that leaves unchanged the element on which it operates; n. exact sameness
translation_zh: n. 身份, 相同, 一致, 特性, 恒等式；[计] (打)标记, 标识
example: 这个身份为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. an expression whose meanings cannot be inferred from the meanings of the words that make it up
translation_zh: n. 习语, 成语, 惯用语法, 方言
example: 这个习语为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a material effigy that is worshipped; n. someone who is adored blindly and excessively
translation_zh: n. 偶像, 崇拜物, 宠儿, 幻象, 谬论
example: 这个偶像为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: v. refuse to acknowledge; v. fail to notice; v. be ignorant of or in the dark about
translation_zh: vt. 不理睬, 忽视, 驳回, 忽略；[计] 忽略
example: Don't ignore my advice.

meaning: r. in an illegal manner
translation_zh: [法] 非法地, 不合法地, 违法地
example: 他ad地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: n. impairment of normal physiological function affecting part or all of an organism
translation_zh: n. 疾病, 恶意；[医] 病
example: She is recovering from a long illness.

meaning: v. add embellishments and paintings to (medieval manuscripts)
translation_zh: vt. 照明, 用灯装饰, 阐明, 说明, 使灿烂；vi. 照亮, 用灯装饰
example: 我们需要逐步illuminate这个方案。

meaning: n (mathematics) a number of the form a+bi where a and b are real numbers and i is the square root of -1; s not based on fact; unreal
translation_zh: a. 想像的, 虚构的, 假想的
example: She had an imaginary friend when she was a child.

meaning: v. reproduce someone's behavior or looks; v. appear like, as in behavior or appearance; v. make a reproduction or copy of
translation_zh: vt. 模仿, 效法, 冒充, 仿造
example: Children often imitate their parents' behavior.

meaning: s. of the present time and place; a. having no intervening medium; s. immediately before or after as in a chain of cause and effect; s. performed with little or no delay
translation_zh: a. 立即的, 直接的, 接近的；[医] 直接的, 立即的
example: We need an immediate response.

meaning: r. without delay or hesitation; with no time intervening; r. near or close by; r. bearing an immediate relation
translation_zh: adv. 直接地, 立刻, 立即
example: Please come here immediately.

meaning: v. migrate to a new environment; v. introduce or send as immigrants; v. come into a new country and change residency
translation_zh: vt. 使移居入境；vi. 移入
example: Many people immigrate to new countries for better opportunities.

meaning: n. migration into a place (especially migration to a country of which you are not a native in order to settle there); n. the body of immigrants arriving during a specified interval
translation_zh: n. 移民, 移居；[医] 移民
example: 这个(机场、港口等)移民局检查站移民为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: v. make worse or less effective
translation_zh: vt. 损害, 减少, 削弱；[法] 损害, 伤害, 减少
example: 我们需要逐步impair这个方案。

meaning: n. a vague idea in which some confidence is placed; n. an outward appearance; n. all the copies of a work printed at one time; n. (dentistry) an imprint of the teeth and gums in wax or plaster
translation_zh: n. 印象, 意念, 盖印, 印记, 印数, 底色, 效果；[医] 压迹, 印模, 印象, 影响
example: 这个印象为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: a. making a strong or vivid impression; s. producing a strong effect
translation_zh: a. 给人深刻印象的, 威严的
example: Her performance was truly impressive.

meaning: a. not suitable or right or appropriate; s. not conforming to legality, moral law, or social convention; s. not appropriate for a purpose or occasion
translation_zh: a. 不合适的, 错误的, 不成体统的, 不道德的；[法] 不适当的, 不合适的, 不正确的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常不合适的的解释。

meaning: n. a change for the better; progress in development; n. the act of improving something; n. a condition superior to an earlier condition
translation_zh: n. 进步, 改善, 利用；[医] 改善, 好转, 进步
example: There has been a significant improvement in his health.

meaning: n. a single distinct event; n. a public disturbance; a. falling or striking of light rays on something
translation_zh: n. 事件, 事变, 小事；a. 附带的, 易于发生的, 外来的, 入射的
example: 这个事件为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: v have as a part, be made up out of; v consider as part of something; v add as part of something else; put in as part of a set, group, or category; v allow participation in or the right to be part of; permit to exercise the rights, functions, and responsibilities of
translation_zh: prep. 包含, 包括；[经] 包括, 算入
example: 这个包括为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. the financial gain (earned or unearned) accruing over a given period of time
translation_zh: n. 收入, 收益, 流入；[经] 收益
example: His income increased last year.

meaning: a. not suited to your comfort, purpose or needs; s. not conveniently timed
translation_zh: a. 不便的, 有困难的
example: It was inconvenient to travel during rush hour.

meaning: a. not correct; not in conformity with fact or truth; s. (of a word or expression) not agreeing with grammatical principles
translation_zh: a. 不正确的；[法] 不正确, 错误的, 不适当的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常错误的的解释。

meaning: n. a change resulting in an increase; n. a process of becoming larger or longer or more numerous or more important; n. the amount by which something increases; n. the act of increasing something
translation_zh: n. 增加, 增进, 利益；vt. 增加, 加大；vi. 增加, 繁殖
example: There has been a significant increase in sales this quarter.

meaning: r. advancing in amount or intensity
translation_zh: adv. 逐渐地, 渐增地
example: 他越来越多地地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: a. beyond belief or understanding
translation_zh: a. 难以置信的
example: The view from the mountain top was incredible.

meaning: r. not easy to believe
translation_zh: adv. 不能相信地
example: 他难以置信地地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: a. free from external control and constraint; a. (of a clause) capable of standing syntactically alone as a complete sentence; s. not controlled by a party or interest group
translation_zh: n. 独立自主者, 无党派者；a. 独立的, 有主见的, 不须依赖的, 不受约束的
example: She is a very independent person.

meaning: s. having intervening factors or persons or influences; a. not direct in spatial dimension; not leading by a straight line or course to a destination; a. extended senses; not direct in manner or language or behavior or action; s. not as a direct effect or consequence
translation_zh: a. 间接的, 非直截了当的, 不坦率的；[医] 间接的
example: We took an indirect route to avoid traffic.

meaning: r. not in a forthright manner
translation_zh: adv. 间接, 曲折, 迂回, 不直截了当, 不诚实, 不坦率；[计] 间接地
example: 他ad地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: n. a single organism; a. being or characteristic of a single thing or person; s. separate and distinct from others of the same kind; s. characteristic of or meant for a single person or thing
translation_zh: n. 人, 个人, 个体；a. 个别的, 个人的, 独特的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常个别的的解释。

meaning: r within a building
translation_zh: adv. 在户内
example: 他在室内地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: a. of or relating to or resulting from industry; a. having highly developed industries; s. employed in industry; s. suitable to stand up to hard wear
translation_zh: a. 工业的, 供工业用的, 工业高度发展的, 产业的；n. 工业工人, 工业股票
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常工业的的解释。

meaning: n. the people or companies engaged in a particular kind of commercial enterprise; n. the organized action of making of goods and services for sale
translation_zh: n. 勤劳, 工业, 企业, 产业, 有组织的劳动；[经] 工业, 实业
example: The car industry is very important.

meaning: n. an unavoidable event; a. incapable of being avoided or prevented; s. invariably occurring or appearing
translation_zh: a. 不可避免的, 必然的；[法] 不可避免的, 无法规避的, 必然的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常不可避免的的解释。

meaning: n. the pathological state resulting from the invasion of the body by pathogenic microorganisms; n. (phonetics) the alteration of a speech sound under the influence of a neighboring sound; n. (medicine) the invasion of the body by pathogenic microorganisms and their multiplication which can lead to tissue damage and disease; n. an incident in which an infectious disease is transmitted
translation_zh: n. 传染, 影响, 传染病；[医] 传染, 感染
example: 这个<医>传染为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. the uninflected form of the verb
translation_zh: n. 不定式；a. 不定式的
example: 这个原形的为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: v. impart knowledge of some fact, state or affairs, or event to; v. give character or essence to; v. act as an informer
translation_zh: vt. 通知, 使了解, 使充满；vi. 提供资料, 告发
example: Please inform me if there are any changes.

meaning: a. providing or conveying information
translation_zh: a. 提供消息的, 见闻广博的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常教育性的的解释。

meaning: n. a component of a mixture or compound; n. food that is a component of a mixture in cooking
translation_zh: n. 成分, 因素；[化] 配合剂; 拼料; 成分; 组分
example: Flour is a key ingredient in bread.

meaning: n. a person who inhabits a particular place
translation_zh: n. 居民, 居住者；[医] 居民
example: 这个居民为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: v. draw deep into the lungs in by breathing; v. draw in (air)
translation_zh: vt. 吸入；vi. 吸气
example: He took a deep breath and began to inhale the fresh air.

meaning: r. at the beginning
translation_zh: adv. 最初, 开头
example: 他最初地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: v. give an injection to; v. to introduce (a new aspect or element); v. force or drive (a fluid or gas) into by piercing; v. take by injection
translation_zh: vt. 注射, 注入, 使入轨；[医] 注射
example: 我们需要逐步inject这个方案。

meaning: n. any physical damage to the body caused by violence or accident or fracture etc.; n. an accident that results in physical damage or hurt; n. an act that causes someone or something to receive physical damage; n. wrongdoing that violates another's rights and is unjustly inflicted
translation_zh: n. 伤害, 侮辱；[医] 伤, 损伤
example: He sustained a serious injury during the game.

meaning: n. a liquid used for printing or writing or drawing; n. dark protective fluid ejected into the water by cuttlefish and other cephalopods; v. append one's signature to; v. mark, coat, cover, or stain with ink
translation_zh: n. 墨水, 墨汁；vt. 涂墨水于, 签署, 加墨水
example: 这个墨水为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: s being deepest within the self; s situated or occurring farthest within
translation_zh: a. 内心的, 秘密的, 最深处的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常最深处的的解释。

meaning: n. a person who lacks knowledge of evil; a. free from evil or guilt; s. lacking intent or capacity to injure; s. lacking in sophistication or worldliness
translation_zh: a. 无罪的, 不懂事的, 无知的；n. 天真的人, 笨蛋
example: The jury found the defendant innocent.

meaning: n someone who helps to open up a new line of research or technology or art
translation_zh: n. 改革者, 创新者
example: 这个改革者为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: a. afflicted with or characteristic of mental derangement
translation_zh: a. 患精神病的, 极愚蠢的；[医] 神经错乱的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常疯癫的的解释。

meaning: v. draw within a figure so as to touch in as many places as possible; v. write, engrave, or print as a lasting record; v. address, (a work of literature) in a style less formal than a dedication
translation_zh: vt. 登记, 铭记于, 题写, 雕刻；[电] 书写
example: 我们需要逐步inscribe这个方案。

meaning: n. letters inscribed (especially words engraved or carved) on something; n. the activity of inscribing (especially carving or engraving) letters or words
translation_zh: n. 题字, 碑铭；[医] 划, 药量记载
example: 这个（作者）题词为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a feeling of understanding; n. the clear (and often sudden) understanding of a complex situation; n. grasping the inner nature of things intuitively
translation_zh: n. 察看, 洞察力, 见识；[医] 自知力, 洞察, 顿悟
example: 这个洞察力为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: v. be emphatic or resolute and refuse to budge; v. assert to be true
translation_zh: v. 坚持, 坚决主张, 强调
example: He insisted on paying for the meal.

meaning: n. a formal or official examination
translation_zh: n. 检验, 检查, 视察；[医] 检查, 视察, 监督, 望诊
example: 这个检查为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: v. heighten or intensify; v. supply the inspiration for
translation_zh: vt. 使感动, 激发, 启示, 吸入, 鼓舞, 产生, 使生灵感；vi. 吸入, 赋予灵感
example: 我们需要逐步inspire这个方案。

meaning: n an occurrence of something; n an item of information that is typical of a class or group; v clarify by giving an example of
translation_zh: n. 建议, 情况, 例子, 场合；vt. 引以为例, 举例说明
example: For instance, consider the case of climate change.

meaning: n. an association organized to promote art or science or education; v. advance or set forth in court
translation_zh: n. 学会, 学院, 协会；vt. 创立, 开始, 制定, 任命
example: 这个建立为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. (computer science) a line of code written as part of a computer program
translation_zh: n. 指令, 教导, 命令；[计] 指令
example: Please read the instructions carefully.

meaning: n a person whose occupation is teaching
translation_zh: n. 教员, 讲师；[法] 指导者, 教员, 讲师
example: The yoga instructor demonstrated the pose.

meaning: n. promise of reimbursement in the case of loss; paid to people or companies so concerned about hazards that they have made prepayments to an insurance company
translation_zh: n. 保险, 保险业, 保险费；[医] 保险
example: 这个保险为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: v. have in mind as a purpose; v. design or destine
translation_zh: vt. 计划, 打算, 意思是；[法] 想要, 打算, 意旨
example: I intend to finish this project by Friday.

meaning: a. possessing or displaying a distinctive feature to a heightened degree; s. (of color) having the highest saturation
translation_zh: a. 非常的, 强烈的, 紧张的, 热情的；[医] 强的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常热情的的解释。

meaning: s. characterized by a high degree or intensity; often used as a combining form; a. tending to give force or emphasis; a. of agriculture; intended to increase productivity of a fixed area by expending more capital and labor
translation_zh: a. 加强的, 内涵的, 集中的；n. 加强器
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常加强的的解释。

meaning: n. (usually plural) the goal with respect to a marriage proposal; n. an act of intending; a volition that you intend to carry out
translation_zh: n. 意图, 目的, 含义；[医] 愈合, 意向
example: His intention was to finish the project by Friday.

meaning: r. with intention; in an intentional manner
translation_zh: adv. 故意地, 有意地
example: 他故意地地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: v. act together or towards others or with others
translation_zh: vi. 互相影响, 交互作用；n. 幕间剧, 幕间休息
example: It's important for children to interact with others.

meaning: n. a mutual or reciprocal action; interacting; n. (physics) the transfer of energy between elementary particles or between an elementary particle and a field or between fields; mediated by gauge bosons
translation_zh: n. 交互作用, 交感；[计] 交互作用
example: 这个相互作用为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a substance formed during a chemical process before the desired product is obtained; a. lying between two extremes in time or space or state
translation_zh: n. 中间物, 调停者, 中级；a. 中间的, 中级的；vi. 起媒介作用；[计] 中级
example: This course is for intermediate learners.

meaning: n. the act of suspending activity temporarily
translation_zh: n. 中止, 中断, 停顿, 间歇；[医] 间歇, 间歇期
example: We bought popcorn during the intermission.

meaning: a. happening or arising or located within some limits or especially surface; s. occurring within an institution or community
translation_zh: a. 内在的, 国内的；[医] 内的, 内部的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常内部的的解释。

meaning: r. throughout the world
translation_zh: adv. 国际性地, 在国际间
example: 他国际性地地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: n. a signal that temporarily stops the execution of a program so that another procedure can be carried out; v. make a break in; v. destroy the peace or tranquility of; v. interfere in someone else's activity
translation_zh: vt. 中断, 妨碍, 插嘴；vi. 打断；n. 中断；[计] 中断
example: Please don't interrupt me when I'm talking.

meaning: n. a set containing all points (or all real numbers) between two given endpoints; n. the distance between things; n. the difference in pitch between two notes
translation_zh: n. 间隔, 距离, 间歇, 间隙；[计] 时间间隔
example: The train departs at regular intervals of 30 minutes.

meaning: n. a person who is interviewed
translation_zh: n. 被接见者, 被采访者, 被面试者
example: 这个被接见者为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. the act of beginning something new; n. the first section of a communication; n. a basic or elementary instructional text; n. a new proposal
translation_zh: n. 介绍, 传入, 采用, 初步
example: The introduction to the book was very informative.

meaning: n. the act of invading; the act of an army that invades for conquest or plunder; n. any entry into an area not previously occupied; n. (pathology) the spread of pathogenic microorganisms or malignant cells to new sites in the body
translation_zh: n. 侵犯, 侵入, 侵害；[医] 侵袭, 侵入, 发病
example: 这个入侵为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: v. make an investment; v. furnish with power or authority; of kings or emperors; v. provide with power and authority
translation_zh: vt. 投资, 花费, 笼罩, 授予；vi. 投资, 利用
example: It's wise to invest in your future.

meaning: n. the work of inquiring into something thoroughly and systematically
translation_zh: n. 调查, 审查；[医] 调查, 调查研究
example: 这个（正式的）调查为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a request (spoken or written) to participate or be present or take part in something; n. a tempting allurement
translation_zh: n. 邀请, 请柬, 引诱；[经] 邀请, 招待, 吸引
example: 这个招待为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: r. against your will
translation_zh: adv. 不知不觉地, 无意识地
example: 他非自愿地地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: v. connect closely and often incriminatingly; v. engage as a participant; v. contain as a part; v. occupy or engage the interest of
translation_zh: vt. 包括, 使陷于, 潜心于, 包围；[医] 累及, 牵涉, 包含
example: The project will involve a lot of teamwork.

meaning: a. connected by participation or association or use; s. entangled or hindered as if e.g. in mire; s. emotionally involved; s. enveloped
translation_zh: a. 难懂的, 复杂的, 不易懂的, 卷入...之中的, 累及..., 与...有关, 被纠缠的；[计] 包含, 涉及
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常复杂难懂的的解释。

meaning: n. garments (clothes or linens) that are to be (or have been) ironed; n. the work of using heat to smooth washed clothes in order to remove any wrinkles
translation_zh: n. 熨烫
example: 这个铁器为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. merchandise that has imperfections; usually sold at a reduced price without the brand name; a. contrary to rule or accepted order or general practice; s. not occurring at expected times; a. (used of the military) not belonging to or engaged in by regular army forces
translation_zh: n. 不规则物, 不合规格之物；a. 不规则的, 不整齐的, 不合法的
example: The shape of the table was irregular.

meaning: v. excite to an abnormal condition, or chafe or inflame; v. excite to some characteristic action or condition, such as motion, contraction, or nervous impulse, by the application of a stimulus
translation_zh: vt. 激怒, 使发怒, 使兴奋, 使发炎；vi. 引起不快
example: His constant complaining really started to irritate me.

meaning: n. a small island
translation_zh: n. 小岛, 群岛；vt. 使成为岛状；vi. 住在岛屿上
example: 这个岛屿 (n.) - 海中的小块陆地为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a state of separation between persons or groups; n. a feeling of being disliked and alone; n. the act of isolating something; setting something apart from others; n. (psychiatry) a defense mechanism in which memory of an unacceptable act or impulse is separated from the emotion originally associated with it
translation_zh: n. 隔绝, 孤立, 隔离；[化] 分离; 生物分离
example: 这个隔离为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a hard smooth ivory colored dentine that makes up most of the tusks of elephants and walruses
translation_zh: n. 象牙, 乳白色；a. 象牙制的, 乳白色的
example: 这个象牙为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a semiprecious gemstone that takes a high polish; is usually green but sometimes whitish; consists of jadeite or nephrite; s. of something having the color of jade; especially varying from bluish green to yellowish green
translation_zh: n. 玉, 翡翠, 老马；a. 绿色的, 玉制的；v. (使)疲倦
example: 这个玉为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a vessel (usually cylindrical) with a wide mouth and without handles; n. the quantity contained in a jar; v. shock physically; v. affect in a disagreeable way
translation_zh: n. 广口瓶, 震动, 刺耳声；vi. 震惊, 冲突, 发刺耳声, 不一致；vt. 震动, 刺激
example: 这个罐为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a genre of popular music that originated in New Orleans around 1900 and developed through increasingly complex styles; n. a style of dance music popular in the 1920s; similar to New Orleans jazz but played by large bands; v. play something in the style of jazz
translation_zh: n. 爵士乐, 喧闹；a. 爵士乐的, 喧吵的；vi. 演奏爵士乐, 跳爵士舞, 游荡；vt. 奏爵士乐, 使活泼
example: I love listening to jazz music.

meaning: s. suspicious or unduly suspicious or fearful of being displaced by a rival
translation_zh: a. 嫉妒的, 羡慕的, 留心的, 戒备的
example: He felt jealous when his friend won the award.

meaning: n. a precious or semiprecious stone incorporated into a piece of jewelry; n. a person who is as brilliant and precious as a piece of jewelry
translation_zh: n. 珠宝, 贵重物, 镶珠宝的饰物；vt. 饰以珠宝, 镶以宝石
example: She wore a beautiful jewel around her neck.

meaning: n. running at a jog trot as a form of cardiopulmonary exercise
translation_zh: n. 慢跑；[电] 轻摇
example: 这个慢跑v.（使）慢走为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. (anatomy) the point of connection between two bones or elements of a skeleton (especially if it allows motion); n. a disreputable place of entertainment; n. junction by which parts or objects are joined together; n. marijuana leaves rolled into a cigarette for smoking
translation_zh: n. 连接处, 接合, 关节；a. 共同的, 联合的, 连接的, 合办的；vt. 连接, 接合, 使有接头；vi. 贴合, 长节
example: They made a joint decision to buy the house.

meaning: n. a periodical dedicated to a particular subject; n. a record book as a physical object; n. the part of the axle contained by a bearing
translation_zh: n. 日记, 杂志, 日报；[化] 轴颈
example: She writes in her journal every night.

meaning: n. a writer for newspapers and magazines
translation_zh: n. 新闻记者, 从事新闻杂志业的人
example: The journalist interviewed the politician.

meaning: n. a public official authorized to decide questions brought before a court of justice; v. determine the result of (a competition); v. put on trial or hear a case and sit as the judge at the trial of
translation_zh: n. 法官, 裁判员, 审判官, 鉴定人；vt. 审理, 鉴定, 判断, 判决, 裁定；vi. 下判断, 作评价
example: The judge listened carefully to the arguments.

meaning: n. a large bottle with a narrow mouth; n. the quantity contained in a jug; v. stew in an earthenware jug
translation_zh: n. 水壶, 监牢, 模仿夜莺的叫声；vt. 放入壶中, 炖, 关押；vi. 模仿夜莺叫
example: 这个[轻] 水壶为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: a. full of juice; s. having strong sexual appeal
translation_zh: a. 多汁液的, 生动的, 多水分的
example: The orange was very juicy and sweet.

meaning: n. a person who jumps; n. an athlete who competes at jumping; n. a coverall worn by children; n. a small connector used to make temporary electrical connections
translation_zh: n. 跳跃者, 工作服；[计] 跳线连接器, 跳接器
example: 这个跳高运动员为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a location marked by an intense competition and struggle for survival; n. an impenetrable equatorial forest
translation_zh: n. 丛林, 杂乱的一堆, 弱肉强食的地方
example: The explorers ventured deep into the Amazon jungle.

meaning: n. the quality of being just or fair; n. judgment involved in the determination of rights and the assignment of rewards and punishments
translation_zh: n. 正义, 公平, 公正, 正确, 司法, 审判
example: 这个司法为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a metal pot for stewing or boiling; usually has a lid; n. the quantity a kettle will hold; n. a large hemispherical brass or copper percussion instrument with a drumhead that can be tuned by adjusting the tension on it
translation_zh: n. 茶壶, 罐；[化] 釜体釜; 锅
example: 这个壶为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. device consisting of a set of keys on a piano or organ or typewriter or typesetting machine or computer or the like; n. holder consisting of an arrangement of hooks on which keys or locks can be hung
translation_zh: n. 键盘；[计] 键盘
example: 这个键盘为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. an event that causes someone to die; n. the act of terminating a life; n. a very large profit; s. very funny
translation_zh: n. 谋杀, 杀戮；a. 杀害的, 疲惫的, 迷人的
example: The police are investigating the killing.

meaning: n. the quality of being warmhearted and considerate and humane and sympathetic; n. a kind act
translation_zh: n. 仁慈, 亲切, 和蔼
example: 这个亲切为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. young domestic cat; v. have kittens
translation_zh: n. 小猫, 淘气姑娘；vt. 产仔, 卖弄风情
example: 这个小猫为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a fabric made by knitting; n. a basic knitting stitch; n. needlework created by interlacing yarn in a series of connected loops using straight eyeless needles or by machine; v. make (textiles) by knitting
translation_zh: v. 编织, 结合
example: My grandmother loves to knit sweaters.

meaning: n. a workplace for the conduct of scientific research
translation_zh: n. 实验室, 研究室；[医] 凝乳酶
example: 这个实验室为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n a workplace for the conduct of scientific research; n a region resembling a laboratory inasmuch as it offers opportunities for observation and practice and experimentation
translation_zh: n. 实验室, 研究室, 化工厂；[医] 实验室, 检验室, 化验室
example: Scientists conduct experiments in the laboratory.

meaning: n. steps consisting of two parallel members connected by rungs; for climbing up or down; n. ascending stages by which somebody or something can progress; v. come unraveled or undone as if by snagging
translation_zh: n. 梯, 梯状物, 发迹的途径；vi. 袜子抽丝, 成名
example: 这个阶梯为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. young sheep; n. English essayist (1775-1834); n. a person easily deceived or cheated (especially in financial matters); n. a sweet innocent mild-mannered person (especially a child)
translation_zh: n. 小羊, 羔羊；v. 产羊羔
example: 这个羔羊为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a landowner who leases to others
translation_zh: n. 房东, 地主；[经] 业主, 地主, 房东
example: Our landlord fixed the broken pipe.

meaning: r. in large part; mainly or chiefly; r. on a large scale
translation_zh: adv. 大量地, 很多地, 大半地
example: 他大部分地地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: n. the last or lowest in an ordering or series; n. a person's dying act; the final thing a person can do; n. a unit of weight equal to 4,000 pounds; n. a unit of capacity for grain equal to 80 bushels
translation_zh: a. 最后的, 末尾的, 最近的；vi. 持续, 支持, 维持；vt. 使维持, 够...用；adv. 最后, 后来；n. 最后, 末尾, 鞋楦头
example: 他末尾地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: s. lasting a long time without change
translation_zh: a. 永久的, 永恒的, 持久的；n. 厚实斜纹织物
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常持久的的解释。

meaning: n. someone who arrives late
translation_zh: n. 迟到者
example: 这个latecomer（noun）为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: r in the recent past
translation_zh: adv. 近来, 最近
example: 他近来地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: n. the sound of laughing; n. a facial expression characteristic of a person laughing; v. produce laughter
translation_zh: n. 笑, 笑声；vi. 笑, 大笑；vt. 以笑表示
example: 这个笑为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. the activity of laughing; the manifestation of joy or mirth or scorn
translation_zh: n. 笑, 笑声；[医] 笑, 大笑
example: 这个笑为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a motorboat with an open deck or a half deck; v. propel with force; v. launch for the first time; launch on a maiden voyage; v. get going; give impetus to
translation_zh: n. 下水, 汽艇, 发射；vt. 使下水, 发射, 发动；vi. 起飞, 下水, 投入, 开始
example: They plan to launch a new product next month.

meaning: a. conformable to or allowed by law; s. according to custom or rule or natural law; s. authorized, sanctioned by, or in accordance with law
translation_zh: a. 法律许可的, 守法的, 合法的；[经] 合法的, 法定的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常合法的的解释。

meaning: n. single thickness of usually some homogeneous substance; n. a relatively thin sheetlike expanse or region lying over or under another; n. a hen that lays eggs; n. thin structure composed of a single thickness of cells
translation_zh: n. 层, 产卵鸡, 放置者；vt. 分层堆积, 压植；[计] 层
example: There was a thick layer of dust on the old books.

meaning: n. an advantage held by a competitor in a race; n. a soft heavy toxic malleable metallic element; bluish white when freshly cut but tarnishes readily to dull grey; n. evidence pointing to a possible solution; n. a position of leadership (especially in the phrase `take the lead')
translation_zh: n. 铅, 铅条, 领导, 超前量, 领引, 榜样, 主角, 导线；vt. 引导, 带领, 领导, 指挥, 致使, 加铅于, 用铅包；vi. 领导, 带头, 导致, 用测深锤测深, 被铅覆盖；a. 带头的, 最重要的
example: She will lead the team on the new project.

meaning: n. the activity of leading; n. the body of people who lead a group; n. the status of a leader; n. the ability to lead
translation_zh: n. 领导能力, 领导阶层
example: 这个领导为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: s. indicating the most important performer or role; s. greatest in importance or degree or significance or achievement; a. going or proceeding or going in advance; showing the way
translation_zh: n. 领导, 指挥, 神示, 铅板；a. 领导的, 主要的, 在前的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常主要的的解释。

meaning: n. an association of sports teams that organizes matches for its members; n. an association of states or organizations or individuals for common action; n. an obsolete unit of distance of variable length (usually 3 miles); v. unite to form a league
translation_zh: n. 同盟, 联盟, 盟约；v. 组联盟, (使)加盟
example: 这个联盟为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: v. to incline or bend from a vertical position; v. cause to lean or incline; v. rely on for support; a. lacking in mineral content or combustible material
translation_zh: n. 瘦肉, 倾斜, 倾斜度；a. 瘦的, 贫乏的, 歉收的；vi. 倚靠, 倾斜, 依赖；vt. 使倾斜
example: Don't lean on the wet paint.

meaning: n. something that is of no importance; a. the superlative of `little' that can be used with mass nouns and is usually preceded by `the'; a quantifier meaning smallest in amount or extent or degree; r. used to form the superlative
translation_zh: n. 最少, 最小, 最小限度；a. 最少的, 最小的；adv. 最小, 最少
example: 他最小的地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: n. the period of time during which you are absent from work or duty; n. permission to do something; v. go away from a place; v. go and leave behind, either intentionally or by neglect or forgetfulness
translation_zh: n. 许可, 告别, 请假, 休假；vt. 离开, 剩下, 遗忘, 委托, 丢弃；vi. 出发, 离开, 生叶
example: 这个离开为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a speech that is open to the public; n. a lengthy rebuke; n. teaching by giving a discourse on some subject (typically to a class); v. deliver a lecture or talk
translation_zh: n. 演讲, 谴责, 讲稿；vt. 演讲, 训诫, 说教；vi. 讲演
example: The professor gave an interesting lecture on history.

meaning: a. established by or founded upon law or official or accepted rules; a. of or relating to jurisprudence; s. having legal efficacy or force; a. relating to or characteristic of the profession of law
translation_zh: a. 法律的, 法定的, 合法的；[经] 法定权利; 法律(上)的, 合法的
example: It's important to get legal advice before signing the contract.

meaning: r. by law; conforming to the law; r. in a legal manner
translation_zh: adv. 法律上, 合法地；[法] 法律上, 合法地, 法定地
example: 他ad地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: n. the linear extent in space from one end to the other; the longest dimension of something that is fixed in place; n. the property of being the extent of something from beginning to end; n. a section of something that is long and narrow
translation_zh: n. 长度, 长, 期间, 一段；[计] 记录长度; 块长; 字长
example: What is the length of this rope?

meaning: v decrease in size, extent, or range; v make smaller; v wear off or die down
translation_zh: vt. 减少, 缩小, 减轻；vi. 变小
example: 我们需要逐步lessen这个方案。

meaning: n. any of various plants of the genus Lactuca; n. leaves of any of various plants of Lactuca sativa
translation_zh: n. 莴苣, 生菜, 纸币；[医] 莴苣
example: 这个[园艺] 生菜为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a person who has lied or who lies repeatedly
translation_zh: n. 说谎者
example: Nobody trusts a liar.

meaning: v. grant freedom to
translation_zh: vt. 解放, 释放, 使自由；[机] 释出, 放出
example: 我们需要逐步liberate这个方案。

meaning: n. the act of liberating someone or something; n. the attempt to achieve equal rights or status
translation_zh: n. 释放, 解放；[化] 发出; 释放; 放出
example: 这个解放名 词:liberationist为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a professional person trained in library science and engaged in library services
translation_zh: n. 图书馆员, 图书管理员；[计] 程序库管理程序; 程序库生成程序
example: 这个图书管理员 (n.) - 管理图书馆为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a statement that deviates from or perverts the truth; n. Norwegian diplomat who was the first Secretary General of the United Nations (1896-1968); n. position or manner in which something is situated; v. be located or situated somewhere; occupy a certain position
translation_zh: n. 谎言, 假象, 位置；vi. 躺着, 说谎, 位于, 展现, 存在, 停泊；vt. 谎骗
example: He likes to lie on the sofa and read.

meaning: n. an attendant employed at a beach or pool to protect swimmers from accidents
translation_zh: n. 卫兵, 禁卫军, 救生员
example: The lifeguard blew his whistle to warn the swimmers.

meaning: s. continuing through life
translation_zh: a. 终身的, 毕生的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常毕生的的解释。

meaning: n. a device for lighting or igniting fuel or charges or fires; v. transport in a flatbottom boat
translation_zh: n. 点火者, 点灯工人, 打火机, 驳船；vt. 以驳船搬运
example: 这个打火机为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: r. without good reason; r. with few burdens; r. with little weight or force; r. indulging with temperance
translation_zh: adv. 轻轻地, 少许, 不费力地
example: She touched his arm lightly to get his attention.

meaning: n. abrupt electric discharge from cloud to cloud or from cloud to earth accompanied by the emission of light; n. the flash of light that accompanies an electric discharge in the atmosphere (or something resembling such a flash); can scintillate for a second or more
translation_zh: n. 闪电；vi. 闪电；a. 闪电的
example: We saw a bright flash of lightning during the storm.

meaning: n. a similar kind; n. a kind of person; v. find enjoyable or agreeable; v. be fond of
translation_zh: a. 相似的, 同样的；vt. 喜欢, 愿意, 想；vi. 喜欢, 希望；n. 爱好, 同样的人(或物)；prep. 象, 如同；adv. 可能
example: 这个喜欢为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. similarity in appearance or character or nature between persons or things; n. picture consisting of a graphic image of a person or thing
translation_zh: n. 相象, 相似物, 样子
example: 这个相似为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. the greatest possible degree of something; n. as far as something can go; n. the boundary of a specific area; n. the mathematical value toward which a function goes as the independent variable approaches infinity
translation_zh: n. 界限, 边界, 限度, 极限, 限制；vt. 限制, 限定
example: There's a speed limit on this road.

meaning: n. the quality of being limited or restricted; n. (law) a time period after which suits cannot be brought; n. an act of limiting or restricting (as by regulation)
translation_zh: n. 限制, 缺陷, 限额；[医] 限界, 限制, 限度
example: 这个限制为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: a. small in range or scope; s. including only a part; s. mediocre; s. not excessive
translation_zh: a. 有限制的, 有限的, 有限责任的；n. 特别快车
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常有限的的解释。

meaning: v. walk impeded by some physical limitation or injury; v. proceed slowly or with difficulty; s. not firm; s. lacking in strength or firmness or resilience
translation_zh: n. 跛行；a. 柔软的, 无力的, 软弱的；vi. 跛行
example: 我们需要逐步limp这个方案。

meaning: n. the means of connection between things linked in series; n. a fastener that serves to join or connect; n. a unit of length equal to 1/100 of a chain; n. (computing) an instruction that connects one part of a program or an element on a list to another program or list
translation_zh: n. 环, 连结物, 链接, 火把；vt. 连结, 联合, 挽住；vi. 连接起来；[计] 连接, 链路
example: Can you send me the link to that website?

meaning: n. a substance that is liquid at room temperature and pressure; n. the state in which a substance exhibits a characteristic readiness to flow with little or no tendency to disperse and relatively high incompressibility; n. fluid matter having no fixed shape but a fixed volume; n. a frictionless continuant that is not a nasal consonant (especially `l' and `r')
translation_zh: n. 液体, 流体, 流音；a. 液体的, 透明的, 明亮的, 流动的, 易变的
example: Water is a clear liquid.

meaning: a. of or relating to or characteristic of literature; s. knowledgeable about literature; s. appropriate to literature rather than everyday speech or writing
translation_zh: a. 文学的, 文艺的, 精通文学的；[法] 文学的, 从事文学的, 从事写作的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常文学的的解释。

meaning: n. creative writing of recognized artistic value; n. the humanistic study of a body of literature; n. published writings in a particular style on a particular subject; n. the profession or art of a writer
translation_zh: n. 文学, 文艺, 著作；[经] 广告, 商品介绍等文学
example: 这个文学为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: v. lead a certain kind of life; live in a certain style; v. pursue a positive and satisfying existence; a. actually being performed at the time of hearing or viewing; a. exerting force or containing energy
translation_zh: a. 活的, 生动的, 精力充沛的, 实况转播的；vi. 活, 生存, 居住；vt. 过着, 度过, 经历；adv. 实况地
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常活的的解释。

meaning: n. large and complicated reddish-brown glandular organ located in the upper right portion of the abdominal cavity; secretes bile and functions in metabolism of protein and carbohydrate and fat; synthesizes substances involved in the clotting of the blood; synthesizes vitamin A; detoxifies poisonous substances and breaks down worn-out erythrocytes; n. liver of an animal used as meat; n. a person who has a special life style; n. someone who lives in a place
translation_zh: n. 肝脏, 生活者, 居民；[医] 肝
example: The liver plays a vital role in digestion.

meaning: n. a quantity of food (other than bread) formed in a particular shape

example: 这个条为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: v. discover the location of; determine the place of; find by searching or examining; v. assign a location to
translation_zh: vt. 找出, 设于, 位于；vi. 定居
example: Can you help me locate my lost keys?

meaning: n. English physicist who studied electromagnetic radiation and was a pioneer of radiotelegraphy (1851-1940); n. small house at the entrance to the grounds of a country mansion; usually occupied by a gatekeeper or gardener; n. a small (rustic) house used as a temporary shelter; n. any of various Native American dwellings
translation_zh: n. 小屋, 门房, 支部, 旅舍, 分会；vi. 临时住宿, 倒伏, 寄宿, 投宿；vt. 安顿, 容纳, 提出, 把...射入, 存放
example: 这个存放为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a segment of the trunk of a tree when stripped of branches; n. a written record of messages sent or received; n. a written record of events on a voyage (of a ship or plane); n. measuring instrument that consists of a float that trails from a ship by a knotted line in order to measure the ship's speed through the water
translation_zh: n. 记录, 圆木, 日志, 计程仪；vt. 伐木, 切, 航行；vi. 伐木；[计] 日志
example: We threw another log on the fire.

meaning: n. the branch of philosophy that analyzes inference; n. reasoned and reasonable judgment; n. the principles that guide reasoning within a given field or situation; n. the system of operations performed by a computer that underlies the machine's representation of logical operations
translation_zh: n. 逻辑, 逻辑学, 推理的方法, 推理, 逻辑性；[计] 逻辑
example: 这个逻辑为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a company emblem or device
translation_zh: n. 连合活字, 商标, 徽标；[计] 徽标
example: The company updated its logo last year.

meaning: n. a large low horse-drawn wagon without sides; n. a large truck designed to carry heavy loads; usually without sides
translation_zh: n. 卡车, 货车；[化] 载重汽车
example: 这个（英）卡车为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. something that is lost; n. gradual decline in amount or activity; n. the act of losing someone or something; n. the disadvantage that results from losing something
translation_zh: n. 损失, 遗失, 失败, 输, 错过, 伤亡；[化] 损失; 损耗
example: The company reported a significant loss this quarter.

meaning: n. something that is regarded as a chance event; n. players buy (or are given) chances and prizes are distributed by casting lots
translation_zh: n. 奖券, 彩票, 运气；[经] 抽彩给奖法
example: He won a small prize in the lottery.

meaning: a. characterized by or producing sound of great volume or intensity
translation_zh: a. 大声的, 不断的, 喧吵的；adv. 高声地, 大声地
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常响亮的的解释。

meaning: n. electro-acoustic transducer that converts electrical signals into sounds loud enough to be heard at a distance
translation_zh: n. 扩音器, 喇叭；[电] 扬声器
example: The announcement was made over the loudspeaker.

meaning: r with fondness; with love
translation_zh: adv. 钟爱地, 亲切地
example: 他亲爱地地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: a. steadfast in allegiance or duty
translation_zh: a. 忠诚的, 忠实的, 忠贞的
example: He is a loyal friend.

meaning: n. the quality of being loyal; n. feelings of allegiance
translation_zh: n. 忠贞, 忠诚, 忠实；[法] 忠诚, 忠心
example: His loyalty to the company was unwavering.

translation_zh: n. 行李, 皮箱

meaning: n. either of two saclike respiratory organs in the chest of vertebrates; serves to remove carbon dioxide and provide oxygen to the blood
translation_zh: n. 肺, 肺脏, 空地；[医] 肺
example: The doctor examined his lungs.

meaning: s possessing or using or characteristic of or appropriate to supernatural powers
translation_zh: a. 魔术的, 有魔力的, 不可思议的
example: The children believed in the magical powers of the fairy.

meaning: n. someone who performs magic tricks to amuse an audience
translation_zh: n. 魔术家, 幻术家, 术士
example: 这个魔术师为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: s characterized by grandeur
translation_zh: a. 华丽的, 高尚的, 宏伟的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常壮丽的的解释。

meaning: n. a private box for delivery of mail
translation_zh: n. 邮筒, 邮箱；[计] 邮箱, 电子邮箱
example: 这个邮筒为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: v. state or assert
translation_zh: vt. 维持, 维修, 保持, 坚持, 供养, 主张；[化] 维修
example: It's important to maintain a healthy diet.

translation_zh: n. 维护, 保持, 维修, 生活费用, 坚持, 扶养；[计] 维护; 维修
example: 这个维持为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. the property resulting from being or relating to the greater in number of two parts; the main part; n. (elections) more than half of the votes; n. the age at which persons are considered competent to manage their own affairs
translation_zh: n. 多数, 大半；[计] 多数逻辑
example: 这个大多数为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

translation_zh: n. 经营, 支配, 管理；[化] 管理处

translation_zh: n. 枫, 枫木, 淡棕色；[机] 枫木
example: Maple syrup comes from maple trees.

meaning: n. a hard crystalline metamorphic rock that takes a high polish; used for sculpture and as building material; n. a small ball of glass that is used in various games; n. a sculpture carved from marble; v. paint or stain like marble
translation_zh: n. 大理石, 石弹, 雕刻品；a. 大理石的, 冷酷无情的, 有大理石花纹的
example: The statue was carved from white marble.

meaning: n. a member of the United States Marine Corps; n. a soldier who serves both on shipboard and on land; a. of or relating to the sea; a. of or relating to military personnel who serve both on land and at sea (specifically the U.S. Marine Corps)
translation_zh: n. 舰队, 水兵, 海景画；a. 海的, 海产的, 海底的, 船舶的, 海运的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常海运业的解释。

meaning: s. strongly marked; easily noticeable; s. singled out for notice or especially for a dire fate; a. having or as if having an identifying mark or a mark as specified; often used in combination
translation_zh: a. 有记号的, 显著的, 醒目的；[化] 有记号的; 显著的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常显著的的解释。

meaning: n. the state of being a married couple voluntarily joined for life (or until divorce); n. two people who are married to each other; n. the act of marrying; the nuptial ceremony; n. a close and intimate union
translation_zh: n. 婚姻, 结婚, 婚礼, 合并；[医] 婚姻, 结婚
example: Their marriage lasted for fifty years.

meaning: n. a mixture of mashed malt grains and hot water; used in brewing; n. mixture of ground animal feeds
translation_zh: n. 碎麦芽, 饲料, 糊状物；vt. 调情, 捣碎
example: 我们需要逐步mash这个方案。

translation_zh: n. 块, 大多数, 质量, 大量, 群众, 弥撒；a. 群众的, 大规模的, 整个的；vt. 使集合, 集中；vi. 聚集
example: A mass of people gathered in the square.

meaning: s. imposing in size or bulk or solidity; s. being the same substance throughout; s. imposing in scale or scope or degree or power; s. consisting of great mass; containing a great quantity of matter
translation_zh: a. 大而重的, 宽大的, 宏伟的；[医] 大块的, 整块的, 大量的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常大而重的的解释。

meaning: n. a person skilled in mathematics
translation_zh: n. 数学家
example: She decided to become a mathematician because she loved solving complex problems.

meaning: n. a science (or group of related sciences) dealing with the logic of quantity and shape and arrangement
translation_zh: n. 数学；[机] 数学
example: She is studying advanced mathematics at university.

meaning: n. the largest possible quantity; n. the point on a curve where the tangent changes from positive on the left to negative on the right
translation_zh: n. 极点, 最大量, 极大；a. 最高的, 最大的, 最大极限的；[计] 最大值
example: The maximum speed limit here is 60 miles per hour.

meaning: n. the head of a city government
translation_zh: n. 市长；[法] 市长
example: The mayor gave a speech about the city's future.

meaning: a. having a meaning or purpose
translation_zh: a. 意味深长的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常有目的的的解释。

meaning: r. at the same time but in another place; r. during the intervening time
translation_zh: n. 其时, 其间；adv. 同时, 于此时
example: The train was delayed; meanwhile, we waited at the station.

meaning: n. any maneuver made as part of progress toward a goal; n. how much there is or how many there are of something that you can quantify; n. musical notation for a repeating pattern of musical beats; n. a container of some standard capacity that is used to obtain fixed amounts of a substance
translation_zh: n. 尺寸, 量度器, 量度标准, 测量, 量具, 程度, 范围, 限度, 分寸, 措施, 方法；vt. 测量, 测度, 估量, 权衡, 调节, 拿(自己或自己的力量等)作较量；vi. 度量
example: 这个措施为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. the act or process of assigning numbers to phenomena according to a rule
translation_zh: n. 尺寸, 度量, 度量单位；[计] 度量, 度量单位
example: Accurate measurement is crucial in scientific experiments.

meaning: s. resembling the action of a machine
translation_zh: n. 机械工, 技工；a. 手工的
example: 这个机械工为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: a. using (or as if using) mechanisms or tools or devices; a. relating to or concerned with machinery or tools; a. relating to or governed by or in accordance with mechanics
translation_zh: a. 机械的, 机械性的, 力学的；[医] 机械的, 力学的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常机械（方面）的的解释。

meaning: v reflect deeply on a subject; v think intently and at length, as for spiritual purposes
translation_zh: vt. 想, 考虑, 计划；vi. 沉思, 反省
example: She tries to meditate for at least 15 minutes every morning.

meaning: n. continuous and profound contemplation or musing on a subject or series of subjects of a deep or abstruse nature; n. (religion) contemplation of spiritual matters (usually on religious or philosophical subjects)
translation_zh: n. 沉思, 冥想
example: 这个默想为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. the largest inland sea; between Europe and Africa and Asia; a. of or relating to or characteristic of or located near the Mediterranean Sea
translation_zh: n. 地中海, 地中海民族；a. 地中海的, 地中海民族的
example: 这个地中海的为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a means or instrumentality for storing or communicating information; n. the surrounding environment; n. an intervening substance through which signals can travel as a means for communication; n. a liquid with which pigment is mixed by a painter
translation_zh: n. 媒体, 方法, 媒介；a. 半生熟的, 中间的；[计] 媒体, 中
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常媒介的解释。

meaning: v. reduce or cause to be reduced from a solid to a liquid state, usually by heating; v. lose its distinct outline or shape; blend gradually; v. become less intense and fade away gradually
translation_zh: n. 熔化, 熔化物, 溶解；v. (使)熔化, (使)溶解, (使)消散, (使)变软
example: 我们需要逐步melt这个方案。

meaning: n. the body of members of an organization or group; n. the state of being a member
translation_zh: n. 会员的资格, 全体会员, 会员数目；[法] 会员资格, 成员资格, 会籍
example: She applied for membership at the local gym.

meaning: s. worth remembering
translation_zh: a. 值得纪念的, 难忘的
example: It was a truly memorable experience.

meaning: n. sewing that repairs a worn or torn hole (especially in a garment); v. heal or recover
translation_zh: n. 改进, 修补, 好转；vt. 修改, 改进, 加快, 修理；vi. 好转, 改善
example: Can you help me mend this torn shirt?

meaning: a. involving the mind or an intellectual process; a. of or relating to the mind; a. of or relating to the chin- or liplike structure in insects and certain mollusks; s. affected by a disorder of the mind
translation_zh: a. 心智的, 精神病的, 心理的, 颏的；n. 精神病患者
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常存在于大脑中的的解释。

meaning: r. in your mind
translation_zh: adv. 心理上, 精神上, 智力上；[法] 精神上, 智力上
example: He was mentally prepared for the challenge.

meaning: n. a businessperson engaged in retail trade
translation_zh: n. 商人, 店主；a. 商业的, 商人的
example: 这个商人为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a small pond of standing water; s. being nothing more than specified
translation_zh: n. 小湖, 池塘；a. 仅仅的, 只不过的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常小湖的解释。

meaning: r. and nothing more
translation_zh: adv. 只
example: 他仅仅地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: n. a state of confusion and disorderliness; n. soft semiliquid food; n. a meal eaten in a mess hall by service personnel; n. a (large) military dining room where service personnel eat or relax
translation_zh: n. 食堂, 伙食, 用膳, 一份食品, 混乱, 乱七八糟, 困境；vt. 将...弄糟, 妨碍, 使紊乱, 使就餐；vi. 陷入困境, 搞乱, 用膳
example: Your room is a complete mess.

meaning: s. dirty and disorderly
translation_zh: a. 散乱的, 污秽的, 麻烦的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常脏的的解释。

meaning: a. moderate in type or degree or effect or force; far from extreme
translation_zh: a. 温和的, 温柔的, 淡味的, 适度的, 轻微的, (肥皂等)软性的；[医] 轻的, 缓和的
example: The weather was mild for this time of year.

meaning: n. solid homogeneous inorganic substances occurring in nature having a definite chemical composition; a. relating to minerals; s. composed of matter other than plant or animal
translation_zh: n. 矿物, 无机物, 苏打水；a. 矿物的, 似矿物的
example: Water often contains various minerals.

meaning: n. the smallest possible quantity; n. the point on a curve where the tangent changes from negative on the left to positive on the right
translation_zh: a. 最小的, 最低的；n. 最小值；[计] 最小值
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常最小量的解释。

meaning: a. of lesser importance or stature or rank; a. lesser in scope or effect; a. inferior in number or size or amount; a. of a scale or mode
translation_zh: n. 未成年人, 副修科目；a. 较小的, 二流的, 未成年的；vi. 副修；[计] 次要
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常未成年人的解释。

meaning: n. a group of people who differ racially or politically from a larger group of which it is a part; n. being or relating to the smaller in number of two parts; n. any age prior to the legal age
translation_zh: n. 少数, 未成年, 少数民族；a. 少数的, 属于少数派的
example: 这个少数为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: a. on the negative side or lower end of a scale; s. involving disadvantage or harm
translation_zh: n. 负号, 不足；a. 减的, 负的, 阴性的；prep. 减, 缺；[计] 负差
example: 这个减为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. any amazing or wonderful occurrence; n. a marvellous event manifesting a supernatural act of a divine agent
translation_zh: n. 奇迹, 奇事
example: 这个奇迹为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. reckless or malicious behavior that causes discomfort or annoyance in others
translation_zh: n. 损害, 伤害, 灾祸, 恶作剧, 淘气；[法] 损害, 伤害, 危害
example: 这个损害为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: s. very unhappy; full of misery; s. characterized by physical misery
translation_zh: a. 悲惨的；痛苦的；卑鄙的
example: I felt miserable after catching the flu.

meaning: n. a state of ill-being due to affliction or misfortune; n. a feeling of intense unhappiness
translation_zh: n. 痛苦, 悲惨, 不幸, 穷困
example: The war brought widespread misery.

meaning: v. lead someone in the wrong direction or give someone wrong directions
translation_zh: vt. 误导
example: 我们需要逐步mislead这个方案。

meaning: n. an organization of missionaries in a foreign land sent to carry on religious work; n. an operation that is assigned by a higher headquarters; n. a special assignment that is given to a person or group; n. the organized work of a religious missionary
translation_zh: n. 任务, 代表团, 使命, 传教团；vt. 派遣, 向...传教
example: Their mission was to explore the new planet.

meaning: s. wet with mist
translation_zh: a. 有雾的, 模糊的, 笼罩着雾的
example: The morning was cold and misty.

meaning: n putting the wrong interpretation on; n an understanding of something that is not correct; v interpret in the wrong way
translation_zh: n. 误会, 误解；[法] 误解, 误会, 不和
example: There was a misunderstanding about the meeting time.

meaning: n. a hypothetical description of a complex entity or process; n. a type of product; n. a person who poses for a photographer or painter or sculptor; n. representation of something (sometimes on a smaller scale)
translation_zh: n. 模型, 模范, 模特儿；a. 模范的, 作模型用的；vi. 做模型, 做模特儿；vt. 使模仿, 塑造；[计] 模型
example: This is a new car model.

meaning: n. (from a combination of MOdulate and DEModulate) electronic equipment consisting of a device used to connect computers by a telephone line
translation_zh: n. 调制解调器；[计] 调制解调器
example: You need a modem to connect to the internet.

meaning: v. preside over; v. make less fast or intense; a. being within reasonable or average limits; not excessive or extreme; s. not extreme
translation_zh: a. 适度的, 稳健的, 中等的, 节制的；vt. 节制, 减轻, 使缓和；vi. 变缓和, 主持会议
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常中等的的解释。

meaning: v. make less severe or harsh or extreme; v. add a modifier to a constituent
translation_zh: vt. 修正, 变更, 修饰, 缓和, 减轻；vi. 被修改；[计] 修改
example: 我们需要逐步modify这个方案。

meaning: n. wetness caused by water
translation_zh: n. 湿气, 水分, 降雨；[化] 含水量; 含湿量
example: The plant needs plenty of moisture to grow.

meaning: n. (physics and chemistry) the simplest structural unit of an element or compound
translation_zh: n. 分子, 些微；[化] 分子
example: 这个分子为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. an ironclad vessel built by Federal forces to do battle with the Merrimac; n. display produced by a device that takes signals and displays them on a television screen or a computer monitor; n. electronic equipment that is used to check the quality or content of electronic transmissions; n. a piece of electronic equipment that keeps track of the operation of a system continuously and warns of trouble
translation_zh: n. 监督器, 级长, 监听员, 班长, 监视器, 告诫物；v. 监视, 监听, 监督；[计] 监视器, 监视程序; 监视
example: 这个显示器为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a male religious living in a cloister and devoting himself to contemplation and prayer and work; n. United States jazz pianist who was one of the founders of the bebop style (1917-1982)
translation_zh: n. 修道士, 僧侣, 和尚
example: The monk lived a life of quiet contemplation.

meaning: n. a periodical that is published every month (or 12 issues per year); s. of or occurring or payable every month; r. occurring once a month
translation_zh: n. 月刊；a. 每月的, 每月一次的
example: We have a monthly meeting.

meaning: n. an important site that is marked and preserved as public property
translation_zh: n. 纪念碑, 纪念物, 石碑
example: The monument stands as a tribute to the fallen soldiers.

meaning: n. English statesman who opposed Henry VIII's divorce from Catherine of Aragon and was imprisoned and beheaded; recalled for his concept of Utopia, the ideal state; a. (comparative of `much' used with mass nouns) a quantifier meaning greater in size or amount or extent or degree; a. (comparative of `many' used with count nouns) quantifier meaning greater in number; r. used to form the comparative of some adjectives and adverbs
translation_zh: n. 更多；a. 多的, 程度较大的, 更大的；adv. 多, 更多, 进一步；[计] DOS外部命令:显示满屏后自动暂停, 并显示:"--More--", 按任意键继续
example: 他更地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: r in addition; furthermore, their quality is improving"; moreover, mice nested there"
translation_zh: adv. 而且, 此外
example: 他再者地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: n. two-winged insect whose female has a long proboscis to pierce the skin and suck the blood of humans and animals
translation_zh: n. 蚊子；[医] 蚊
example: 这个蚊子 (n.) - 小飞虫为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. tiny leafy-stemmed flowerless plants
translation_zh: n. 苔藓, 泥沼；vt. 使长满苔藓
example: 这个苔藓为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n the country where you were born
translation_zh: n. 祖国
example: 这个祖国为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: s not in physical motion
translation_zh: a. 不动的, 静止的；[机] 不动的, 静止的
example: The cat sat motionless, watching the bird.

meaning: v. give an incentive for action
translation_zh: vt. 给与动机, 刺激, 提高...的学习欲望, 促动；[经] 促动, 激发, 激励
example: 我们需要逐步motivate这个方案。

meaning: n. the psychological feature that arouses an organism to action toward a desired goal; the reason for the action; that which gives purpose and direction to behavior; n. the condition of being motivated; n. the act of motivating; providing incentive
translation_zh: n. 动机, 刺激, 推动；[医] 促动, 推动, 诱导
example: His motivation to succeed was very strong.

meaning: s. causing or able to cause motion
translation_zh: n. 动机, 目的, 主题, 基调；a. 运动的, 成为动机的
example: 这个动机为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. machine that converts other forms of energy into mechanical energy and so imparts motion; n. a nonspecific agent that imparts motion
translation_zh: n. 马达, 发动机, 原动力, 汽车；a. 马达的, 发动机的, 汽车的, 发动的；vt. 推动, 以汽车载运；vi. 乘汽车, 驾车
example: The car's motor needs to be repaired.

meaning: n. a motor vehicle with two wheels and a strong frame
translation_zh: n. 摩托车；[机] 机动车, 机踏车, 摩托车
example: 这个摩托车动 词:motorcycle为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a favorite saying of a sect or political group
translation_zh: n. 箴言, 座右铭, 警句
example: 这个座右铭为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a mounting consisting of a piece of metal (as in a ring or other jewelry) that holds a gem in place; v. attach to a support; v. fix onto a backing, setting, or support; v. put up or launch
translation_zh: n. 乘骑用马, 框, 衬纸, 山；vi. 乘马, 爬上, 增长；vt. 爬上, 使上马, 装上, 装裱, 安放, 制作...的标本, 设置, 上演；[计] 安装
example: 这个& vi. 登上为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: the summit or peak of a mountain
translation_zh: n. 山顶
example: They hiked for hours to reach the mountaintop.

meaning: v. feel sadness; v. observe the customs of mourning after the death of a loved one
translation_zh: v. 哀悼, 忧伤, 服丧
example: 我们需要逐步mourn这个方案。

meaning: n. a natural event that involves a change in the position or location of something; n. a group of people with a common ideology who try together to achieve certain general goals; n. a major self-contained part of a symphony or sonata; n. the driving and regulating parts of a mechanism (as of a watch or clock)
translation_zh: n. 运动, 动作, 运转, 移动, 倾向, 变化, 活动, 乐章；[医] 运动
example: We observed the movement of the stars.

meaning: n. water soaked soil; soft wet earth; n. slanderous remarks or charges; v. plaster with mud
translation_zh: n. 泥, 诽谤；vt. 弄脏
example: 这个泥为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. hybrid offspring of a male donkey and a female horse; usually sterile; n. a slipper that has no fitting around the heel
translation_zh: n. 骡, 倔强之人
example: The farmer used a mule to pull the cart.

meaning: n. a criminal who commits homicide (who performs the unlawful premeditated killing of another human being)
translation_zh: n. 凶手, 杀人者, 谋害者；[法] 谋杀犯, 凶手
example: 这个凶手为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. one of the contractile organs of the body; n. animal tissue consisting predominantly of contractile cells; n. authority or power or force (especially when used in a coercive way); v. make one's way by force
translation_zh: n. 肌肉, 臂力；[医] 肌
example: Regular exercise helps build strong muscles.

meaning: n. any of several cruciferous plants of the genus Brassica; n. pungent powder or paste prepared from ground mustard seeds; n. leaves eaten as cooked greens
translation_zh: n. 芥末, 芥菜, 强烈的兴趣；[医] 芥子; 芥属植物
example: 这个芥末为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: s common to or shared by two or more parties; a concerning each of two or more persons or things; especially given or done in return
translation_zh: a. 相互的, 共有的；[经] 相互的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常相互的的解释。

meaning: n. a traditional story accepted as history; serves to explain the world view of a people
translation_zh: n. 神话, 虚构的事, 虚构的人
example: 这个神话为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. horny plate covering and protecting part of the dorsal surface of the digits; n. a thin pointed piece of metal that is hammered into materials as a fastener; n. a former unit of length for cloth equal to 1/16 of a yard; v. attach something somewhere by means of nails
translation_zh: n. 钉子, 指甲；vt. 用钉钉牢, 使固定, 截住, 揭露
example: 这个钉为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: s. having no protecting or concealing cover; s. (of the eye or ear e.g.) without the aid of an optical or acoustical device or instrument; s. devoid of elaboration or diminution or concealment; bare and pure; s. lacking any cover
translation_zh: a. 裸体的, 无装饰的, 无保护的, 赤贫的；[医] 裸露的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常裸体的的解释。

meaning: n. a soft or fuzzy surface texture; n. sleeping for a short period of time (usually not in bed); v. take a siesta
translation_zh: n. 小睡, 稍睡, 细毛, 孤注一掷；vi. 小睡, 疏忽；vt. 使拉毛, 打盹度过, 预测...为获胜马
example: 这个（尤指在白天）小睡为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: v. provide commentary for a film, for example
translation_zh: v. 说故事, 说明, 叙述
example: 我们需要逐步narrate这个方案。

meaning: n. a message that tells the particulars of an act or occurrence or course of events; presented in writing or drama or cinema or as a radio or television program; s. consisting of or characterized by the telling of a story
translation_zh: n. 叙述, 故事；a. 叙述的, 叙事的, 故事体的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常记叙文的解释。

meaning: n. a narrow strait connecting two bodies of water; v. make or become more narrow or restricted; a. not wide; s. limited in size or scope
translation_zh: n. 狭窄部分, 隘路；a. 狭窄的, 仔细的, 有限的, 勉强的, 狭隘的, 手紧的；vi. 变窄；vt. 使变狭窄
example: The road was very narrow.

meaning: a. offensive or even (of persons) malicious; s. exasperatingly difficult to handle or circumvent
translation_zh: a. 污秽的, 下流的, 险恶的
example: That was a nasty comment to make.

meaning: n. an advocate of national independence of or a strong national government; s. devotion to the interests or culture of a particular nation including promoting the interests of one country over those of others
translation_zh: n. 国家主义者, 民族主义者
example: 这个民族主义者为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: r. as might be expected; r. according to nature; by natural means; without artificial help; r. through inherent nature; r. in a natural or normal manner
translation_zh: adv. 自然地, 以自然力, 天生地
example: She naturally excels at sports.

meaning: a. not far distant in time or space or degree or circumstances; s. being on the left side; s. closely resembling the genuine article; r. near in time or place or relationship
translation_zh: a. 近的, 近亲的, 近似的；adv. 接近, 亲近；prep. 靠近, 近似于；v. 接近, 走近
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常ad的解释。

meaning: n. jewelry consisting of a cord or chain (often bearing gems) worn about the neck as an ornament (especially by women)
translation_zh: n. 项链
example: 这个项链 (noun)为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a sweet liquid secretion that is attractive to pollinators; n. fruit juice especially when undiluted
translation_zh: n. 神酒, 甜美饮料, 甘露
example: Bees collect nectar from flowers to make honey.

meaning: n. a slender pointer for indicating the reading on the scale of a measuring instrument; n. a sharp pointed implement (usually steel); v. goad or provoke,as by constant criticism; v. prick with a needle
translation_zh: n. 针, 尖；vt. 用针缝；vi. 缝纫；[计] 探针
example: She threaded the needle carefully.

meaning: v. succeed in passing through, around, or over
translation_zh: vi. 商议, 谈判, 交涉；vt. 谈妥, 转让, 处理
example: 我们需要逐步negotiate这个方案。

meaning: n. a discussion intended to produce an agreement; n. the activity or business of negotiating an agreement; coming to terms
translation_zh: n. 谈判, 磋商, 交涉；[经] 谈判, 协商
example: 这个协商为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a son of your brother or sister
translation_zh: n. 侄子, 外甥
example: 这个侄子 (n.) - 弟弟的儿子为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. an uneasy psychological state; n. a sensitive or highly strung temperament
translation_zh: n. 神经, 神经元, 易激动, 紧张不安, 神经过敏, 神经质, 担忧, 害怕, 简练, 刚劲；[医] 神经过敏
example: 这个神经质为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n a strip of land projecting into a body of water
translation_zh: n. 海角
example: 这个ness（noun）为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. an interconnected system of things or people; n. (broadcasting) a communication system consisting of a group of broadcasting stations that all transmit the same programs; n. a system of intersecting lines or channels; n. (electronics) a system of interconnected electronic components or circuits
translation_zh: n. 网络, 广播网, 网状物；[计] 网络
example: 这个网状物(电视与计算机)网络为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. one who does not side with any party in a war or dispute; s. not supporting or favoring either side in a war, dispute, or contest; a. possessing no distinctive quality or characteristics; s. lacking distinguishing quality or characteristics
translation_zh: n. 中立者, 中立国, 非彩色, 空档；a. 中立的, 中性的, 无色的
example: It's important to remain neutral in an argument.

meaning: r despite anything to the contrary (usually following a concession)
translation_zh: adv. 然而, 虽然如此；conj. 然而
example: 他ad地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: s. recently born; s. having just or recently arisen or come into existence
translation_zh: n. 婴儿；a. 新生的
example: The hospital nursery was full of newborn babies.

meaning: n. any new participant in some activity; n. a recent arrival
translation_zh: n. 新来者
example: The village welcomed the newcomers with a party.

meaning: r. very recently
translation_zh: adv. 重新, 最近
example: 他新近地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: n. a familiar name for a person (often a shortened version of a person's given name); n. a descriptive name for a place or thing
translation_zh: n. 绰号, 昵称；vt. 给...取绰号, 叫错名字；[计] 绰号
example: 这个绰号为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a daughter of your brother or sister
translation_zh: n. 侄女, 甥女
example: 这个外甥女为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. the entertainment available to people seeking nighttime diversion; n. the activity of people seeking nighttime diversion (as at the theater, a nightclub, etc.)
translation_zh: n. 夜生活
example: London is famous for its vibrant nightlife.

meaning: n. a sign of assent or salutation or command; n. the act of nodding the head; v. express or signify by nodding; v. lower and raise the head, as to indicate assent or agreement or confirmation
translation_zh: n. 点头, 打盹, 晃动；vi. 点头, 打盹；vt. 点头表示, 点(头)
example: She gave a nod of approval.

meaning: r. with much noise or loud and unpleasant sound
translation_zh: adv. 吵闹地
example: 他ad地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: n. a canonical hour that is the ninth hour of the day counting from sunrise; n. a service in the Roman Catholic Church formerly read or chanted at 3 PM (the ninth hour counting from sunrise) but now somewhat earlier; s. not any; r. not at all or in no way
translation_zh: adv. 一点也不, 毫不；pron. 没有人, 无一物, 并无一个；a. 没有的
example: 这个没有的为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: r despite anything to the contrary (usually following a concession)
translation_zh: conj. 然而, 尽管, 不过；adv. 不过, 仍然, 尽管如此, 然而
example: 他ad地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: n. a message that seems to convey no meaning; s. having no intelligible meaning
translation_zh: n. 无意义的事, 荒谬言行, 荒唐
example: Don't talk nonsense; focus on the task.

meaning: conj. A negative connective or particle, introducing the second; member or clause of a negative proposition, following neither, or not,; in the first member or clause (as or in affirmative propositions; follows either). Nor is also used sometimes in the first member for; neither, and sometimes the neither is omitted and implied by the use of; nor.
translation_zh: conj. 也不, 也没有；[计] 或非
example: 这个也不为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: r. under normal conditions
translation_zh: adv. 正规地, 合规则, 正常地
example: I normally wake up at 7 AM.
