meaning: n. the compass point midway between north and east; at 45 degrees; n. the northeastern region of the United States; n. the direction corresponding to the northeastward compass point
translation_zh: n. 东北；a. 东北的, 向东北的, 来自东北的；adv. 向东北, 来自东北
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常东北的解释。

meaning: s. situated in or oriented toward the northeast; s. of a region of the United States generally including the New England states; New York; and sometimes New Jersey and Pennsylvania
translation_zh: a. 东北方的, 在东北的, 来自东北的
example: The storm is moving towards the northeastern states.

meaning: n. the northwestern region of the United States; n. the direction corresponding to the northwestward compass point; n. the compass point midway between north and west; at 315 degrees
translation_zh: n. 西北, 西北方；a. 西北的, 在西北的, 来自西北的；adv. 向西北
example: The wind is blowing from the northwest.

meaning: s. situated in or oriented toward the northwest; s. of a region of the United States generally including Washington; Oregon; Idaho; and sometimes Montana; Wyoming
translation_zh: a. 在西北部的, 西北方的, 来自西北的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常（在）西北的的解释。

meaning: a. capable or worthy of being perceived; s. readily noticed
translation_zh: a. 显而易见的, 显著的, 值得注意的
example: There was a noticeable change in his attitude.

meaning: noticeboard
translation_zh: n. 布告牌
example: 这个布告栏为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a general inclusive concept; n. an odd or fanciful or capricious idea; n. (usually plural) small personal articles or clothing or sewing items
translation_zh: n. 概念, 观念, 想法, 打算, 别致的小东西；[经] 概念, 打算, 想法
example: 这个概念为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: s known widely and usually unfavorably;
translation_zh: a. 声名狼藉的, 臭名昭著的, 众人皆知的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常臭名昭著的的解释。

meaning: n. one who writes novels
translation_zh: n. 小说家
example: She dreams of becoming a famous novelist.

meaning: n. an insignificant place; r. not anywhere; in or at or to no place
translation_zh: adv. 无处, 到处都无
example: We searched everywhere, but the keys were nowhere to be found.

meaning: a. (weapons) deriving destructive energy from the release of atomic energy; a. of or relating to or constituting the nucleus of an atom; a. of or relating to or constituting the nucleus of a cell; s. constituting or like a nucleus
translation_zh: a. 核子的, 原子能的, 核的, 中心的；[医] 核的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常核子的的解释。

meaning: n. a part of the cell containing DNA and RNA and responsible for growth and reproduction; n. the positively charged dense center of an atom; n. (astronomy) the center of the head of a comet; consists of small solid particles of ice and frozen gas that vaporizes on approaching the sun to form the coma and tail; n. any histologically identifiable mass of neural cell bodies in the brain or spinal cord
translation_zh: n. 核心, 核子, 原子核, 起点；[计] 核心程序
example: 这个原子核为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: s. amounting to a large indefinite number
translation_zh: a. 很多的, 数目众多的, 多数的；[机] 多数的, 甚多的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常很多的的解释。

meaning: n. any substance (such as a chemical element or inorganic compound) that can be taken in by a green plant and used in organic synthesis
translation_zh: a. 营养的, 滋养的；n. 营养物, 滋养物
example: 这个营养物为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. (physiology) the organic process of nourishing or being nourished; the processes by which an organism assimilates food and uses it for growth and maintenance; n. the scientific study of food and drink (especially in humans)
translation_zh: n. 营养, 营养学；[医] 营养, 营养品
example: Good nutrition is essential for a healthy lifestyle.

meaning: s of or providing nourishment
translation_zh: a. 滋养的, 营养的；[医] 有营养的
example: Eating nutritious food is essential for good health.

meaning: n. a tangible and visible entity; an entity that can cast a shadow; n. (grammar) a constituent that is acted upon; n. the focus of cognitions or feelings; n. (computing) a discrete item that provides a description of virtually anything known to a computer
translation_zh: n. 物体, 目标, 目的, 对象, 宾语, 客体；vi. 反对, 抱反感；vt. 提出...来反对；[计] 对象
example: 这个物体对象为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. the speech act of objecting; n. (law) a procedure whereby a party to a suit says that a particular line of questioning or a particular witness or a piece of evidence or other matter is improper and should not be continued and asks the court to rule on its impropriety or illegality
translation_zh: n. 异议, 反对, 不喜欢, 缺点, 缺陷, 妨碍, 拒绝之理由；[法] 异议, 反对, 抗议
example: 这个异议为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. the act of making and recording a measurement; n. the act of observing; taking a patient look; n. a remark expressing careful consideration; n. facts learned by observing
translation_zh: n. 观察, 注意, 观测, 观察力；[化] 观察
example: 这个观察为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: v. watch attentively; v. behave as expected during of holidays or rites; v. stick to correctly or closely; v. conform one's action or practice to
translation_zh: vt. 觉察到, 遵守, 注意到, 庆祝；vi. 注意, 评论
example: Scientists observe the stars.

meaning: n. something immaterial that stands in the way and must be circumvented or surmounted; n. an obstruction that stands in the way (and must be removed or surmounted or circumvented)
translation_zh: n. 障碍, 妨害物, 阻碍
example: Lack of funding was a major obstacle to the project.

meaning: v. come into possession of
translation_zh: vt. 获得, 达到；vi. 流行, 得到公认
example: 我们需要逐步obtain这个方案。

meaning: a. easily perceived by the senses or grasped by the mind
translation_zh: a. 明显的, 明白的, 显然的, 平淡无奇的
example: It was obvious that he was lying.

meaning: r. unmistakably (`plain' is often used informally for `plainly')
translation_zh: adv. 显而易见地, 明显地
example: Obviously, you need to study more for the exam.

meaning: n. reason; n. the time of a particular event; n. an opportunity to do something; v. give occasion to
translation_zh: n. 场合, 时机, 机会, 诱因, 理由；vt. 惹起, 引起
example: It was a special occasion for the family.

meaning: s. occurring from time to time
translation_zh: a. 偶然的, 临时的；[法] 偶然的, 特殊场合的
example: We enjoy an occasional walk in the park.

meaning: r. now and then or here and there
translation_zh: adv. 有时候, 偶而
example: 他偶尔地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: v. live (in a certain place); v. occupy the whole of
translation_zh: vt. 占领, 占(时间、空间等), 住进, 担任, 使从事, 使全神贯注；[法] 占领, 占据, 占有
example: 我们需要逐步occupy这个方案。

meaning: v. come to one's mind; suggest itself; v. to be found to exist
translation_zh: vi. 发生, 被想到, 存在
example: 我们需要逐步occur这个方案。

meaning: s. violating or tending to violate or offend against; a. for the purpose of attack rather than defense; a. causing anger or annoyance; a. unpleasant or disgusting especially to the senses
translation_zh: a. 令人不快的, 侮辱的, 攻击性的；[法] 攻击的, 进攻的, 冒犯的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常无礼的的解释。

meaning: r. in an official role
translation_zh: adv. 作为公务员, 职务上, 官方地
example: 他官方地地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: s. coated or covered with oil
translation_zh: a. 油的, 油滑的, 油嘴的；[化] 油的; 含油的; 油性的; 油质的; 多油的; 油腻的; 油滑的
example: The fried food left an oily residue on the plate.

meaning: pron. A reflexive form of the indefinite pronoun one.; Commonly writen as two words, one's self.
translation_zh: pron. 自己, 亲自
example: 这个自己为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: a. situated or taking place on the area of a stage visible to the audience; r. on the stage
translation_zh: adv. 在前台；a. 在前台的
example: The actor walked onstage to thunderous applause.

meaning: n. an open or empty space in or between things; n. a ceremony accompanying the start of some enterprise; n. becoming open or being made open; n. the first performance (as of a theatrical production)
translation_zh: n. 开始, 口子, 穴, 揭幕；a. 开始的
example: There's an opening for a new position at work.

meaning: n. the state of being in effect or being operative; n. a business especially one run on a large scale; n. a planned activity involving many people performing various actions; n. (computer science) data processing in which the result is completely specified by a rule (especially the processing that results from a single instruction)
translation_zh: n. 操作, 动作, 手术, 运算, 作用, 业务；[计] 运算
example: 这个操作为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. the relation between opposed entities; n. a contestant that you are matched against; n. a body of people united in opposing something; n. a direction opposite to another
translation_zh: n. 反对, 敌对, 相反, 在野党；[医] 对生, 对向, 反抗, 反对症
example: 这个反对为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: v. come down on or keep down by unjust use of one's authority
translation_zh: vt. 压迫, 压抑, 使烦恼
example: 我们需要逐步oppress这个方案。

meaning: n. the act of subjugating by cruelty; n. the state of being kept down by unjust use of force or authority: "after years of oppression they finally revolted"; n. a feeling of being oppressed
translation_zh: n. 压抑, 沉闷, 压迫手段；[医] 压迫, 压抑
example: 这个压迫为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. the right to buy or sell property at an agreed price; the right is purchased and if it is not exercised by a stated date the money is forfeited; n. one of a number of things from which only one can be chosen
translation_zh: n. 选择权, 挑选, 选项；[计] 选项
example: We have several options for dinner tonight.

meaning: n. the (usually elliptical) path described by one celestial body in its revolution about another; n. the path of an electron around the nucleus of an atom
translation_zh: n. 轨道, 常轨, 眼眶；vt. 绕...轨道而行；vi. 进入轨道, 盘旋
example: 这个轨道为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a musical organization consisting of a group of instrumentalists including string players; n. seating on the main floor in a theater
translation_zh: n. 管弦乐队, 乐队演奏处
example: The orchestra played a beautiful symphony.

meaning: n. a soldier who serves as an attendant to a superior officer; n. a male hospital attendant who has general duties that do not involve the medical treatment of patients; a. devoid of violence or disruption
translation_zh: a. 有秩序的, 整齐的, 值班的；n. 护理员, 清道夫, 传令兵, 勤务兵；adv. 依次地, 顺序地
example: Her desk was always very orderly.

meaning: n. a judge of a probate court; n. the expected or commonplace condition or situation; n. a clergyman appointed to prepare condemned prisoners for death; n. an early bicycle with a very large front wheel and small back wheel
translation_zh: a. 平常的, 普通的, 平凡的；n. 平常的人(或事)
example: It was just an ordinary day.

meaning: n. a fully differentiated structural and functional unit in an animal that is specialized for some particular function; n. a government agency or instrument devoted to the performance of some specific function; n. a periodical that is published by a special interest group; n. wind instrument whose sound is produced by means of pipes arranged in sets supplied with air from a bellows and controlled from a large complex musical keyboard
translation_zh: n. 风琴, 器官, 元件, 机构, 机关；[电] 风琴
example: The heart is a vital organ.

meaning: n. a fertilizer that is derived from animal or vegetable matter; a. relating or belonging to the class of chemical compounds having a carbon basis; a. being or relating to or derived from or having properties characteristic of living organisms; a. involving or affecting physiology or bodily organs
translation_zh: a. 器官的, 有机的, 组织的, 根本的；[医] 器官的, 有生命的, 有机的, 器质的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常器官的的解释。

meaning: n. a living thing that has (or can develop) the ability to act or function independently; n. a system considered analogous in structure or function to a living body
translation_zh: n. 生物, 有机体, 社会组织；[医] 生物[体],[有]机体
example: 这个生物为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. properties attributable to your ancestry; n. an event that is a beginning; a first part or stage of subsequent events; n. the point of intersection of coordinate axes; where the values of the coordinates are all zero; n. the source of something's existence or from which it derives or is derived
translation_zh: n. 起源, 起因, 出身, 开端；[计] 原点; 起始地址; 信件来源的相关数据
example: What is the origin of this tradition?

meaning: s. other than as supposed or expected; r. in other respects or ways
translation_zh: adv. 否则, 不同地, 别的方式
example: You should study hard; otherwise, you might fail the exam.

meaning: a. located, suited for, or taking place in the open air; a. pertaining to or concerning the outdoors or outdoor activities
translation_zh: a. 户外的, 屋外的, 露天的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常户外的的解释。

meaning: n. where the air is unconfined
translation_zh: n. 户外, 野外活动；adv. 在户外, 在野外
example: 他在户外地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: a. being on the outside or further from a center; s. located outside; s. being on or toward the outside of the body
translation_zh: a. 外部的, 外面的, 在外的, 远离中心的；[机] 外部的, 外面的, 外侧的
example: The outer layer of the onion was dry.

meaning: v. declare illegal; outlaw
translation_zh: n. 被剥夺法律保护的人, 罪犯；vt. 使...失去法律保护, 将...逐出社会, 宣告非法, 取缔
example: 这个歹徒为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: s. distinguished from others in excellence; s. having a quality that thrusts itself into attention; s. owed as a debt
translation_zh: a. 杰出的, 突出的, 未偿付的, 未决定的；[经] 未解决的, 未偿付
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常突出的的解释。

meaning: a. relating to physical reality rather than with thoughts or the mind; r. toward the outside
translation_zh: a. 向外的, 表面的, 外服的；adv. 向外, 在外, 表面
example: Her outward appearance was calm, but inside she was nervous.

meaning: v. be heavier than
translation_zh: vt. 比...重, 比...重要, 比...有价值
example: 我们需要逐步outweigh这个方案。

meaning: v. get on top of; deal with successfully
translation_zh: vt. 战胜, 克服, 胜过；vi. 得胜
example: 我们需要逐步overcome这个方案。

meaning: s. extremely joyful
translation_zh: a. 狂喜的, 非常高兴的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常万分高兴的的解释。

meaning: r. during or for the length of one night; r. happening in a short time or with great speed
translation_zh: n. 前一天晚上, 一夜的逗留；a. 通宵的, 晚上的, 前夜的；adv. 在前一夜, 整夜, 昨晚一晚上
example: The package arrived overnight.

meaning: v. overcome, as with emotions or perceptual stimuli; v. charge someone with too many tasks
translation_zh: vt. 淹没, 受打击, 制服, 压倒, 使不知所措；[法] 打翻, 倾覆, 覆盖
example: 我们需要逐步overwhelm这个方案。

meaning: v overcome, as with emotions or perceptual stimuli; v charge someone with too many tasks; v cover completely or make imperceptible; v overcome by superior force; s so strong as to be irresistible; s very intense
translation_zh: a. 压倒性的, 无法抵抗的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常压倒性的的解释。

meaning: n. the act of working too much or too long; v. use too much; v. work excessively hard
translation_zh: n. 过度操劳的工作, 额外工作；v. (使)工作过度, 使过分劳累
example: He tends to overwork himself before deadlines.

meaning: v. be obliged to pay or repay; v. be indebted to, in an abstract or intellectual sense; v. be in debt
translation_zh: vt. 亏欠, 负...债, 归功于, 怀有, 应给予, 感恩；vi. 欠钱
example: I owe you five dollars for the coffee.

meaning: v be obliged to pay or repay; v be indebted to, in an abstract or intellectual sense; v be in debt; s owed as a debt
translation_zh: a. 未付的, 亏欠的, 受惠的, 归因于...的；[经] 应付的, 欠着的, 未付的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常欠着的的解释。

meaning: n. a nonmetallic bivalent element that is normally a colorless odorless tasteless nonflammable diatomic gas; constitutes 21 percent of the atmosphere by volume; the most abundant element in the earth's crust
translation_zh: n. 氧；[化] 氧O-2
example: Humans need oxygen to breathe.

meaning: n. the rate of moving (especially walking or running); n. the relative speed of progress or change; n. a step in walking or running; v. walk with slow or fast paces
translation_zh: n. 速度, 步调, 步法；vi. 踱步, 缓慢走；vt. 用步测, 踱步于
example: He walked at a slow pace.

meaning: n. a collection of things wrapped or boxed together; n. a wrapped container
translation_zh: n. 包裹, 套装软件, 包, 包装用物, 程序包；vt. 包装, 打包；a. 一揽子的；[计] 包, 软件包, 包装
example: 这个把…包成一包包装为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. the enclosure of something in a package or box; n. carrying something in a pack on the back
translation_zh: n. 包装, 填垫材料, 封函, 行李；[化] 填充物; 填料; 填充; 装柱; 装色谱柱; 垫革; 紧束; 敛集; 堆积
example: 这个包装为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. small wooden bat with a flat surface; used for hitting balls in various games; n. a blade of a paddle wheel or water wheel; n. an instrument of punishment consisting of a flat board; n. a short light oar used without an oarlock to propel a canoe or small boat
translation_zh: n. 桨, 划桨, 明轮翼；vi. 划桨, 戏水, 涉水；vt. 用桨划, 划船运送, 搅, 拌
example: We used a paddle to move the canoe.

meaning: a. marked by the reception of pay
translation_zh: a. 受雇的, 付清的；pay的过去式和过去分词
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常有报酬的的解释。

meaning: a. causing physical or psychological pain
translation_zh: a. 痛苦的, 困难的, 令人烦恼的；[医] 疼痛的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常痛苦的的解释。

meaning: v. turn pale, as if in fear; s. very light colored; highly diluted with white; s. (of light) lacking in intensity or brightness; dim or feeble; s. lacking in vitality or interest or effectiveness
translation_zh: n. 栅栏, 界线, 范围；a. 苍白的, 暗淡的, 无力的；vi. 变苍白, 变暗, 失色；vt. 使变苍白, 使失色, 用栅栏围
example: She looked pale after the long flight.

meaning: n. the inner surface of the hand from the wrist to the base of the fingers; n. a linear unit based on the length or width of the human hand; n. any plant of the family Palmae having an unbranched trunk crowned by large pinnate or palmate leaves
translation_zh: n. 手掌, 棕榈, 胜利；vt. 与...握手, 藏...于掌中
example: 这个手掌为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. rescue equipment consisting of a device that fills with air and retards your fall
translation_zh: n. 降落伞；vi. 跳伞
example: He packed his parachute carefully before the jump.

meaning: n. (Christianity) the abode of righteous souls after death
translation_zh: n. 天堂, 乐园, 伊甸园
example: 这个天堂为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. the allotment of some amount by dividing something; v. divide into parts; v. cover with strips of canvas; v. make into a wrapped container
translation_zh: n. 包裹, 部分, 片；vt. 分配, 打包；a. 部分的；adv. 局部地
example: 这个包袱为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: a. designating the generation of organisms from which hybrid offspring are produced; a. relating to or characteristic of or befitting a parent
translation_zh: a. 父母亲的, 做双亲的, 作为渊源的；[医] 父母的, 双亲的
example: Children need parental guidance as they grow up.

meaning: n. space in which vehicles can be parked; n. the act of maneuvering a vehicle into a location where it can be left temporarily
translation_zh: n. 停车；a. 停车的
example: 这个停车 adj. 停车的 v. 停车（park的ing形式） n. (Parking)人名为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. usually brightly colored zygodactyl tropical birds with short hooked beaks and the ability to mimic sounds; n. a copycat who does not understand the words or acts being imitated; v. repeat mindlessly
translation_zh: n. 鹦鹉, 应声虫；vt. 学舌, 机械地模仿
example: 这个鹦鹉为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: s. being or affecting only a part; not total; a. showing favoritism
translation_zh: a. 部分的, 偏袒的, 偏爱的；n. 分音
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常部分的的解释。

meaning: n. someone who takes part in an activity
translation_zh: n. 参加者, 参与者；a. 有份的, 参加的, 参与的
example: Each participant received a certificate.

meaning: v. share in something
translation_zh: vi. 参加, 分享, 参与, 带有；vt. 分享, 分担
example: Everyone should participate in the discussion.

meaning: n. a non-finite form of the verb; in English it is used adjectivally and to form compound tenses
translation_zh: n. 分词
example: 这个分词为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: r. to a distinctly greater extent or degree than is common; r. specifically or especially distinguished from others
translation_zh: adv. 特别, 格外, 尤其, 详细地, 细致地
example: 他特别地地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: n. a strong feeling or emotion; n. a feeling of strong sexual desire; n. the suffering of Jesus at the Crucifixion
translation_zh: n. 激情, 酷爱, 热爱, 强烈感情, 耶稣受难(故事)
example: She has a great passion for music.

meaning: a. lacking in energy or will; s. peacefully resistant in response to injustice; a. expressing that the subject of the sentence is the patient of the action denoted by the verb
translation_zh: a. 消极的, 被动的, 冷漠的, 顺从的, 无源的；[医] 被动的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常被动的的解释。

meaning: n. a document issued by a country to a citizen allowing that person to travel abroad and re-enter the home country
translation_zh: n. 护照, 手段, 通行证；[法] 通行证, 护照
example: 这个护照为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a secret word or phrase known only to a restricted group
translation_zh: n. 密码, 口令, 通行手段；[计] 口令
example: You need to enter your password to log in.

meaning: n. good-natured tolerance of delay or incompetence
translation_zh: n. 耐性, 忍耐
example: 这个耐性为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a person who requires medical care; a. enduring trying circumstances with even temper or characterized by such endurance
translation_zh: n. 病人, 承受者；a. 忍耐的, 容忍的, 有耐性的, 坚忍的
example: The doctor visited the patient in the hospital.

meaning: n. a detachment used for security or reconnaissance; n. the activity of going around or through an area at regular intervals for security purposes; n. a group that goes through a region at regular intervals for the purpose of security; v. maintain the security of by carrying out a patrol
translation_zh: n. 巡逻, 巡逻员, 侦察队；v. 巡逻, 巡视
example: 这个巡逻为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a time interval during which there is a temporary cessation of something; n. temporary inactivity; v. cease an action temporarily
translation_zh: n. 暂停, 中止, 停顿, 间歇, 踌躇, 休止符；vi. 暂停, 中止, 停顿, 踌躇；[计] DOS内部命令:暂时停止批处理文件的执行
example: 这个暂时的停顿为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. underground pod of the peanut vine; n. widely cultivated American plant cultivated in tropical and warm regions; showy yellow flowers on stalks that bend over to the soil so that seed pods ripen underground; n. a young child who is small for his age; n. pod of the peanut vine containing usually 2 nuts or seeds; `groundnut' and `monkey nut' are British terms
translation_zh: n. 花生, 小人物, 极小的数额；a. 渺小的, 微不足道的
example: 这个花生为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: s. markedly different from the usual; s. characteristic of one only; distinctive or special
translation_zh: a. 奇特的, 罕见的, 特殊的, 特别的；n. 特有财产, 特权
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常奇怪的的解释。

meaning: s not having enough money to pay for necessities
translation_zh: a. 赤贫的, 贫穷的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常penniless（adjective）的解释。

meaning: n. a fractional monetary unit of Ireland and the United Kingdom; equal to one hundredth of a pound; n. a coin worth one-hundredth of the value of the basic unit
translation_zh: n. 便士, 一分, 小钱, 点滴；[经] 便士
example: 这个便士为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: prep. Through; by means of; through the agency of; by; for; for; each; as, per annum; per capita, by heads, or according to individuals;; per curiam, by the court; per se, by itself, of itself. Per is also; sometimes used with English words.
translation_zh: prep. 每一, 通过, 经, 按照；[经] 每, 按照
example: 这个〈拉〉(表示关涉)通过为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. an entertainer who performs a dramatic or musical work for an audience
translation_zh: n. 表演者, 执行者, 完成者；[法] 执行者, 履行者, 实行者
example: The performer sang beautifully on stage.

meaning: a. continuing or enduring without marked change in status or condition or place; s. not capable of being reversed or returned to the original condition
translation_zh: a. 永久的, 不变的, 固定的, 持久的；n. 烫发；[计] 永久的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常永久的的解释。

meaning: r. for a long time without essential change
translation_zh: adv. 永久, 不变, 持久；[计] 永久性的
example: 他ad地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: n. large game fish; found in waters of the West Indies; v. consent to, give permission
translation_zh: n. 许可证, 许可, 执照, 通行证；vt. 允许, 容许, 可能, 使放手做；vi. 容许, 给以机会, 提供可能
example: You need a permit to build a new house.

meaning: r. as yourself; r. as a person; r. in a personal way; r. in the flesh; without involving anyone else
translation_zh: adv. 亲自地, 个别地, 当面, 就本人而言, 针对个人地
example: Personally, I think it's a great idea.

meaning: v. cause somebody to adopt a certain position, belief, or course of action; twist somebody's arm
translation_zh: vt. 劝, 使相信, 恳求, 敦促, 说服；vi. 劝服, 被说服
example: I tried to persuade her to come with us.

meaning: a. intended or having the power to induce action or belief
translation_zh: a. 有说服力的, 劝诱的, 劝导性的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常有说服力的的解释。

meaning: s. something apparently sensed but having no physical reality
translation_zh: n. 幻影, 虚位, 幽灵, 化身, 令人恐惧的事物, 骇人的想法；a. 幻觉的, 幻影的, 幽灵的, 虚无飘渺的, 捉摸不定的, 有名无实的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常幻影的解释。

meaning: n. the art and science of preparing and dispensing drugs and medicines,
translation_zh: n. 药房, 配药学, 制药业；[医] 药学, 药剂学, 调剂学, 药房
example: 这个药房为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. any state or process known through the senses rather than by intuition or reasoning; n. a remarkable development
translation_zh: n. 现象, 迹象, 表现, 奇迹, 奇才；[化] 现象
example: 这个现象为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a specialist in philosophy; n. a wise person who is calm and rational; someone who lives a life of reason with equanimity
translation_zh: n. 哲学家, 哲人, 思想开创人, 达观的人；[法] 哲学家, 哲学研究者
example: 这个哲学家为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. the rational investigation of questions about existence and knowledge and ethics; n. any personal belief about how to live or how to deal with a situation
translation_zh: n. 哲学, 人生观, 哲学思想, 哲理, 基本原理, 见解, 达观, 沉着
example: 这个哲学为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. the state capital and largest city located in south central Arizona; situated in a former desert that has become a prosperous agricultural area thanks to irrigation; n. a large monocotyledonous genus of pinnate-leaved palms found in Asia and Africa; n. a legendary Arabian bird said to periodically burn itself to death and emerge from the ashes as a new phoenix; according to most versions only one phoenix lived at a time and it renewed itself every 500 years
translation_zh: n. 凤凰, 不死鸟, 死而复生的人, 完人, 殊品
example: 这个凤凰为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a photographic copy of written or printed or graphic work; v. reproduce by xerography
translation_zh: n. 影印, 复印件；v. 影印
example: 这个影印本为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. an expression consisting of one or more words forming a grammatical constituent of a sentence; n. a short musical passage; n. dance movements that are linked in a single choreographic sequence; v. divide, combine, or mark into phrases
translation_zh: n. 惯用语, 词组, 成语, 措词, 乐句；vt. 用短语表达, 把(乐曲)分成短句；[计] 短语
example: Can you explain the meaning of that phrase?

meaning: n. the science of matter and energy and their interactions; n. the physical properties, phenomena, and laws of something
translation_zh: n. 物理学, 物理过程, 物理现象；[化] 物理; 物理学
example: She is studying physics at university.

meaning: n. dish baked in pastry-lined pan often with a pastry top
translation_zh: n. 馅饼, 财富, 总额, 贪污受贿, 杂乱, 喜鹊；[计] 饼图
example: 这个馅饼为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. righteousness by virtue of being pious
translation_zh: n. 虔诚, 孝敬, 虔诚的行为
example: 这个虔诚为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a cushion to support the head of a sleeping person; v. rest on or as if on a pillow
translation_zh: n. 枕头, 靠垫, 枕状岩；vt. 作...的枕头, 垫, 枕于；vi. 靠在枕上
example: 这个枕头 vt. 垫为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a tropical American plant bearing a large fleshy edible fruit with a terminal tuft of stiff leaves; widely cultivated in the tropics; n. large sweet fleshy tropical fruit with a terminal tuft of stiff leaves; widely cultivated
translation_zh: n. 凤梨, 菠萝, 失业救济金；[医] 凤梨, 波萝
example: 这个[园艺] 菠萝为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a tube with a small bowl at one end; used for smoking tobacco; n. a long tube made of metal or plastic that is used to carry water or oil or gas etc.; n. a hollow cylindrical shape; n. a tubular wind instrument
translation_zh: n. 管, 导管, 输送管, 管状器官, 声带, 尖细的声音, 烟斗, 笛, 管乐器；vt. 以管输送, 吹哨子, 吹奏, 尖声唱；vi. 吹笛, 尖叫, 吹长哨发令；[计] 管道
example: 这个管子为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a sizeable hole (usually in the ground); n. a concavity in a surface (especially an anatomical depression); n. an enclosure in which animals are made to fight; n. (commodity exchange) the part of the floor of a commodity exchange where trading in a particular commodity is carried on
translation_zh: n. 深坑, 矿井, 果核, 地窖, 深渊, 绝境, 陷阱；vt. 窖藏, 使凹下, 使有麻点, 去...之核, 使留疤痕, 使相斗, 使竞争；vi. 起凹点, 凹陷
example: They dug a deep pit to plant the new tree.

meaning: n. extensive tract of level open land; a. not elaborate or elaborated; simple; a. lacking patterns especially in color; s. not mixed with extraneous elements
translation_zh: n. 平原, 草原, 朴实无华的东西, 无格式；a. 简单的, 明白的, 平常的, 不好看的, 朴素的, 清晰的, 普通的, 平坦的, 十足的；adv. 清楚地, 显然地；[计] 无格式
example: She prefers plain clothes without any patterns.

meaning: n. a raised horizontal surface; n. a document stating the aims and principles of a political party; n. the combination of a particular computer and a particular operating system; n. any military structure or vehicle bearing weapons
translation_zh: n. 站台, 月台, 讲台, 论坛, 平台；[计] 平台
example: The train is arriving on platform 3.

meaning: r. in a cheerful manner; r. in an enjoyable manner
translation_zh: adv. 和蔼地, 亲切地；友好地；愉快地
example: The weather was pleasantly warm.

meaning: n. blockage consisting of an object designed to fill a hole tightly; n. an electrical device with two or three pins that is inserted in a socket to make an electrical connection; v. fill or close tightly with or as if with a plug; v. persist in working hard
translation_zh: n. 塞子, 栓, 插头；vt. 插入, 塞住, 接插头；vi. 被塞住
example: He pulled the plug out of the wall.

meaning: a. on the positive side or higher end of a scale; s. involving advantage or good
translation_zh: prep. 加上, 加, 外加；a. 正的, 附加的；n. 正号, 加号, 附加额, 正数, 增益；[计] 正差
example: 这个加为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a writer of poems (the term is usually reserved for writers of good poetry)
translation_zh: n. 诗人
example: William Shakespeare is a famous English poet.

meaning: n. literature in metrical form; n. any communication resembling poetry in beauty or the evocation of feeling
translation_zh: n. 诗, 韵文, 诗歌艺术
example: She enjoys reading modern poetry.

meaning: n. any substance that causes injury or illness or death of a living organism; n. anything that harms or destroys; v. spoil as if by poison; v. kill with poison
translation_zh: n. 毒药, 毒, 毒物, 有毒害的事物；vt. 毒害, 毒杀, 使中毒；vi. 放毒, 下毒
example: Be careful, that plant contains poison.

meaning: s. having the qualities or effects of a poison; s. not safe to eat; s. marked by deep ill will; deliberately harmful
translation_zh: a. 有毒的, 恶毒的, 讨厌的；[医] 有毒的
example: Some mushrooms are poisonous and should not be eaten.

meaning: n. a long (usually round) rod of wood or metal or plastic; n. a native or inhabitant of Poland; n. one of two divergent or mutually exclusive opinions; n. one of two points of intersection of the Earth's axis and the celestial sphere
translation_zh: n. 波兰人, 极点, 磁极, 电极, 杆, 竿, 相反的极端；vt. 用竿支撑；vi. 撑篙
example: The flag was flying from the top of the pole.

meaning: n. a plan of action adopted by an individual or social group; n. a line of argument rationalizing the course of action of a government; n. written contract or certificate of insurance
translation_zh: n. 政策, 方针, 策略, 保险单；[医] 凭单, 保险单
example: The company has a strict no-smoking policy.

meaning: r. in a polite manner
translation_zh: adv. 有礼貌地, 文雅地, 客气地
example: 他ad地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: n. a leader engaged in civil administration; n. a person active in party politics; n. a schemer who tries to gain advantage in an organization in sly or underhanded ways
translation_zh: n. 政客, 政治家, 从事党派政治的人；[法] 政客, 政治家
example: The politician gave a speech about the economy.

meaning: n. social relations involving intrigue to gain authority or power; n. the study of government of states and other political units; n. the profession devoted to governing and to political affairs; n. the opinion you hold with respect to political questions
translation_zh: n. 政治, 政治学, 政见, 政治活动；[法] 政治, 政治学, 政纲
example: 这个政治活动政治学政论为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. waste matter that contaminates the water or air or soil
translation_zh: n. 污染物质；[法] 污染物
example: 这个污染物为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a small lake
translation_zh: n. 池塘；v. 筑成池塘
example: 这个池塘为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. corn having small ears and kernels that burst when exposed to dry heat; n. small kernels of corn exploded by heat
translation_zh: n. 爆米花
example: 这个爆米花为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. meat from a domestic hog or pig
translation_zh: n. 猪肉；[医] 猪肉
example: 这个猪肉 vt. 与女子性交 n. (Pork)人名为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a place (seaport or airport) where people and merchandise can enter or leave a country; n. sweet dark-red dessert wine originally from Portugal; n. an opening (in a wall or ship or armored vehicle) for firing through; v. put or turn on the left side, of a ship
translation_zh: n. 港口, 埠, 舱门, 避风港, 左舷, 炮眼, 姿势, 意义；vt. 左转舵, 持(枪)；vi. 左转舵；[计] 端口, 移植
example: The ship arrived at the port.

meaning: n. the primary form of an adjective or adverb; denotes a quality without qualification, comparison, or relation to increase or diminution; n. a film showing a photographic image whose tones correspond to those of the original subject; a. characterized by or displaying affirmation or acceptance or certainty etc.; a. indicating existence or presence of a suspected condition or pathogen
translation_zh: a. 肯定的, 积极的, 有把握的；[医] 正的, 阳性的
example: We received positive feedback on our project.

meaning: r. extremely; r. so as to be positive; in a positive manner
translation_zh: adv. 明确地, 肯定地, 无疑地, (非正式)确实地, 真正地
example: 他肯定地地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: v. have as an attribute, knowledge, or skill; v. enter into and control, as of emotions or ideas
translation_zh: vt. 持有, 占有, 拥有, 克制, 支配, 迷住；[法] 持有, 占有, 具有
example: He possesses great skill in playing the piano.

meaning: n. the act of having and controlling property; n. anything owned or possessed; n. being controlled by passion or the supernatural; n. a territory that is controlled by a ruling state
translation_zh: n. 拥有, 占有, 所有, 财产, 领土, 领地, 自制, 着迷；[经] 占有, 持有
example: He took possession of the new house.

meaning: a. serving to express or indicate possession; s. desirous of owning; s. having or showing a desire to control or dominate
translation_zh: n. 所有格；a. 所有的, 占有的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常possessive（adjective）的解释。

meaning: n. a future prospect or potential; n. capability of existing or happening or being true; n. a possible alternative
translation_zh: n. 可能性, 可能的事；[法] 可能性, 可能发生的事, 不确定权
example: There's a possibility of rain later today.

meaning: n. a card for sending messages by post without an envelope
translation_zh: n. 明信片
example: 这个明信片 (n.) - 邮寄卡片为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n a man who delivers the mail
translation_zh: n. 邮递员；[法] 邮递员, 理财法庭的高级律师
example: 这个邮递员 (noun)为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. metal or earthenware cooking vessel that is usually round and deep; often has a handle and lid; n. the quantity contained in a pot; n. a container in which plants are cultivated; n. the cumulative amount involved in a game (such as poker)
translation_zh: n. 盆, 罐, 壶, 坩埚, 奖杯；vt. 装入盆中, 在锅中煮, 随手射击；vi. 随手射击
example: 这个罐为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. ceramic ware made from clay and baked in a kiln; n. the craft of making earthenware; n. a workshop where clayware is made
translation_zh: n. 陶器, 陶器厂；[化] 陶器
example: She enjoys making pottery in her free time.

meaning: n. the state of having little or no money and few or no material possessions
translation_zh: n. 贫穷, 贫困, 缺乏；[医] 贫乏, 缺乏
example: 这个贫穷为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a solid substance in the form of tiny loose particles; a solid that has been pulverized; n. any of various cosmetic or medical preparations dispensed in the form of a pulverized powder; v. apply powder to
translation_zh: n. 粉, 粉末, 火药；vt. 搽粉于, 搽粉, 撒粉, 使成粉末；vi. 搽粉, 变成粉末
example: 这个粉末为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: a. concerned with actual use or practice; s. having or put to a practical purpose or use
translation_zh: a. 实际的, 现实的, 实用性的；[法] 事实上的, 实际上的, 接近...的
example: It's a practical solution to the problem.

meaning: n. an expression of approval and commendation; n. offering words of homage as an act of worship; v. express approval of
translation_zh: n. 赞美, 称赞, 崇拜；vt. 称赞, 赞美；vi. 赞扬, 表扬
example: The teacher gave him praise for his hard work.

meaning: n. the act of communicating with a deity (especially as a petition or in adoration or contrition or thanksgiving); n. reverent petition to a deity; n. a fixed text used in praying; n. someone who prays to God
translation_zh: n. 祈祷, 恳求, 祷辞, 祈祷者
example: She said a silent prayer before bed.

meaning: s. of high worth or cost; r. extremely
translation_zh: a. 宝贵的, 珍贵的, 过于精致的, 珍爱的
example: Time is a precious commodity.

meaning: n. a strong liking; n. the right or chance to choose; n. grant of favor or advantage to one over another (especially to a country or countries in matters of international trade, such as levying duties)
translation_zh: n. 偏爱, 优先, 喜爱物；[计] 首选项
example: Do you have a preference for tea or coffee?

meaning: n. an affix that is added in front of the word; v. attach a prefix to
translation_zh: 前缀, 称谓；[计] 地区号码, 前缀
example: 这个前缀为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: a. carrying developing offspring within the body or being about to produce new life
translation_zh: a. 怀孕的, 充满的, 思想丰富的, 成果丰硕的；[医] 妊娠的, 有孕的
example: She announced that she was pregnant with her first child.

meaning: v. disadvantage by prejudice; v. influence (somebody's) opinion in advance
translation_zh: n. 偏见, 成见, 侵害；vt. 使存偏见, 使有成见, 侵害
example: 这个成见为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. the activity of putting or setting in order in advance of some act or purpose; n. (music) a note that produces a dissonant chord is first heard in a consonant chord
translation_zh: n. 准备, 预备, 预习；[化] 制剂
example: The team is in full preparation for the big game.

meaning: a. made ready or fit or suitable beforehand; s. equipped or prepared with necessary intellectual resources
translation_zh: a. 准备好的, 特制的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常事先准备好的的解释。

meaning: n. a function word that combines with a noun or pronoun or noun phrase to form a prepositional phrase that can have an adverbial or adjectival relation to some other word; n. (linguistics) the placing of one linguistic element before another (as placing a modifier before the word it modifies in a sentence or placing an affix before the base to which it is attached)
translation_zh: n. 前置词, 介词
example: 这个介词 (n.) - 语法词类为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. an educational institution for children too young for elementary school
translation_zh: a. 就学前的；n. 育幼院, 幼稚园
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常未满学龄的的解释。

meaning: n. directions prescribed beforehand; the action of prescribing authoritative rules or directions; n. written instructions for an optician on the lenses for a given person; n. written instructions from a physician or dentist to a druggist concerning the form and dosage of a drug to be issued to a given patient; a. available only with a doctor's written prescription
translation_zh: n. 处方, 命令, 指定；[医] 处方, 药方
example: 这个处方为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. the state of being present; current existence; n. the immediate proximity of someone or something; n. an invisible spiritual being felt to be nearby; n. the impression that something is present
translation_zh: n. 出席, 面前, 存在, 仪态, 风度；[电] 出现
example: 这个出席为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. the activity of formally presenting something (as a prize or reward); n. a show or display; the act of presenting something to sight or view; n. the act of making something publicly available; presenting news or other information by broadcasting or printing it; n. the act of presenting a proposal
translation_zh: n. 赠与, 描述, 介绍；[计] 简报
example: She gave a great presentation on her research.

meaning: n. the activity of protecting something from loss or danger; n. the condition of being (well or ill) preserved; n. a process that saves organic substances from decay
translation_zh: n. 保存, 保藏, 保护；[医] 保藏, 保存, 防腐
example: 这个保存为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a domain that seems to be specially reserved for someone; n. a reservation where animals are protected; v. prevent (food) from rotting; v. keep undisturbed for personal or private use for hunting, shooting, or fishing
translation_zh: vt. 保护, 保持, 保存, 维持, 腌, 禁猎；vi. 加工食品, 禁猎；n. 加工成的食品, 禁猎地, 保护区, 防护物
example: 我们需要逐步preserve这个方案。

meaning: n. an executive officer of a firm or corporation; n. the chief executive of a republic; n. the officer who presides at the meetings of an organization; n. the head administrative officer of a college or university
translation_zh: n. 总统, 总裁, 董事长, (学院)院长, (大学)校长, 主管人, 主持人；[经] 总经理, 董事长, 总裁
example: The president gave a speech.

meaning: n. the print media responsible for gathering and publishing news in the form of newspapers or magazines; n. a machine used for printing; n. clamp to prevent wooden rackets from warping when not in use; n. any machine that exerts pressure to form or shape or cut materials or extract liquids or compress solids
translation_zh: n. 压, 揿, 按, 人群, 印刷机, 压力, 出版社, 记者, 报刊, 新闻舆论, 紧迫；vt. 压, 压榨, 紧抱, 逼迫, 推进, 强迫征募, 催逼；vi. 压, 重压, 催促, 拥挤, 奋力前进, 受压
example: The event attracted a lot of attention from the press.

meaning: s. just preceding something else in time or order; s. too soon or too hasty
translation_zh: a. 早先的, 前面的, 过急的；[法] 以前的, 生前的, 前述的
example: We discussed this in the previous meeting.

meaning: n. a clergyman in Christian churches who has the authority to perform or administer various religious rites; one of the Holy Orders; n. a person who performs religious duties and ceremonies in a non-Christian religion
translation_zh: n. 祭司, 牧师, 神父, 神质人员, 僧侣, 泰斗
example: The priest gave a sermon during the service.

meaning: r. of primary import
translation_zh: adv. 主要地, 首先地
example: 他首先地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: n. a person who belongs to an early stage of civilization; n. a mathematical expression from which another expression is derived; n. a word serving as the basis for inflected or derived forms; s. used of preliterate or tribal or nonindustrial societies
translation_zh: n. 原始人, 早期艺术家；a. 原始的, 上古的；[计] 图元; 原语; 基元
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常原始的的解释。

meaning: n. a basic generalization that is accepted as true and that can be used as a basis for reasoning or conduct; n. a rule or standard especially of good behavior; n. a basic truth or law or assumption; n. a rule or law concerning a natural phenomenon or the function of a complex system
translation_zh: n. 原则, 原理, 主义；[化] 原理
example: 这个原理为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a correctional institution where persons are confined while on trial or for punishment; n. a prisonlike situation; a place of seeming confinement
translation_zh: n. 监狱, 监禁, 拘留所；vt. 监禁
example: He spent five years in prison for the crime.

meaning: n. a person who is confined; especially a prisoner of war
translation_zh: n. 囚犯, 犯人, 战俘；[法] 犯人, 囚犯, 扣押犯
example: The prisoner attempted to escape.

meaning: n. the quality of being secluded from the presence or view of others; n. the condition of being concealed or hidden
translation_zh: n. 隐私, 隐居, 秘密；[计] 个人保密权
example: 这个隐私为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a measure of how likely it is that some event will occur; a number expressing the ratio of favorable cases to the whole number of cases possible; n. the quality of being probable; a probable event or the most probable event
translation_zh: n. 可能性, 或然率, 几率, 概率；[化] 概率; 几率
example: 这个可能性为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: v. move ahead; travel onward in time or space; v. follow a certain course
translation_zh: vi. 继续进行, 进行, 开始, 发出, 起诉；[法] 所得, 收入, 收益
example: Please proceed with your presentation.

meaning: n. (psychology) the performance of some composite cognitive activity; an operation that affects mental contents; n. a mental process that you are not directly aware of; n. a natural prolongation or projection from a part of an organism either animal or plant; n. a sustained phenomenon or one marked by gradual changes through a series of states
translation_zh: n. 程序, 进行, 过程；vt. 加工, 使...接受处理, 对...处置, 对...起诉；a. 经加工的, 有特殊光效的；[计] 进程
example: 这个步骤为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: v. declare formally; declare someone to be something; of titles; v. state or announce
translation_zh: vt. 宣布, 公告, 宣言, 表明, 赞扬；[法] 宣布, 宣告, 公布
example: 我们需要逐步proclaim这个方案。

meaning: n. the act of procrastinating; putting off or delaying or defering an action to a later time
translation_zh: n. 拖延, 因循, 耽搁；[法] 拖延, 耽搁, 因循
example: 这个procrastination（noun）为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. someone who finds financing for and supervises the making and presentation of a show (play or film or program or similar work); n. something that produces
translation_zh: n. 生产者, 制作者, 制作人；[化] 发生器; (炉煤气)发生炉; 制气炉; 生产者
example: The film producer announced the new project.

meaning: a. producing or capable of producing (especially abundantly); s. yielding positive results
translation_zh: a. 能生产的, 有生产价值的, 多产的；[医] 产出性的, 产生性的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常多产的的解释。

meaning: n. the body of people in a learned occupation; n. an occupation requiring special education (especially in the liberal arts or sciences); n. an open avowal (true or false) of some belief or opinion; n. affirmation of acceptance of some religion or faith
translation_zh: n. 职业, 表白, 声明；[化] 工种; 职业
example: Teaching is a noble profession.

meaning: n. someone who is a member of the faculty at a college or university
translation_zh: n. 教授
example: Professor Smith teaches history.

meaning: n. the act of moving forward (as toward a goal); n. a movement forward; v. develop in a positive way
translation_zh: n. 进步, 发展, 前进；vi. 进步, 进行
example: We are making good progress on the project.

meaning: n. a law forbidding the sale of alcoholic beverages; n. a decree that prohibits something; n. the period from 1920 to 1933 when the sale of alcoholic beverages was prohibited in the United States by a constitutional amendment; n. refusal to approve or assent to
translation_zh: n. 禁令, 禁止
example: 这个禁令为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: s having a quality that thrusts itself into attention; s conspicuous in position or importance
translation_zh: a. 卓越的, 显著的, 突出的, 凸出的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常重要的的解释。

meaning: v. contribute to the progress or growth of; v. give a promotion to or assign to a higher position; v. be changed for a superior chess or checker piece; v. change a pawn for a better piece by advancing it to the eighth row, or change a checker piece for a more valuable piece by moving it to the row closest to your opponent
translation_zh: vt. 促进, 晋升, 创办, 推销；[经] 促进, 推广, 推销
example: The campaign aims to promote healthy eating habits.

meaning: n. a message issued in behalf of some product or cause or idea or person or institution; n. act of raising in rank or position; n. encouragement of the progress or growth or acceptance of something
translation_zh: n. 晋级, 创建, 增进；[经] 推广, 推销, 促进
example: She received a promotion at work last week.

meaning: n. a function word that is used in place of a noun or noun phrase
translation_zh: n. 代词
example: 这个代词 (n.) - 语法词类为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. any factual evidence that helps to establish the truth of something; n. a formal series of statements showing that if one thing is true something else necessarily follows from it; n. a measure of alcoholic strength expressed as an integer twice the percentage of alcohol present (by volume); n. (printing) an impression made to check for errors
translation_zh: n. 证据, 证明, 试验, 检验, 考验；a. 不能透入的, 证明用的, 防...的, 耐...的；vt. 检验, 试验, 校对, 使不被穿透；[计] 审稿
example: Can you show me proof of purchase?

meaning: r. in the right manner
translation_zh: adv. 适当地, 相当地
example: Make sure you close the door properly.

meaning: n. something owned; any tangible or intangible possession that is owned by someone;; n. a basic or essential attribute shared by all members of a class; n. a construct whereby objects or individuals can be distinguished; n. any movable articles or objects used on the set of a play or movie
translation_zh: n. 财产, 所有权, 性质, 属性；[计] 属性
example: This house is a valuable property.

meaning: n. the quotient obtained when the magnitude of a part is divided by the magnitude of the whole; n. magnitude or extent; n. the relation between things (or parts of things) with respect to their comparative quantity, magnitude, or degree; n. harmonious arrangement or relation of parts or elements within a whole (as in a design)
translation_zh: n. 比例, 比率, 均衡, 部分, 面积；vt. 使成比例, 使均衡
example: 这个均衡为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. something proposed (such as a plan or assumption); n. the act of making a proposal
translation_zh: n. 提议, 计划, 求婚；[经] 提案, 申请, 投标
example: 这个提议为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: v. make a proposal, declare a plan for something; v. ask (someone) to marry you
translation_zh: vt. 计划, 打算, 建议, 提议, 求(婚)；vi. 打算, 求婚
example: 我们需要逐步propose这个方案。

meaning: n. an economic state of growth with rising profits and full employment; n. the condition of prospering; having good fortune
translation_zh: n. 繁荣, 茂盛, 成功；[经] 繁荣
example: 这个繁荣 (n.) - 富裕状态为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: s in fortunate circumstances financially; moderately rich; s very lively and profitable; s marked by peace and prosperity; s presaging or likely to bring good luck
translation_zh: a. 成功的, 繁盛的, 幸运的；[经] 繁荣的, 昌盛的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常繁荣的的解释。

meaning: v. shield from danger, injury, destruction, or damage; v. use tariffs to favor domestic industry
translation_zh: vt. 防卫, 保护, 警戒；[法] 庇护, 保护, 警戒
example: Parents try to protect their children from danger.

meaning: n. the activity of protecting someone or something; n. the condition of being protected; n. the imposition of duties or quotas on imports in order to protect domestic industry against foreign competition; n. payment extorted by gangsters on threat of violence
translation_zh: n. 保护, 防卫, 贸易保护制度；[计] 保护
example: Wear a helmet for head protection.

meaning: a. intended or adapted to afford protection of some kind; s. showing care; s. (usually followed by `of') solicitously caring or mindful
translation_zh: a. 给予保护的, 保护的；[医] 保护的, 防护的, 保护剂, 保护物, 油绸
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常保护的的解释。

meaning: n. a formal and solemn declaration of objection; n. the act of protesting; a public (often organized) manifestation of dissent; n. the act of making a strong public expression of disagreement and disapproval; v. utter words of protest
translation_zh: n. 抗议, 反对, 抗议书, 断言；v. 反对, 抗议, 断言
example: 这个抗议为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: v. be shown or be found to be; v. establish the validity of something, as by an example, explanation or experiment; v. prove formally; demonstrate by a mathematical, formal proof; v. take a trial impression of
translation_zh: vt. 证明, 查验, 检验, 勘探, 显示；vi. 证明是
example: Can you prove that you were there?

meaning: n. a condensed but memorable saying embodying some important fact of experience that is taken as true by many people
translation_zh: n. 谚语, 格言, 箴言；vt. 使众所周知, 用谚语表达
example: 这个谚语为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: v give something useful or necessary to; v give what is desired or needed, especially support, food or sustenance; v determine (what is to happen in certain contingencies), especially by including a proviso condition or stipulation; v mount or put up; v make a possibility or provide opportunity for; permit to be attainable or cause to remain; v supply means of subsistence; earn a living; v take measures in preparation for
translation_zh: conj. 倘若, 以...为条件
example: 这个如果为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: s. mental or emotional as opposed to physical in nature; a. of or relating to or determined by psychology
translation_zh: a. 心理学的, 精神上的, 心灵的；[法] 心理上的, 心理学的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常心理的的解释。

meaning: n tavern consisting of a building with a bar and public rooms; often provides light meals
translation_zh: n. 酒馆, 客栈
example: 这个酒馆为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: r. in a manner accessible to or observable by the public; openly; r. by the public or the people generally
translation_zh: adv. 公然地, 以公众名义
example: He apologized publicly for his mistake.

meaning: n. a firm in the publishing business; n. a person engaged in publishing periodicals or books or music; n. the proprietor of a newspaper
translation_zh: n. 出版者, 发行人；[法] 发行人, 出版者, 报刊发行者
example: 这个出版者为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a sweater that is put on by pulling it over the head
translation_zh: n. 套衫；a. 套穿的
example: He wore a warm wool pullover to protect himself from the cold.

meaning: n. a mechanical device that moves fluid or gas by pressure or suction; n. a low-cut shoe without fastenings; v. operate like a pump; move up and down, like a handle or a pedal; v. deliver forth
translation_zh: n. 抽水机, 打气筒, 泵, 抽吸；vt. 用唧筒抽水, 打气, 盘问, 倾注, 使疲惫；vi. 抽水, 上下(或往复)运动
example: We need a pump to inflate the tires.

meaning: v. impose a penalty on; inflict punishment on
translation_zh: vt. 处罚, 惩罚, 严厉对待；vi. 惩罚
example: The teacher had to punish the student for cheating.

meaning: n. the act of punishing
translation_zh: n. 处罚, 刑罚, 惩罚；[法] 罚, 处罚, 刑罚
example: The punishment for the crime was severe.

meaning: n. the contractile aperture in the center of the iris of the eye; resembles a large black dot
translation_zh: n. 学生, 门生, 未成年人, 瞳孔；[医] 瞳孔
example: The teacher asked the pupil to answer the question.

meaning: n. a young dog; n. an inexperienced young person
translation_zh: n. 小狗, 小动物, 自负的年轻人
example: 这个小狗为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: a. free of extraneous elements of any kind; s. free from discordant qualities; s. concerned with theory and data rather than practice; opposed to applied; a. (used of persons or behaviors) having no faults; sinless
translation_zh: a. 纯的, 纯净的, 纯洁的, 清白的, 完美的, 无瑕的, 抽象的；[医] 的, 纯净的
example: We drank pure water from the mountain spring.

meaning: v. remove impurities from, increase the concentration of, and separate through the process of distillation; v. make pure or free from sin or guilt; v. become clean or pure or free of guilt and sin
translation_zh: vi. 变纯净；vt. 使纯净, 净化, 提纯, 精炼
example: The water filter helps to purify drinking water.

meaning: n. a sum of money spoken of as the contents of a money purse; n. a small bag for carrying money; n. a sum of money offered as a prize; v. contract one's lips into a rounded shape
translation_zh: n. 钱包, 小钱袋, 金钱, 募捐款, 囊状物；v. 缩拢, 皱起
example: 这个(女士)手提袋为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. the act of applying force in order to move something away; n. the force used in pushing; n. an effort to advance; v. move with force, "He pushed the table into a corner"
translation_zh: n. 推, 推动, 奋斗, 攻击, 进取心；vt. 推, 推动, 使伸出, 推行, 逼迫, 增加；vi. 推, 推进, 增加, 努力争取
example: 这个& vi. 推为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a particularly baffling problem that is said to have a correct solution; n. a game that tests your ingenuity; v. be uncertain about; think about without fully understanding or being able to decide
translation_zh: n. 难题, 迷惑；vt. 使困惑, 使为难；vi. 迷惑, 苦思
example: 这个使困惑为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n shaking and vibration at the surface of the earth resulting from underground movement along a fault plane of from volcanic activity; v shake with fast, tremulous movements; v shake with seismic vibrations
translation_zh: vi. 颤抖, 地震；n. 颤抖, 地震
example: The small quake rattled the windows.

meaning: a. meeting the proper standards and requirements and training for an office or position or task; a. limited or restricted; not absolute
translation_zh: a. 有资格的；[经] 合格的, 有条件的, 有限制的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常具备……的学历（资历）的的解释。

meaning: v. prove capable or fit; meet requirements; v. pronounce fit or able; v. make more specific; v. make fit or prepared
translation_zh: vi. 取得资格, 有资格；vt. 使有资格, 使合格, 限定, 限制, 准予
example: 我们需要逐步qualify这个方案。

meaning: n. an essential and distinguishing attribute of something or someone; n. a degree or grade of excellence or worth; n. a characteristic property that defines the apparent individual nature of something; n. high social status
translation_zh: n. 品质, 特性, 才能, 质量；a. 优质的；[计] 品质
example: We aim for high quality in our products.

meaning: n. an adequate or large amount; n. the concept that something has a magnitude and can be represented in mathematical expressions by a constant or a variable
translation_zh: n. 量, 数量, 总量；[计] 数量; 量
example: We need a large quantity of materials for the project.

meaning: n. a form containing a set of questions; submitted to people to gain statistical information
translation_zh: n. 调查表, 问卷；[经] 调查表
example: Please fill out this questionnaire before the interview.

meaning: n. a line of people or vehicles waiting for something; n. (information processing) an ordered list of tasks to be performed or messages to be transmitted; n. a braid of hair at the back of the head
translation_zh: n. 辫子, 一队人, 队列；vt. 使排队, 将...梳成辫子；vi. 排队；[计] 队列
example: We had to wait in a long queue for tickets.

meaning: a. of or related to genetically distinguished groups of people; a. of or characteristic of race or races or arising from differences among groups
translation_zh: a. 人种的, 种族的；[医] 种族的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常种族的的解释。

meaning: n. energy that is radiated or transmitted in the form of rays or waves or particles; n. the act of spreading outward from a central source; n. the spontaneous emission of a stream of particles or electromagnetic rays in nuclear decay; n. the spread of a group of organisms into new habitats
translation_zh: n. 辐射；[化] 放射
example: 这个辐射为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a state of extreme anger; n. something that is desired intensely; n. violent state of the elements; v. be violent; as of fires and storms
translation_zh: n. 愤怒, 情绪激动, 狂暴；vi. 大怒, 狂吹, 流行
example: 这个盛怒为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. short for railway; n. a horizontal bar (usually of wood or metal); n. any of numerous widely distributed small wading birds of the family Rallidae having short wings and very long toes for running on soft mud; v. complain bitterly
translation_zh: n. 横杆, 围栏, 栏杆, 铁轨, 扶手, 秧鸡；vt. 以横木围栏, 给...铺铁轨；vi. 责骂, 抱怨
example: The train runs on a steel rail.

meaning: v. supply with railroad lines; v. transport by railroad
translation_zh: n. 铁路, 铁路公司；vt. 铺设铁路, 用铁路运输；vi. 在铁路工作
example: The old railroad tracks are no longer in use.

meaning: n. line that is the commercial organization responsible for operating a system of transportation for trains that pull passengers or freight
translation_zh: n. 铁路, 轨道；[经] 铁路
example: The old railway line is now used for walking.

meaning: n water falling in drops from vapor condensed in the atmosphere
translation_zh: n. 降雨, 降雨量；[经] 降雨量
example: The region receives high rainfall.

meaning: n a forest with heavy annual rainfall
translation_zh: [生态]雨林
example: The Amazon is the world's largest rainforest.

meaning: n. a row or line of people (especially soldiers or police) standing abreast of one another; n. relative status; v. take or have a position relative to others; v. take precedence or surpass others in rank
translation_zh: n. 等级, 排, 横列, 队伍, 阶级；a. 茂密丛生的, 恶臭的, 十足的, 粗俗的；vt. 排列, 归类于, 把...分等；vi. 列为, 列队；n. 秩；[计] 秩
example: 这个军衔为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a part of a river where the current is very fast; s. done or occurring in a brief period of time; s. characterized by speed; moving with or capable of moving with high speed
translation_zh: a. 迅速的, 飞快的, 急促的, 陡的；n. 急流
example: The river had a rapid current.

meaning: r with rapid movements
translation_zh: adv. 飞快地, 迅速地, 赶紧地
example: The technology is developing rapidly.

meaning: s. not widely known; especially valued for its uncommonness; s. recurring only at long intervals; s. not widely distributed; s. having low density
translation_zh: a. 稀罕的, 罕有的, 珍奇的, 稀薄的, 半熟的, 非常好的；adv. 非常
example: It's rare to see such a beautiful bird.

meaning: r. not often
translation_zh: adv. 很少地, 罕有地
example: 他很少地地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: n. woody brambles bearing usually red but sometimes black or yellow fruits that separate from the receptacle when ripe and are rounder and smaller than blackberries; n. red or black edible aggregate berries usually smaller than the related blackberries
translation_zh: n. 悬钩子, 呸声；[化] 覆盆子; 悬钩子
example: 这个悬钩子（树）为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. the food allowance for one day (especially for service personnel); n. a fixed portion that is allotted (especially in times of scarcity); v. restrict the consumption of a relatively scarce commodity, as during war; v. distribute in rations, as in the army
translation_zh: n. 定额, 定量, 配给；vt. 配给, 定量供应
example: 这个配给量为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: a. consistent with or based on or using reason; a. capable of being expressed as a quotient of integers; s. having its source in or being guided by the intellect (as distinguished from experience or emotion)
translation_zh: a. 理性的, 合理的；n. 有理数
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常（想法、决定等）合理的的解释。

meaning: n. edge tool used in shaving; v. shave with a razor
translation_zh: n. 剃刀；vt. 剃
example: He used a sharp razor to shave his beard.

meaning: v. show a response or a reaction to something; v. act against or in opposition to; v. undergo a chemical reaction; react with another substance under certain conditions
translation_zh: vi. 起反应, 起作用, 反攻；[医] 应答, 发生反应
example: How did he react to the news?

meaning: a. aware or expressing awareness of things as they really are; a. of or relating to the philosophical doctrine of realism
translation_zh: a. 现实的, 逼真的, 现实主义的, 实在论的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常现实的的解释。

meaning: n. the state of being actual or real; n. the state of the world as it really is rather than as you might want it to be; n. the quality possessed by something that is real
translation_zh: n. 实在, 事实, 实体, 逼真；[法] 现实, 实在存在的事物, 实在性
example: 这个现实为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: v. put into a new order or arrangement
translation_zh: vt. 再排列, 重新整理；[计] 重新排列; 重新整理
example: She decided to rearrange the furniture in her living room.

meaning: a. showing reason or sound judgment; s. marked by sound judgment
translation_zh: a. 合理的, 明理的, 适当的；[法] 合理的, 公道的, 正当的
example: That's a very reasonable price for such a good car.

meaning: v. build again
translation_zh: vt. 改建, 重建, 改造；vi. 重建
example: 我们需要逐步rebuild这个方案。

meaning: n. a request by the manufacturer of a defective product to return the product (as for replacement or repair); n. a call to return; n. a bugle call that signals troops to return; n. the process of remembering (especially the process of recovering information by mental effort)
translation_zh: n. 回忆, 召回, 撤消；vt. 回想, 回忆, 召回, 撤消, 使恢复；[计] 检索
example: 我们需要逐步recall这个方案。

meaning: n. the manner in which something is greeted; n. a formal party of people; as after a wedding; n. quality or fidelity of a received broadcast; n. the act of receiving
translation_zh: n. 接待, 接受, 招待会；[医] 接受, 感受
example: Please ask at the reception desk for your key.

meaning: v. repeat aloud from memory; v. render verbally, "recite a poem"
translation_zh: v. 背诵, 朗读, 叙述
example: 我们需要逐步recite这个方案。

meaning: v. claim back; v. reuse (materials from waste products); v. make useful again; transform from a useless or uncultivated state
translation_zh: vt. 开垦, 改造, 感化, 纠正, 回收；vi. 喊叫, 抗议
example: 我们需要逐步reclaim这个方案。

meaning: v. push for something; v. make attractive or acceptable
translation_zh: vt. 推荐, 介绍, 劝告, 使受欢迎, 托付；[经] 建议, 推荐
example: I highly recommend this book.

meaning: n. anything (such as a document or a phonograph record or a photograph) providing permanent evidence of or information about past events; n. the number of wins versus losses and ties a team has had; n. the sum of recognized accomplishments; n. a compilation of the known facts regarding something or someone
translation_zh: n. 记录, 履历, 档案, 审判记录, 最高纪录, 唱片；vt. 记录, 记载, 标明, 将...录音；vi. 记录, 录音, 可被录音；a. 创纪录的；[计] 录制, 记录
example: He broke the world record.

meaning: n. a signal that encodes something (e.g., picture or sound) that has been recorded; n. the act of making a record (especially an audio record); n. a storage device on which information (sounds or images) have been recorded
translation_zh: a. 记录的, 记录用的；n. 录音
example: The band released a new recording of their live concert.

meaning: v. get or find back; recover the use of; v. regain a former condition after a financial loss; v. regain or make up for; v. cover anew
translation_zh: vt. 重新获得, 恢复, 复原, 拯救；vi. 痊愈, 复原, 胜诉；[计] 恢复
example: It took him a long time to recover from the illness.

meaning: n. return to an original state; n. the act of regaining or saving something lost (or in danger of becoming lost)
translation_zh: n. 恢复, 复原, 痊愈, 重获；[计] 恢复
example: 这个恢复为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: v cause to repeat a cycle; v use again after processing
translation_zh: v. 回收利用( recycle的过去式和过去分词 ); 再利用; 再次应用; 重新使用（概念、方法、玩笑等）
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常回收利用( recycle的过去式和过去分词 )的解释。

meaning: n. the act of processing used or abandoned materials for use in creating new products
translation_zh: [电] 再循环
example: 这个再循环v.回收利用( recycle的现在分词 )为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: v. cut down on; make a reduction in; v. make less complex; v. bring to humbler or weaker state or condition; v. simplify the form of a mathematical equation of expression by substituting one term for another
translation_zh: vt. 减少, 分解, 降低, 使衰退, 把...分解, 把...归纳；vi. 减少, 减肥, 缩小；[计] 缩小
example: We need to reduce our expenses.

meaning: n. any process in which electrons are added to an atom or ion (as by removing oxygen or adding hydrogen); always occurs accompanied by oxidation of the reducing agent; n. the act of reducing complexity
translation_zh: n. 减少, 缩影, 变化；[化] 还原
example: 这个减少为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a submerged ridge of rock or coral near the surface of the water; n. one of several strips across a sail that can be taken in or rolled up to lessen the area of the sail that is exposed to the wind; v. lower and bring partially inboard; v. roll up (a portion of a sail) in order to reduce its area
translation_zh: n. 暗礁, 礁, 缩帆；v. 缩(帆)
example: We went snorkeling near the coral reef.

meaning: n. (sports) the chief official (as in boxing or American football) who is expected to ensure fair play; n. an attorney appointed by a court to investigate and report on a case; v. be a referee or umpire in a sports competition; v. evaluate professionally a colleague's work
translation_zh: n. 仲裁人, 调解人, 裁判员；v. 仲裁, 裁判
example: The referee blew the whistle to end the game.

meaning: n. the phenomenon of a propagating wave (light or sound) being thrown back from a surface; n. the image of something as reflected by a mirror (or other reflective material); n. (mathematics) a transformation in which the direction of one axis is reversed; n. the ability to reflect beams or rays
translation_zh: n. 反映, 沉思, 映像, 想法, 责难；[计] 反射
example: She saw her reflection in the mirror.

meaning: n snacks and drinks served as a light meal; n activity that refreshes and recreates; activity that renews your health and spirits by enjoyment and relaxation
translation_zh: n. 茶点；点心；小吃
example: 这个提神为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. money returned to a payer; n. the act of returning money received previously; v. pay back
translation_zh: n. 偿还；vt. 付还, 偿还借款；vi. 归还, 偿还
example: I asked for a full refund.

meaning: n. the act of refusing; n. a message refusing to accept something that is offered
translation_zh: n. 拒绝, 推却, 优先决定权；[法] 拒绝, 谢绝, 取舍权
example: His refusal to cooperate caused problems.

meaning: v. show unwillingness towards; v. refuse to accept
translation_zh: vt. 拒绝, 谢绝；vi. 拒绝；n. 废物；a. 扔掉的, 无用的
example: She refused to answer the question.

meaning: v get or find back; recover the use of; v come upon after searching; find the location of something that was missed or lost
translation_zh: vt. 取回, 恢复, 重回, 复得；[化] 回潮
example: 我们需要逐步regain这个方案。

meaning: v deem to be; v look at attentively; v connect closely and often incriminatingly
translation_zh: prep. 关于
example: 这个关于为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. the extended spatial location of something; n. a large indefinite location on the surface of the Earth; n. the approximate amount of something (usually used prepositionally as in `in the region of'); n. a knowledge domain that you are interested in or are communicating about
translation_zh: n. 区域, 地带, 地区, 领域, 范围, 区；[计] 区, 区域
example: This region is known for its beautiful mountains.

meaning: a. characteristic of a region; s. related or limited to a particular region
translation_zh: a. 地方的, 地域性的；[医] 区的, 部位的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常地区的的解释。

meaning: n. an official written record of names or events or transactions; n. (music) the timbre that is characteristic of a certain range and manner of production of the human voice or of different pipe organ stops or of different musical instruments; n. a book in which names and transactions are listed; n. (computer science) memory device that is the part of computer memory that has a specific address and that is used to hold information of a specific kind
translation_zh: n. 寄存器, 记录, 登记簿, 注册；vt. 记录, 注册, 提示, 表达, 把...挂号；vi. 登记, 注册, 挂号；[计] 寄存器
example: You need to register for the course by Friday.

meaning: n. the act of enrolling; n. the body of people (such as students) who register or enroll at the same time; n. a document certifying an act of registering; n. (music) the sound property resulting from a combination of organ stops used to perform a particular piece of music; the technique of selecting and adjusting organ stops
translation_zh: n. 登记, 挂号, 注册；[计] 登记; 定位; 对齐; 记录
example: Online registration for the conference is now open.

meaning: n. an authoritative rule; n. the state of being controlled or governed; n. (embryology) the ability of an early embryo to continue normal development after its structure has been somehow damaged or altered; n. the act of bringing to uniformity; making regular
translation_zh: n. 规则, 管理, 调整；[计] 调整; 规章; 规则; 调节
example: 这个管理为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: v. refuse to accept or acknowledge; v. reject with contempt; v. refuse entrance or membership
translation_zh: n. 被拒之人, 被弃之物, 不合格品, 次品；vt. 拒绝, 抵制, 否决, 驳回, 丢弃, 呕出
example: They decided to reject the offer.

meaning: v. give an account of; v. be in a relationship with; v. have or establish a relationship to
translation_zh: vt. 讲, 叙述, 使互相关联；vi. 有关, 符合, 相处得好
example: I can relate to your feelings.

meaning: n. an abstraction belonging to or characteristic of two entities or parts together; n. an act of narration; n. (usually plural) mutual dealings or connections among persons or groups
translation_zh: n. 关系, 联系, 叙述, 故事, 家属, 亲戚；[计] 关系
example: What is your relation to the victim?

meaning: n. a relation between people; (`relationship' is often used where `relation' would serve, as in `the relationship between inflation and unemployment', but the preferred usage of `relationship' is for human relations or states of relatedness); n. a state of connectedness between people (especially an emotional connection); n. a state involving mutual dealings between people or parties or countries
translation_zh: n. 关系, 关联；[医] 关系
example: Their relationship is very strong.

meaning: n. a person related by blood or marriage; n. an animal or plant that bears a relationship to another (as related by common descent or by membership in the same genus); a. estimated by comparison; not absolute or complete
translation_zh: n. 亲戚, 关系词；a. 有关系的, 相对的, 比较的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常相对的的解释。

meaning: r. in a relative manner; by comparison to something else
translation_zh: adv. 相对地, 比较地, 相当地, 相关地；[计] 相对地
example: 他ad地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: v become less tense, rest, or take one's ease; v make less taut; v become loose or looser or less tight; v cause to feel relaxed; v become less tense, less formal, or less restrained, and assume a friendlier manner; v make less severe or strict; v become less severe or strict; v make less active or fast; a affording physical or mental rest
translation_zh: a. 令人轻松的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常令人轻松的v.放松的解释。

meaning: a. worthy of reliance or trust
translation_zh: a. 可靠的, 可信赖的；[法] 可靠的, 可信赖的, 确实的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常可靠的的解释。

meaning: n. a strong belief in a supernatural power or powers that control human destiny; n. an institution to express belief in a divine power
translation_zh: n. 宗教, 信仰；[法] 宗教, 宗教信仰, 信仰
example: Freedom of religion is an important right.

meaning: n. a member of a religious order who is bound by vows of poverty and chastity and obedience; s. concerned with sacred matters or religion or the church; a. having or showing belief in and reverence for a deity; a. of or relating to clergy bound by monastic vows
translation_zh: a. 宗教性的, 虔诚的, 宗教上的, 严谨的；n. 修道士, 出家人
example: She has strong religious beliefs.

meaning: v have confidence or faith in
translation_zh: vi. 信赖, 依赖, 信任
example: You can always rely on him for help.

meaning: n. something left after other parts have been taken away; n. the part of the dividend that is left over when the dividend is not evenly divisible by the divisor; n. the number that remains after subtraction; the number that when added to the subtrahend gives the minuend; v. sell cheaply as remainders
translation_zh: n. 剩余物, 其他人, 残余, 余数；v. 削价出售(图书)；a. 剩余的, 出售削价剩书的；[计] 余数
example: 这个[数] 余数为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: s. unusual or striking
translation_zh: a. 不平常的, 值得注意的, 显著的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常异常的的解释。

meaning: n. a medicine or therapy that cures disease or relieve pain; v. provide relief for
translation_zh: n. 药物, 治疗法, 治疗, 补救, 赔偿；vt. 治疗, 补救, 矫正, 改善, 修补, 修缮
example: 这个解决方法为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. the ability to recall past occurrences
translation_zh: n. 回想, 记忆, 纪念品, 记忆力, 问候, 致意
example: 这个回想为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. degree of figurative distance or separation;; v. remove something concrete, as by lifting, pushing, or taking off, or remove something abstract; v. remove from a position or an office; v. shift the position or location of, as for business, legal, educational, or military purposes
translation_zh: vt. 移动, 调动, 除去, 迁移, 开除, 移交；vi. 迁移, 移动, 搬家；n. 班级, 升级, 移动, 搬家, 间距；[计] 删除
example: Please remove your shoes before entering.

meaning: v reestablish on a new, usually improved, basis or make new or like new; v cause to appear in a new form
translation_zh: vt. 使更新, 使恢复, 复兴, 修补, 补充, 继续, 重订, 重申, 续借；vi. 更新, 重新开始
example: 我们需要逐步renew这个方案。

meaning: v pay back; v make repayment for or return something; v act or give recompense in recognition of someone's behavior or actions; v answer back
translation_zh: v. 偿还, 报答, 报复
example: He promised to repay the loan by next month.

meaning: r. several time
translation_zh: adv. 重复地, 再三地
example: He repeatedly asked the same question.

meaning: n. a person who represents others; s. serving to represent or typify; a. standing for something else; s. being or characteristic of government by representation in which citizens exercise power through elected officers and representatives
translation_zh: n. 代表, 众议员, 典型；a. 描写的, 表现的, 代理的, 代表的, 代议制的, 典型的
example: 这个代表代理人为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: v. make a copy or equivalent of; v. have offspring or produce more individuals of a given animal or plant; v. recreate a sound, image, idea, mood, atmosphere, etc.
translation_zh: v. 繁殖, 再生, 复制, 生殖；[计] 复制
example: 我们需要逐步reproduce这个方案。

meaning: n. a form of government whose head of state is not a monarch
translation_zh: n. 共和国, 共和政体, 团体, 界
example: 这个共和国为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. notoriety for some particular characteristic; n. the general estimation that the public has for a person
translation_zh: n. 名誉, 名声, 声望；[法] 名声, 名誉, 公认证据
example: 这个名气为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: v require as useful, just, or proper; v consider obligatory; request and expect; v make someone do something; v have need of
translation_zh: vt. 需要, 命令, 要求；[法] 需要, 要求, 命令
example: 我们需要逐步require这个方案。

meaning: n. required activity
translation_zh: n. 需求, 必要条件, 要求；[化] 要求; 合同要求
example: 这个要求为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. recovery or preservation from loss or danger; v. free from harm or evil; v. take forcibly from legal custody
translation_zh: n. 援救, 解救, 营救；vt. 援救, 救出, 营救
example: The firefighters managed to rescue everyone from the burning building.

meaning: n a scientist who devotes himself to doing research
translation_zh: n. 研究人员
example: 这个研究员为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: v. appear like; be similar or bear a likeness to
translation_zh: vt. 相似, 类似
example: 我们需要逐步resemble这个方案。

meaning: n. a district that is reserved for particular purpose; n. a statement that limits or restricts some claim; n. the written record or promise of an arrangement by which accommodations are secured in advance; n. something reserved in advance (as a hotel accommodation or a seat on a plane etc.)
translation_zh: n. 保留, 预定, 保留品, 保留地；[经] 预定, 预约, 权益保留
example: I made a dinner reservation for two.

meaning: n. something kept back or saved for future use or a special purpose; n. (medicine) potential capacity to respond in order to maintain vital functions; n. the trait of being uncommunicative; not volunteering anything more than necessary; v. hold back or set aside, especially for future use or contingency
translation_zh: n. 储备品, 贮量, 后备军, 自然保护区, 保留, 拘谨, 节制, 储备金；vt. 保留, 保存, 预订, 延期, 推迟
example: 这个保留[储备]某物具有或保持(某种权利)预订或保留(座位、住处等)为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. someone who lives at a particular place for a prolonged period or who was born there; a. living in a particular place
translation_zh: n. 居民, 常驻程序, 居住者, 留鸟；a. 居留的, 定居的
example: She has been a resident of this city for twenty years.

meaning: a. used or designed for residence or limited to residences; a. of or relating to or connected with residence
translation_zh: a. 住宅的, 与居住有关的；[法] 有关居住的, 房产的:居所的, 适于居住的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常住宅的的解释。

meaning: v. stand up or offer resistance to somebody or something; v. withstand the force of something; v. resist immunologically the introduction of some foreign tissue or organ; v. refuse to comply
translation_zh: v. 抵抗, 耐得住, 抵制, 反抗；n. 防染材料
example: It's hard to resist chocolate.

meaning: v. make clearly visible; v. find the solution
translation_zh: vi. 决定, 分解, 决心；vt. 使分解, 解析, 解决, 消除, 决心；n. 决定之事, 决心, 坚决
example: 我们需要逐步resolve这个方案。

meaning: n. a hotel located in a resort area
translation_zh: n. 度假胜地, 手段, 凭借, 常去之地；vi. 诉诸, 常去
example: We stayed at a beautiful beach resort.

meaning: n. available source of wealth; a new or reserve supply that can be drawn upon when needed; n. a source of aid or support that may be drawn upon when needed; n. the ability to deal resourcefully with unusual problems
translation_zh: n. 资源, 财力, 办法, 策略, 急智, 消遣；[计] 资源
example: 这个资源为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. (usually preceded by `in') a detail or point; n. an attitude of admiration or esteem; v. regard highly; think much of; v. show respect towards
translation_zh: n. 尊敬, 尊重, 问候；vt. 尊敬, 注意, 遵守
example: We should show respect for elders.

meaning: a. characterized by socially or conventionally acceptable morals
translation_zh: a. 值得尊重的, 人格高尚的, 相当数量的；n. 品格高尚的人
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常可敬的人 adj. 值得尊敬的的解释。

meaning: n. a form of trustworthiness; the trait of being answerable to someone for something or being responsible for one's conduct
translation_zh: n. 责任, 职责, 负担, 可靠性；[化] 职责
example: Taking care of a pet is a big responsibility.

meaning: a. worthy of or requiring responsibility or trust; or held accountable; s. being the agent or cause
translation_zh: a. 有责任的, 负责的, 责任重大的；[法] 应负责任的, 有责任的, 能履行责任的
example: You are responsible for your own actions.

meaning: v. return to its original or usable and functioning condition; v. give or bring back; v. bring back into original existence, use, function, or position
translation_zh: vt. 回复, 恢复, 归还, 修补, 修复；vt. 还原；vi. 还原；[计] 还原; DOS外部命令:从备份盘中取回文件
example: 我们需要逐步restore这个方案。

meaning: v. place restrictions on; v. place under restrictions; limit access to; v. place limits on (extent or access)
translation_zh: vt. 限制, 限定, 约束；[医] 限制
example: 我们需要逐步restrict这个方案。

meaning: n. the selling of goods to consumers; usually in small quantities and not for resale; v. be sold at the retail level; v. sell on the retail market; r. at a retail price
translation_zh: n. 零售；a. 零售的；vt. 零售, 详述, 传播；vi. 零售
example: 这个零售为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: v. hold back within; v. allow to remain in a place or position or maintain a property or feature; v. secure and keep for possible future use or application; v. keep in one's mind
translation_zh: vt. 保持, 保有, 留住, 记得, 付定金聘请；[经] 保留, 留存
example: 我们需要逐步retain这个方案。

meaning: v render verbally, "recite a poem"; v make into fiction; v to say, state, or perform again
translation_zh: vt. 再讲, 重复, 重说
example: She asked him to retell the story from the beginning.

meaning: n. contemplation of things past
translation_zh: n. 回顾, 追忆, 回溯；v. 回顾, 追忆
example: 这个回顾为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n the act of coming together again
translation_zh: n. 使重新统一, 使重新团结
example: 这个重新统一为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: v. unify again, as of a country
translation_zh: vt. 使重新统一
example: 我们需要逐步reunify这个方案。

meaning: v. make revisions in
translation_zh: n. 校订, 修正, 改样；vt. 校订, 修正, 校正
example: She needs to revise her essay before submitting it.

meaning: n. the act of revising or altering (involving reconsideration and modification); n. the act of rewriting something
translation_zh: n. 校订, 修正, 修订本, 修订版；[计] 修订版
example: I need to do some revision for my exams.

meaning: n. payment made in return for a service rendered; n. an act performed to strengthen approved behavior; n. the offer of money for helping to find a criminal or for returning lost property; v. act or give recompense in recognition of someone's behavior or actions
translation_zh: n. 报酬, 酬谢, 赏金；vt. 奖赏, 酬谢, 给...应有报应
example: Hard work often brings its own reward.

meaning: n. something that has been written again; v. write differently; alter the writing of; v. rewrite so as to make fit to suit a new or different purpose
translation_zh: vt. 重写, 改写, 改写新闻, 书面答复；vi. 修改旧作；n. 改写的作品；[计] 重写
example: She had to rewrite her essay to improve the arguments.

meaning: v. relieve from
