translation_zh: vt. 免除, 以...清除, 使获自由, 使摆脱；[法] 免除, 清除, 摆脱
example: We need to get rid of this old furniture.

meaning: s inspiring scornful pity; s incongruous; inviting ridicule; s broadly or extravagantly humorous; resembling farce
translation_zh: a. 荒谬的, 可笑的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常可笑的的解释。

meaning: a. fully developed or matured and ready to be eaten or used; s. fully prepared or eager; s. at the highest point of development especially in judgment or knowledge
translation_zh: a. 成熟的, 熟练的, 成年的；[医] 成熟的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常（水果、谷物等）成熟的的解释。

meaning: n. a venture undertaken without regard to possible loss or injury; n. the probability of becoming infected given that exposure to an infectious agent has occurred; n. the probability of being exposed to an infectious agent; v. expose to a chance of loss or damage
translation_zh: n. 冒险, 危险, 保险额；vt. 冒...的危险, 冒险干
example: There's a high risk of rain today.

meaning: n edge of a way or road or path
translation_zh: n. 路旁, 路边；a. 路边的
example: 这个路边为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n a mechanism that can move automatically
translation_zh: n. 机械人, 自动机械, 机械般工作的人；[计] 机器人; 自动机
example: 这个机器人为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. the act of robbing a helpless person
translation_zh: a. 旋转的, 波动的, 起伏的；n. 旋转, 轰响, 动摇
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常旋转的的解释。

meaning: s. having decayed or disintegrated; usually implies foulness
translation_zh: a. 腐烂的, 恶臭的, 堕落的, 风化的, 虚弱的；[经] 腐烂的, 堕落的
example: The apple was rotten inside.

meaning: n. the part of a golf course bordering the fairway where the grass is not cut short; a. having or caused by an irregular surface; s. (of persons or behavior) lacking refinement or finesse; a. of the margin of a leaf shape; having the edge cut or fringed or scalloped
translation_zh: n. 粗糙的东西, 毛坯, 未加工品, 梗概, 草图, 暴徒, 艰难；a. 粗糙的, 粗暴的, 蓬乱的, 草率的, 大致的, 简陋的, 暴风雨的, 艰难的；vt. 使粗糙, 使不平, 使蓬乱, 粗制, 草拟, 粗暴对待, 对...动粗；vi. 变粗糙；adv. 粗糙地, 粗暴地
example: The road was rough and bumpy.

meaning: n. an unvarying or habitual method or procedure; n. a set sequence of steps, part of larger computer program
translation_zh: n. 常规, 日常工作, 惯例, 例行公事；a. 日常的, 常规的；[计] 例程
example: My morning routine includes exercise.

meaning: n. an elastic material obtained from the latex sap of trees (especially trees of the genera Hevea and Ficus) that can be vulcanized and finished into a variety of products; n. any of various synthetic elastic materials whose properties resemble natural rubber; s. returned for lack of funds
translation_zh: n. 橡皮, 橡胶, 做摩擦动作的人, 按摩师, 决胜盘；vt. 用橡胶制造, 涂橡胶于
example: The sole of the shoe is made of rubber.

meaning: n. worthless material that is to be disposed of; v. attack strongly
translation_zh: n. 废物, 垃圾, 胡说
example: Please put the rubbish in the bin.

meaning: r in an impolite manner
translation_zh: adv. 无礼地, 粗鲁地, 粗陋地
example: 他粗鲁地地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: n. an irrecoverable state of devastation and destruction; n. a ruined building; n. an event that results in destruction; v. destroy or cause to fail
translation_zh: n. 毁灭, 推翻, 废墟；vi. 毁灭, 衰败, 破坏, 破产, 堕落；vt. 使毁灭, 毁坏, 使破产
example: 这个破坏为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. an easy victory; s. completely out of control
translation_zh: n. 逃跑, 逃走的人, 逃亡, 压倒性的优胜；a. 逃亡的, 逃走的
example: 这个逃走的为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a chute down which logs can slide; n. a narrow platform extending from the stage into the audience in a theater or nightclub etc.; n. a strip of level paved surface where planes can take off and land
translation_zh: n. 跑道, 河床, 过道；[化] 单轨架空道; 吊车道
example: The plane taxied down the runway before takeoff.

meaning: a. concerned with religion or religious purposes; s. worthy of respect or dedication; s. (often followed by `to') devoted exclusively to a single use or purpose or person
translation_zh: a. 神圣的, 献给上帝的, 庄严的, 祭祀的；[法] 神圣的, 不可侵犯的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常神圣的的解释。

meaning: n. emotions experienced when not in a state of well-being; n. the state of being sad
translation_zh: n. 悲哀, 悲伤
example: 这个悲哀为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n an overland journey by hunters (especially in Africa)
translation_zh: n. 旅行, 旅行队, 科学考察
example: They went on a safari in Kenya.

meaning: v. make safe; v. escort safely
translation_zh: n. 保卫, 保护措施, 防护设施；vt. 保卫, 保护
example: 这个保护为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: r. with safety; in a safe manner
translation_zh: adv. 安全地, 确实地
example: Please drive safely and arrive home soon.

meaning: n. the state of being certain that adverse effects will not be caused by some agent under defined conditions; n. a safe place; n. a score in American football; a player is tackled behind his own goal line
translation_zh: n. 安全, 保险, 平安, 保安设备；vt. 保护, 防护
example: Safety is our top priority.

meaning: n. a man salesperson
translation_zh: n. 售货员, 推销员；[经] 售货员, 店员, 推销员
example: The salesman tried to convince me to buy the car.

meaning: n. any of various large food and game fishes of northern waters; usually migrate from salt to fresh water to spawn; n. a tributary of the Snake River in Idaho; n. flesh of any of various marine or freshwater fish of the family Salmonidae; n. a pale pinkish orange color
translation_zh: n. 鲑鱼, 大麻哈鱼；[医] 鲑
example: 这个鲑鱼为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a loose material consisting of grains of rock or coral; n. French writer known for works concerning women's rights and independence (1804-1876)
translation_zh: n. 沙, 沙子, 沙滩, 光阴, 生涯；vt. 撒沙, 以沙掩盖
example: 这个沙为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a shoe consisting of a sole fastened by straps to the foot
translation_zh: n. 凉鞋, 拖鞋, 檀香木；vt. 穿以便鞋
example: 这个凉鞋为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. man-made equipment that orbits around the earth or the moon; n. a person who follows or serves another; n. any celestial body orbiting around a planet or star; v. broadcast or disseminate via satellite
translation_zh: n. 人造卫星；[医] 伴行静脉, 陪静脉, 陪病部, 随体, 卫星
example: 这个卫星为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. the contentment one feels when one has fulfilled a desire, need, or expectation; n. (law) the payment of a debt or fulfillment of an obligation; n. act of fulfilling a desire or need or appetite
translation_zh: n. 满足, 满意, 快事, 赔偿, 赎罪, 报仇的机会；[经] 偿还, 赎回
example: 这个满足为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: s. filled with satisfaction
translation_zh: a. 感到满意的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常满意的的解释。

meaning: n. a deep pan with a handle; used for stewing or boiling
translation_zh: n. (长柄有盖)深平底锅, 炖锅
example: 这个长柄而有盖子的深平底锅为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a small shallow dish for holding a cup at the table
translation_zh: n. 茶碟, 茶托；[医] 碟
example: 这个茶杯托为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. the act of scanning; systematic examination of a prescribed region; n. an image produced by scanning; v. examine minutely or intensely; v. examine hastily
translation_zh: n. 审视, 浏览, 扫描, 细查；vt. 细看, 浏览, 扫描, 详细调查, 标出格律；vi. 押韵, 扫描；[计] 网络软件目录, 编码与分析系统
example: Please scan this document and email it to me.

meaning: v cause fear in; v cause to lose courage; v mark with a scar; s made afraid
translation_zh: a. 害怕的, 担惊受怕的, 惊慌的, 吓坏了的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常恐惧的的解释。

meaning: s provoking fear terror
translation_zh: a. 容易受惊的, 胆小的, 提心吊胆的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常（事物）可怕的的解释。

meaning: n. a haphazard distribution in all directions; n. the act of scattering; v. distribute loosely; v. sow by scattering
translation_zh: n. 消散, 分散, 散播, 散射, 散布, 酒馆；vi. 散布, 散播, 消散；vt. 使消散, 使分散, 撒, 散布, 散播, 散射；[计] 散点图
example: 我们需要逐步scatter这个方案。

meaning: s. used of locations; having beautiful natural scenery; a. of or relating to the stage or stage scenery
translation_zh: a. 风景好的, 戏剧性的, 舞台的, 布景的；n. 风光影片, 风景照片
example: We drove along a scenic route through the mountains.

meaning: n. a learned person (especially in the humanities); someone who by long study has gained mastery in one or more disciplines; n. a student who holds a scholarship
translation_zh: n. 学者, 奖学金获得者, 有文化者, 学习者
example: 这个奖学金获得者为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. financial aid provided to a student on the basis of academic merit
translation_zh: n. 学问, 学术成就, 奖学金
example: She received a scholarship to study at university.

meaning: n. an acquaintance that you go to school with
translation_zh: n. 同窗, 同学
example: 这个同学为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a teacher in a school below the college level
translation_zh: n. 教师
example: 这个（中、小学的）教师为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. someone (especially a woman) who annoys people by constantly finding fault
translation_zh: n. 好骂街的人, 责骂；v. 责骂
example: She would often scold her children for misbehaving.

meaning: n. an area in which something acts or operates or has power or control: "the range of a supersonic jet"
translation_zh: n. 范围, 机会, 广度, 眼界, 观察仪器, 导弹射程；[计] 作用域
example: 这个范围为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a competitor who has withdrawn from competition; n. (golf) a handicap of zero strokes; n. an indication of damage; v. cut the surface of; wear away the surface of
translation_zh: n. 抓痕, 搔, 抓, 擦伤, 刮擦声, 乱写, 零分, 起跑线；vt. 搔, 抓, 挖出, 擦, 刮, 乱涂, 勾抹掉；vi. 搔, 抓, 发刮擦声, 勉强糊口；a. 碰巧的, 凑合的, 打草稿用的；[计] 擦除
example: Be careful not to scratch the new car.

meaning: n. a three-dimensional work of plastic art; n. creating figures or designs in three dimensions
translation_zh: n. 雕刻, 雕塑；vt. 雕刻, 雕塑；vi. 当雕刻师
example: The museum has a beautiful collection of modern sculpture.

meaning: n. water containing salts
translation_zh: n. 海水；[化] 海水
example: Seawater is too salty to drink.

meaning: n. plant growing in the sea, especially marine algae
translation_zh: n. 海草, 海藻；[医] 海藻
example: We saw a lot of seaweed washed up on the beach.

meaning: r. in secrecy; not openly; r. not openly; inwardly
translation_zh: adv. 秘密地, 背地里
example: 他秘密地地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: v. assure payment of; a. free from fear or doubt; easy in mind; a. free from danger or risk; a. not likely to fail or give way
translation_zh: a. 无虑的, 安心的, 安全的, 可靠的, 保险的；vt. 固定, 获得, 保证, 使安全, 掩护, 招致；vi. 停止操作, 船抛锚
example: The building is very secure with multiple cameras.

meaning: n. the state of being free from danger or injury; n. defense against financial failure; financial independence; n. freedom from anxiety or fear; n. a formal declaration that documents a fact of relevance to finance and investment; the holder has a right to receive interest or dividends
translation_zh: n. 安全, 安全性, 防护物, 保安, 可靠性, 担保人, 抵押品, 保证金；[计] 安全性, 保密性, 安全检查程序
example: Airport security is very strict.

meaning: v. take hold of; grab; v. take or capture by force; v. hook by a pull on the line; v. affect
translation_zh: vt. 抓住, 逮捕, 俘获, 没收, 扣押, 掌握；vi. 突然抓住, 利用
example: 我们需要逐步seize这个方案。

meaning: v pick out, select, or choose from a number of alternatives; s of superior grade; s selected or chosen for special qualifications
translation_zh: a. 挑选出来的, 极好的；v. 选择, 挑选；n. 被挑选者, 精萃；[计] 选定
example: Please select your preferred option.

meaning: n. an assortment of things from which a choice can be made
translation_zh: n. 选择, 选文, 精选品；[医] 选择, 淘汰
example: 这个选择为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: a. concerned chiefly or only with yourself and your advantage to the exclusion of others
translation_zh: a. 自私的, 利己主义的, 自我中心的
example: It was selfish of him to take the last piece of cake.

meaning: n. an unelaborated elementary awareness of stimulation; n. a general feeling of excitement and heightened interest; n. a state of widespread public excitement and interest
translation_zh: n. 感觉, 轰动；[医] 感觉
example: 这个感觉为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. the state of lacking unity; n. coming apart; n. sorting one thing from others; n. the social act of separating or parting company
translation_zh: n. 分离, 分居, 缺口, 退职；[化] 分离
example: 这个分离为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. serial arrangement in which things follow in logical order or a recurrent pattern; n. a following of one thing after another in time; n. film consisting of a succession of related shots that develop a given subject in a movie; n. several repetitions of a melodic phrase in different keys
translation_zh: n. 序列, 续发事件, 顺序, 连续；vt. 按顺序排好；[计] 顺序
example: 这个顺序为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. similar things placed in order or happening one after another; n. a periodical that appears at scheduled times; n. (sports) several contests played successively by the same teams; n. (electronics) connection of components in such a manner that current flows first through one and then through the other
translation_zh: n. 串联, 序列, 连续, 系列, 丛书, 套, 级数, 组；[计] 系列
example: The TV series has many episodes.

meaning: a. concerned with work or important matters rather than play or trivialities; s. of great consequence; s. requiring effort or concentration; complex and not easy to answer or solve
translation_zh: a. 严肃的, 认真的, 重要的, 严重的；[电] 严重的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常严重的的解释。

meaning: n. (court games) the player who serves to start a point; n. (computer science) a computer that provides client stations with access to files and printers as shared resources to a computer network; n. utensil used in serving food or drink
translation_zh: n. 服伺者, 上菜用具, 发球员；n. 服务器；[计] 服务器, 服务器启动程序, 服务台程序
example: The restaurant server was very polite.

meaning: n. work done by one person or group that benefits another; n. an act of help or assistance; n. the act of public worship following prescribed rules; n. a company or agency that performs a public service; subject to government regulation
translation_zh: n. 服务, 贡献, 雇佣, 公职, 服役, 功劳, 仪式, 送达, 行政部门；vt. 保养, 维修；a. 武装部队的, 服务性的, 仆人的, 耐用的；[计] 服务, 业务
example: The customer service was excellent.

meaning: n. a meeting for execution of a group's functions; n. a meeting devoted to a particular activity
translation_zh: n. 期间, 开庭期, 会议, 学期；[计] 会话, 对话, 会晤, 通用任务程序
example: The training session lasted for two hours.

meaning: n. the context and environment in which something is set; n. the state of the environment in which a situation exists; n. the physical position of something
translation_zh: n. 环境, 背景, 布景, 镶嵌, 调整, 沉落, 一副餐具；[计] 设置
example: The story has a beautiful mountain setting.

meaning: n. a long wooden bench with a back; v. settle into a position, usually on a surface or ground; v. settle conclusively; come to terms; v. take up residence and become established
translation_zh: n. 有背长椅；vt. 决定, 整理, 安放, 使定居, 使平静, 支付, 安排, 解决, 结算；vi. 停留, 下陷, 沉淀, 澄清, 安下心来, 结清, 定居, 安家
example: Let's try to settle this argument peacefully.

meaning: n. a conclusive resolution of a matter and disposition of it; n. something settled or resolved; the outcome of decision making; n. an area where a group of families live together
translation_zh: n. 安顿, 解决, 处理, 结算, 殖民, 殖民地, 沉降；[医] 居住区; 沉渣
example: 这个解决为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a person who settles in a new colony or moves into new country; n. a negotiator who settles disputes; n. a clerk in a betting shop who calculates the winnings
translation_zh: n. 移民者, 解决者, 结算员；[化] 沉淀池; 沉降器; 澄清槽
example: 这个移居者为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: s. intensely or extremely bad or unpleasant in degree or quality; s. unsparing and uncompromising in discipline or judgment; s. very bad in degree or extent
translation_zh: a. 严格的, 尖锐的, 严肃的, 严重的, 严厉的, 朴素的；[法] 严厉的, 苛刻的, 严重的
example: The storm caused severe damage to the coast.

meaning: r to a severe or serious degree; r with sternness; in a severe manner; r causing great damage or hardship
translation_zh: adv. 严格, 尖锐, 严肃, 严重, 严厉, 朴素
example: 他ad地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: n. either of the two categories (male or female) into which most organisms are divided; n. all of the feelings resulting from the urge to gratify sexual impulses; n. the properties that distinguish organisms on the basis of their reproductive roles; v. tell the sex (of young chickens)
translation_zh: n. 性别, 性欲；vt. 区别...的性别, 引起...的性欲
example: Please indicate your sex on the form.

meaning: s. lacking in substance
translation_zh: a. 有影的, 暗黑的, 朦胧的, 虚幻的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常朦胧的的解释。

translation_zh: n. 修面, 刮胡子, 幸免, 剃刀；vt. 修面, 剃, 修剪, 掠过；vi. 刮脸, 勉强通过
