translation_zh: vt. 增威严, 使高贵, 故作显贵
example: 我们需要逐步dignify这个方案。

meaning: n. the quality of being worthy of esteem or respect; n. formality in bearing and appearance; n. high office or rank or station
translation_zh: n. 尊严, 高贵；[法] 尊严, 高位, 高贵
example: 这个尊严为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. state of uncertainty or perplexity especially as requiring a choice between equally unfavorable options
translation_zh: n. 困境, (进退两难的)窘境
example: He faced a difficult dilemma: either miss the meeting or cancel his vacation.

meaning: v. switch (a car's headlights) from a higher to a lower beam; v. become dim or lusterless; v. make dim or lusterless; s. lacking in light; not bright or harsh
translation_zh: a. 暗淡的, 模糊的；vt. 使暗淡；[计] 数据解释模块
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常暗淡的的解释。

meaning: n. a United States coin worth one tenth of a dollar
translation_zh: n. 10分硬币(美、加)
example: 这个（美国、加拿大的）10分铸币为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. the magnitude of something in a particular direction (especially length or width or height); n. one of three Cartesian coordinates that determine a position in space; v. indicate the dimensions on; v. shape or form to required dimensions
translation_zh: n. 尺寸, 次元, 面积, 维数；vt. 标出尺寸
example: We need to consider every dimension of the problem.

meaning: n. a depression in an otherwise level surface; n. (physics) the angle that a magnetic needle makes with the plane of the horizon; n. tasty mixture or liquid into which bite-sized foods are dipped; n. a brief immersion
translation_zh: v. 浸, 降下, 把(手、勺等)伸入, 舀取；n. 浸, 涉猎；[计] 双列直插式组件, 分布式输入输出系统, 双排直插封装
example: 我们需要逐步dip这个方案。

meaning: n. acute contagious infection caused by the bacterium Corynebacterium diphtheriae; marked by the formation of a false membrane in the throat and other air passages causing difficulty in breathing
translation_zh: n. 白喉；[医] 白喉
example: 这个diphtheria（noun）为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a document certifying the successful completion of a course of study
translation_zh: n. 文凭, 毕业证书；[医] 文凭
example: 这个毕业证书为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. an official engaged in international negotiations; n. a person who deals tactfully with others
translation_zh: n. 外交官, 有外交手腕的人；[法] 外交家, 外交官, 有权谋的人
example: The diplomat worked to improve relations between the two nations.

meaning: n. the act of leaving secretly or without explanation; n. the event of passing out of sight; n. ceasing to exist
translation_zh: n. 看不见, 失踪, 消失
example: The police are investigating the mysterious disappearance of the artifact.

meaning: n. a feeling of disliking something or what someone is doing; n. the expression of disapproval; n. the act of disapproving or condemning
translation_zh: n. 不赞成
example: Her parents expressed their strong disapproval of her new boyfriend.

meaning: v. consider bad or wrong; v. deem wrong or inappropriate
translation_zh: v. 不赞成
example: 我们需要逐步disapprove这个方案。

meaning: n. the sudden giving off of energy; n. the act of venting; n. a substance that is emitted or released; n. any of several bodily processes by which substances go out of the body
translation_zh: vt. 卸下, 放出, 解雇, 拔染, 履行, 放电；vi. 卸货, 流出；n. 卸货, 流出, 放电
example: The hospital will discharge the patient tomorrow.

meaning: n. someone who believes and helps to spread the doctrine of another
translation_zh: n. 弟子, 门徒
example: 这个耶稣的十二门徒之一（=the Disciples）为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a branch of knowledge; n. a system of rules of conduct or method of practice;; n. the trait of being well behaved; n. training to improve strength or self-control
translation_zh: n. 训练, 纪律；vt. 训练, 惩罚
example: 这个训练为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: v. make disconnected, disjoin or unfasten
translation_zh: vt. 使分离, 使不相连, 拆开；vi. 断开；[计] 断开
example: 我们需要逐步disconnect这个方案。

meaning: v. cause to be distrusted or disbelieved; v. damage the reputation of
translation_zh: n. 无信用, 丢脸, 不名誉；vt. 不信, 怀疑, 使丢脸
example: 我们需要逐步discredit这个方案。

meaning: v. recognize or perceive the difference; v. treat differently on the basis of sex or race; v. distinguish; a. marked by the ability to see or make fine distinctions
translation_zh: v. 区别, 差别待遇
example: It is illegal to discriminate against someone based on their age.

meaning: n a state of dishonor; v bring shame or dishonor upon; v reduce in worth or character, usually verbally; v damage the reputation of
translation_zh: n. 耻辱, 不名誉；vt. 使受耻辱, 使失体面
example: His actions brought disgrace upon his family.

meaning: n. an outward semblance that misrepresents the true nature of something; n. any attire that modifies the appearance in order to conceal the wearer's identity; n. the act of concealing the identity of something by modifying its appearance; v. make unrecognizable
translation_zh: n. 假面目, 假装；vt. 假装, 隐瞒
example: He wore a clever disguise to the party.

meaning: n. the quality of being dishonest; n. lack of honesty; acts of lying or cheating or stealing
translation_zh: n. 不诚实；[法] 不诚实, 诈欺, 不正
example: His dishonesty led to his dismissal from the company.

meaning: n freeing from false belief or illusions; v free from enchantment
translation_zh: n. 觉醒, 幻灭；vt. 使醒悟, 使幻想破灭
example: 我们需要逐步disillusion这个方案。

meaning: v. bar from attention or consideration; v. cease to consider; put out of judicial consideration; v. stop associating with; v. end one's encounter with somebody by causing or permitting the person to leave
translation_zh: vt. 解散, 开除, 解职；vi. 解散；[计] 解散
example: 我们需要逐步dismiss这个方案。

meaning: n. a physical condition in which there is a disturbance of normal functioning; n. a disturbance of the peace or of public order; v. bring disorder to
translation_zh: n. 杂乱, 混乱；vt. 扰乱, 使失调
example: The room was in complete disorder after the party.

meaning: a. undisciplined and unruly; s. in utter disorder
translation_zh: a. 无秩序的, 乱的, 骚乱的；[法] 妨害治安的, 骚乱的, 无法无天的
example: The police were called to break up a disorderly crowd.

meaning: a. capable of being dispensed with or done without
translation_zh: a. 不是必要的, 可有可无的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常不必要的的解释。

meaning: v. cause to move, usually with force or pressure; v. terminate the employment of; discharge from an office or position
translation_zh: vt. 移置, 替换, 转移
example: The new factory will displace many local workers.

meaning: n. the feeling of being displeased or annoyed or dissatisfied with someone or something
translation_zh: n. 不愉快, 生气, 不满
example: The manager expressed his displeasure with the team's performance.

meaning: n. the power to use something or someone; n. the act or means of getting rid of something; n. a kitchen appliance for disposing of garbage
translation_zh: n. 丢掉, 处理, 排列, 销毁, 布置；[医] 处理, 处置
example: Waste disposal is a major environmental concern.

meaning: n. your usual mood; n. a natural or acquired habit or characteristic tendency in a person or thing
translation_zh: n. 性情, 处置, 处理, 布置；[医] 素因, 性情
example: 这个性情为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a disagreement or argument about something important; n. coming into conflict with
translation_zh: n. 争论；v. 争论
example: They had a dispute over the property.

meaning: v. make unfit or unsuitable; v. declare unfit
translation_zh: vt. 使不适合, 取消...资格
example: The athlete was disqualified for using banned substances.

meaning: n. lack of attention and due care; n. willful lack of care and attention
translation_zh: n. 忽视, 漠视；vt. 忽视, 不顾
example: He showed a complete disregard for the rules.

meaning: v. throw into disorder
translation_zh: a. 分裂的, 中断的；vt. 使分裂, 使瓦解
example: The loud music began to disrupt the class.

meaning: n. the feeling of being displeased and discontent
translation_zh: n. 不满, 不平
example: There was widespread dissatisfaction with the new policy.

meaning: v fail to satisfy; s in a state of sulky dissatisfaction
translation_zh: a. 不满的, 显出不满的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常使不满（dissatisfy的过去式和过去分词） adj. 不满意的的解释。

meaning: s. characterized by departure from accepted beliefs or standards
translation_zh: a. 意见不同的, 持不同政见的；n. 意见不同的人, 持不同政见者
example: 这个持异议者为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: s. (used of persons) standing above others in character or attainment or reputation; s. used of a person's appearance or behavior; befitting an eminent person
translation_zh: a. 卓著的, 著名的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常卓越的的解释。

meaning: n. a change for the worse; n. a change (usually undesired) in the waveform of an acoustic or analog electrical signal; the difference between two measurements of a signal (as between the input and output signal); n. the act of distorting something so it seems to mean something it was not intended to mean
translation_zh: n. 扭曲, 变形, 曲解；[计] 畸变; 失真
example: 这个扭曲为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: v. draw someone's attention away from something
translation_zh: vt. 转移, 分心, 使发狂
example: 我们需要逐步distract这个方案。

meaning: n. mental turmoil; n. an obstacle to attention; n. the act of distracting; drawing someone's attention away from something
translation_zh: n. 娱乐, 分心的事物, 分心；[医] 注意力分散, 内脱位, 牙弓过宽
example: The noise was a major distraction.

meaning: s. causing distress or worry or anxiety
translation_zh: a. 使痛苦的, 使烦恼的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常使人痛苦的的解释。

meaning: n. someone who markets merchandise; n. a company that markets merchandise; n. electrical device that distributes voltage to the spark plugs of a gasoline engine in the order of the firing sequence
translation_zh: n. 分发者, 分布者, 散布者, 分配者, 销售者, 分配器, 配电盘, 自动拆版机；[计] 分配器
example: We are looking for a new distributor for our products in Asia.

meaning: n. an activity that diverts or amuses or stimulates; n. a turning aside (of your course or attention or concern); n. an attack calculated to draw enemy defense away from the point of the principal attack
translation_zh: n. 转移；[医] 转向
example: The road closure caused a major diversion.

meaning: v. send on a course or in a direction different from the planned or intended one; v. withdraw (money) and move into a different location, often secretly and with dishonest intentions
translation_zh: vt. 转移, 使欢娱；vi. 转移
example: The police had to divert traffic.

meaning: a. separated into parts or pieces; s. having a median strip or island between lanes of traffic moving in opposite directions; s. distributed in portions (often equal) on the basis of a plan or purpose
translation_zh: a. 分开的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常分离的的解释。

meaning: n. an army unit large enough to sustain combat; n. the act or process of dividing; n. an administrative unit in government or business; n. discord that splits a group
translation_zh: n. 分, 分开, 除法, 部门(如部、处、系等), 师；[计] 部分
example: The division of tasks made the project easier.

meaning: n. the legal dissolution of a marriage; v. get a divorce; formally terminate a marriage
translation_zh: n. 离婚；vt. 与...离婚
example: 这个使离婚为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n (biochemistry) a long linear polymer found in the nucleus of a cell and formed from nucleotides and shaped like a double helix; associated with the transmission of genetic information
translation_zh: 脱氧核糖核酸；[计] 无效数据, 数字网络体系结构, 分布式网络体系结构
example: DNA carries genetic information in all living organisms.

meaning: n. an enclosure in a court of law where the defendant sits during the trial; n. any of certain coarse weedy plants with long taproots, sometimes used as table greens or in folk medicine; n. a platform where trucks or trains can be loaded or unloaded; n. landing in a harbor next to a pier where ships are loaded and unloaded or repaired; may have gates to let water in or out
translation_zh: n. 码头, 船坞, 被告席, 尾巴的骨肉部分；vt. 使靠码头, 使(船)进港, 剪短；vi. 进港
example: 这个码头为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a servant who is paid to perform menial tasks around the household; a. of concern to or concerning the internal affairs of a nation; a. of or relating to the home; a. of or involving the home or family
translation_zh: a. 家庭的, 国内的, 驯养的；[医] 家庭的, 家用的
example: We need to address domestic issues first.

meaning: v. be in control; v. have dominance or the power to defeat over; v. look down on
translation_zh: v. 支配, 占优势
example: The team managed to dominate the game from start to finish.

meaning: v. give to a charity or good cause
translation_zh: v. 捐赠
example: 我们需要逐步donate这个方案。

meaning: n a voluntary gift (as of money or service or ideas) made to some worthwhile cause; n act of giving in common with others for a common purpose especially to a charity
translation_zh: n. 捐赠物, 捐款, 捐赠；[经] 赠品, 捐款, 捐赠
example: 这个捐赠为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. the symbol of the Democratic Party; introduced in cartoons by Thomas Nast in 1874
translation_zh: n. 驴子, 笨蛋, 顽固者, 辅助发动机, 辅助泵
example: 这个驴为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. an unpleasant or disastrous destiny; v. make certain of the failure or destruction of
translation_zh: n. 厄运, 不幸, 法律, 宣告, 判决, 死亡；vt. 命中注定, 判决
example: The ancient prophecy spoke of a terrible doom.

meaning: n. the lowest of the minor Holy Orders in the unreformed Western Church but now suppressed by the Roman Catholic Church; n. someone who guards an entrance
translation_zh: n. 看门人, 门卫
example: 这个doorkeeper（noun）为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. the entrance (the space in a wall) through which you enter or leave a room or building; the space that a door can close
translation_zh: n. 门口, 途径
example: 这个门口为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n a college or university building containing living quarters for students
translation_zh: n. 宿舍
example: 这个宿舍为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a college or university building containing living quarters for students; n. a large sleeping room containing several beds
translation_zh: n. 宿舍
example: 这个集体宿舍为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a measured portion of medicine taken at any one time; n. the quantity of an active agent (substance or radiation) taken in or absorbed at any one time; v. treat with an agent; add (an agent) to
translation_zh: n. 剂量, 服用量；vt. 给药, (用药)医治；vi. 服药
example: 这个剂量为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: r. to double the degree; r. in a twofold manner
translation_zh: adv. 加倍地, 双重地；[计] 双地
example: 他加倍地地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: s. open to doubt or suspicion; s. fraught with uncertainty or doubt; s. unsettled in mind or opinion
translation_zh: a. 可疑的, 疑心的, 不明确的；[法] 怀疑的, 有疑问的, 未确的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常难以预测的的解释。

meaning: n. any of numerous small pigeons; n. someone who prefers negotiations to armed conflict in the conduct of foreign relations; n. an emblem of peace
translation_zh: n. 鸽子；dive的过去式
example: 这个鸽为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. soft fine feathers; n. (American football) a complete play to advance the football; n. English physician who first described Down's syndrome (1828-1896); n. (usually plural) a rolling treeless highland with little soil
translation_zh: a. 向下的；adv. 下, 下去, 降下；prep. 往下, 沿着；n. 丘陵, 软毛, 开阔的高地；[计] 向下, 退下命令
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常（坐、倒、躺）下的解释。

meaning: n. failure that results in a loss of position or reputation
translation_zh: n. 衰败, 大雨
example: His arrogance led to his downfall.

meaning: v. dismiss from work; v. make in a smaller size; v. reduce in size or number
translation_zh: vt. 以较小尺寸设计；缩小尺寸；裁减人数
example: The company decided to downsize its workforce to cut costs.

meaning: n. money or property brought by a woman to her husband at marriage
translation_zh: n. 嫁妆；[法] 陪嫁物, 嫁妆
example: In some cultures, a dowry is still an important part of marriage traditions.

meaning: n. emptying something accomplished by allowing liquid to run out of it; n. tube inserted into a body cavity (as during surgery) to remove unwanted material; n. a pipe through which liquid is carried away; n. a gradual depletion of energy or resources
translation_zh: n. 排水沟, 消耗, 排水；vt. 排出, 喝光, 耗尽；vi. 排水, 流干
example: 这个排水为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: r. in a very impressive manner; r. in a dramatic manner; r. with respect to dramatic value
translation_zh: adv. 戏剧地, 引人注目地, 突然地
example: The situation changed dramatically.

meaning: n. cloth gracefully draped and arranged in loose folds
translation_zh: n. 帏帐, 布料
example: The elegant drapery framed the large window.

meaning: n fearful expectation or anticipation; v be afraid or scared of; be frightened of; s causing fear or dread or terror
translation_zh: n. 恐惧, 可怕的人(或事)；a. 可怕的, 可怖的；v. 恐惧, 害怕
example: She felt a sense of dread as the deadline approached.

meaning: s. very unpleasant
translation_zh: a. 可怕的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常可怕的的解释。

meaning: s. dreamy in mood or nature; s. lacking spirit or liveliness
translation_zh: a. 空幻的, 梦想的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常如梦的的解释。

meaning: a. suitable for drinking
translation_zh: a. 可以喝的, 饮用的；n. 饮料
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常drinkable（adjective）的解释。

meaning: v. hang loosely or laxly
translation_zh: vi. 下垂, 消沉；vt. 使下垂；n. 低垂, 消沉
example: The flowers began to droop after a few days without water.

meaning: n. someone who quits school before graduation; n. someone who withdraws from a social group or environment
translation_zh: n. 退学学生, 中途退学；[电] 离去
example: He became a successful entrepreneur despite being a college dropout.

meaning: n. a shortage of rainfall; n. a prolonged shortage
translation_zh: n. 干旱, 缺乏
example: The region is experiencing a severe drought.

meaning: n. a prearranged fight with deadly weapons by two people (accompanied by seconds) in order to settle a quarrel over a point of honor; n. any struggle between two skillful opponents (individuals or groups); v. fight a duel, as over one's honor or a woman
translation_zh: n. 决斗, 斗争；vi. 决斗
example: The two knights fought a duel.

meaning: n. a copy that corresponds to an original exactly; v. make or do or perform again; v. make a duplicate or duplicates of; s. identically copied from an original
translation_zh: n. 副本, 复本, 复制品；a. 复制的, 二重的；vt. 复制, 使加倍；[计] 复制
example: Make sure you don't create duplicate files on your computer.

meaning: n. the act of copying or making a duplicate (or duplicates) of something
translation_zh: n. 副本, 复制；[医] 重迭, 双折, 复制
example: We need to avoid duplication of effort in this project.

meaning: n. a person who is markedly small; n. a plant or animal that is atypically small; v. check the growth of
translation_zh: n. 矮子, 侏儒；v. (使)变矮小
example: 这个侏儒为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a usually soluble substance for staining or coloring e.g. fabrics or hair; v. color with dye
translation_zh: n. 颜料, 染料；vt. 染, 染色；vi. 被着色
example: 这个染料为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: a. characterized by action or forcefulness or force of personality; a. of or relating to dynamics
translation_zh: a. 动态的, 有活力的, 有力的, 动力的, 不断变化的；n. 动力, 动态；[计] 动态的
example: The city has a dynamic and growing economy.

meaning: r. with eagerness; in an eager manner
translation_zh: adv. 渴望, 热衷于, 热切
example: 他渴望地地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: n. any of various large keen-sighted diurnal birds of prey noted for their broad wings and strong soaring flight; n. (golf) a score of two strokes under par on a hole; n. a former gold coin in the United States worth 10 dollars; n. an emblem representing power
translation_zh: n. 鹰, 鹰状标饰
example: 这个鹰为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n the excess of revenues over outlays in a given period of time (including depreciation and other non-cash expenses); n something that remunerates; v earn on some commercial or business transaction; earn as salary or wages; v acquire or deserve by one's efforts or actions
translation_zh: n. 所赚的钱, 工资, 收入；[经] 工资, 收入, 收益, 盈余
example: 这个收入为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. freedom from difficulty or hardship or effort; n. a freedom from financial difficulty that promotes a comfortable state; n. freedom from constraint or embarrassment; v. move gently or carefully
translation_zh: n. 安乐, 安逸, 悠闲；vt. 使安乐, 使安心, 减轻, 放松；vi. 减轻, 放松, 灵活地移动
example: 这个减轻为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: r. toward the east
translation_zh: n. 朝东方向；a. 向东方的；adv. 向东
example: 他向东方的地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: r. with respect to ecology; economically, it is a disaster"
translation_zh: adv. 从生态学的观点看
example: 他从生态学的观点看地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: n. a biologist who studies the relation between organisms and their environment
translation_zh: n. 生态学者
example: An ecologist presented findings on climate change.

meaning: s. avoiding waste
translation_zh: a. 节俭的, 经济的, 合算的；[经] 经济的, 节约的
example: Buying in bulk can be more economical in the long run.

meaning: n. an expert in the science of economics
translation_zh: n. 经济学者, 经济家；[经] 经济学家
example: The economist predicted a rise in inflation next year.

meaning: s. feeling great rapture or delight
translation_zh: n. 狂喜的人；a. 狂喜的
example: She was ecstatic when she heard the good news.

meaning: v. prepare for publication or presentation by correcting, revising, or adapting; v. supervise the publication of; v. cut and assemble the components of; v. cut or eliminate
translation_zh: vt. 编辑, 编校, 修订, 剪辑；[计] 编辑; DOS外部命令:该命令是一个用于编辑文本文件的全屏幕编辑程序
example: 这个编辑为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: a. of or relating to an article stating opinions or giving perspectives; a. relating to or characteristic of an editor
translation_zh: n. 社论, 评论；a. 编辑的, 主笔的, 社论的
example: The newspaper's editorial criticized the new policy.

meaning: a. possessing an education (especially having more than average knowledge); s. characterized by full comprehension of the problem involved
translation_zh: a. 受过教育的, 有教养的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常有教育的的解释。

meaning: n. someone who educates young people
translation_zh: n. 教育家
example: 这个（尤指作为一种职业的）教育工作者为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: r. in actuality or reality or fact
translation_zh: adv. 有效地, 有力地, 实际上
example: The new system effectively reduced costs.

meaning: n. power to be effective; the quality of being able to bring about an effect
translation_zh: n. 效力；[经] 有效性, 能行性
example: The effectiveness of the new policy is still being evaluated.

meaning: a. subject to popular election; s. not compulsory
translation_zh: a. 选举的, 根据选举的, 选修的；n. 选修课程
example: Students can choose two elective courses this semester.

meaning: n. a person who installs or repairs electrical or telephone lines
translation_zh: n. 电学家, 电气技师, 电工；[化] 电工; 电气工人
example: 这个电工为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: r. by electronic means
translation_zh: adv. 电子地
example: 他电子地地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: n. the branch of physics that deals with the emission and effects of electrons and with the use of electronic devices
translation_zh: n. 电子学；[计] 电子学
example: 这个电子学为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a refined quality of gracefulness and good taste; n. a quality of neatness and ingenious simplicity in the solution of a problem (especially in science or mathematics)
translation_zh: n. 高雅, 典雅, 优雅
example: Her dress had an air of timeless elegance.

meaning: a. refined and tasteful in appearance or behavior or style; s. suggesting taste, ease, and wealth; s. displaying effortless beauty and simplicity in movement or execution
translation_zh: a. 优雅的, 端庄的, 高雅的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常优美的的解释。

meaning: r. with elegance; in a tastefully elegant manner; r. in a gracefully elegant manner
translation_zh: adv. 优美地
example: 他优美地地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: a. relating to or being an element; a. relating to severe atmospheric conditions
translation_zh: a. 元素的, 基本的
example: Water is an elemental force of nature.

meaning: a. qualified for or allowed or worthy of being chosen
translation_zh: a. 有资格当选的, 合格的；n. 有资格者, 合格者, 适任者
example: Only citizens are eligible to vote.

meaning: n. a group or class of persons enjoying superior intellectual or social or economic status
translation_zh: n. 精华, 精锐, 中坚分子
example: 这个（社会）上层集团为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. powerful and effective language
translation_zh: n. 口才, 雄辩术, 雄辩；[法] 善辩, 口才
example: 这个流利的口才为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: s. expressing yourself readily, clearly, effectively
translation_zh: a. 雄辩的, 有口才的, 有说服力的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常雄辩的的解释。

meaning: n. a diplomatic building where ambassadors live or work; n. an ambassador and his entourage collectively
translation_zh: n. 大使馆, 大使馆全体人员；[经] 大使馆
example: We visited the American embassy in London.

meaning: n. the act of clasping another person in the arms (as in greeting or affection); n. the state of taking in or encircling; n. a close affectionate and protective acceptance; v. include in scope; include as part of something broader; have as one's sphere or territory
translation_zh: n. 拥抱；vt. 拥抱, 互相拥抱, 包含, 收买；vi. 拥抱
example: She embraced the new challenge with enthusiasm.

meaning: n. the gradual beginning or coming forth; n. the becoming visible; n. the act of emerging
translation_zh: n. 出现, 浮现, 发生
example: The emergence of new technologies has changed our lives.

meaning: r without question and beyond doubt
translation_zh: adv. 强调地, 着重地
example: She emphatically denied the accusations.

meaning: n the state of being employed or having a job; v put into service; make work or employ for a particular purpose or for its inherent or natural purpose; v engage or hire for work
translation_zh: n. 雇用；vt. 雇用, 使用, 使从事于
example: 我们需要逐步employ这个方案。

meaning: n. a person or firm that employs workers
translation_zh: n. 雇主, 老板；[经] 雇主, 业主
example: 这个雇主为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: r. with unflagging resolve; r. (spatial sense) without bounds
translation_zh: adv. 不断地, 无穷尽地
example: 他无穷地地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: v. sign as evidence of legal transfer
translation_zh: vt. 支持, 赞同, 背书于, 签署；[经] 赞成, 背书
example: 我们需要逐步endorse这个方案。

meaning: n. the power to withstand hardship or stress
translation_zh: n. 忍耐, 忍耐力, 耐性；[机] 持九性
example: Running a marathon requires great endurance.

meaning: s. patiently bearing continual wrongs or trouble
translation_zh: a. 持久的, 忍耐的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常持久的的解释。

meaning: v. ensure observance of laws and rules;; v. compel to behave in a certain way
translation_zh: vt. 强迫, 执行, 坚持；[经] 予以强制执行
example: The police are here to enforce the law.

meaning: n. employment for performers or performing groups that lasts for a limited period of time; n. contact by fitting together; n. the act of sharing in the activities of a group
translation_zh: n. 诺言, 约会, 婚约, 交战；[医] 衔接
example: Their engagement was announced last week.

meaning: v. flow over or cover completely
translation_zh: vt. 卷入, 吸进, 吞没, 使全神贯注
example: The flames quickly engulfed the old building.

meaning: v. increase; v. make better or more attractive
translation_zh: vt. 提高, 加强, 增加
example: This software can enhance the quality of your photos.

meaning: n. a purposeful or industrious undertaking (especially one that requires effort or boldness); n. an organization created for business ventures; n. readiness to embark on bold new ventures
translation_zh: n. 企业, 事业心, 进取心, 干事业；[计] 企业
example: Starting a new enterprise requires courage.

meaning: s. agreeably diverting
translation_zh: a. 使人愉快的, 有趣的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常有趣的的解释。

meaning: r. with enthusiasm; in an enthusiastic manner
translation_zh: adv. 热心地, 狂热地
example: 他热心地地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: v. give the right to; v. give a title to
translation_zh: vt. 给...权利, 取名为, 给予名称, 叫做；[法] 给...权利, 使有资格, 称呼
example: 我们需要逐步entitle这个方案。

meaning: n. someone who organizes a business venture and assumes the risk for it
translation_zh: n. 企业家, 主办人；[经] 承包商, 企业家
example: She is a successful entrepreneur who started her own tech company.

meaning: r. for the environment
translation_zh: adv. 有关环境方面
example: 他有关环境方面地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: n. a mathematical statement that two expressions are equal; n. the act of regarding as equal
translation_zh: n. 相等, 等式, 平衡；[化] 方程式; 等式; 反应式; 公式
example: Solve the equation for x.

meaning: v. provide with (something) usually for a specific purpose; v. provide with abilities or understanding
translation_zh: vt. 装备, 配备；[机] 设备, 装置
example: The school aims to equip students with essential skills.

meaning: n. the difference between the market value of a property and the claims held against it; n. the ownership interest of shareholders in a corporation
translation_zh: n. 公平, 公正；[经] 权益, 产权
example: 这个公平为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: a. upright in position or posture
translation_zh: a. 直立的, 竖立的, 笔直的；vt. 使竖立, 使直立, 树立, 建立；vi. 勃起
example: They plan to erect a new monument in the town square.

meaning: v. start abruptly; v. erupt or intensify suddenly; v. start to burn or burst into flames; v. break out
translation_zh: vi. 爆发；vt. 喷出
example: The volcano is expected to erupt soon.

meaning: n. symptom consisting of a breaking out and becoming visible; n. (of volcanos) pouring out fumes or lava (or a deposit so formed); n. the emergence of a tooth as it breaks through the gum
translation_zh: n. 爆发, 喷出物, 出疹；[化] 喷发
example: The volcanic eruption caused widespread ashfall.

meaning: n. a writer of literary works
translation_zh: n. 随笔作家, 评论家
example: 这个小品作者为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: r in essence; at bottom or by one's (or its) very nature
translation_zh: adv. 本质上, 本来
example: Essentially, we need to start over.

meaning: n. everything you own; all of your assets (whether real property or personal property) and liabilities; n. extensive landed property (especially in the country) retained by the owner for his own use
translation_zh: n. 不动产, (人生的)阶段, 阶层, 财产；[经] 房地产, 遗产, 财产
example: The family owns a large country estate.

meaning: n. an approximate calculation of quantity or degree or worth; n. a judgment of the qualities of something or somebody; n. a statement indicating the likely cost of some job; n. the respect with which a person is held
translation_zh: n. 估计, 判断；vt. 估计, 评价, 判断；vi. 估计
example: Can you estimate the cost of the repairs?

meaning: v judge tentatively or form an estimate of (quantities or time); v judge to be probable
translation_zh: a. 估算的；估计的；预计的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常估计的的解释。

meaning: r for a limitless time
translation_zh: adv. 永恒地, 常常
example: 他永恒地地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: n. the principles of right and wrong that are accepted by an individual or a social group; n. a system of principles governing morality and acceptable conduct
translation_zh: n. 道德规范, 伦理
example: 这个伦理为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a person who is a member of an ethnic group
translation_zh: a. 人种的, 种族的；[医] 人种的
example: The city is known for its diverse ethnic groups.

meaning: v. move out of an unsafe location into safety; v. empty completely; v. move people from their homes or country; v. create a vacuum in (a bulb, flask, reaction vessel)
translation_zh: v. 疏散, 撤出, 排泄
example: The police ordered everyone to evacuate the building immediately.

meaning: n. the act of evacuating; leaving a place in an orderly fashion; especially for protection
translation_zh: n. 撤退, 疏散；[化] 抽空; 排空
example: The evacuation of the building was ordered due to the fire.

meaning: v. form a critical opinion of
translation_zh: vt. 评估, 评价, 赋值
example: We need to evaluate the risks before proceeding.

meaning: n. act of ascertaining or fixing the value or worth of; n. an appraisal of the value of something
translation_zh: n. 评估, 估价, 求值；[计] 鉴定; 评价; 求值
example: The teacher gave an evaluation of the student's progress.

meaning: n. any of various plants of various genera of the family Compositae having flowers that can be dried without loss of form or color
translation_zh: a. 永恒的, 持久的；n. 上帝, 神
example: They promised each other everlasting love.

meaning: r unmistakably (`plain' is often used informally for `plainly')
translation_zh: adv. 明显地, 根据现有证据来看
example: Evidently, he was not happy with the decision.

meaning: n. morally objectionable behavior; n. that which causes harm or destruction or misfortune; the good is oft interred with their bones"- Shakespeare; n. the quality of being morally wrong in principle or practice; a. morally bad or wrong
translation_zh: n. 邪恶, 不幸, 罪恶；a. 邪恶的, 不幸的, 有害的, 讨厌的
example: He believed the villain was truly evil.

meaning: n. (biology) the sequence of events involved in the evolutionary development of a species or taxonomic group of organisms
translation_zh: n. 进化, 发展, 进展, (气体)放出, 开方；[医] 进化, 演化, 旋出
example: The evolution of technology is rapid.

meaning: v. work out; v. undergo development or evolution
translation_zh: vi. 进展, 进化, 展开；vt. 使发展, 使推断出, 使进化
example: Species evolve over millions of years.

meaning: n. the quality of being exact
translation_zh: n. 正确, 精确
example: 这个exactness（noun）为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: v to enlarge beyond bounds or the truth; v do something to an excessive degree
translation_zh: v. 夸大, 夸张
example: Don't exaggerate; it wasn't that bad.

meaning: n. the act of making something more noticeable than usual; n. making to seem more important than it really is
translation_zh: n. 夸张, 夸大的事物, 夸大之词
example: His story was full of exaggeration.

meaning: v. raise in rank, character, or status
translation_zh: vt. 提升, 提高, 赞扬, 使得意；vi. 使人兴奋, 使人得意
example: 我们需要逐步exalt这个方案。

meaning: n someone who is tested (as by an intelligence test or an academic examination)
translation_zh: n. 受试人, 应试者；[法] 受审人, 接受讯问者, 接受考试者
example: 这个examinee（noun）为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: v. be greater in scope or size than some standard; v. be superior or better than some standard
translation_zh: vt. 超过, 超越, 胜过；vi. 超过其他
example: Do not exceed the speed limit.

meaning: v. distinguish oneself
translation_zh: vt. 胜过, 优于, 擅长；vi. 胜过其他
example: 我们需要逐步excel这个方案。

meaning: n. a deliberate act of omission; n. an instance that does not conform to a rule or generalization; the only exception was her last child"; n. grounds for adverse criticism
translation_zh: n. 例外, 除外, 异议；[计] 例外; 异常
example: 这个例外为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: s. deviating widely from a norm of physical or mental ability; used especially of children below normal in intelligence
translation_zh: a. 例外的, 异常的, 特别的
example: Her performance was truly exceptional.

meaning: r. to an exceptional degree
translation_zh: adv. 特殊地；异常地；例外地
example: 他例外地地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: s. beyond normal limits; s. unrestrained, especially with regard to feelings
translation_zh: a. 过度的, 过多的, 极端的；[法] 过度的, 过分的, 额外的
example: The noise level was excessive.

meaning: v. utter aloud; often with surprise, horror, or joy
translation_zh: v. 大叫, 呼喊, 大声叫
example: 我们需要逐步exclaim这个方案。

meaning: v. prevent from being included or considered or accepted; v. prevent from entering; shut out; v. lack or fail to include
translation_zh: vt. 除外, 排除, 排斥；[医] 除外(诊断)
example: The club decided to exclude members who didn't pay their fees.

meaning: n. the state of being excluded
translation_zh: n. 排除, 除外, 逐出；[医] 排除, 除外, 分离术
example: The exclusion of certain groups from the event caused controversy.

meaning: r without any others being included or involved
translation_zh: adv. 排他地, 仅仅, 专门, 只, 仅, 唯一地, 专有地
example: This offer is available exclusively to our members.

meaning: n. a journey taken for pleasure
translation_zh: n. 远足, 游览圆, 短程旅行；[医] 移动, 离轨, 逸出
example: 这个（尤指集体）远足为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: v. kill as a means of socially sanctioned punishment; v. murder in a planned fashion; v. carry out the legalities of; v. sign in the presence of witnesses
translation_zh: vt. 执行, 实行, 完成, 处死, 制成；[计] 执行
example: The team needs to execute the plan perfectly.

meaning: n. putting a condemned person to death; n. (computer science) the process of carrying out an instruction by a computer; n. (law) the completion of a legal instrument (such as a contract or deed) by signing it (and perhaps sealing and delivering it) so that it becomes legally binding and enforceable
translation_zh: n. 实行, 完成, 执行, 死刑；[计] 执行
example: 这个依法处决实行为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a person responsible for the administration of a business; n. persons who administer the law; a. having the function of carrying out plans or orders etc.
translation_zh: n. 执行部门, 执行委员会, 执行者, 经理主管人员；a. 执行的, 善于执行的, 善于经营的；[计] 执行程序
example: She is a senior executive at the company.

meaning: n. gases ejected from an engine as waste products; n. system consisting of the parts of an engine through which burned gases or steam are discharged; v. wear out completely; v. use up the whole supply of
translation_zh: n. 排气, 排气装置, 废气；vt. 抽完, 用尽, 耗尽, 使精疲力尽；vi. 排气
example: 这个用尽为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: s. producing exhaustion
translation_zh: a. 使耗尽的, 使人筋疲力尽的；[计] 经验, 技巧, 穷举, 耗尽, 排气
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常使耗尽的的解释。

meaning: n. extreme fatigue; n. the act of exhausting something entirely
translation_zh: n. 抽空, 耗尽, 疲惫, 筋疲力尽；[化] 抽空
example: 这个疲惫为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. an object or statement produced before a court of law and referred to while giving evidence; v. show an attribute, property, knowledge, or skill
translation_zh: n. 显示, 显现, 展览品, 陈列品, 展览；vt. 展现, 陈列, 展览；vi. 开展览会
example: The museum will exhibit ancient artifacts.

meaning: n. a person who is voluntarily absent from home or country; n. a person who is expelled from home or country by authority; n. the act of expelling a person from their native land
translation_zh: n. 放逐, 流放, 被放逐者；vt. 放逐, 流放, 使背井离乡
example: The political leader lived in exile for many years.

meaning: s. presently existing; s. existing in something specified
translation_zh: a. 存在的, 目前的, 现存的, 现有的；[计] 现成的, 已有的, 现存的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常目前的的解释。

meaning: s. strikingly strange or unusual
translation_zh: a. 异国的, 外来的；n. 外来人, 外来物, 舶来品
example: The market sold a variety of exotic fruits.

meaning: n. the act of increasing (something) in size or volume or quantity or scope; n. a function expressed as a sum or product of terms; n. a discussion that provides additional information
translation_zh: n. 扩充, 开展, 膨胀；[计] 扩展
example: The company announced its expansion into new markets.

meaning: n. belief about (or mental picture of) the future; n. the feeling that something is about to happen
translation_zh: n. 期待, 指望, 展望；[化] 期望值
example: His performance exceeded all expectations.

meaning: a. considered likely or probable to happen or arrive
translation_zh: a. 预期的；预料的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常（用作定语）预期要发生的的解释。

meaning: n. a military campaign designed to achieve a specific objective in a foreign country; n. an organized group of people undertaking a journey for a particular purpose; n. a journey organized for a particular purpose
translation_zh: n. 远征, 探险队, 迅速
example: They planned an expedition to the Amazon rainforest.

meaning: v. cause to burst with a violent release of energy; v. burst outward, usually with noise; v. show a violent emotional reaction; v. be unleashed; emerge with violence or noise
translation_zh: vi. 爆炸, 爆发, 激增；vt. 使爆炸
example: 我们需要逐步explode这个方案。

meaning: v. use or manipulate to one's advantage; v. draw from; make good use of
translation_zh: n. 功绩, 勋绩；vt. 开发, 利用, 开拓, 剥削
example: 我们需要逐步exploit这个方案。

meaning: n. someone who travels into little known regions (especially for some scientific purpose)
translation_zh: n. 探险家, 探测者, 勘探器；[医] 探察器
example: 这个探险家为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a chemical substance that undergoes a rapid chemical change (with the production of gas) on being heated or struck; a. serving to explode or characterized by explosion or sudden outburst; s. liable to lead to sudden change or violence; s. sudden and loud
translation_zh: n. 炸药, 爆破音；a. 易爆发的, 爆炸的, 暴躁的
example: The situation became explosive after the announcement.

meaning: n. commodities (goods or services) sold to a foreign country; v. sell or transfer abroad; v. transfer (electronic data) out of a database or document in a format that can be used by other programs; v. cause to spread in another part of the world
translation_zh: n. 输出品, 输出；vt. 输出, 出口；vi. 输出物资；[计] 导出
example: Coffee is a major export of Brazil.

meaning: s. characterized by expression
translation_zh: a. 表达的, 富于表情的
example: Her face was very expressive, showing all her emotions.

meaning: s. intense or sharp; s. lavishly elegant and refined; s. of extreme beauty
translation_zh: a. 精致的, 细腻的, 敏锐的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常精致的的解释。

meaning: n. a mutually agreed delay in the date set for the completion of a job or payment of a debt; n. act of expanding in scope; making more widely available; n. an educational opportunity provided by colleges and universities to people who are not enrolled as regular students; n. act of stretching or straightening out a flexed limb
translation_zh: n. 延长, 扩充, 范围, 扩展名；a. 伸缩的；[计] 扩展名, 扩充名
example: They requested an extension for the project deadline.

meaning: s. large in spatial extent or range or scope or quantity; a. of agriculture; increasing productivity by using large areas with minimal outlay and labor
translation_zh: a. 广的, 广泛的, 多方面的；[经] 广大的, 扩大的
example: The company has extensive experience in this field.

meaning: n. outward features; a. happening or arising or located outside or beyond some limits or especially surface; s. coming from the outside; s. from or between other countries
translation_zh: n. 外部, 外面；a. 外部的, 客观的, 表面的
example: The building has an external staircase.

meaning: v. remove, usually with some force or effort; also used in an abstract sense; v. get despite difficulties or obstacles; v. separate (a metal) from an ore; v. calculate the root of a number
translation_zh: n. 榨出物, 精汁, 摘录, 选段；vt. (费力地)取出, 采掘, 榨取, 摘录, 吸取；[计] 提取
example: The book contains an extract from his diary.

meaning: r extremely
translation_zh: adv. 非凡, 破例, 特别, 非常, 离奇, 使人惊奇, 惊人, 特命, 特派
example: 他很地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: s. joyful and proud especially because of triumph or success
translation_zh: a. 非常高兴的, 欢欣的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常非常高兴的的解释。

meaning: n. the arch of hair above each eye
translation_zh: n. 眉毛；[医] 眉
example: 这个眉毛 v. 为…描眉为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. any of the short curved hairs that grow from the edges of the eyelids
translation_zh: n. 睫毛；[医] 睫[毛]
example: 这个睫毛为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. either of two folds of skin that can be moved to cover or open the eye
translation_zh: n. 眼皮, 眼睑；[医] 睑
example: 这个[解剖] 眼睑为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. artifact made by weaving or felting or knitting or crocheting natural or synthetic fibers
translation_zh: n. 织物, 布, 结构, 构造, 建筑物；[经] 组织, 建筑物, 工厂
example: 这个织物为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: s. extremely pleasing; s. based on or told of in traditional stories; lacking factual basis or historical validity; s. barely credible
translation_zh: a. 传说的, 寓言般的, 难以置信的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常难以置信的的解释。

meaning: v. make easier; v. increase the likelihood of (a response)
translation_zh: vt. 使容易, 促进, 帮助；[法] 使容易, 使便利, 推进
example: 我们需要逐步facilitate这个方案。

meaning: n a building or place that provides a particular service or is used for a particular industry; n skillful performance or ability without difficulty; n a natural effortlessness; n something designed and created to serve a particular function and to afford a particular convenience or service; n a service that an organization or a piece of equipment offers you
translation_zh: n. 工具, 设施, 设备
example: 这个设施为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. anything that contributes causally to a result; n. any of the numbers (or symbols) that form a product when multiplied together; n. an independent variable in statistics; v. resolve into factors
translation_zh: n. 因素, 因数, 系数, 基因, 代理人；[计] 因式
example: Cost was a major factor in our decision.

meaning: n. one of the inherent cognitive or perceptual powers of the mind
translation_zh: n. 才能, 能力, 全体教员, (大学的)系；[医] 能力, [大学]院系
example: The university faculty met to discuss the new curriculum.

meaning: n. complete confidence in a person or plan etc; n. loyalty or allegiance to a cause or a person
translation_zh: n. 信心, 信任, 忠实, 保证；[法] 信任, 信仰, 信念
example: I have faith in your abilities.

meaning: v. be unsure or weak; v. move hesitatingly, as if about to give way
translation_zh: vt. 支吾地说；vi. 支吾, 蹒跚地走；n. 颤抖, 支吾, 踌躇
example: Her voice began to falter as she told the sad story.

meaning: n. the state or quality of being widely honored and acclaimed; n. favorable public reputation
translation_zh: n. 名望, 名声, 传说
example: 这个名声为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: r exceedingly; extremely
translation_zh: adv. 空想地, 捕风捉影地
example: 他空想的地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: s. having your attention fixated as though by a spell
translation_zh: a. 着迷的；被深深吸引的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常着迷的的解释。

meaning: n. the state of being intensely interested (as by awe or terror); n. the capacity to attract intense interest
translation_zh: n. 令人着迷的事物, 入迷, 魅力
example: She had a lifelong fascination with ancient Egypt.

meaning: a. bringing death; s. controlled or decreed by fate; predetermined
translation_zh: a. 致命的, 重大的, 命运注定的, 粗心的, 不幸的；[医] 致命的, 致死的
example: The accident proved fatal for the driver.

meaning: n an event (or a course of events) that will inevitably happen in the future; n the ultimate agency regarded as predetermining the course of events (often personified as a woman); n your overall circumstances or condition in life (including everything that happens to you); v decree or designate beforehand
translation_zh: n. 命运, 运气；vt. 注定
example: It was fate that brought them together.

meaning: s. characterized by errors; not agreeing with a model or not following established rules; the wrong side of the road"
translation_zh: a. 有过失的, 有缺点的, 不完美的, 应受责备的；[经] 缺点多的
example: The washing machine is faulty and needs to be repaired.

meaning: s causing fear or dread or terror
translation_zh: a. 吓人的, 可怕的, 害怕的
example: The dragon was a fearsome creature in the legend.

meaning: n. a notable achievement
translation_zh: n. 壮举, 功绩, 技艺表演；a. 灵巧的, 合适的, 整洁的
example: 这个技艺表演为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a member of the Union Army during the American Civil War; n. any federal law-enforcement officer; s. national; especially in reference to the government of the United States as distinct from that of its member units; a. of or relating to the central government of a federation
translation_zh: a. 联邦的, 联合的, 同盟的；[法] 联邦的, 联邦制的, 联盟的
example: The federal government announced new policies.

meaning: n. the process in which part of the output of a system is returned to its input in order to regulate its further output; n. response to an inquiry or experiment
translation_zh: n. 反馈, 反应；[计] 反馈
example: 这个反馈为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a member of a learned society; n. an informal form of address for a man
translation_zh: n. 男人, 朋友, 同事；a. 同伴的, 同事的, 同道的
example: He's a good fellow to have around.

meaning: n a boat that transports people or vehicles across a body of water and operates on a regular schedule
translation_zh: n. 渡船
example: 这个渡船为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: a. related to or involving literary fiction
translation_zh: a. 虚构的, 编造的, 小说式的；[法] 拟制的, 假定的, 虚构的
example: The characters in the novel are entirely fictional.

meaning: s. marked by extreme intensity of emotions or convictions; inclined to react violently; fervid
translation_zh: a. 凶猛的, 猛烈的, 热烈的, 暴躁的
example: The tiger gave a fierce roar.

meaning: n the act of fighting; any contest or struggle; v be engaged in a fight; carry on a fight; v fight against or resist strongly; v make a strenuous or labored effort; v exert oneself continuously, vigorously, or obtrusively to gain an end or engage in a crusade for a certain cause or person; be an advocate for; s engaged in or ready for military or naval operations
translation_zh: a. 战斗的, 容易引起争斗的, 适于格斗的, 好斗的, 好战的, 斗争的, 搏斗的；n. 战斗, 斗争, 搏斗
example: 这个战斗的为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: a. (used of the meanings of words or text) not literal; using figures of speech
translation_zh: a. 比喻的, 象征的, 修饰丰富的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常比喻的的解释。

meaning: a. designating the generation or the sequence of generations following the parental generation; a. relating to or characteristic of or befitting an offspring
translation_zh: a. 子女的, 当做子女的, 孝顺的；[医] 子女的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常孝顺的的解释。

meaning: n. the commercial activity of providing funds and capital; n. the branch of economics that studies the management of money and other assets; n. the management of money and credit and banking and investments; v. obtain or provide money for
translation_zh: n. 财政, 财务；vt. 供给...经费, 负担经费；vi. 筹措资金
example: He works in the field of finance.

meaning: r. from a financial point of view
translation_zh: adv. 金融上；财政上
example: 他财政上地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: r. in tiny pieces; r. in an elegant manner; r. in a delicate manner
translation_zh: adv. 雅致地, 仔细地, 敏锐地, 微细地
example: 他ad地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: n. the nail at the end of a finger
translation_zh: n. 手指甲
example: 这个指甲为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a portable gun
translation_zh: n. 火器, 枪炮
example: The police officer carried a firearm.

meaning: n. an open recess in a wall at the base of a chimney where a fire can be built
translation_zh: n. 壁炉
example: 这个壁炉 (noun)为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. the muscle tone of healthy tissue; n. the property of being unyielding to the touch
translation_zh: n. 坚固, 坚牢, 坚定
example: The firmness of the mattress provided good support.

meaning: r before anything else
translation_zh: adv. 第一, 首先
example: 他首先（主要用于列举条目、论点时）地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: a. involving financial matters
translation_zh: a. 财政的, 国库的；[经] 财政上的, 会计的, 国库的
example: The government announced new fiscal policies.

meaning: s. (of a number) having a fixed and unchanging value; s. fixed and unmoving; a. securely placed or fastened or set; s. incapable of being changed or moved or undone; e.g. "frozen prices"
translation_zh: a. 固定的, 不变的；[法] 固定的, 确定的, 不变的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常固定的的解释。

meaning: v. be in flames or aflame; v. criticize harshly, usually via an electronic medium
translation_zh: n. 火焰, 火舌, 热情, 光辉；vt. 焚烧, 用火焰给...灭菌, 用火焰传送(信号), 点燃, 激动；vi. 燃烧, 爆发, 闪耀；[计] 无聊邮件, 无益邮件
example: 这个火焰为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. any broad thin and limber covering attached at one edge; hangs loose or projects freely; n. the motion made by flapping up and down; n. a movable piece of tissue partly connected to the body; n. a movable airfoil that is part of an aircraft wing; used to increase lift or drag
translation_zh: n. 飘, 摆动, 拍打, 拍打声, 片状垂悬物；v. 拍打, 鼓翼而飞, 飘动
example: 我们需要逐步flap这个方案。

meaning: n. defect or weakness in a person's character; n. an imperfection in a plan or theory or legal document that causes it to fail or that reduces its effectiveness; v. add a flaw or blemish to; make imperfect or defective
translation_zh: n. 缺点, 裂纹, 瑕疵, 一阵狂风；[化] 划痕; 裂缝; 裂纹
example: The only flaw in the plan was the lack of funding.

meaning: s. without a flaw
translation_zh: a. 无瑕疵的, 无缺点的；[化] 无裂纹的; 无裂缝的
example: Her performance was absolutely flawless.

meaning: n. fiber of the flax plant that is made into thread and woven into linen fabric; n. plant of the genus Linum that is cultivated for its seeds and for the fibers of its stem
translation_zh: n. 亚麻, 麻布, 亚麻织品；[医] 亚麻
example: Linen fabric is made from the fibers of the flax plant.

meaning: v. run away quickly
translation_zh: vt. 逃避, 逃跑, 逃走；vi. 逃, 消失
example: 我们需要逐步flee这个方案。

meaning: n. group of aircraft operating together under the same ownership; n. group of motor vehicles operating together under the same ownership; n. a group of steamships operating together under the same ownership; n. a group of warships organized as a tactical unit
translation_zh: n. 舰队, 港湾, 小河；a. 快速的, 敏捷的, 浅的, 短暂的；adv. 浅；vi. 疾驰, 飞逝, 掠过；vt. 消磨, 变换船(或船员)的位置
example: The company has a large fleet of delivery trucks.

meaning: n. the soft tissue of the body of a vertebrate: mainly muscle tissue and fat; v. remove adhering flesh from (hides) when preparing leather manufacture
translation_zh: n. 肉, 肉体, 肉欲, 人性, 亲属, 人类, 众生, 人体；vt. 以肉喂, 激起...的杀戳情绪, 使肥, 赋以血肉；vi. 长胖
example: 这个（人或动物的）肉为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. the property of being flexible; easily bent or shaped; n. the quality of being adaptable or variable
translation_zh: n. 弹性, 适应性；[计] 灵活性; 适应性
example: Yoga helps improve your flexibility.

meaning: a. capable of being changed; a. able to flex; able to bend easily; s. bending and snapping back readily without breaking
translation_zh: a. 易曲的, 灵活的, 柔顺的, 能变形的, 可通融的；[医] 能屈的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常灵活的的解释。

meaning: r. with flexibility
translation_zh: adv. 易曲地, 柔软地
example: 他灵活地地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: n. hot or cold alcoholic mixed drink containing a beaten egg; n. a sudden, quick movement; n. the act of flipping a coin; n. a dive in which the diver somersaults before entering the water
translation_zh: vt. 掷, 弹, 轻击, 空翻；vi. 用指轻弹, 抽打, 蹦跳；n. 抛, 弹, 筋斗；a. 无礼的；[计] 翻转
example: 我们需要逐步flip这个方案。

meaning: n. skillfulness in speaking or writing; n. the quality of being facile in speech and writing
translation_zh: n. 流畅, 雄辩, 善辩
example: Achieving fluency in a second language takes time and practice.

meaning: n. a substance that is fluid at room temperature and pressure; n. continuous amorphous matter that tends to flow and to conform to the outline of its container: a liquid or a gas; s. subject to change; variable; s. characteristic of a fluid; capable of flowing and easily changing shape
translation_zh: n. 液体, 分泌液, 流体；a. 流动的, 可改变的
example: Drink plenty of fluids when you are sick.

meaning: n. abnormally rapid beating of the auricles of the heart (especially in a regular rhythm); can result in heart block; v. flap the wings rapidly or fly with flapping movements
translation_zh: n. 摆动, 鼓翼, 烦扰；vi. 摆动, 鼓翼, 烦扰；vt. 拍(翅), 使焦急；[计] 颤动
example: 这个飘动为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a person who accepts the leadership of another; n. someone who travels behind or pursues another
translation_zh: n. 从者, 属下, 追补者；[电] 随动机
example: 这个追随者为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. the trait of acting stupidly or rashly; n. the quality of being rash and foolish; n. foolish or senseless behavior
translation_zh: n. 愚蠢, 荒唐事, 讽刺剧
example: 这个蠢笨为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: r. with fondness; with love
translation_zh: adv. 溺爱地, 怜爱地, 情柔地
example: 他亲爱地地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: r. without good sense or judgment
translation_zh: adv. 愚笨地, 无聊地
example: 他愚蠢地地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: n. a printed note placed below the text on a printed page
translation_zh: n. 脚注；[计] 脚注
example: Please check the footnote for more details.

meaning: r. with full force
translation_zh: adv. 激烈地；强有力地；有说服力地
example: 他强有力地地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: n. a person who exercises control over workers; n. a man who is foreperson of a jury
translation_zh: n. 领班, 工头, 陪审长；[经] 领班, 工头
example: The construction foreman supervised the team.

meaning: v realize beforehand; v picture to oneself; imagine possible; v act in advance of; deal with ahead of time
translation_zh: vt. 预见, 预知
example: We couldn't foresee the problems that would arise.

meaning: n. the science of planting and caring for forests and the management of growing timber
translation_zh: n. 林学, 森林地；[法] 林地, 林学, 林业
example: Forestry is important for sustainable timber production.

meaning: n. an arrangement of people or things acting as a unit; n. the act of fabricating something in a particular shape; n. a particular spatial arrangement; n. natural process that causes something to form
translation_zh: n. 形成, 构造, 编队；[医] 形成, 结构
example: The rock formation was millions of years old.

meaning: r at a previous time;
translation_zh: adv. 从前, 以前
example: She formerly worked as a teacher before becoming a writer.

meaning: s. extremely impressive in strength or excellence; s. inspiring fear
translation_zh: a. 巨大的, 优秀的, 可怕的, 艰难的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常可怕的的解释。

meaning: s. available when required or as promised
translation_zh: a. 即将来临的；n. 来临
example: The forthcoming election will be very close.

meaning: n. an act that violates the rules of a sport; v. hit a foul ball; v. commit a foul; break the rules; v. spot, stain, or pollute
translation_zh: a. 污秽的, 邪恶的, 恶臭的, 肮脏的, 恶劣的, 淤塞的；vt. 弄脏, 妨害, 污蔑, 犯规, 淤塞；vi. 腐烂, 犯规, 缠结；adv. 违反规则地, 不正当地；n. 犯规, 缠绕
example: The air in the old building had a foul smell.

meaning: n a distinctive odor that is pleasant; n a pleasingly sweet olfactory property
translation_zh: n. 芬芳, 香味
example: 这个芳香为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: r (used as intensives reflecting the speaker's attitude) it is sincerely the case that
translation_zh: adv. 坦白地
example: 他直率地（说）地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: r in an uncontrolled manner
translation_zh: adv. 狂暴地, 疯狂似地
example: She frantically searched for her lost keys.

meaning: n. intentional deception resulting in injury to another person; n. something intended to deceive; deliberate trickery intended to gain an advantage
translation_zh: n. 欺骗, 欺诈, 诡计, 骗子；[经] 欺诈, 舞弊, 骗子
example: He was arrested for credit card fraud.

meaning: n. a person or animal that is markedly unusual or deformed
translation_zh: n. 畸形人, 畸形物, 不正常的事物, 反复无常；a. 奇异的, 反常的
example: He's a real fitness freak.

meaning: n. a medium size square-rigged warship of the 18th and 19th centuries; n. a United States warship larger than a destroyer and smaller than a cruiser
translation_zh: n. 装有大炮的快速帆船, 护卫舰
example: The frigate sailed across the ocean.

meaning: n. a wilderness at the edge of a settled area of a country; n. an international boundary or the area (often fortified) immediately inside the boundary; n. an undeveloped field of study; a topic inviting research and development
translation_zh: n. 边界, 边境；[法] 国境, 边境, 边界
example: Space is often called the final frontier.

meaning: s avoiding waste
translation_zh: a. 节俭的, 朴素的
example: She lives a very frugal life, saving money wherever she can.

meaning: v. be mad, angry, or furious; v. emit a cloud of fine particles
translation_zh: n. 臭气, 烟, 激怒；vt. 熏；vi. 冒烟
example: The car exhaust produced thick, black fumes.

meaning: a. designed for or capable of a particular function or use; a. involving or affecting function rather than physiology; a. relating to or based on function especially as opposed to structure; it is a functional one"; s. fit or ready for use or service
translation_zh: a. 功能的；[医] 机能的, 功能的, 官能的
example: The new software is fully functional.

meaning: n. capable of serving a purpose well
translation_zh: [计] 功能性, 泛函性；[化] 官能度
example: 这个（计算机或电子系统的）功能为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. any factor that could be considered important to the understanding of a particular business; n. the lowest tone of a harmonic series; s. being or involving basic facts or principles; s. far-reaching and thoroughgoing in effect especially on the nature of something
translation_zh: n. 基本原理, 原则, 基波；a. 基本的, 重要的, 原音的
example: Understanding the fundamental principles is crucial.

meaning: n. a state of nervous depression; n. United States biochemist (born in Poland) who showed that several diseases were caused by dietary deficiencies and who coined the term `vitamin' for the chemicals involved (1884-1967); n. an earthy type of jazz combining it with blues and soul; has a heavy bass line that accentuates the first beat in the bar
translation_zh: n. 怯懦, 恐惧, 臭味；vt. 畏缩, 害怕, 使闻到臭味；vi. 惊恐, 发出臭味
example: 这个惊恐为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: s. (of jazz) having the soulful feeling of early blues; s. stylish and modern in an unconventional way; s. in a state of cowardly fright
translation_zh: a. 畏缩的, 怯懦的, 恶臭的
example: She wore a funky hat to the party.

meaning: s marked by extreme and violent energy; s marked by extreme anger; s (of the elements) as if showing violent anger
translation_zh: a. 狂怒的, 激烈的, 吵闹的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常狂怒的的解释。

meaning: r. (of the elements) in a wild and stormy manner; r. in a manner marked by extreme or violent energy; r. in an impassioned or very angry manner
translation_zh: adv. 狂暴地；猛烈地
example: 他狂怒地地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: n. a gay feeling; n. a festive merry feeling
translation_zh: n. 愉快, 快活, 高兴
example: 这个快乐为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. the act of playing for stakes in the hope of winning (including the payment of a price for a chance to win a prize)
translation_zh: n. 赌博
example: He lost a lot of money due to his gambling habit.

meaning: n. an association of criminals; n. an organized group of workmen; n. tool consisting of a combination of implements arranged to work together; v. act as an organized group
translation_zh: n. 队, 群, 帮；vi. 成群结队, 结成一伙；vt. 使成群结队
example: A gang of friends went to the movies.

meaning: n. a criminal who is a member of gang
translation_zh: n. 流氓, 歹徒；[法] 暴徒, 恶棍, 打手
example: The movie was about a notorious gangster from the 1930s.

meaning: n. someone who takes care of a garden; n. someone employed to work in a garden
translation_zh: n. 园丁, 花匠, 园艺家
example: 这个园丁为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a short labored intake of breath with the mouth open
translation_zh: n. 喘气；vi. 喘气, 喘息, 渴望；vt. 气喘吁吁地说
example: 这个喘气 vi. 喘气为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. an entrance that can be closed by a gate
translation_zh: n. 门, 通路；[计] 网关
example: The city is often called the gateway to the West.

meaning: n. (Britain) a celebratory reunion feast or entertainment held a college
translation_zh: a. 俗丽的, 华而不实的；n. 盛大宴会
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常花哨的的解释。

meaning: n. a long fixed look; v. look at with fixed eyes
translation_zh: n. 注视, 凝视；vi. 注视, 凝视
example: Her gaze was fixed on the distant horizon.

meaning: n. a toothed wheel that engages another toothed mechanism in order to change the speed or direction of transmitted motion; n. a mechanism for transmitting motion for some specific purpose (as the steering gear of a vehicle); n. equipment consisting of miscellaneous articles needed for a particular operation or sport etc.; v. set the level or character of
translation_zh: n. 齿轮, 工具；vt. 以齿轮连起, 开动, 使适应, 安排；vi. 连接上, 适合
example: 这个用具为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. the trait of being willing to give your money or time; n. acting generously
translation_zh: n. 慷慨, 宽大
example: 这个慷慨为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: r in a generous manner
translation_zh: adv. 宽大地；慷慨地；丰盛地
example: He generously donated to the charity.

meaning: n. someone who has exceptional intellectual ability and originality; n. exceptional creative ability
translation_zh: n. 天才, 天赋, 精神, 神魔；[医] 特征
example: Albert Einstein was a scientific genius.

meaning: n. a kind of literary or artistic work; n. a class of art (or artistic endeavor) having a characteristic form or technique
translation_zh: n. 类型, 流派
example: My favorite music genre is jazz.

meaning: r. in a gradual manner; r. in a gentle manner
translation_zh: adv. 温和地, 温柔地, 轻轻地, 逐渐地
example: 他温柔地地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: a. not fake or counterfeit; s. not pretended; sincerely felt or expressed
translation_zh: a. 真正的, 真实的, 诚恳的；[医] 真性的
example: This is a genuine leather bag.

meaning: r in accordance with truth or fact or reality; r genuinely; with authority
translation_zh: adv. 真诚地；诚实地
example: He genuinely apologized for his mistake.

meaning: a. of or relating to the science of geography; a. determined by geography
translation_zh: a. 地理(学)的, 地区(性)的
example: They studied the geographic features of the region.

meaning: n. a small apparently simple structure (as a fertilized egg) from which new tissue can develop into a complete organism
translation_zh: n. 细菌, 种子, 生殖细胞, 根源；[医] 芽胞, 胚, 胚芽, 病菌
example: 这个生幼芽为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a rapid escape (as by criminals)
translation_zh: n. 逃走, 起步
example: The thieves made a quick getaway in a stolen car.

meaning: n. formerly the restricted quarter of many European cities in which Jews were required to live; n. any segregated mode of living or working that results from bias or stereotyping; n. a poor densely populated city district occupied by a minority ethnic group linked together by economic hardship and social restrictions
translation_zh: n. 犹太人区
example: 这个少数民族的集中住宅区为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a gift of public land or resources for the private gain of a limited group; n. an unintentional disclosure
translation_zh: n. 泄漏, 免费赠品
example: The company offered a free giveaway to attract new customers.

meaning: n. A gentle slope, or a smooth, gently sloping bank;; especially (Fort.), that slope of earth which inclines from the covered; way toward the exterior ground or country (see Illust. of Ravelin).
translation_zh: n. 缓慢倾斜, 斜堤, 缓冲地区
example: 这个glacis（noun）为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a light within the field of vision that is brighter than the brightness to which the eyes are adapted; n. an angry stare; v. be sharply reflected; v. shine intensely
translation_zh: n. 闪耀光, 刺眼；vi. 发眩光, 瞪视；vt. 瞪眼表示
example: She gave him a fierce glare.

meaning: n. an appearance of reflected light; n. a flash of light (especially reflected light); v. shine brightly, like a star or a light; v. appear briefly
translation_zh: n. 光束, 微光, 反光；vi. 闪烁, 隐约地闪现；vt. 使发微光, 使闪烁
example: The polished silver began to gleam under the light.

meaning: n great merriment; n malicious satisfaction
translation_zh: n. 欢乐, 高兴
example: He jumped with glee when he heard the news.

meaning: r. throughout the world
translation_zh: [计] 全局地
example: 他计 全局地地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: glocal
translation_zh: [网络] 全球本土化；全球本地化(glocalization)；全球在地
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常glocal（adjective）的解释。

meaning: s. filled with melancholy and despondency
translation_zh: a. 抑沉的, 忧闷的, 黑暗的, 悲观的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常阴暗的的解释。

meaning: v. bestow glory upon; v. cause to seem more splendid
translation_zh: vt. 赞美, 美化, 赞扬, 使辉煌
example: The song tends to glorify violence.

meaning: n. a feeling of considerable warmth; n. a steady even light without flames; v. emit a steady even light without flames; v. have a complexion with a strong bright color, such as red or pink
translation_zh: n. 赤热, 光辉, 热情, 热烈, 红光；vi. 发红光, 红光焕发, 发热, 洋溢, 激动
example: 这个发光为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. any of numerous agile ruminants related to sheep but having a beard and straight horns
translation_zh: n. 山羊, 替罪羊, 色鬼
example: 这个山羊为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. the supernatural being conceived as the perfect and omnipotent and omniscient originator and ruler of the universe; the object of worship in monotheistic religions; n. a man of such superior qualities that he seems like a deity to other people
translation_zh: n. 上帝, 神像, 偶像；vt. 使神化
example: 这个神为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: s. showing great reverence for god
translation_zh: a. 敬神的, 虔诚的, 神的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常神的解释。

meaning: n (accounting) an intangible asset valued according to the advantage or reputation a business has acquired (over and above its tangible assets); n the friendly hope that something will succeed; n a disposition to kindness and compassion
translation_zh: n. 友好, 好意, 善意, 亲善, (企业享有的)信誉, 声誉；[经] (企业的)商誉, 信誉
example: The company built up a lot of goodwill with its customers.

meaning: n. (slang) a disparaging term for an Asian person (especially for North Vietnamese soldiers in the Vietnam War)
translation_zh: n. 污物, 粘性物质, 畸形人, 亚洲佬(对韩、日等国人的轻蔑称呼)
example: 这个gook（noun）为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a deep ravine (usually with a river running through it); v. overeat or eat immodestly; make a pig of oneself
translation_zh: n. 峡谷, 凹槽, 塞饱, 咽喉；vi. 狼吞虎咽；vt. 塞饱, 狼吞虎咽地吃
example: The river carved a deep gorge through the mountains.

meaning: s. relating to or dealing with the affairs or structure of government or politics or the state
translation_zh: a. 政治的, 统治上的, 政府的；[法] 政府的, 统治的, 政治上的
example: Governmental policies can have a big impact on the economy.

meaning: n. beautiful carriage
translation_zh: n. 温文, 优雅；优美
example: 这个gracefulness（noun）为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. (Roman Catholic Church) an antiphon (usually from the Book of Psalms) immediately after the epistle at Mass; a. proceeding in small stages; a. (of a topographical gradient) not steep or abrupt
translation_zh: a. 逐渐的, 渐增的；n. 弥撒升阶圣歌
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常逐渐的的解释。

meaning: n. a relatively small granular particle of a substance; n. foodstuff prepared from the starchy grains of cereal grasses; n. the side of leather from which the hair has been removed; n. a weight unit used for pearls or diamonds: 50 mg or 1/4 carat
translation_zh: n. 谷粒, 颗粒, 谷类, 纹理, 本质；v. (使)成谷粒
example: 这个谷物为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: s. large and impressive in physical size or extent; s. the most important and magnificent in adornment
translation_zh: a. 庄重的, 壮观的, 显赫的, 重大的, 最高的, 雄伟的, 宏大的, 豪华的, 傲慢的；[法] 重大的, 主要的, 伟大的
example: The old building had a grand staircase.

meaning: r. with respect to graphic aspects; r. in a graphic way
translation_zh: adv. 生动地, 活灵活现地, (正式)用图表表示, 以图显示
example: 他通过图表地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: v. hold firmly
translation_zh: n. 把握, 抓紧, 理解, 抓, 柄, 控制；vt. 抓住, 紧握, 领会；vi. 抓
example: He has a good grasp of the subject.

meaning: n. a stone that is used to mark a grave
translation_zh: n. 墓石, 墓碑
example: 这个墓碑为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. movement downward resulting from gravitational attraction; n. a figurative movement toward some attraction
translation_zh: n. 引力, 重力, 沉下；[化] 引力
example: Newton's law of universal gravitation explains why apples fall.

meaning: n. the property possessed by something or someone of outstanding importance or eminence
translation_zh: n. 大, 巨大, 广大
example: 这个伟大为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. intense sorrow caused by loss of a loved one (especially by death); n. something that causes great unhappiness
translation_zh: n. 伤心, 忧愁, 悲痛, 不幸, 灾难
example: He felt deep grief after the loss.

meaning: v. feel grief; v. cause to feel sorrow
translation_zh: vt. 使悲伤；vi. 悲痛, 伤心
example: 我们需要逐步grieve这个方案。

meaning: s. not to be placated or appeased or moved by entreaty
translation_zh: a. 冷酷的, 坚强的, 残忍的, 可怕的, 讨厌的
example: The news was grim, indicating a difficult road ahead.

meaning: v. to draw back the lips and reveal the teeth, in a smile, grimace, or snarl
translation_zh: n. 露齿笑；v. 露齿而笑
example: 这个露齿而笑为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. the friction between a body and the surface on which it moves (as between an automobile tire and the road); n. worker who moves the camera around while a film or television show is being made; n. an intellectual hold or understanding; v. hold fast or firmly
translation_zh: n. 紧握, 柄, 握力, 握手方式, 手提包, 掌握, 支配, 控制；vt. 抓紧, 抱住, 吸住, 掌握；vi. 握牢, 有吸引力
example: 这个紧握为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. twelve dozen; n. the entire amount of income before any deductions are made; v. earn before taxes, expenses, etc.; a. before any deductions
translation_zh: n. 总数, 总量；a. 总共的, 未打折扣的, 恶劣的, 粗野的；vt. 总共收入
example: His gross income is higher than his net income.

meaning: n. (electronics) the production of (semiconductor) crystals by slow crystallization from the molten state; a. relating to or suitable for growth
translation_zh: a. 成长的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常生长的的解释。

meaning: n. a member of an irregular armed force that fights a stronger force by sabotage and harassment
translation_zh: n. 游击队
example: The guerrilla fighters launched a surprise attack.

meaning: n. a light line that is used in lettering to help align the letters
translation_zh: n. 指导路线, 方针, 指标；[经] 指导路线, 方针, 准则
example: The company issued new guidelines for remote work.

meaning: n. a large and hurried swallow; n. a spasmodic reflex of the throat made as if in swallowing; v. to swallow hurriedly or greedily or in one draught; v. utter or make a noise, as when swallowing too quickly
translation_zh: vt. 吞, 大口大口地吸气, 吸收, 抑制；vi. 吞咽；n. 吞咽；[计] 字节组
example: 这个狼吞虎咽地吃为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. any of various substances (soluble in water) that exude from certain plants; they are gelatinous when moist but harden on drying; v. cover, fill, fix or smear with or as if with gum; v. become sticky; v. exude or form gum
translation_zh: n. 树胶, 橡皮, 橡皮糖, 牙床, 老天；vt. 涂以树胶, 用胶粘, 使有粘性；vi. 分泌树胶, 发粘
example: 这个口香糖为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n the act of shooting a gun
translation_zh: n. 枪弹, (枪炮)射击, 炮击, 射程；a. 射击的
example: We heard a gunshot in the distance.

meaning: n fortitude and determination; n the part of the alimentary canal between the stomach and the anus; n a narrow channel or strait; n a strong cord made from the intestines of sheep and used in surgery; v empty completely; destroy the inside of; v remove the guts of
translation_zh: n. 飞碟游戏（比赛双方每组5人, 相距15码, 互相掷接飞碟）；内脏；狭道；[口语]贪食者（gut的复数）
example: 这个内脏为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: a. of or relating to or used in exercises intended to develop strength and agility
translation_zh: a. 体操的, 体育的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常体操的的解释。

meaning: n a person who inhabits a particular place
translation_zh: n. 居住者, 居民
example: 这个habitant（noun）为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. precipitation of ice pellets when there are strong rising air currents; n. many objects thrown forcefully through the air; n. enthusiastic greeting; v. be a native of
translation_zh: n. 冰雹, 致敬, 欢呼, 招呼；vt. 向...欢呼, 致敬, 招呼, 使象下雹样落下；vi. 招呼, 下雹；interj. 万岁, 欢迎
example: 我们需要逐步hail这个方案。

meaning: a. having or covered with hair; s. hazardous and frightening
translation_zh: a. 多毛的, 毛状的, 长毛的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常多毛的的解释。

meaning: n. advantage given to a competitor to equalize chances of winning; v. attempt to forecast the winner (especially in a horse race) and assign odds for or against a contestant; v. put at a disadvantage
translation_zh: n. 障碍, 困难, 不利条件；vt. 加障碍于, 妨碍
example: His lack of experience was a significant handicap in the competition.

meaning: n. a work produced by hand labor; n. a craft that requires skillful hands
translation_zh: n. 手工艺, 手艺；[经] 手工业, 手工
example: 这个手工艺为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. an announcement distributed to members of the press in order to supplement or replace an oral presentation; n. giving money or food or clothing to a needy person
translation_zh: n. 施舍物, 救济品, 分发的印刷品资料, 广告物品
example: 这个散发材料（免费发给的新闻通报）为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n a railing at the side of a staircase or balcony to prevent people from falling
translation_zh: n. 栏杆, 扶手
example: 这个handrail（noun）为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. major items of military weaponry (as tanks or missile); n. instrumentalities (tools or implements) made of metal; n. (computer science) the mechanical, magnetic, electronic, and electrical components making up a computer system
translation_zh: n. 硬件, 五金器具, 零件；[计] 硬件
example: 这个五金器具为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: v. cause or do harm to
translation_zh: n. 伤害, 害处；vt. 伤害, 损害
example: 这个损害为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: a. not causing or capable of causing harm
translation_zh: a. 无害处的, 未受损害的, 无辜的, 无恶意的；[法] 无害的, 无恶意的, 无损害的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常无害的的解释。

meaning: n. a cultivator that pulverizes or smooths the soil; v. draw a harrow over (land)
translation_zh: n. 哈罗公学, 耙；vt. 耙掘, 伤害, 使苦恼；vi. 被耙松
example: 这个耙 vt. 耙地为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. overly eager speed (and possible carelessness); n. the act of moving hurriedly and in a careless manner
translation_zh: n. 匆忙, 急忙
example: In her haste, she forgot her keys.

meaning: r in a hurried or hasty manner
translation_zh: adv. 匆忙地, 急速地, 急躁地
example: He hastily packed his bags and left.

meaning: n the production of young from an egg; n shading consisting of multiple crossing lines; v emerge from the eggs; v devise or invent; v inlay with narrow strips or lines of a different substance such as gold or silver, for the purpose of decorating; v draw, cut, or engrave lines, usually parallel, on metal, wood, or paper; v sit on (eggs)
translation_zh: n. 阴影, 影线；[机] 剖面线
example: 这个& vi.孵化为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: s. continually recurring to the mind; s. having a deeply disquieting or disturbing effect
translation_zh: a. 常浮现于脑海中的, 不易忘怀的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常不易忘怀的的解释。

meaning: n. grass mowed and cured for use as fodder; v. convert (plant material) into hay
translation_zh: n. 干草；vt. 制干草, 供给干草；vi. 晒干草
example: 这个干草为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: s. involving risk or danger
translation_zh: a. 危险的, 冒险的, 碰运气的；[法] 危险的, 冒险的, 碰运气的
example: Working with these chemicals is hazardous.

meaning: n. (usually plural) the office that serves as the administrative center of an enterprise; n. the military installation from which a commander performs the functions of command; n. (plural) a military unit consisting of a commander and the headquarters staff
translation_zh: n. 总部, 司令部, 总部人员；[经] 本部, 总部, 总署
example: The company's headquarters are in London.

meaning: v. bestow in large quantities; v. fill to overflow
translation_zh: n. 堆, 许多, 累积；vt. 堆积, 装满；[计] 堆
example: 这个堆为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: s causing or marked by grief or anguish
translation_zh: a. 令人悲伤的, 极其累人的, 令人动情的
example: The news of the accident was absolutely heartbreaking.

meaning: n. a fence formed by a row of closely planted shrubs or bushes; n. any technique designed to reduce or eliminate financial risk; for example, taking two positions that will offset each other if prices change; n. an intentionally noncommittal or ambiguous statement; v. avoid or try to avoid fulfilling, answering, or performing (duties, questions, or issues)
translation_zh: n. 树篱, 障碍, 套头交易；vt. 用树篱围, 套期保值, 妨碍, 两面下注以防...的损失；vi. 筑树篱, 躲闪, 两面下注以防损失；a. 树篱的, 偷偷摸摸的
example: 这个树篱为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. an aircraft without wings that obtains its lift from the rotation of overhead blades
translation_zh: n. 直升机；vt. 由直升机运送；vi. 乘直升机
example: 这个[航] 直升飞机 vt. 由直升机运送 vi. [航] 乘直升飞机为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. any place of pain and turmoil;; n. a cause of difficulty and suffering; n. (Christianity) the abode of Satan and the forces of evil; where sinners suffer eternal punishment; n. (religion) the world of the dead
translation_zh: n. 地狱, 邪恶势力, 苦境, 阴间, 毁坏, 训斥；vi. 狂饮, 飞驰
example: The traffic was hell this morning.

meaning: n a person who contributes to the fulfillment of a need or furtherance of an effort or purpose; n a person who helps people or institutions (especially with financial help)
translation_zh: n. 帮忙者, 有益的东西；[机] 助手
example: 这个助手为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a plant fiber
translation_zh: n. 大麻烟卷, 大麻, 麻类植物；[医] 大麻
example: Hemp fibers are used to produce strong and durable textiles.

meaning: n. a plant lacking a permanent woody stem; many are flowering garden plants or potherbs; some having medicinal properties; some are pests; n. aromatic potherb used in cookery for its savory qualities
translation_zh: n. 药草, 香草；[医] 草, 草本, 草药
example: 这个香草为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. practices that are handed down from the past by tradition
translation_zh: n. 遗产, 祖先遗留物, 继承物；[医] 遗传性
example: The building is part of our national heritage.

meaning: n. indecision in speech or action; n. the act of pausing uncertainly
translation_zh: n. 犹豫, 踌躇, 含糊, 口吃, 暂停；[计] 暂停
example: 这个犹豫为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. the most interesting or memorable part; n. an area of lightness in a picture; v. apply a highlighter to one's cheeks or eyebrows in order to make them more prominent
translation_zh: n. 加亮区, 精彩场面；vt. 加亮, 使显著, 以强光照射, 突出；[计] 突出
example: The highlight of the trip was visiting the ancient ruins.

meaning: n. seizure of a vehicle in transit either to rob it or divert it to an alternate destination; v. seize control of
translation_zh: vt. 抢劫, 劫持, 敲诈；[法] 挡路抢劫, 抢劫, 绑架
example: The terrorists attempted to hijack the plane.

meaning: s. marked by or causing boisterous merriment or convulsive laughter
translation_zh: a. 喜不自禁的, 欢闹的, 引人发笑的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常很可笑的的解释。

meaning: n. an indirect suggestion; n. a slight indication; v. drop a hint; intimate by a hint
translation_zh: n. 暗示, 提示；v. 暗示, 示意
example: 这个暗示为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a holding device; n. a person who holds something; n. the person who is in possession of a check or note or bond or document of title that is endorsed to him or to whoever holds it
translation_zh: n. 持有人, 所有人, 支持物；[化] 夹持器; 夹具; 贮罐
example: 这个持有人为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a cavity or space in something; n. a small valley between mountains; v. remove the interior of; a. not solid; having a space or gap or cavity
translation_zh: n. 洞, 窟窿, 山谷；a. 空的, 虚伪的, 空腹的, 凹的；vi. 形成空洞；vt. 挖空
example: The tree trunk was hollow.

meaning: n. an act of mass destruction and loss of life (especially in war or by fire); n. the mass murder of Jews under the German Nazi regime from 1941 until 1945
translation_zh: n. 大屠杀, 大火灾, 毁灭, 大规模烧杀
example: 这个大屠杀为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: s. oriented toward home; r. toward home
translation_zh: a. 在归途上的, 向家的；adv. 在归途上, 向家地
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常在归途上的解释。

meaning: n. a whetstone made of fine gritstone; used for sharpening razors; v. sharpen with a hone
translation_zh: n. 磨刀石, 抱怨, 想念；vt. 用磨刀石磨, 磨练
example: 这个用磨刀石磨为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. an aggressive and violent young criminal; n. a protective covering that is part of a plant; n. (slang) a neighborhood; n. a tubular attachment used to keep stray light out of the lens of a camera
translation_zh: n. 头巾, 兜帽, 覆盖, 强盗；vt. 罩上, 覆盖
example: 这个兜帽为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a catch for locking a door; n. a sharp curve or crook; a shape resembling a hook; n. a mechanical device that is curved or bent to suspend or hold or pull something; n. a curved or bent implement for suspending or pulling something
translation_zh: n. 钩, 钩状, 镰刀, 陷阱；vt. 挂...于钩上, 钩住, 引上钩, 偷窃；vi. 弯成钩状, 钩紧；[计] 钩
example: 这个& vi. 钩住为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a lodging for travelers (especially one kept by a monastic order); n. a program of medical and emotional care for the terminally ill
translation_zh: n. 旅客住宿处, 收容所
example: She spent her final days comfortably in the hospice.

meaning: a. favorable to life and growth; a. disposed to treat guests and strangers with cordiality and generosity; s. having an open mind
translation_zh: a. 好客的, 招待周到的
example: The locals were very hospitable to the tourists.

meaning: n kindness in welcoming guests or strangers
translation_zh: n. 款待, 亲切, 殷勤
example: They showed great hospitality to their foreign guests.

meaning: s. occurring every hour or payable by the hour; r. every hour; by the hour
translation_zh: a. 每小时的, 以小时计的, 频繁的；adv. 每小时地, 频繁地, 不绝地
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常每一小时的的解释。

meaning: n. a servant who is employed to perform domestic task in a household
translation_zh: n. 主妇, 女管家
example: 这个主妇为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. teacher in charge of a school boardinghouse
translation_zh: n. 男舍监
example: 这个男舍监为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。
