meaning: n. a wife who manages a household while her husband earns the family income
translation_zh: n. 主妇, 家庭妇女
example: 这个家庭主妇 (n.) - 家庭女性成员为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: v. be undecided about something; waver between conflicting positions or courses of action; v. move to and fro; v. hang in the air; fly or be suspended above
translation_zh: vi. 盘旋, 翱翔, 徘徊；vt. 孵；n. 翱翔
example: The hummingbird continued to hover near the flower.

meaning: n. a tight or amorous embrace; v. fit closely or tightly
translation_zh: n. 紧抱, 拥抱；vt. 紧抱, 坚持, 使沾沾自喜
example: 这个拥抱为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: r extremely
translation_zh: adv. 巨大地, 非常地
example: 他非常地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: a. marked or motivated by concern with the alleviation of suffering; s. showing evidence of moral and intellectual advancement
translation_zh: a. 有人情的, 人道的, 仁慈的
example: They advocated for more humane treatment of animals.

meaning: n. a classical scholar or student of the liberal arts; n. an advocate of the principles of humanism; someone concerned with the interests and welfare of humans; a. of or pertaining to a philosophy asserting human dignity and man's capacity for fulfillment through reason and scientific method and often rejecting religion
translation_zh: n. 人道主义者, 人文学者
example: 这个人道主义者为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: v. cause to be unpretentious; s. low or inferior in station or quality; a. marked by meekness or modesty; not arrogant or prideful; s. used of unskilled work (especially domestic work)
translation_zh: a. 低下的, 谦逊的, 粗陋的；vt. 使...卑下, 降低...地位, 贬抑
example: Despite his success, he remained a humble person.

meaning: n. communication (written or spoken) intended to deceive; v. trick or deceive
translation_zh: vt. 欺骗, 哄骗；vi. 行骗；n. 骗子, 欺骗, 欺诈
example: He dismissed the whole idea as a complete humbug.

meaning: v. cause to feel shame; hurt the pride of
translation_zh: vt. 使丢脸, 使蒙羞, 屈辱
example: He tried to humiliate her in front of her friends.

meaning: v cause to feel shame; hurt the pride of; s causing awareness of your shortcomings
translation_zh: a. 丢脸的, 耻辱的, 羞愧的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常丢脸的的解释。

meaning: n. state of disgrace or loss of self-respect; n. an instance in which you are caused to lose your prestige or self-respect; n. depriving one of self-esteem
translation_zh: n. 耻辱, 丢脸, 谦卑
example: He felt deep humiliation after his public mistake.

meaning: n the pursuit and killing or capture of wild animals regarded as a sport; n the activity of looking thoroughly in order to find something or someone; n the work of finding and killing or capturing animals for food or pelts; v pursue for food or sport (as of wild animals); v pursue or chase relentlessly; v chase away, with as with force; v yaw back and forth about a flight path; v oscillate about a desired speed, position, or state to an undesirable extent; v seek, search for; v search (an area) for prey
translation_zh: n. 狩猎, 猎狐, 探求；[计] 寻找平衡; 寻找
example: 这个打猎为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. (poetic) tranquil silence; v. become quiet or still; fall silent; v. cause to be quiet or not talk; v. wash by removing particles
translation_zh: n. 肃静, 安静, 沉默；vt. (使)肃静, (使)安静, (使)缄默；interj. 嘘, 别作声
example: A sudden hush fell over the crowd.

meaning: n. a composite of mixed origin; n. (genetics) an organism that is the offspring of genetically dissimilar parents or stock; especially offspring produced by breeding plants or animals of different varieties or breeds or species; s. produced by crossbreeding
translation_zh: n. 混血儿, 杂种, 混合物；a. 混合的, 杂种的, 混合语的；[计] NetWare的主机实用程序, 双重用户建立程序
example: The new car is a hybrid, running on both gasoline and electricity.

meaning: n. a condition promoting sanitary practices; n. the science concerned with the prevention of illness and maintenance of health
translation_zh: n. 卫生保健, 卫生学, 保健法；[医] 卫生, 卫生学
example: Good personal hygiene is important for preventing illness.

meaning: n. extravagant exaggeration
translation_zh: n. 夸张法
example: 这个<语>夸张法为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a punctuation mark (-) used between parts of a compound word or between the syllables of a word when the word is divided at the end of a line of text
translation_zh: n. 连字符；vt. 用连字符连接
example: Remember to use a hyphen when writing "well-known."

meaning: n. someone who cuts and delivers ice
translation_zh: n. 零售冰的人, 制冰的人
example: The iceman delivered a block of ice for the cooler.

meaning: n. (computer science) a graphic symbol (usually a simple picture) that denotes a program or a command or a data file or a concept in a graphical user interface; n. a conventional religious painting in oil on a small wooden panel; venerated in the Eastern Church
translation_zh: n. 画像, 肖像, 偶像, 图标, 像标；[计] 像标, 图标
example: The pop star became a cultural icon.

meaning: s. covered with or containing or consisting of ice; s. shiny and slick as with a thin coating of ice
translation_zh: a. 冰的, 冰冷的, 冷淡的, 滑溜的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常寒冷的的解释。

meaning: r. in an ideal manner
translation_zh: adv. 完美地, 理想地
example: 他完美地地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: s. exactly alike; incapable of being perceived as different; s. being the exact same one; not any other:; a. (of twins) derived from a single egg or ovum; s. having properties with uniform values along all axes
translation_zh: a. 同一的, 恒等的, 完全相同的；[医] 同一的, 同等的
example: The two cars were identical.

meaning: n. evidence of identity; something that identifies a person or thing; n. the condition of having the identity (of a person or object) established; n. the attribution to yourself (consciously or unconsciously) of the characteristics of another person (or group of persons)
translation_zh: n. 识别, 身份证明, 认同；[化] 鉴定; 鉴别; 鉴别法; 认证
example: 这个鉴定为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: v. recognize as being; establish the identity of someone or something; v. consider (oneself) as similar to somebody else; v. conceive of as united or associated; v. identify as in botany or biology, for example
translation_zh: vt. 识别, 认为...等同于, 确定, 使参与；vi. 一致, 认同
example: 我们需要逐步identify这个方案。

meaning: n. imaginary or visionary theorization
translation_zh: n. 思想体系, 意识形态, 观念学, 空论；[医] 观念学, 观念形态
example: 这个意识形态为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a person of subnormal intelligence
translation_zh: n. 白痴, 极蠢之人；[医] 白痴者, 痴子
example: Don't be an idiot, think before you act.

meaning: n. the state of an engine or other mechanism that is idling; v. run disconnected or idle; v. be idle; exist in a changeless situation; a. not in action or at work
translation_zh: a. 懒惰的, 闲散的, 停顿的, 空闲的, 无用的；vi. 无所事事, 闲散, 浪费, 空转；vt. 虚度, 使闲散, 使空转；n. 空转, 空闲时间；[计] 空闲时间
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常无意义的的解释。

meaning: n. the lack of knowledge or education
translation_zh: n. 无知, 愚味；[法] 无知, 不知情, 愚昧
example: His ignorance of the law was no excuse.

meaning: s. uneducated in general; lacking knowledge or sophistication; s. uneducated in the fundamentals of a given art or branch of learning; lacking knowledge of a specific field; s. unaware because of a lack of relevant information or knowledge
translation_zh: a. 无知识的, 不知道的, 由无知产生的；[法] 无知的, 愚昧的, 不知情的
example: Many people are ignorant of the true cost of living.

meaning: v. depict with an illustration; v. supply with illustrations
translation_zh: vt. 举例说明, 作图解, 阐明；vi. 举例说明
example: The speaker used slides to illustrate his points.

meaning: n. artwork that helps make something clear or attractive; n. a visual representation (a picture or diagram) that is used make some subject more pleasing or easier to understand
translation_zh: n. 例证, 插图；[化] 插图
example: The book contained many beautiful illustrations.

meaning: n the ability to form mental images of things or events
translation_zh: n. 肖像, 比喻, 雕刻；[化] 成像
example: The poem used vivid imagery to describe the sunset.

meaning: n. the doctrine that representations of nature or human behavior should be accurate imitations; n. something copied or derived from an original; n. copying (or trying to copy) the actions of someone else
translation_zh: n. 模仿, 效法, 冒充, 赝品；[医] 模仿, 仿制, 仿制品
example: 这个模仿为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: v. thrust or throw into; v. enclose or envelop completely, as if by swallowing
translation_zh: vt. 沉浸, 使陷入；[医] 浸[入]
example: She decided to immerse herself in her studies.

meaning: n. a person who comes to a country where they were not born in order to settle there
translation_zh: n. 移民；a. 移入的, 移民的
example: Many immigrants contribute to the economy.

meaning: a. deliberately violating accepted principles of right and wrong
translation_zh: a. 不道德的, 邪恶的, 放荡的；[法] 不道德的, 道德败坏的, 邪恶的
example: His actions were considered deeply immoral by the community.

meaning: n. a person (such as an author) of enduring fame; a. not subject to death
translation_zh: n. 不朽人物, 神仙；a. 永远的, 不死的, 长久的
example: Many myths tell stories of immortal gods and goddesses.

meaning: n. the quality or state of being immortal; n. perpetual life after death
translation_zh: n. 不朽, 不灭的声望
example: 这个不朽为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: a. showing lack of favoritism
translation_zh: a. 公平的, 不偏不倚的；[法] 公正无私的, 不偏袒的, 公平的
example: A judge must remain impartial during a trial.

meaning: r. with impatience; in an impatient manner
translation_zh: adv. 不耐烦, 忍受不了, 急躁, [表]急欲, 急切
example: 他不耐烦地地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: n. some duty that is essential and urgent; a. requiring attention or action; a. relating to verbs in the imperative mood
translation_zh: n. 命令, 必要的事, 规则, 祈使语气；a. 命令式的, 急需的, 势在必行的, 强制的
example: 这个必要的为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: a. not permanent; not lasting; s. existing or enduring for a limited time only
translation_zh: a. 暂时的, 非永久的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常impermanent（adjective）的解释。

meaning: n. instrumentation (a piece of equipment or tool) used to effect an end; v. apply in a manner consistent with its purpose or design
translation_zh: n. 工具, 器具, 手段；vt. 实现, 使生效, 执行
example: The company decided to implement new safety procedures.

meaning: n. an accusation that brings into intimate and usually incriminating connection; n. a logical relation between propositions p and q of the form `if p then q'; if p is true then q cannot be false; n. a relation implicated by virtue of involvement or close connection (especially an incriminating involvement)
translation_zh: n. 牵连, 含义, 暗示；[法] 推断, 含蓄之意, 暗示
example: The implication of his words was clear.

meaning: v. express or state indirectly; v. suggest as a logically necessary consequence; in logic; v. have as a necessary feature
translation_zh: vt. 暗示, 意味；[计] 隐含
example: His silence seemed to imply agreement.

meaning: a. not polite
translation_zh: a. 无礼的, 粗鲁的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常无礼的的解释。

meaning: r in an impolite manner
translation_zh: adv. 无礼地, 没规矩地
example: 他无礼的地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: n. commodities (goods or services) bought from a foreign country; n. an imported person brought from a foreign country; v. bring in from abroad; v. transfer (electronic data) into a database or document
translation_zh: n. 进口货, 进口, 输入, 含义, 重要性；vt. 输入, 引入, 进口, 含...的意思, 重要；vi. 有关系；[计] 引入
example: 我们需要逐步import这个方案。

meaning: v compel to behave in a certain way; v impose something unpleasant; v impose and collect
translation_zh: vt. 征(税), 把...强加于, 以...欺骗；vi. 利用, 欺骗, 施加影响
example: The government decided to impose new taxes.

meaning: n. incapability of existing or occurring; n. an alternative that is not available
translation_zh: n. 不可能之事, 不可能；[法] 不可能性, 不可能的事
example: Climbing Mount Everest without oxygen was an impossibility for most.

meaning: a. not practical; not workable or not given to practical matters
translation_zh: a. 不切实际的, 不能实行的, 不现实的, 不合情理的
example: His ideas were often impractical but interesting.

meaning: s. deeply or markedly affected or influenced
translation_zh: a. 外加的；印象深刻的；了不起的；受感动的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常印象深刻的v.使感动的解释。

meaning: n. a school of late 19th century French painters who pictured appearances by strokes of unmixed colors to give the impression of reflected light
translation_zh: n. 印象主义, 印象派
example: Monet is one of the most famous painters of Impressionism.

meaning: n. a painter who follows the theories of Impressionism; a. relating to or characteristic of Impressionism
translation_zh: n. 印象主义者, 印象派作家
example: Monet is considered a master impressionist painter.

meaning: v. lock up or confine, in or as in a jail; v. confine as if in a prison; he does not let them go out without a chaperone"
translation_zh: vt. 使下狱, 关闭, 拘禁, 限制；[法] 关押, 监禁, 限制
example: The judge decided to imprison the criminal for ten years.

meaning: n. putting someone in prison or in jail as lawful punishment; n. the act of confining someone in a prison (or as if in a prison)
translation_zh: n. 监禁, 下狱, 坐牢；[法] 监禁, 徒刑, 拘禁
example: He faced a long period of imprisonment.

meaning: a. not likely to be true or to occur or to have occurred; s. having a probability too low to inspire belief; s. too improbable to admit of belief
translation_zh: a. 不大可能的, 不象发生的, 荒谬可笑的；[法] 未必会的, 不大可能发生的, 未必确实的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常不大可能是真实的的解释。

meaning: r. in an improper way
translation_zh: [计] 不适当地
example: He was accused of improperly handling the funds.

meaning: a. made more desirable or valuable or profitable; especially made ready for use or marketing; s. become or made better in quality; s. (of land) made ready for development or agriculture by clearing of trees and brush
translation_zh: a. 改良的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常改良的v.改善的解释。

meaning: n. the act of applying force suddenly
translation_zh: n. 冲动, 驱使, 刺激, 推动, 冲力, 建议, 脉冲；vt. 推动
example: She bought the shoes on impulse.

meaning: s. proceeding from natural feeling or impulse without external stimulus; s. without forethought
translation_zh: a. 冲动的, 受感情驱使的, 任性的；[医] 冲动的
example: His impulsive decision to buy the car without checking its history led to problems.

meaning: a. not exact
translation_zh: a. 错误的, 不准确的；[化] 不精确
example: The report contained several inaccurate figures.

meaning: a. lacking the requisite qualities or resources to meet a task; s. not sufficient to meet a need
translation_zh: a. 不充分的, 不适当的；[法] 不充分的, 不适当的
example: The resources provided were inadequate for the task.

meaning: a. belonging to the class of nouns denoting nonliving things; a. not endowed with life
translation_zh: a. 失去知觉的, 没生命的, 无精打采的；[医] 无生命的, 无生机的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常无生命的的解释。

meaning: s present at birth but not necessarily hereditary; acquired during fetal development; s normally existing at birth
translation_zh: a. 天生的；先天的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常天生的的解释。

meaning: n. a substance that produces a fragrant odor when burned; n. the pleasing scent produced when incense is burned
translation_zh: n. 香, 香气, 奉承；vi. 焚香；vt. 用香焚, 使发怒
example: The temple was filled with the sweet smell of burning incense.

meaning: n. a positive motivational influence
translation_zh: n. 动机；a. 激励的
example: The company offered a bonus as an incentive.

meaning: v. make oneself subject to; bring upon oneself; become liable to
translation_zh: vt. 招致, 蒙受, 遭遇；[经] 招致, 蒙受, 担负
example: He incurred heavy losses in the stock market.

meaning: n. a person whose disease is incurable; a. incapable of being cured; s. unalterable in disposition or habits
translation_zh: a. 不能医治的, 不能矫正的, 无救的；n. 不治的病人, 无救的人
example: The disease was incurable, but treatments could manage the symptoms.

meaning: s. owing gratitude or recognition to another for help or favors etc; s. under a legal obligation to someone
translation_zh: a. 负债的, 受惠的；[法] 负债的, 法律上有义务偿还的
example: I am deeply indebted to you for your help.

meaning: n. an order for goods to be exported or imported; v. set in from the margin; v. cut or tear along an irregular line so that the parts can later be matched for authentication
translation_zh: n. 契约, 订货单, 凹痕；vi. 切割成锯齿状；vt. 缩排, 定货, 印凹痕；[计] 缩进
example: Please indent the first line of each paragraph.

meaning: r. on your own; without outside help; r. apart from others
translation_zh: adv. 独立地, 自立地
example: She learned to work independently.

meaning: s defying expression or description
translation_zh: a. 不能用语言表达的, 不可名状的, 莫名其妙的
example: The beauty of the sunset was indescribable.

meaning: n. a numerical scale used to compare variables with one another or with some reference number; n. a number or ratio (a value on a scale of measurement) derived from a series of observed facts; can reveal relative changes as a function of time; n. an alphabetical listing of names and topics along with page numbers where they are discussed; n. the finger next to the thumb
translation_zh: n. 索引, 指针, 指数, 指标；vt. 编入索引中, 指出；vi. 做索引；[计] 下标; 附标; 变址; 索引; 编索引
example: Check the index at the back of the book.

meaning: s. showing no care or concern in attitude or action; s. fairly poor to not very good; s. marked by no especial liking or dislike or preference for one thing over another; s. characterized by a lack of partiality
translation_zh: a. 漠不关心的, 无重要性的, 中立的；[医] 中性的, 无作用的, 无亲和力的, 淡漠的
example: She was indifferent to their pleas.

meaning: n. an affront to one's dignity or self-esteem
translation_zh: n. 侮辱；[法] 侮辱的言行, 无礼, 有伤尊严
example: 这个侮辱为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: a. not to be dispensed with; essential; s. unavoidable
translation_zh: n. 不可缺少之物；a. 不可缺少的, 责无旁贷的, 绝对必要的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常不可或缺的的解释。

meaning: v. give free rein to; v. enjoy to excess
translation_zh: vt. 纵情于, 使高兴, 放任, 迁就；vi. 沉溺
example: I decided to indulge in a piece of chocolate cake.

meaning: a. characterized by or given to yielding to the wishes of someone; s. tolerant or lenient; s. being favorably inclined
translation_zh: a. 纵容的, 任性的, 宽容的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常（对己）放纵的的解释。

meaning: a. not producing an intended effect; s. lacking in power or forcefulness; s. lacking the ability or skill to perform effectively; inadequate
translation_zh: a. 无效的；[法] 失效的, 无效的, 效率低的
example: The old methods proved to be ineffective.

meaning: s. unable to move or resist motion; s. having only a limited ability to react chemically; chemically inactive; s. slow and apathetic
translation_zh: a. 惰性的, 迟钝的, 无活力的, 呆滞的；[医] 惰性的, 无作用的, 无效的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常[化学] 惰性的的解释。

meaning: a. lacking practical experience or training
translation_zh: a. 无经验的, 不熟练的
example: The new employee was very inexperienced.

meaning: n a very young child (birth to 1 year) who has not yet begun to walk or talk
translation_zh: n. 婴儿, 儿童, 初学者；a. 婴儿的, 幼稚的
example: 这个婴儿为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: v. communicate a disease to; v. contaminate with a disease or microorganism; v. corrupt with ideas or an ideology; v. affect in a contagious way
translation_zh: vt. 传染, 感染；[医] 传染, 感染
example: Viruses can infect computer systems.

meaning: v communicate a disease to; v contaminate with a disease or microorganism; v corrupt with ideas or an ideology; v affect in a contagious way; a containing or resulting from disease-causing organisms
translation_zh: a. 被感染的；[计] 被感染的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常（伤口）被感染的v.（受）传染( infect的过去式和过去分词 )的解释。

meaning: s. caused by infection or capable of causing infection; a. easily spread; children catch it from their elders"- Bertrand Russell; a. of or relating to infection
translation_zh: a. 有传染性的, 易传染的；[医] 传染性的
example: His enthusiasm was infectious, and soon everyone was excited.

meaning: v reason by deduction; establish by deduction; v draw from specific cases for more general cases; v conclude by reasoning; in logic; v guess correctly; solve by guessing; v believe to be the case
translation_zh: vt. 推论出, 推断；vi. 作推论
example: From his silence, I could infer that he was unhappy.

meaning: n. the reasoning involved in drawing a conclusion or making a logical judgment on the basis of circumstantial evidence and prior conclusions rather than on the basis of direct observation
translation_zh: n. 推论；[法] 推论, 推理, 推断
example: We can draw an inference from the data.

meaning: n. a response of body tissues to injury or irritation; characterized by pain and swelling and redness and heat; n. arousal to violent emotion
translation_zh: n. 怒火, 发火, 燃烧, 发炎；[医] 炎[症]
example: 这个[病理] 炎症为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: s. characterized or caused by inflammation
translation_zh: a. 激动的, 煽动的, 炎症性的；[医] 炎的, 炎性的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常令人激动的的解释。

meaning: v. exaggerate or make bigger; v. fill with gas or air; v. cause prices to rise by increasing the available currency or credit; v. increase the amount or availability of, creating a rise in value
translation_zh: vt. 使膨胀, 使得意, 使通货膨胀, 使充气；vi. 充气, 膨胀
example: 我们需要逐步inflate这个方案。

meaning: n. a general and progressive increase in prices; n. (cosmology) a brief exponential expansion of the universe (faster than the speed of light) postulated to have occurred shortly after the big bang; n. the act of filling something with air
translation_zh: n. 胀大, 夸张, 通货膨胀；[化] 充气吹胀; 膨胀
example: High inflation is a concern for the economy.

meaning: a. having or exercising influence or power
translation_zh: a. 有影响的, 有势力的
example: She is an influential figure in the art world.

meaning: n. an acute febrile highly contagious viral disease
translation_zh: n. 流行性感冒；[医] 流行性感冒, 流感
example: 这个[内科] 流行性感冒（简写flu）为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: a. not formal; s. not officially recognized or controlled; a. used of spoken and written language
translation_zh: a. 非正式的, 不拘礼的, 通俗的；[经] 非正式的, 日常使用的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常轻松友好的的解释。

meaning: v go against, as of rules and laws; v advance beyond the usual limit
translation_zh: v. 破坏, 侵犯, 违反
example: 我们需要逐步infringe这个方案。

meaning: n an act that disregards an agreement or a right; n a crime less serious than a felony
translation_zh: n. 违犯, 侵害, 违反, 侵犯；[计] 违反, 侵犯, 侵权, 侵犯
example: 这个侵权为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: v. be present in
translation_zh: vt. 居住于, 占据, 栖息
example: Many species inhabit this forest.

meaning: v. obtain from someone after their death; v. receive from a predecessor; v. receive by genetic transmission
translation_zh: vt. 继承, 遗传；vi. 接受遗产
example: She will inherit a large fortune from her grandmother.

meaning: n. the first letter of a word (especially a person's name); v. mark with one's initials; s. occurring at the beginning
translation_zh: n. 字首, 首字母；a. 开始的, 最初的, 字首的；vt. 用姓名的首字母签名
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常最初的的解释。

meaning: n readiness to embark on bold new ventures; n the first of a series of actions; s serving to set in motion
translation_zh: n. 主动行动, 首创精神, 主动权；a. 自发的, 起始的
example: She showed great initiative in her new role.

meaning: n. the forceful insertion of a substance under pressure; n. any solution that is injected (as into the skin); n. the act of putting a liquid into the body by means of a syringe
translation_zh: n. 注射, 注射剂；[化] 注入; 注射
example: 这个注射为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: a. harmed
translation_zh: a. 受伤的, 受损害的, 被触怒的；[法] 受害的, 被害的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常受伤的的解释。

meaning: a not established by conditioning or learning; s being talented through inherited qualities; s present at birth but not necessarily hereditary; acquired during fetal development
translation_zh: a. 先天的, 天生的；[医] 先天的, 生来的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常天生的的解释。

meaning: r. in a not unlawful manner; r. in a naively innocent manner
translation_zh: adv. 纯洁地；无罪地
example: 他无罪地地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: n a creation (a new device or process) resulting from study and experimentation; n the creation of something in the mind; n the act of starting something for the first time; introducing something new
translation_zh: n. 改革, 创新；[法] 创新, 改革, 刷新
example: The company is known for its constant innovation.

meaning: s. being or producing something like nothing done or experienced or created before
translation_zh: a. 革新的, 创新的, 富有革新精神的
example: The company is known for its innovative designs.

meaning: n. a component of production; something that goes into the production of output; v. enter (data or a program) into a computer
translation_zh: n. 输入, 输入电路；vt. 输入；[计] 输入
example: 这个投入为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: s. not capable of being separated
translation_zh: a. 不能分的；[化] 不可分的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常不可分的的解释。

meaning: v. look over carefully
translation_zh: vt. 检查, 检阅, 检验；vi. 检查
example: 我们需要逐步inspect这个方案。

meaning: n. a high ranking police officer
translation_zh: n. 检查员, 巡视员；[化] 检查员
example: 这个检查员为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: s. imparting a divine influence on the mind and soul
translation_zh: a. 凭灵感的, 鼓舞人心的, 神感的
example: Her story was truly inspirational.

meaning: r without delay or hesitation; with no time intervening; r without any delay
translation_zh: adv. 立即地, 即刻地
example: 他立即地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: n. inborn pattern of behavior often responsive to specific stimuli; s. (followed by `with')deeply filled or permeated
translation_zh: n. 本能, 直觉；a. 充满着的
example: Birds build nests by instinct.

meaning: n. an organization founded and united for a specific purpose; n. an establishment consisting of a building or complex of buildings where an organization for the promotion of some cause is situated; n. a custom that for a long time has been an important feature of some group or society
translation_zh: n. 机构, 惯例, 制度；[医] 机关, 机构, 设施
example: The university is a respected educational institution.

meaning: v. give instructions or directions for some task; v. make aware of
translation_zh: vt. 教, 教育, 命令, 通知；[法] 托办, 指导, 指示
example: 我们需要逐步instruct这个方案。

meaning: a. of a quantity not able to fulfill a need or requirement
translation_zh: a. 不够的, 不能胜任的, 不充足的；[法] 不足的, 不充分的, 不能胜任的
example: There was insufficient evidence to prove his guilt.

meaning: n. a deliberately offensive act or something producing the effect of deliberate disrespect
translation_zh: n. 侮辱, 无礼, 损害；vt. 损害, 侮辱, 攻击
example: 这个侮辱为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: v. make into a whole or make part of a whole; v. become one; become integrated; v. calculate the integral of; calculate by integration
translation_zh: vt. 综合, 使完整, 使成整体；vi. 成一体；a. 完整的, 完全的
example: It's important to integrate new employees into the team quickly.

meaning: n. a person who uses the mind creatively; s. of or associated with or requiring the use of the mind; a. appealing to or using the intellect
translation_zh: n. 有知识者, 知识分子, 凭理智做事者；a. 智力的, 用脑力的, 聪明的
example: She is a highly intellectual person.

meaning: n. the intended meaning of a communication
translation_zh: n. 意图, 含义, 故意；a. 专心的, 决心的, 热心的
example: His intent was to finish the project on time.

meaning: a used especially of drugs or muscles that work together so the total effect is greater than the sum of the two (or more); s capable of acting on or influencing each other
translation_zh: a. 相互作用的, 相互影响的；[计] 交互, 人机对话的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常(指至少两个人或物)一起活动或互相合作的交互式的的解释。

meaning: v. come between so as to be hindrance or obstacle
translation_zh: vi. 妨碍, 冲突, 干涉, 抵触；[医] 干扰, 干涉, 阻碍, 碰腿(马)
example: Don't interfere in matters that don't concern you.

meaning: a. situated within or suitable for inside a building; s. inside and toward a center; s. of or coming from the middle of a region or country
translation_zh: n. 内部, 内政；a. 内部的, 心灵的, 内地的, 内政的
example: The interior of the house was beautifully decorated.

meaning: s. occurring among or involving several people
translation_zh: a. 人与人之间的, 人际(关系)的；[法] 人与人之间的, 需要与他人接触的
example: Good interpersonal skills are essential for this job.

meaning: v. make sense of; assign a meaning to; v. give an interpretation or rendition of
translation_zh: vt. 解释, 演出, 翻译, 理解；vi. 翻译, 解释
example: It's difficult to interpret these complex instructions.

meaning: n. a mental representation of the meaning or significance of something; n. an explanation that results from interpreting something; n. an explanation of something that is not immediately obvious
translation_zh: n. 解释, 演出, 翻译；[计] 插值; 插值法; 解释
example: Her interpretation of the poem was very insightful.

meaning: n. someone who mediates between speakers of different languages; n. someone who uses art to represent something; n. (computer science) a program that translates and executes source language statements one line at a time
translation_zh: n. 直译程序, 解释者, 口译者, 注释器；[计] 注释器
example: 这个解释者为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. some abrupt occurrence that interrupts an ongoing activity
translation_zh: n. 打扰, 中断, 障碍物；[医] 间断, 阻断, 中止
example: 这个中断为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a point where lines intersect; n. a junction where one street or road crosses another; n. a point or set of points common to two or more geometric configurations
translation_zh: n. 交集, 十字路口, 交叉点；[计] 逻辑乘; 与
example: 这个横断为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: v. give to understand; s. marked by close acquaintance, association, or familiarity; s. involved in a sexual relationship; s. thoroughly acquainted through study or experience
translation_zh: a. 亲密的, 私人的, 秘密的；vt. 暗示, 通知, 告诉；n. 至交
example: They shared an intimate moment together.

meaning: a. designating a verb that does not require or cannot take a direct object
translation_zh: a. 不及物的；n. 不及物动词
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常不及物的的解释。

meaning: a. within or by means of a vein
translation_zh: a. 静脉内的；[医] 静脉内的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常进入静脉的的解释。

meaning: v. enter uninvited; v. search or inquire in a meddlesome way; v. thrust oneself in as if by force
translation_zh: vi. 闯入, 侵入；vt. 强加于
example: I didn't mean to intrude on your private conversation.

meaning: n. someone who intrudes on the privacy or property of another without permission
translation_zh: n. 侵入者, 干扰者, 妨碍者；[计] 入侵者
example: The alarm system detected an intruder.

meaning: n. entrance by force or without permission or welcome; n. the forcing of molten rock into fissures or between strata of an earlier rock formation; n. rock produced by an intrusive process
translation_zh: n. 闯入, 侵扰；[医] [向内]突入
example: She felt the constant media attention was an unwelcome intrusion into her private life.

meaning: a. not liable to or capable of change
translation_zh: n. 不变的东西, 常数；a. 不变的, 常数的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常不变的的解释。

meaning: r without variation or change, in every case
translation_zh: adv. 不变化地, 恒定地, 始终如一地
example: 他总是地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: n. someone who is the first to think of or make something
translation_zh: n. 发明家；[法] 发明人, 发明家, 创造者
example: 这个发明家为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: v. investigate scientifically; v. conduct an inquiry or investigation of
translation_zh: v. 调查, 审查
example: 我们需要逐步investigate这个方案。

meaning: n. someone who investigates
translation_zh: n. 调查者, 审查者；[法] 审查员, 侦查员, 调查员
example: 这个调查者为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. money that is invested with an expectation of profit; n. the commitment of something other than money (time, energy, or effort) to a project with the expectation of some worthwhile result; n. outer layer or covering of an organ or part or organism; n. the act of putting on robes or vestments
translation_zh: n. 投资；[医] 包埋料, 围模料, 包埋法, 围模法
example: Buying a house is a big investment.

meaning: n. someone who commits capital in order to gain financial returns
translation_zh: n. 投资者；[经] 投资者
example: The company is looking for new investors.

meaning: a. impossible or nearly impossible to see; imperceptible by the eye
translation_zh: a. 看不见的, 无形的；[经] 无形的, 表面上看不见的, 未列在公开帐目的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常看不见的的解释。

meaning: r in a tantalizing manner
translation_zh: adv. 吸引人地, 诱人地; 动人地
example: 他吸引人的地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: v. cite as an authority; resort to
translation_zh: vt. 祈求, 恳求, 实行, 援引, 引起；[计] 调用; 请求
example: 我们需要逐步invoke这个方案。

meaning: n. a connection of inclusion or containment
translation_zh: n. 卷入, 牵连, 包含, 困窘；[经] 财政困难, 经济上的困窘
example: Her involvement in the project was crucial for its success.

meaning: r. contrary to plan or expectation; r. in an ironic manner
translation_zh: adv. 冷嘲地, 挖苦地, 讽刺地, 令人啼笑皆非地
example: 他ad地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: a. not consistent with or using reason; a. real but not expressible as the quotient of two integers
translation_zh: n. 无理数；a. 无理性的, 不合理的
example: Her fear of flying was completely irrational.

meaning: a. impossible to resist; overpowering; s. overpoweringly attractive
translation_zh: a. 不可抵抗的, 不能压制的；[经] 不可抗力
example: The offer was so good it was irresistible.

meaning: r incapable of being resisted
translation_zh: adv. 无法抵抗地, 不能自持地; 极为诱惑人地
example: 他irresistibly（adverb）地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: a. showing lack of care for consequences
translation_zh: a. 不负责任的；不可靠的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常不负责任的的解释。

meaning: v cause annoyance in; disturb, especially by minor irritations; v excite to an abnormal condition, or chafe or inflame; v excite to some characteristic action or condition, such as motion, contraction, or nervous impulse, by the application of a stimulus; s aroused to impatience or anger
translation_zh: a. 被激怒的, 生了气的, 变粗的, 因刺激而发炎的, 发红的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常恼怒的的解释。

meaning: s. (used of physical stimuli) serving to stimulate or excite; s. causing physical discomfort; they can be very painful"
translation_zh: a. 刺激的, 使愤怒的, 气人的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常气人的的解释。

meaning: n. the psychological state of being irritated or annoyed; n. (pathology) abnormal sensitivity to stimulation
translation_zh: n. 刺激, 烦恼, 刺激物；[医] 刺激[作用], 兴奋
example: 这个刺激为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. an inhabitant of an island
translation_zh: n. 岛民
example: 这个岛民为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. an irritating cutaneous sensation that produces a desire to scratch; v. have or perceive an itch; v. cause to perceive an itch; v. have a strong desire or urge to do something
translation_zh: n. 痒, 渴望, 疥疮；vi. 发痒, 渴望
example: 我们需要逐步itch这个方案。

meaning: n. the part of the skull of a vertebrate that frames the mouth and holds the teeth; n. the bones of the skull that frame the mouth and serve to open it; the bones that hold the teeth; n. holding device consisting of one or both of the opposing parts of a tool that close to hold an object
translation_zh: n. 颚, 颌；v. 闲谈, 教训, 唠叨
example: 这个颌为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: r. with jealousy

example: 这个女士为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. title used for a married Frenchwoman
translation_zh: n. 夫人, 小姐, 太太, 女士, 主妇, (非正式)喜欢差使/指使别人的女子, 鸨母
example: 这个（用于谈论或称呼讲法语的妇女）夫人为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. unrestrained excitement or enthusiasm
translation_zh: n. 疯狂, 愚蠢的行为；[医] 狂, 疯狂
example: The crowd descended into madness after the goal.

meaning: n. an artist of consummate skill
translation_zh: n. 音乐大师, 大音乐家
example: 这个<意>音乐大师（尤指名指挥）为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: v. increase in size, volume or significance
translation_zh: vt. 放大, 扩大, 赞美, 夸大；vi. 有放大能力
example: The microscope can magnify tiny objects.

meaning: v. engage in; v. give certain properties to something; v. make or cause to be or to become; v. compel or make somebody or something to act in a certain way
translation_zh: vt. 制造, 安排, 创造, 构成, 使得, 产生, 造成, 整理, 布置, 引起, 到达, 进行；vi. 开始, 前进, 增大, 被制造, 被处理；n. 制造, 构造, 性情
example: 这个做为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. any unwholesome or desperate condition
translation_zh: n. 病, 疾病, 弊病；[医] 病
example: 这个弊病为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. an infective disease caused by sporozoan parasites that are transmitted through the bite of an infected Anopheles mosquito; marked by paroxysms of chills and fever
translation_zh: n. 疟疾, 瘴气；[医] 疟[疾]
example: Travelers to tropical regions should take precautions against malaria.

meaning: n. large evergreen tropical tree cultivated for its large oval fruit; n. large oval tropical fruit having smooth skin, juicy aromatic pulp, and a large hairy seed
translation_zh: n. 芒果；[化] 芒果Mangifera indica
example: 这个芒果为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: v. influence or control shrewdly or deviously; v. hold something in one's hands and move it; v. control (others or oneself) or influence skillfully, usually to one's advantage; v. treat manually, as with massage, for therapeutic purposed
translation_zh: vt. 操纵, 利用, 操作, 巧妙地处理, 假造
example: He tried to manipulate the situation to his advantage.

meaning: n. a large and imposing house
translation_zh: n. 大厦, 宅邸
example: 这个大厦为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a small handbook; a. of or relating to the hands; a. requiring human effort; s. doing or requiring physical work
translation_zh: n. 手册, 指南；a. 手的, 手动的, 手工的, 体力的；[计] 人工的, 手动的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常用手的的解释。

meaning: v. put together out of artificial or natural components or parts; He manufactured a popular cereal"; v. produce naturally; v. create or produce in a mechanical way
translation_zh: n. 产品, 制造；vt. 制造, 假造；vi. 制造
example: The company manufactures cars in Germany.

meaning: n. a business engaged in manufacturing some product; n. someone who manufactures something
translation_zh: n. 制造业者, 厂商；[经] 制造人, 制造商, 制造厂
example: The car manufacturer recalled several models.

meaning: n the act of making something (a product) from raw materials; v put together out of artificial or natural components or parts; He manufactured a popular cereal"; v make up something artificial or untrue; v produce naturally; v create or produce in a mechanical way
translation_zh: n. 制造业；a. 制造业的
example: The manufacturing industry is crucial for the economy.

meaning: n. any long and arduous undertaking; n. a footrace of 26 miles 385 yards; n. a battle in 490 BC in which the Athenians and their allies defeated the Persians
translation_zh: n. 马拉松, 耐力的考验
example: 这个<体>马拉松赛跑为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. the boundary line or the area immediately inside the boundary; n. an amount beyond the minimum necessary; n. the amount of collateral a customer deposits with a broker when borrowing from the broker to buy securities; n. the blank space that surrounds the text on a page
translation_zh: n. 页边的空白, 边缘, 界限, 余裕, 差数, 差额, 保证金；vt. 加边于, 加旁注于；[计] 页边距
example: Please write your notes in the margin of the page.

meaning: n. the commercial processes involved in promoting and selling and distributing a product or service; n. shopping at a market
translation_zh: n. 行销, 买卖；[经] 推销, 在市场买卖, 销售
example: The company needs a new marketing strategy.

meaning: n. a covering to disguise or conceal the face; n. activity that tries to conceal something; n. a protective covering worn over the face; v. put a mask on or cover with a mask
translation_zh: n. 面具, 假面具, 掩饰, 石膏面模；vt. 戴面具, 掩饰, 使模糊；vi. 化装, 戴面具, 掩饰, 参加化装舞会；[计] 屏蔽; 掩码
example: 这个掩饰为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: v. kill a large number of people indiscriminately
translation_zh: n. 大屠杀；vt. 大屠杀, 残杀
example: The historical records describe a terrible massacre.

meaning: n. kneading and rubbing parts of the body to increase circulation and promote relaxation; v. manually manipulate (someone's body), usually for medicinal or relaxation purposes; v. give a massage to
translation_zh: n. 按摩, 揉；vt. 按摩, 揉
example: 这个按摩为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a male massager
translation_zh: n. 男按摩师；[医] 按摩员, 按摩器
example: 这个masseur（noun）为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. directs the work of others; n. an original creation (i.e., an audio recording) from which copies can be made; n. an officer who is licensed to command a merchant ship; n. someone who holds a master's degree from academic institution
translation_zh: n. 主人, 硕士, 大师, 母机；a. 主人的, 主要的；vt. 征服, 控制, 精通
example: He is a master of chess.

meaning: n. the most outstanding work of a creative artist or craftsman; n. an outstanding achievement
translation_zh: n. 杰作, 名著
example: The painting is considered a true masterpiece.

meaning: n. the act of mastering or subordinating someone
translation_zh: n. 征服, 统治权, 优势, 精通, 掌握；[法] 统治权, 控制权, 征服
example: Achieving mastery in a language takes years of practice.

meaning: n. the officer below the master on a commercial ship; n. the partner of an animal (especially a sexual partner); n. one of a pair; n. South American holly; leaves used in making a drink like tea
translation_zh: n. 配偶, 对手, 助手, (象棋)将死；vt. 使配对, 使一致, 结伴, (象棋)将死；vi. 成配偶, 紧密配合
example: 这个（工人间的）伙伴为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: a. of or pertaining to or of the nature of mathematics; s. beyond question; s. statistically possible though highly improbable; s. characterized by the exactness or precision of mathematics
translation_zh: a. 数学的, 精确的；[机] 数学上的
example: He has a strong mathematical mind.

meaning: v. develop and reach maturity; undergo maturation; v. develop and work out fully in one's mind; v. become due for repayment; a. characteristic of maturity
translation_zh: a. 成熟的, 到期的, 充分考虑的；vt. 使成熟；vi. 成熟, 到期
example: She is very mature for her age.

meaning: n. a large burial chamber, usually above ground
translation_zh: n. 陵墓, 阴森森的大厦
example: The ancient mausoleum was an impressive structure.

meaning: n. how a result is obtained or an end is achieved; n. an instrumentality for accomplishing some end; n. considerable capital (wealth or income)
translation_zh: n. 方法, 手段, 工具, 财产, 收入；[经] 方法, 手段, 工具; 意谓
example: 这个方法为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n a means or instrumentality for storing or communicating information; n the surrounding environment; n an intervening substance through which signals can travel as a means for communication; n (bacteriology) a nutrient substance (solid or liquid) that is used to cultivate micro-organisms; n a liquid with which pigment is mixed by a painter; n (biology) a substance in which specimens are preserved or displayed; n an intervening substance through which something is achieved; n a state that is intermediate between extremes; a middle position; n someone who serves as an intermediary between the living and the dead; n (usually plural) transmissions that are disseminated widely to the public; n an occupation for which you are especially well suited
translation_zh: n. 媒体；[计] 媒质
example: 这个媒体为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. the act of treating with medicines or remedies
translation_zh: n. 药物治疗, 药物处理, 医药；[医] 药疗法, 投药法
example: 这个药物为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: s. moderate to inferior in quality; s. poor to middling in quality
translation_zh: a. 不好不坏的, 通常, 平凡的
example: The restaurant served mediocre food, nothing special.

meaning: n. the perception of pleasant arrangements of musical notes
translation_zh: n. 曲子, 美妙音乐, 曲调
example: 这个旋律为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a recognition of meritorious service; n. a written statement of facts submitted in conjunction with a petition to an authority; n. a structure erected to commemorate persons or events
translation_zh: n. 纪念物, 请愿书；a. 记念的, 记忆的
example: They built a memorial to honor the fallen soldiers.

meaning: n. a wise and trusted guide and advisor; v. serve as a teacher or trusted counselor
translation_zh: n. 指导者, 良师益友
example: She found a great mentor who guided her through her career.

meaning: n. commodities offered for sale
translation_zh: n. 商品, 货物；v. 交易, 买卖
example: 这个商品为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. something for which to be thankful; n. alleviation of distress; showing great kindness toward the distressed
translation_zh: n. 仁慈, 宽恕, 慈悲, 怜悯, 幸运；[法] 权宜处置权, 决定权, 宽恕
example: The judge showed mercy to the young offender.

meaning: v become one; v mix together different elements; v join or combine
translation_zh: vt. 使合并, 使消失, 吞没；vi. 合并, 渐渐消失；[计] 合并
example: The two companies decided to merge.

meaning: n the combination of two or more commercial companies; n an occurrence that involves the production of a union
translation_zh: n. 合并, 归并；[经] 购并
example: The two companies announced a merger.

meaning: n. a person who carries a message
translation_zh: n. 报信者, 使者；[经] 使者, 送信者, 通信员
example: 这个报信者为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a figure of speech in which an expression is used to refer to something that it does not literally denote in order to suggest a similarity
translation_zh: n. 隐喻
example: 这个隐喻形容词:metaphoric为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: a. based on the meter as a standard of measurement
translation_zh: a. 公尺的, 公制的, 计量的；[医] 测量的, 米制的, 公制的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常米制的的解释。

meaning: s. extremely small in scale or scope or capability
translation_zh: [计] 表示"小","微","微量","百分之一"
example: 这个<口>微型计算机为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a minute life form (especially a disease-causing bacterium); the term is not in technical use
translation_zh: n. 微生物, 细菌；[医] 微生物
example: Scientists study microbes to understand how they affect human health.

meaning: n a small digital computer based on a microprocessor and designed to be used by one person at a time
translation_zh: n. 微电脑, 微机；[计] 微型计算机; 微计算机
example: 这个微电脑为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. any organism of microscopic size
translation_zh: n. 微生物, 微小动植物；[化] 微生物
example: 这个[微] 微生物为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. device for converting sound waves into electrical energy
translation_zh: n. 扩音器, 麦克风；[医] 扩音器, 传声器
example: 这个扩音器为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. magnifier of the image of small objects
translation_zh: n. 显微镜；[化] 显微镜
example: 这个显微镜 (noun)为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: a. of or relating to or used in microscopy; s. visible under a microscope; using a microscope; s. extremely precise with great attention to details; s. so small as to be invisible without a microscope
translation_zh: a. 显微镜的, 用显微镜可见的, 微观的, (非正式)极微小的, 细微的；[计] 微观的
example: Bacteria are microscopic organisms.

meaning: n. research with the use of microscopes
translation_zh: n. 显微镜使用, 用显微镜检查, 显微镜学；[医] 显微镜检查
example: 这个microscopy（noun）为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a short electromagnetic wave (longer than infrared but shorter than radio waves); used for radar and microwave ovens and for transmitting telephone, facsimile, video and data; n. kitchen appliance that cooks food by passing an electromagnetic wave through it; heat results from the absorption of energy by the water molecules in the food; v. cook or heat in a microwave oven
translation_zh: n. 微波；[计] 微波
example: 这个微波炉为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. the location of something surrounded by other things
translation_zh: n. 中间；prep. 在...中间
example: He found himself in the midst of a crowd.

meaning: s. having or showing great strength or force or intensity; r. (Southern regional intensive) very; to a great degree
translation_zh: n. 有势力的人；a. 有势力的, 强大的, 有力的；adv. 很, 极
example: The mighty river flowed through the valley.

meaning: n. the movement of persons from one country or locality to another; n. a group of people migrating together (especially in some given time period); n. (chemistry) the nonrandom movement of an atom or radical from one place to another within a molecule
translation_zh: n. 移民, 移往, 移动；[计] 迁移
example: The annual bird migration is a spectacular sight.

meaning: n. Scottish philosopher who expounded Bentham's utilitarianism; father of John Stuart Mill (1773-1836); n. English philosopher and economist remembered for his interpretations of empiricism and utilitarianism (1806-1873); n. machinery that processes materials by grinding or crushing; v. move about in a confused manner
translation_zh: n. 压榨机, 磨坊, 制造厂；vt. 碾磨, 磨细, 搅拌, 使乱转；vi. 乱转, 被碾磨
example: 这个磨坊为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a person whose material wealth is valued at more than a million dollars
translation_zh: n. 百万富翁, 大富豪；[经] 大资本家, 巨富, 百万富翁
example: He became a millionaire by investing wisely.

meaning: n. someone who mimics (especially an actor or actress); v. imitate (a person or manner), especially for satirical effect; s. constituting an imitation
translation_zh: a. 模仿的, 摹拟的；n. 效颦者, 模仿者, 小丑, 仿制品；vt. 模仿, 摹拟
example: The comedian could mimic various accents perfectly.

meaning: n. excavation in the earth from which ores and minerals are extracted; n. explosive device that explodes on contact; designed to destroy vehicles or ships or to kill or maim personnel; v. get from the earth by excavation; v. lay mines
translation_zh: n. 矿, 矿藏, 地雷；vt. 挖掘, 开采, 在...布雷, 破坏；vi. 开矿, 埋设地雷；pron. 我的
example: 这个我的为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. painting or drawing included in a book (especially in illuminated medieval manuscripts); n. a copy that reproduces a person or thing in greatly reduced size; s. being on a very small scale
translation_zh: n. 缩图, 小画像；a. 小规模的, 纤小的
example: She collected miniature dollhouse furniture.

meaning: n. a person appointed to a high office in the government; n. a diplomat representing one government to another; ranks below ambassador; n. the job of a head of a government department; v. attend to the wants and needs of others
translation_zh: n. 部长, 牧师, 公使；vi. 服侍, 救助, 主持宗教仪式
example: The Prime Minister announced new policies.

meaning: n. any north temperate plant of the genus Mentha with aromatic leaves and small mauve flowers; n. any member of the mint family of plants; n. the leaves of a mint plant used fresh or candied; n. a candy that is flavored with a mint oil
translation_zh: n. 薄荷, 造币厂, 巨额；vt. 铸造, 铸币, 制造
example: 这个薄荷为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. an incorrect conception
translation_zh: n. 误解
example: Many people have a misconception about how the system works.

meaning: n. unnecessary and unforeseen trouble resulting from an unfortunate event; n. an unfortunate state resulting from unfavorable outcomes
translation_zh: n. 不幸, 灾祸, 坏运气；[法] 不幸事故, 不幸, 灾祸
example: 这个不幸为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: v lead someone in the wrong direction or give someone wrong directions; v give false or misleading information to; s designed to deceive or mislead either deliberately or inadvertently
translation_zh: a. 引入歧途的, 使人误解的, 骗人的；[法] 误写姓名的, 误称的, 令人误解的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常给…带错路的解释。

meaning: n. a rocket carrying a warhead of conventional or nuclear explosives; may be ballistic or directed by remote control
translation_zh: n. 发射物, 导弹, 飞弹, 火箭；a. 可发射的
example: The missile was launched from the submarine.

meaning: n. a thin fog with condensation near the ground; v. become covered with mist; v. spray finely or cover with mist
translation_zh: n. 雾, 迷蒙, 朦胧不清；vt. 使模糊, 使蒙上雾；vi. 变模糊, 下雾
example: 这个薄雾为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: v. treat badly
translation_zh: vt. 虐待；[法] 虐待, 苛待
example: 我们需要逐步mistreat这个方案。

meaning: s openly distrustful and unwilling to confide
translation_zh: a. 不信任的, 深疑的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常mistrustful（adjective）的解释。

meaning: v interpret in the wrong way
translation_zh: vt. 误解, 误会
example: 我们需要逐步misunderstand这个方案。

meaning: n. (chemistry) a substance consisting of two or more substances mixed together (not in fixed proportions and not with chemical bonding)
translation_zh: n. 混合, 混淆, 混合物；[化] 混合物
example: 这个混合为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. the quality of moving freely
translation_zh: n. 可动性, 流动性, 机动性；[化] 迁移率
example: Improved public transport increases urban mobility.

meaning: n. the act of mocking or ridiculing; v. treat with contempt; v. imitate with mockery and derision; s. constituting a copy or imitation of something
translation_zh: n. 嘲笑, 戏弄, 模仿；a. 假的, 伪造的, 模拟的；adv. 虚伪地；vt. 嘲弄, 模仿, 使失望, 欺骗, 挫败；vi. 嘲弄
example: Don't mock his efforts; he's trying his best.

meaning: a. marked by simplicity; having a humble opinion of yourself; s. not large but sufficient in size or amount; s. free from pomp or affectation; a. not offensive to sexual mores in conduct or appearance
translation_zh: a. 谦逊的, 羞怯的, 端庄的, 适度的；[经] 适当的
example: She was very modest about her achievements.

meaning: n. slightly modified copy; not an exact copy; n. the grammatical relation that exists when a word qualifies the meaning of the phrase
translation_zh: n. 修正, 修饰, 修改；[化] 修饰; 修改
example: They made a slight modification to the original design.

meaning: n. a bump on a ski slope; n. a member of the Muslim dynasty that ruled India until 1857
translation_zh: n. 大人物, 有权势的人
example: He became a media mogul after years of hard work.

meaning: r. for an instant or moment; r. at any moment
translation_zh: adv. 暂时地, 立刻, 随时地
example: 他顷刻之间地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: s lasting for a markedly brief time
translation_zh: a. 瞬间的, 刹那间的
example: There was a momentary pause before she continued speaking.

meaning: n. the residence of a religious community
translation_zh: n. 修道院, 僧侣
example: The monks lived a quiet life in the ancient monastery.

meaning: n. United States tennis player who dominated women's tennis in the 1920s and 1930s (1905-1998); n. United States evangelist (1837-1899); s. subject to sharply varying moods
translation_zh: a. 心情不稳的, 郁郁寡欢的, 喜怒无常的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常喜怒无常的的解释。

meaning: n. the light of the Moon; v. work a second job, usually after hours
translation_zh: n. 月光；a. 有月光的, 月夜的
example: 这个月光 adj. 月夜的为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: moonscape
translation_zh: n. 月球表面
example: 这个moonscape（noun）为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. the significance of a story or event; a. concerned with principles of right and wrong or conforming to standards of behavior and character based on those principles; s. psychological rather than physical or tangible in effect
translation_zh: n. 道德, 品行, 寓意；a. 道德的, 品性端正的, 精神上的
example: It's important to make moral choices.

meaning: n. concern with the distinction between good and evil or right and wrong; right or good conduct
translation_zh: n. 道德, 教训, 品行；[法] 道德, 道义
example: The story explores themes of morality and justice.

meaning: r. with respect to moral principles; r. in a moral manner
translation_zh: adv. 道德上, 德性上, 有道德地
example: 他ad地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: a. subject to death; s. unrelenting and deadly
translation_zh: n. 生物, 人类；a. 不免一死的, 人类的, 临终的
example: All humans are mortal.

meaning: n. a muzzle-loading high-angle gun with a short barrel that fires shells at high elevations for a short range; n. used as a bond in masonry or for covering a wall; n. a bowl-shaped vessel in which substances can be ground and mixed with a pestle; v. plaster with mortar
translation_zh: n. 臼, 研钵, 灰泥；vt. 用灰泥涂抹, 用灰泥结合
example: The bricks were held together with mortar.

meaning: n. a conditional conveyance of property as security for the repayment of a loan; v. put up as security or collateral
translation_zh: n. 抵押, 约束性义务, 抵押借款；vt. 抵押, 以...作担保, 把...许给
example: They took out a mortgage to buy their house.

meaning: v. practice self-denial of one's body and appetites; v. hold within limits and control

meaning: r. in an original manner
translation_zh: adv. 本来, 原来, 最初, 就起源而论, 独创地
example: The house was originally built in 1900.

meaning: v. come into existence; take on form or shape; v. bring into being; v. begin a trip at a certain point, as of a plane, train, bus, etc.
translation_zh: vt. 创始, 发明, 发起；vi. 发源, 发生, 起航；[计] 发自
example: The custom originated in ancient Egypt.

meaning: v. be an ornament to
translation_zh: n. 装饰, 点缀品, 教堂用品；vt. 装饰, 修饰
example: 这个装饰品为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a unit of apothecary weight equal to 480 grains or one twelfth of a pound; n. a unit of weight equal to one sixteenth of a pound or 16 drams or 28.349 grams
translation_zh: n. 盎司, 少量, 雪豹；[医] 英两, Г
example: 这个盎司 (n.) - 重量单位为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. the bush country of the interior of Australia; s. inaccessible and sparsely populated;
translation_zh: n. 内地；a. 内地的；adv. 在内地
example: They traveled deep into the Australian outback.

meaning: n. a sudden violent spontaneous occurrence (usually of some undesirable condition)
translation_zh: n. 爆发, 暴动；[医] 暴发
example: There was a sudden outbreak of flu in the region.

meaning: n something that results; n a phenomenon that follows and is caused by some previous phenomenon
translation_zh: n. 结果, 出口
example: 这个结果为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: v. go far ahead of
translation_zh: vt. 把...远远抛在后面, 大大超越
example: 我们需要逐步outdistance这个方案。

meaning: v. get the better of
translation_zh: vt. 超越, 胜过, 战胜
example: She always tries to outdo her brother in school.

meaning: n. any cohesive unit such as a military company; n. a set of clothing (with accessories)
translation_zh: n. 用具, 配备, 机构；vt. 配备, 供应；vi. 得到装备
example: 这个（为特定场合或活动而穿的）全套服装为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: v. grow too large or too mature for; v. grow faster than
translation_zh: vt. 过大而不适于, 长得比...高(或大、快), 成长得不再具有...
example: My son has outgrown all his clothes.

meaning: n a journey taken for pleasure; n a day devoted to an outdoor social gathering; v to state openly and publicly one's homosexuality; v reveal (something) about somebody's identity or lifestyle; v be made known; be disclosed or revealed
translation_zh: n. 郊游, 远足；a. 远足适用的
example: 这个短途旅游为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n a place of business for retailing goods; n receptacle providing a place in a wiring system where current can be taken to run electrical devices; n an opening that permits escape or release; n activity that frees or expresses creative energy or emotion
translation_zh: n. 出口, 发泄方法, 市场；[医] 出口
example: She uses painting as an outlet for her creativity.

meaning: n. the line that appears to bound an object; n. a sketchy summary of the main points of an argument or theory; n. a schematic or preliminary plan
translation_zh: n. 大纲, 轮廓, 概要；vt. 描画轮廓, 描述要点；n. 大纲, 分级, 轮廓；[计] 大纲, 分级, 轮廓
example: She drew an outline of the main points for her presentation.

meaning: v. live longer than
translation_zh: vt. 比...经久, 比...活得长, 度过(风暴)而健在
example: She hopes to outlive her grandmother, who is 95.

meaning: n a habitual or characteristic mental attitude that determines how you will interpret and respond to situations; n belief about (or mental picture of) the future; n the act of looking out
translation_zh: n. 观点, 景色, 前途, 了望；[经] 展望
example: The economic outlook for next year is positive.

meaning: n. a patient who does not reside in the hospital where he is being treated
translation_zh: n. 门诊病人；[医] 门诊病人
example: The clinic treats many outpatients who don't need to stay overnight.

meaning: n. production of a certain amount; n. the quantity of something (as a commodity) that is created (usually within a given period of time); n. what is produced in a given time period; v. to create or manufacture a specific amount
translation_zh: n. 输出, 产品, 产量；[计] 输出
example: The factory's output increased this quarter.

meaning: n. a wantonly cruel act
translation_zh: n. 暴行, 侮辱, 愤怒；vt. 凌辱, 虐待, 触犯
example: There was public outrage over the decision.

meaning: s grossly offensive to decency or morality; causing horror; s greatly exceeding bounds of reason or moderation
translation_zh: a. 暴虐的, 极无礼的, 可恶的
example: The prices at that restaurant are simply outrageous.

meaning: v. shine brighter than; v. attract more attention and praise than others
translation_zh: vt. 光亮强过..., 使相形见绌, 使失色；vi. 发光
example: 我们需要逐步outshine这个方案。

meaning: n. a contestant (human or animal) not considered to have a good chance to win
translation_zh: n. 外人, 局外人, 非会员, 外行, 门外汉, 比赛中获胜可能性不大的选手；[经] 外船公司
example: He felt like an outsider in the new school.

meaning: n. outlying areas (as of a city or town)
translation_zh: n. 近郊, 市郊
example: 这个郊外为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: r. with respect to the outside; r. in outward appearance
translation_zh: adv. 表面上, 在外, 外表上
example: 他外表上地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: n a closed plane curve resulting from the intersection of a circular cone and a plane cutting completely through it; s rounded like an egg
translation_zh: n. 椭圆形；a. 卵形的, 椭圆形的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常椭圆形的的解释。

meaning: n. (usually plural) work clothing consisting of denim trousers (usually with a bib and shoulder straps); n. a loose protective coverall or smock worn over ordinary clothing for dirty work; s. involving only main features; s. including everything
translation_zh: a. 全部的, 全体的, 从头至尾的, 一切在内的；adv. 从头到尾, 总的说来；n. 罩衫, 工作服
example: The overall cost was higher than expected.

meaning: r. to extremes; r. from on board a vessel into the water
translation_zh: adv. 自船上落下, 在船外
example: Don't go overboard with the decorations.

meaning: overbook
translation_zh: vt. 使过量预订；超额订出
example: 我们需要逐步overbook这个方案。

meaning: n. an additional protective coating (as of paint or varnish)
translation_zh: n. 外套大衣
example: 这个大衣为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. an appraisal that is too high; n. a calculation that results in an estimate that is too high; v. make too high an estimate of
translation_zh: vt. 评价过高, 过高估价；n. 估计过高, 评价过高
example: Don't overestimate how much time you have to complete the task.

meaning: v hear, usually without the knowledge of the speakers
translation_zh: vt. 无意中听到, 偷听
example: 我们需要逐步overhear这个方案。

meaning: n. a representation of common ground between theories or phenomena; n. the property of partial coincidence in time; v. coincide partially or wholly; v. extend over and cover a part of
translation_zh: n. 重叠, 重复, 部分的同时发生；vt. 重叠, 重复, 与...同时发生；vi. 迭盖, 部分的同时发生；[计] 重叠
example: There's a significant overlap between their interests.

meaning: n. a high place affording a good view; v. look past, fail to notice; v. watch over
translation_zh: vt. 俯瞰, 远眺, 没注意到；n. 眺望, 俯瞰到的景色
example: Please don't overlook the details.

meaning: r to a degree exceeding normal or proper limits
translation_zh: adv. 过度地, 极度地
example: Don't be overly critical of yourself.

meaning: r. in a place across an ocean
translation_zh: a. 海外的, 国外的；adv. 在海外, 在国外
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常在向海外的解释。

meaning: v. be greater in significance than; v. cast a shadow upon
translation_zh: vt. 遮阴, 使阴暗, 使失色, 使相形见绌, 使蒙上阴影
example: His earlier achievements were overshadowed by his later failures.

meaning: s larger than normal for its kind
translation_zh: a. 太大的, 超大型的；n. 特大型
example: He bought an oversize sweater for comfort.

meaning: v pass beyond (limits or boundaries); v be superior or better than some standard
translation_zh: vt. 踏过, 逾越, 超出...的限度；[法] 违犯, 逾越
example: 我们需要逐步overstep这个方案。

meaning: v. catch up with and possibly overtake
translation_zh: vt. 赶上, 突然降临于, 压倒, 代替
example: 我们需要逐步overtake这个方案。

meaning: n. the termination of a ruler or institution (especially by force); v. cause the downfall of; of rulers
translation_zh: n. 推翻, 瓦解, 倾覆；vt. 打倒, 推翻, 倾覆
example: 我们需要逐步overthrow这个方案。

meaning: n. work done in addition to regular working hours; n. playing time beyond regulation, to break a tie; r. beyond the regular time
translation_zh: n. 超时, 加班, 延长时间；a. 超时的, 加班的；adv. 加班地；vt. 使超过时间
example: 他超出的时间地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: n. an improbable and unexpected victory; v. turn from an upright or normal position; v. cause to overturn from an upright or normal position
translation_zh: n. 倾覆, 破灭, 革命；vt. 推翻, 颠倒；vi. 翻倒
example: The boat might overturn in the strong waves.

meaning: ow
translation_zh: interj. 啊唷
example: 这个ow（noun）为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. nocturnal bird of prey with hawk-like beak and claws and large head with front-facing eyes
translation_zh: n. 猫头鹰；[法] 走私
example: 这个猫头鹰为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. an adult castrated bull of the genus Bos; especially Bos taurus; n. any of various wild bovines especially of the genera Bos or closely related Bibos
translation_zh: n. 牛
example: 这个牛为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a colorless gas (O3) soluble in alkalis and cold water; a strong oxidizing agent; can be produced by electric discharge in oxygen or by the action of ultraviolet radiation on oxygen in the stratosphere (where it acts as a screen for ultraviolet radiation)
translation_zh: n. 新鲜的空气, 臭氧, 使人愉快的影响；[化] 臭氧
example: The ozone layer protects us from harmful UV radiation.

meaning: n an informal term for a father; probably derived from baby talk; n a short-lived radioactive metallic element formed from uranium and disintegrating into actinium and then into lead; n a unit of pressure equal to one newton per square meter; n a Mid-Atlantic state; one of the original 13 colonies; n an electronic amplification system used as a communication system in public areas
translation_zh: 私人秘书, (露天)扩音系统；[计] 程序存取, 程序地址, 程序分析
example: 这个pa（noun）为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: s. pressed together or compressed
translation_zh: a. 充满...的, 满座的, 挤得满满的, 压坚实的, 塞满了...的, 挤满了人的, 拥挤的；[计] 压缩的, 装配的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常[包装] 包装（pack的过去分词） adj. （常用来构成复合词）充满…的的解释。

meaning: n. (computer science) a message or message fragment; n. a small package or bundle
translation_zh: n. 小包, 一批信件, 大量, 信息包；vt. 打包, 装进小包；[计] 分组, 分组报文, 数据分组
example: 这个小包为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a number of sheets of paper fastened together along one edge; n. the large floating leaf of an aquatic plant (as the water lily); n. a block of absorbent material saturated with ink; used to transfer ink evenly to a rubber stamp; n. a flat mass of soft material used for protection, stuffing, or comfort
translation_zh: n. 填补, 衬垫, 印色盒, 路；vt. 填补, 走, 夸大；vi. 步行；[计] 焊接点; 包装配/拆卸
example: 这个衬垫为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a brush used as an applicator (to apply paint)
translation_zh: n. 画笔, 漆刷；[计] 画笔
example: 这个漆刷为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a portable platform for storing or moving goods that are stacked on it; n. a hand tool with a flat blade used by potters for mixing and shaping clay; n. a mattress filled with straw or a pad made of quilts; used as a bed
translation_zh: n. 草铺, 简陋小床, 调色板, 棘爪；[经] 夹板
example: The boxes were stacked on a wooden pallet.

meaning: n. a flat cake of thin batter fried on both sides on a griddle
translation_zh: n. 薄烤饼, 薄煎饼, 烙饼
example: 这个薄烤饼为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. an epidemic that is geographically widespread; occurring throughout a region or even throughout the world; s. epidemic over a wide geographical area; s. existing everywhere
translation_zh: a. 大流行的, 普遍的, 全世界的；[医] 大流行的, 大流行病
example: The world faced a severe pandemic last year.

meaning: n. sheet that forms a distinct (usually flat and rectangular) section or component of something; n. (law) a group of people summoned for jury service (from whom a jury will be chosen); n. a group of people gathered for a special purpose as to plan or discuss an issue or judge a contest etc; n. a soft pad placed under a saddle
translation_zh: n. 嵌板, 仪表板, 专题讨论小组, 全体陪审员；vt. 嵌镶板
example: 这个仪表板为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. tropical American shrub or small tree having huge deeply palmately cleft leaves and large oblong yellow fruit; n. large oval melon-like tropical fruit with yellowish flesh
translation_zh: n. 番木瓜树；[化] 番瓜; 番木瓜
example: 这个番木瓜树为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: paperless
translation_zh: a. 无纸传输信息(或数据)的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常paperless（adjective）的解释。

meaning: n. work that involves handling papers: forms or letters or reports etc.
translation_zh: n. 文书工作
example: 这个文书工作为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a ceremonial procession including people marching; n. an extended (often showy) succession of persons or things; n. a visible display; v. walk ostentatiously
translation_zh: n. 游行, 炫耀, 阅兵；v. 游行, 炫耀, (使)列队行进
example: 这个游行为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. (logic) a statement that contradicts itself
translation_zh: n. 似非而是的论点, 自相矛盾的话, 悖论, 怪人怪事；[化] 佯谬
example: 这个反论为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. loss of the ability to move a body part
translation_zh: n. 麻痹, 停顿, 瘫痪；[医] 麻痹, 瘫痪
example: The accident caused temporary paralysis in his legs.

meaning: n. a person trained to assist medical professionals and to give emergency medical treatment
translation_zh: n. 伞兵军医, 伞降急救人员
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常<美>护理人员的解释。

meaning: n. a soldier in the paratroops
translation_zh: n. 伞兵
example: The paratrooper landed safely behind enemy lines.

meaning: n. a legislative assembly in certain countries
translation_zh: n. 国会, 议会；[法] 会议, 国会, 议院
example: The new law was debated in parliament.

meaning: n. the condition of sharing in common with others (as fellows or partners etc.)
translation_zh: n. 参与, 分享；[经] 参与, 参股
example: 这个参加为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a body having finite mass and internal structure but negligible dimensions; n. a function word that can be used in English to form phrasal verbs
translation_zh: n. 颗粒, 粒子, 质点, 极小量；[化] 粒子; 质点
example: Dust particles were floating in the air.

meaning: n. a fact about some part (as opposed to general); n. (logic) a proposition that asserts something about some (but not all) members of a class; s. unique or specific to a person or thing or category; s. separate and distinct from others of the same group or category
translation_zh: n. 一项(或条、点), 个别项目, 详细说明；a. 特别的, 独有的, 挑剔的, 详尽的
example: Is there any particular reason you chose that color?

meaning: n. a fervent and even militant proponent of something; n. a pike with a long tapering double-edged blade with lateral projections; 16th and 17th centuries; a. devoted to a cause or party
translation_zh: n. 党羽, 虔诚信徒, 同党, 游击队员；a. 党派的, 偏袒的, 效忠的, 献身的, 盲目推崇的
example: 这个（对个别人、团体或思想）偏袒的为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. the members of a business venture created by contract; n. a cooperative relationship between people or groups who agree to share responsibility for achieving some specific goal; n. a contract between two or more persons who agree to pool talent and money and share profits or losses
translation_zh: n. 合伙, 合股, 合作关系；[经] 合伙(合作)关系, 全体合伙人
example: They formed a partnership to start the new business.

meaning: a. having or expressing strong emotions
translation_zh: a. 热情的, 热烈的, 易怒的, 热恋的
example: She is passionate about her work.

meaning: r. with passion
translation_zh: adv. 热情地, 激昂地
example: 他热情地地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: n. only the rose-colored starlings; in some classifications considered a separate genus
translation_zh: n. 牧师
example: The pastor delivered a sermon.

meaning: n. a letter from a pastor to the congregation; n. a literary work idealizing the rural life (especially the life of shepherds); a. of or relating to a pastor
translation_zh: n. 牧歌, 田园诗；a. 牧人的, 田园生活的, 牧师的, 田园式的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常牧师的的解释。

meaning: n. a piece of cloth used as decoration or to mend or cover a hole; n. a short set of commands to correct a bug in a computer program; v. to join or unite the pieces of; v. provide with a patch; also used metaphorically
translation_zh: n. 片, 补缀, 碎片, 斑, 傻瓜；vt. 补缀, 掩饰, 拼凑, 平息；[计] 修补; 拼凑
example: 这个眼罩为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: r. with patience; in a patient manner
translation_zh: adv. 耐心地；有毅力地
example: 他耐心地地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: n. one who loves and defends his or her country
translation_zh: n. 爱国者, 爱国主义者
example: 这个爱国者为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: a. inspired by love for your country
translation_zh: a. 爱国的, 有爱国心的；[法] 爱国的, 有爱国心的
example: He felt a strong patriotic duty to serve his country.

meaning: n. love of country and willingness to sacrifice for it
translation_zh: n. 爱国心, 爱国精神, 爱国主义
example: His patriotism was evident in his actions.

meaning: n. a regular customer; n. the proprietor of an inn; n. someone who supports or champions something
translation_zh: n. 赞助人, 顾客, 保护人；[法] 保护人, 庇护人, 赞助人
example: The museum thanked its generous patrons.

meaning: n. a setting with precious stones so closely set that no metal shows; v. cover with a material such as stone or concrete to make suitable for vehicle traffic
translation_zh: vt. 铺设, 安排, 铺满, 为...铺路；[化] 铺设
example: The workers will pave the new road next week.

meaning: n. the paved surface of a thoroughfare
translation_zh: n. 路面, 人行道, 铺面路, 铺路材料
example: 这个人行道为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a clawed foot of an animal especially a quadruped; v. scrape with the paws; v. touch clumsily
translation_zh: n. 爪；v. 以蹄扒地, 用爪子抓, 拼命抓, 向...乱抓, 笨拙地使用, 费力地前进
example: 这个爪子为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a person who lends money at interest in exchange for personal property that is deposited as security
translation_zh: n. 典当商, 当铺老板
example: 这个pawnbroker（noun）为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n a shop where loans are made with personal property as security
translation_zh: n. 当铺；[经] 当铺
example: 这个pawnshop（noun）为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a sum of money paid or a claim discharged; n. the act of paying money
translation_zh: n. 付款, 支付的款项(或实物), 偿还, 报应, 惩罚；[经] 支付, 缴纳, 支付款额
example: 这个支付为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: r. in a peaceful manner
translation_zh: adv. 平静地
example: 他平静地地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: n. cultivated in temperate regions; n. downy juicy fruit with sweet yellowish or whitish flesh
translation_zh: n. 桃子, 桃树, 桃色, 美人儿, 极好的事物；vt. 告发；vi. 告密, 检举
example: 这个桃子为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. the top or extreme point of something (usually a mountain or hill)
translation_zh: n. 山峰, 巅, 山顶, 顶点, 尖峰, 帽舌；a. 最高的, 最大值的；vi. 到达最高点, 消瘦, 变憔悴, 逐渐缩小；vt. 使竖起, 使达到最高点
example: We reached the peak of the mountain.

meaning: n. a smooth lustrous round structure inside the shell of a clam or oyster; much valued as a jewel; v. gather pearls, from oysters in the ocean
translation_zh: n. 珍珠, 珠灰色, 杰出者, 珍贵之物；vt. 用珍珠镶, 使成珠状；vi. 成珠子状, 采珍珠, 用珍珠做
example: 这个珍珠为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a small smooth rounded rock
translation_zh: n. 小圆石, 小鹅卵石, 水晶透镜, 碎石花纹；[医] 小石
example: 这个卵石为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a lever that is operated with the foot; v. operate the pedals on a keyboard instrument; a. of or relating to the feet
translation_zh: n. 踏板, 脚蹬子；a. 脚的, 脚踏的；vt. 用脚踏动；vi. 踩踏板, 骑车
example: 这个踏板为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: s marked by a narrow focus on or display of learning especially its trivial aspects
translation_zh: a. 卖弄学问的, 学究式的, 假装学者的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常迂腐的的解释。

meaning: n. a person who travels by foot; s. lacking wit or imagination
translation_zh: n. 行人, 步行者；a. 人行的, 徒步的, 呆板的, 通俗的, 平淡无奇的
example: 这个步行者为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n liquid excretory product; n informal terms for urination; v eliminate urine
translation_zh: n. (英)便士, 小便；vi. 小便
example: 我们需要逐步pee这个方案。

meaning: n. British politician (1788-1850); n. the rind of a fruit or vegetable
translation_zh: n. 皮, 外壳；vt. 削...皮, 剥去...的壳；vi. 蜕皮, 剥落, 脱皮, 脱去衣服
example: 这个除去为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: v. look furtively; v. cause to appear; v. make high-pitched sounds; v. speak in a hesitant and high-pitched tone of voice
translation_zh: n. 一瞥, 偷看, 不完全的景象, 初现, 吱吱声, 嘀咕抱怨声, 汽车喇叭声；vi. 窥视, 出现, 吱吱叫；vt. 使隐约显现
example: 这个窥视为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a person who is of equal standing with another in a group; n. a nobleman (duke or marquis or earl or viscount or baron) who is a member of the British peerage; v. look searchingly
translation_zh: n. 同等的人, 匹敌, 贵族；vi. 凝视, 窥视, 费力地看, 隐现；vt. 与...同等, 封为贵族
example: Children often learn a lot from their peers.

meaning: n. a wooden pin pushed or driven into a surface; n. small markers inserted into a surface to mark scores or define locations etc.; n. a prosthesis that replaces a missing leg; n. regulator that can be turned to regulate the pitch of the strings of a stringed instrument
translation_zh: n. 钉, 桩, 栓, 藉口, 销子, 借口；vt. 钉木钉, 固定, 限制, 使受约束；vi. 坚持不懈地奋力于, 疾行
example: 这个钉为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a payment required for not fulfilling a contract; n. the disadvantage or painful consequences of an action or condition; n. (games) a handicap or disadvantage that is imposed on a competitor (or a team) for an infraction of the rules of the game
translation_zh: n. 处罚, 刑罚, 罚款, 罚球, 报应, 不利结果, 妨碍；[经] 罚金(款), 违约金
example: The referee awarded a penalty kick.

meaning: v. pass into or through, often by overcoming resistance; v. come to understand; v. make one's way deeper into or through; v. insert the penis into the vagina or anus of
translation_zh: vt. 穿透, 刺穿, 渗透, 看穿, 洞察, 了解, 使充溢；vi. 刺入, 看穿, 渗透, 打进
example: The roots of the tree can penetrate deep into the soil.

meaning: n. short-legged flightless birds of cold southern especially Antarctic regions having webbed feet and wings modified as flippers
translation_zh: n. 企鹅, 空军地勤人员
example: 这个企鹅为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. any of various antibiotics obtained from Penicillium molds (or produced synthetically) and used in the treatment of various infections and diseases
translation_zh: n. 盘尼西林, 青霉素；[化] 青霉素
example: Penicillin revolutionized medicine.

meaning: n. a regular payment to a person that is intended to allow them to subsist without working; v. grant a pension to
translation_zh: n. 养老金, 退休金, 津贴, 年金, 抚恤金, 膳宿学校, 膳宿费；vt. 发给退休金, 用津贴拉拢
example: He retired last year and is now living on his pension.

meaning: n. a government building with five sides that serves as the headquarters of the United States Department of Defense; n. the United States military establishment; n. a five-sided polygon
translation_zh: n. 五角形, 五边形；[经] 五角平台
example: 这个地名 美国 五角大楼〈弗吉尼亚州〉为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: v. to become aware of through the senses; v. become conscious of
translation_zh: v. 感觉; 认识, 理解; 察觉到, 意识到, 注意到
example: He could perceive a faint light in the distance.

meaning: n. a proportion in relation to a whole (which is usually the amount per hundred)
translation_zh: n. 百分比, 比率, 部分, 可能性；[计] 百分比
example: 这个百分比为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a way of conceiving something; n. the process of perceiving; n. knowledge gained by perceiving
translation_zh: n. 知觉, 感觉, 领悟力, 获取；[医] 知觉
example: His perception of the situation was very different from mine.

meaning: n. the property of being able to exist for an indefinite duration
translation_zh: n. 永久, 持久, 固定性；[法] 永久性, 持久性
example: They sought permanence in their relationship.

meaning: v. spread or diffuse through
translation_zh: vt. 弥漫, 渗透, 充满, 影响, 感染；vi. 透入, 散布
example: 我们需要逐步permeate这个方案。

meaning: n. the act of persisting or persevering; continuing or repeating behavior
translation_zh: n. 毅力, 忍耐, 锲而不舍, 不屈不挠
example: Her perseverance paid off when she finally achieved her goal.

meaning: v. stay behind
translation_zh: vi. 坚持, 固执, 持续, 坚称；[经] 持续
example: 我们需要逐步persist这个方案。

meaning: n the property of a continuous and connected period of time; n persistent determination; n the act of persisting or persevering; continuing or repeating behavior
translation_zh: n. 固执, 坚持不懈, 持续(性), 存留(状态)；[电] 持久
example: Her persistence paid off, and she finally achieved her goal.

meaning: s. never-ceasing; a. retained; not shed
translation_zh: a. 固执的, 坚持的, 持续的, 作用持久的；[法] 坚持的, 固执的, 持续的
example: Her persistent efforts finally paid off.

meaning: n. a person who represents an abstract quality; n. representing an abstract quality or idea as a person or creature; n. the act of attributing human characteristics to abstract ideas etc.
translation_zh: n. 拟人, 人格化, 拟人法, 化身, 象征
example: 这个人格化为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: v. attribute human qualities to something
translation_zh: vt. 看做人, 赋与人性, 使人格化, 体现, 是...的化身
example: 我们需要逐步personify这个方案。

meaning: n group of people willing to obey orders; n the department responsible for hiring and training and placing employees and for setting policies for personnel management
translation_zh: n. 人员, 人事部门, 人事科(处)；[经] 人事, 全体人员, 职工
example: 这个（公司、组织或军队中的）全体人员为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. the appearance of things relative to one another as determined by their distance from the viewer
translation_zh: n. 远景, 透视感, (观察问题的)视角, 透视法, 看法, 透视图；a. 透视的, 透视法的；[计] 透视
example: Try to see the situation from her perspective.

meaning: n. salty fluid secreted by sweat glands; n. the process of the sweat glands of the skin secreting a salty fluid
translation_zh: n. 汗, 流汗, 努力；[医] 出汗; 汗
example: Beads of perspiration formed on his forehead.

meaning: n. the act of persuading (or attempting to persuade); communication intended to induce belief or action
translation_zh: n. 说服, 信念, 派别, 说服力
example: He used his powers of persuasion to convince them.

meaning: n. a person who expects the worst
translation_zh: n. 悲观者, 厌世者, 悲观主义者
example: Don't be such a pessimist; things will get better.

meaning: a. expecting the worst possible outcome
translation_zh: a. 悲观的, 厌世的, 悲观主义的
example: He has a very pessimistic outlook on the future.

meaning: v cause to become stonelike or stiff or dazed and stunned; v change into stone; v make rigid and set into a conventional pattern
translation_zh: a. 惊呆的; 目瞪口呆的；v. 使吓呆, 使惊呆; 变僵硬; 使石化(petrify的过去式和过去分词)
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常惊呆的的解释。

meaning: s. contemptibly narrow in outlook
translation_zh: a. 琐碎的, 小规模的, 小气的, 委琐的；[经] 小额的, 微小的, 小规模的
example: Don't argue over such petty matters.

meaning: n. (from potential of Hydrogen) the logarithm of the reciprocal of hydrogen-ion concentration in gram atoms per liter; provides a measure on a scale from 0 to 14 of the acidity or alkalinity of a solution (where 7 is neutral and greater than 7 is more basic and less than 7 is more acidic);
translation_zh: 氢离子指数；[医] 药典; 苯基
example: 这个ph（noun）为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a health professional trained in the art of preparing and dispensing drugs
translation_zh: n. 药师, 药品商, 药商, 药剂师；[医] 药师, 调剂员, 药商
example: 这个药剂师为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. any distinct time period in a sequence of events; n. (physical chemistry) a distinct state of matter in a system; matter that is identical in chemical composition and physical state and separated from other material by the phase boundary; n. a particular point in the time of a cycle; measured from some arbitrary zero and expressed as an angle; n. (astronomy) the particular appearance of a body's state of illumination (especially one of the recurring shapes of the part of Earth's moon that is illuminated by the sun)
translation_zh: n. 时期, 局面, 方面, 位相, 相, 阶段；vt. 使调整相位, 使定相, 使一致, 逐步执行, 实行；[计] 阶段
example: The project is currently in its final phase.

meaning: s. characterized by the attitude of a philosopher; meeting trouble with level-headed detachment
translation_zh: a. 哲学的, 冷静的, 达观的, 哲学上的, 哲学家似的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常哲学上的冷静的的解释。

meaning: n a licensed medical practitioner
translation_zh: n. 医师, 内科医师, 解除痛苦者；[医] 主治医师
example: The physician advised him to rest.

meaning: n. the ratio of the circumference to the diameter of a circle; approximately equal to 3.14159265358979323846...; n. the 16th letter of the Greek alphabet
translation_zh: n. 圆周率；[计] 处理器接口, 程序中断
example: 这个pi（noun）为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. vegetables (especially cucumbers) preserved in brine or vinegar; v. preserve in a pickling liquid
translation_zh: n. 盐卤, 腌汁, 泡菜, 困境, 讨厌鬼；vt. 腌制, 酸洗, 葬送(机会等), 泡
example: 这个腌渍（泡菜等）n.腌菜为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: s exacting especially about details
translation_zh: a. 吹毛求疵的, 挑剔的, 找麻烦的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常吹毛求疵的的解释。

meaning: s. suggesting or suitable for a picture; pretty as a picture; s. strikingly expressive
translation_zh: a. 生动的, 如画的, 独特的, 别致的, 栩栩如生的
