example: 她在演讲中给出了非常（地方）古雅的的解释。

meaning: n bed linen consisting of a cover for a pillow
translation_zh: n. 枕套
example: 这个枕套（等同pillow slip）为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a piece of jewelry that is pinned onto the wearer's garment; n. informal terms for the leg; n. cylindrical tumblers consisting of two parts that are held in place by springs; when they are aligned with a key the bolt can be thrown; n. flagpole used to mark the position of the hole on a golf green
translation_zh: n. 大头针, 针, 别针, 栓, 销子, 图钉, 插头, 管脚, 品(液量单位)；vt. 将...用针别住, 钉住, 压住, 牵制, 使不能动, 归罪于；a. 针的, 销子的, 闩的
example: 这个大头针为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a coniferous tree; n. straight-grained durable and often resinous white to yellowish timber of any of numerous trees of the genus Pinus
translation_zh: n. 松树, 松木；vi. 消瘦, 憔悴, 痛苦, 怀念, 渴望；[计] 邮件程序
example: 这个[林] 松树为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a British imperial capacity measure (liquid or dry) equal to 4 gills or 568.26 cubic centimeters; n. a United States dry unit equal to 0.5 quart or 33.6 cubic inches; n. a United States liquid unit equal to 16 fluid ounces; two pints equal one quart
translation_zh: n. 品脱(干量或液量的单位)；[医] 量磅, 品脱
example: 这个品脱为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. hijacking on the high seas or in similar contexts; taking a ship or plane away from the control of those who are legally entitled to it
translation_zh: n. 海盗行为, 海上劫掠, 剽窃, 著作权侵害, 非法翻印；[法] 海盗行为, 海上掠夺, 海盗罪
example: Software piracy is a serious problem for many companies.

meaning: n. someone who robs at sea or plunders the land from the sea without having a commission from any sovereign nation; n. a ship that is manned by pirates; v. copy illegally; of published material
translation_zh: n. 海盗, 盗印者, 侵犯专利权者；vt. 盗印, 掠夺, 翻印；vi. 做海盗, 从事劫掠
example: 这个海盗为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. the property of sound that varies with variation in the frequency of vibration; n. (baseball) the act of throwing a baseball by a pitcher to a batter; n. a vendor's position (especially on the sidewalk); n. degree of deviation from a horizontal plane
translation_zh: n. 程度, 坡度, 顶点, 前倾, 倾斜, 投掷, 音高, 螺距, 节距, 摊位, 树脂, 沥青；vt. 投, 掷, 向前倾跌, 扎营, 竭力推销, 为...定调, 定位于, 用沥青涂；vi. 搭帐篷, 投掷, 向前跌, 猛然摔倒, 坠落, 倾斜；[计] 孔距
example: 这个&lt为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a serious (sometimes fatal) infection of rodents caused by Yersinia pestis and accidentally transmitted to humans by the bite of a flea that has bitten an infected animal; n. any epidemic disease with a high death rate; n. any large scale calamity (especially when thought to be sent by God); n. an annoyance
translation_zh: n. 瘟疫, 天罚, 麻烦, 灾祸；vt. 折磨, 使苦恼, 使得灾祸
example: The Black Death was a devastating plague.

meaning: n. an act of formulating a program for a definite course of action; n. the act or process of drawing up plans or layouts for some project or enterprise; n. the cognitive process of thinking about what you will do in the event of something happening
translation_zh: n. 计划的制订, 策划, 设计, 规划；[计] 计划, 规划
example: 这个计划编制为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a companion at play
translation_zh: n. 玩伴, 游伴
example: 这个一起玩耍的朋友为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n someone who writes plays
translation_zh: n. 剧作家
example: William Shakespeare is a famous playwright.

meaning: v. appeal or request earnestly; v. offer as an excuse or plea; v. enter a plea, as in courts of law; v. make an allegation in an action or other legal proceeding, especially answer the previous pleading of the other party by denying facts therein stated or by alleging new facts
translation_zh: vi. 辩护, 恳求；vt. 为...辩护, 提出...借口, 托称, 恳求
example: He decided to plead guilty to the charges.

meaning: n. a secret scheme to do something (especially something underhand or illegal); n. a small area of ground covered by specific vegetation; n. the story that is told in a novel or play or movie etc.; n. a chart or map showing the movements or progress of an object
translation_zh: n. 小块土地, 地区图, 图, 阴谋, 情节；vt. 划分, 绘图, 密谋；vi. 密谋, 策划；[计] 绘制
example: 这个阴谋为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. the act of pulling and releasing a taut cord; v. pull or pull out sharply; v. pull lightly but sharply with a plucking motion; v. strip of feathers
translation_zh: n. 勇气, 猛拉, 动物内脏；vt. 摘, 猛拉, 拔, 拉, 扯, 采；vi. 拉, 拽
example: She carefully plucked a single rose from the bush.

meaning: n. any of several trees producing edible oval fruit having a smooth skin and a single hard stone; n. any of numerous varieties of small to medium-sized round or oval fruit having a smooth skin and a single pit; n. a highly desirable position or assignment
translation_zh: n. 李子
example: 这个李子为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a craftsman who installs and repairs pipes and fixtures and appliances
translation_zh: n. 水管工人；[法] 堵漏防漏人员
example: 这个管子工为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. respiratory disease characterized by inflammation of the lung parenchyma (excluding the bronchi) with congestion caused by viruses or bacteria or irritants
translation_zh: n. 肺炎；[医] 肺炎
example: He was diagnosed with pneumonia and needed to rest.

meaning: a. not having a point especially a sharp point
translation_zh: a. 不尖的, 钝的, 不得要领的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常无意义的的解释。

meaning: n an acute viral disease marked by inflammation of nerve cells of the brain stem and spinal cord
translation_zh: n. 脊髓灰质炎, 小儿麻痹症；[医] 脊髓灰质炎
example: The vaccine helped to eradicate polio in many parts of the world.

meaning: n. the property of being smooth and shiny; n. a highly developed state of perfection; having a flawless or impeccable quality; n. a preparation used in polishing; n. the Slavic language of Poland
translation_zh: a. 波兰的；n. 波兰人, 上光剂, 光泽, 优雅；vt. 擦亮, 擦去, 使完美；vi. 擦亮, 变得光亮
example: 这个磨光为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a courteous manner that respects accepted social usage; n. the act of showing regard for others
translation_zh: n. 有礼, 优雅
example: 这个有礼貌为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: r. with regard to social relationships involving authority; r. with regard to government
translation_zh: adv. 政治上
example: The decision was politically motivated.

meaning: n. a politically organized unit; n. shrewd or crafty management of public affairs
translation_zh: n. 政体, 国体, 政治组织；[法] 政府, 政治制度, 政治形态
example: 这个政治组织为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. Venetian traveler who explored Asia in the 13th century and served Kublai Khan (1254-1324); n. a game similar to field hockey but played on horseback using long-handled mallets and a wooden ball
translation_zh: n. 马球, 水球
example: 这个马球为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: v reflect deeply on a subject
translation_zh: v. 沉思, 考虑
example: She paused to ponder her next move.

meaning: n. the quality of being widely admired or accepted or sought after
translation_zh: n. 名声, 受大众欢迎, 流行
example: 这个普及为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a structure attached to the exterior of a building often forming a covered entrance
translation_zh: n. 门廊, 走廊
example: 这个门廊 (n.) - 房屋入口处为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n something determined in relation to something that includes it; n something less than the whole of a human artifact; n the allotment of some amount by dividing something; n assets belonging to or due to or contributed by an individual person or group; n your overall circumstances or condition in life (including everything that happens to you); n money or property brought by a woman to her husband at marriage; n an individual quantity of food or drink taken as part of a meal; v give out
translation_zh: n. 部分, 一份, 命运, 嫁妆；vt. 分配, 给...嫁妆
example: 这个（某物的）一部分为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a posture assumed by models for photographic or artistic purposes; v. pretend to be someone you are not; sometimes with fraudulent intentions; v. behave affectedly or unnaturally in order to impress others
translation_zh: n. 姿势, 姿态, 装模作样, 伪装；vi. 摆姿势, 装模作样, 假装；vt. 使摆好姿势, 提出, 造成
example: 这个造成为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: s elegant and fashionable
translation_zh: a. 豪华的, 漂亮的, 优雅的, 极好的；interj. 呸
example: They stayed in a very posh hotel in the city center.

meaning: v have as an attribute, knowledge, or skill; v have ownership or possession of; v enter into and control, as of emotions or ideas; s influenced or controlled by a powerful force such as a strong emotion; s frenzied as if possessed by a demon
translation_zh: a. 中邪魔的, 被妖魔缠住的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常具有占据的解释。

meaning: a. of or relating to the system for delivering mail
translation_zh: a. 邮政的, 邮局的；[经] 邮政的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常邮政的的解释。

meaning: v. hold back to a later time
translation_zh: vt. 延迟, 使延期, 缓办, 搁延；vi. 延缓, 延缓发作
example: 我们需要逐步postpone这个方案。

meaning: s. having great influence; s. having or wielding force or authority; a. having a strong physiological or chemical effect; a. (of a male) capable of copulation
translation_zh: a. 有力的, 有说服力的, 有效的；[医] 有力的, 有性交能力的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常强大的的解释。

meaning: n. the inherent capacity for coming into being; a. existing in possibility
translation_zh: n. 潜在性, 可能性, 潜力, 潜能, 势, 位；a. 有潜力的, 可能的, 潜在的
example: He has great potential as a leader.

meaning: r. with a possibility of becoming actual
translation_zh: adv. 可能地, 潜在地
example: 他潜在地地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: r. in a powerful manner
translation_zh: adv. 强有力, 强大, 效力大, 有权威, 权力大, 有影响, 很多, 相当, 非常
example: 他强大地地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: n. concerned with actual use rather than theoretical possibilities
translation_zh: n. 实际性, 实用性, 实际事物
example: We need to consider the practicality of implementing such a large-scale project.

meaning: r. almost; nearly; r. in a practical manner
translation_zh: adv. 几乎, 差不多, 事实上
example: It was practically impossible to finish on time.

meaning: v. spring forward on the hind legs; v. cause (a horse) to bound spring forward; v. ride a horse such that it springs and bounds forward
translation_zh: n. (马)腾跃, 昂首阔步；vi. 腾跃, 昂首阔步；vt. 使腾跃
example: The horse began to prance excitedly before the race.

meaning: n. any of various edible decapod crustaceans; n. shrimp-like decapod crustacean having two pairs of pincers; most are edible; v. fish for prawns
translation_zh: n. 明虾, 对虾；vi. 捕虾
example: 这个对虾为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: v. come before; v. be the predecessor of; v. move ahead (of others) in time or space; v. furnish with a preface or introduction
translation_zh: vt. 在...之前, 优于, 较...优先；vi. 在前面
example: A short introduction will precede the main presentation.

meaning: r. indicating exactness or preciseness; r. in a precise manner; r. just as it should be
translation_zh: adv. 精确地, 明确地, 刻板地, 拘泥地, 正好, 恰恰, 对, 正是如此, 确实如此, 不错
example: That's precisely what I meant.

meaning: n. a situation from which extrication is difficult especially an unpleasant or trying one
translation_zh: n. 处境, 穷境, 困局
example: 这个困境为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. (logic) what is predicated of the subject of a proposition; the second term in a proposition is predicated of the first term by means of the copula; n. one of the two main constituents of a sentence; the predicate contains the verb and its complements; v. make the (grammatical) predicate in a proposition
translation_zh: n. 谓语, 谓项；a. 谓语的；vt. 断定为, 使基于, 意味着, 预言；vi. 断言；[计] 谓词; 判定; 断定
example: 我们需要逐步predicate这个方案。

meaning: a. of adjectives; relating to or occurring within the predicate of a sentence
translation_zh: a. 断定性的, 谓语性的, 表语的；n. 谓语性成分, 表语
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常predicative（adjective）的解释。

meaning: a. capable of being foretold
translation_zh: a. 可预言的
example: The movie's ending was very predictable.

meaning: s. of or relating to prediction; having value for making predictions
translation_zh: a. 预言性的, 成为前兆的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常预言性的的解释。

meaning: n. information that supports a probabilistic estimate of future events; n. a computer for controlling antiaircraft fire that computes the position of an aircraft at the instant of a shell's arrival
translation_zh: n. 预言者；[计] 预示变量; 预测程序
example: High school grades are often a good predictor of college success.

meaning: n. a chief officer or chief magistrate
translation_zh: n. 长官, 地方行政长官；[法] 县长, 地方行政长官, 司令官
example: She was appointed school prefect in her final year.

meaning: s. more desirable than another
translation_zh: a. 更可取的, 更好的, 更合意的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常更好的的解释。

meaning: r. more readily or willingly
translation_zh: adv. 更可取地, 更好地, 更合意地
example: Please arrive on time, preferably a few minutes early.

meaning: s. belonging to or existing in times before recorded history; a. of or relating to times before written history; s. no longer fashionable
translation_zh: a. 历史以前的, 史前的
example: Dinosaurs lived in prehistoric times.

meaning: prehuman
translation_zh: a. 人类出现以前的, 类人猿的
example: 这个prehuman（noun）为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: preindustrial
translation_zh: a. 未工业化的, 工业化前的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常preindustrial（adjective）的解释。

meaning: v. judge beforehand, especially without sufficient evidence
translation_zh: vt. 预先判断, 对...预先作出判决
example: 我们需要逐步prejudge这个方案。

meaning: n. a minor match preceding the main event; n. something that serves as a preceding event or introduces what follows; s. denoting an action or event preceding or in preparation for something more important; designed to orient or acquaint with a situation before proceeding
translation_zh: n. 初步做法, 初步措施, 预试, 预选赛；a. 初步的, 开始的, 预备的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常初步的的解释。

meaning: v. engage or engross the interest or attention of beforehand or occupy urgently or obsessively; v. occupy or take possession of beforehand or before another or appropriate for use in advance
translation_zh: vt. 抢先占领, 使全神贯注
example: 我们需要逐步preoccupy这个方案。

meaning: v issue commands or orders for
translation_zh: v. 规定, 指定, 嘱咐, 开处方
example: The doctor prescribed antibiotics for her infection.

meaning: n. someone who presents a message of some sort (as a petition or an address or a check or a memorial etc.); n. an advocate who presents a person (as for an award or a degree or an introduction etc.)
translation_zh: n. 节目主持人, 奉献者, 提出者；[法] 告发者, 提出者, 推荐者
example: 这个节目主持人为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. the tenure of a president; n. the office and function of president
translation_zh: n. 总统职权, 总裁职位
example: His presidency lasted for four years.

meaning: a. relating to a president or presidency; a. befitting a president
translation_zh: a. 总统制的, 总统的, 首长的, 统辖的；[法] 总统的, 议长的, 总经理的
example: The presidential election will be held next year.

meaning: n. a high standing achieved through success or influence or wealth etc.
translation_zh: n. 声望, 威望, 威信；[经] 商誉, 声誉
example: The university has a lot of academic prestige.

meaning: s. exerting influence by reason of high status or prestige
translation_zh: a. 享有声望的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常受尊敬的的解释。

meaning: r. by reasonable assumption
translation_zh: adv. 推测上, 大概
example: Presumably, he's still at work.

meaning: v. put forward a claim and assert right or possession of
translation_zh: v. 假装, 伪称, 自命, 自称
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常伪装的解释。

meaning: v. be valid, applicable, or true; v. continue to exist; v. prove superior; v. use persuasion successfully
translation_zh: vi. 获胜, 流行, 盛行；[医] 流行, 盛行
example: Justice will eventually prevail.

meaning: n. the act of preventing
translation_zh: n. 阻止, 妨碍, 预防；[医] 预防
example: Disease prevention is crucial for public health.

meaning: n. remedy that prevents or slows the course of an illness or disease; s. preventing or contributing to the prevention of disease; a. tending to prevent or hinder
translation_zh: a. 预防的, 防止的；n. 防止物, 预防方法, 预防药
example: Preventive measures were taken to avoid the spread of the disease.

meaning: r. at an earlier time or formerly
translation_zh: adv. 先, 先前, 以前, 前, (非正式)过早, 过急, 在前, 在...以前, 在先；[计] 先前地
example: 他事先地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: s having incalculable monetary, intellectual, or spiritual worth
translation_zh: a. 无价的, 极贵重的
example: The ancient artifact was considered priceless.

meaning: n. the act of puncturing with a small point; v. cause a stinging pain; v. to cause a sharp emotional pain
translation_zh: vt. 刺, 戳, 刺痛, 使竖起；vi. 刺, 竖起；n. 扎, 一刺, 刺痛；a. 竖起的
example: She felt a prick from the rose thorn.

meaning: n. a preliminary election where delegates or nominees are chosen; n. one of the main flight feathers projecting along the outer edge of a bird's wing; n. (astronomy) a celestial body (especially a star) relative to other objects in orbit around it; a. of first rank or importance or value; direct and immediate rather than secondary
translation_zh: n. 最主要者, 原色；a. 主要的, 初期的, 根本的, 原始的, 首要的, 基本的；[计] 初等量; 主要的; 一次的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常主要的的解释。

meaning: n. a number that has no factor but itself and 1; n. the second canonical hour; about 6 a.m.; n. the time of maturity when power and vigor are greatest; v. insert a primer into (a gun, mine, or charge) preparatory to detonation or firing
translation_zh: n. 最佳部分, 初期, 全盛期；a. 主要的, 最初的, 根本的；v. 加油启动, 灌注, 填装
example: His prime concern is the safety of his family.

meaning: n. the head of a religious order; in an abbey the prior is next below the abbot
translation_zh: a. 更重要的, 较早的, 在先的；n. 小隐修院院长, 大隐修院副院长
example: You need to get prior approval for this.

meaning: n. preceding in time
translation_zh: n. 优先权, 优先；[计] 优先级
example: 这个优先为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: r. kept private or confined to those intimately concerned; r. by a private person or interest
translation_zh: adv. 秘密地；私下地
example: 他私下地地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: n. a special advantage or immunity or benefit not enjoyed by all; n. (law) the right to refuse to divulge information obtained in a confidential relationship; v. bestow a privilege upon
translation_zh: n. 特权, 特别恩典, 基本权利, 特免；vt. 给与...特权, 特免
example: It was a privilege to meet her.

meaning: n. an applicant likely to be chosen; a. likely but not certain to be or become true or real; s. apparently destined
translation_zh: a. 很可能的, 大概的, 可信的；n. 很有希望的候选人, 很可能的事情
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常很可能发生（或存在等）的的解释。

meaning: n. an inquiry into unfamiliar or questionable activities; n. a flexible slender surgical instrument with a blunt end that is used to explore wounds or body cavities; n. an exploratory action or expedition; n. an investigation conducted using a flexible surgical instrument to explore an injury or a body cavity
translation_zh: n. 探索, 调查, 探针, 探测器；v. 用探针探测, 调查, 探索
example: The police launched a full probe into the incident.

meaning: n. a particular course of action intended to achieve a result; n. a mode of conducting legal and parliamentary proceedings
translation_zh: n. 程序, 过程, 手续；[计] 规程; 过程
example: 这个程序为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. an analysis (often in graphical form) representing the extent to which something exhibits various characteristics; n. an outline of something (especially a human face as seen from one side); n. biographical sketch; n. a vertical section of the Earth's crust showing the different horizons or layers
translation_zh: n. 侧面, 轮廓, 传略；vt. 描绘...轮廓, 写...的传略；[计] 提问档; 剖面图法; 剖面法
example: 这个（人头部的）侧面（像）为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. the advantageous quality of being beneficial; v. derive a benefit from; v. make a profit; gain money or materially
translation_zh: n. 利润, 赢利, 利益；vi. 有益, 获利, 赚钱；vt. 有益于
example: 这个利润为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: a. yielding material gain or profit
translation_zh: a. 有利润的, 有利益的, 赚钱的；[经] 有利(可图)的, 合算的
example: The new business venture proved to be very profitable.

meaning: n. a person who designs and writes and tests computer programs
translation_zh: n. 程序员；[计] 程序设计员; 程序员
example: 这个计 程序设计者为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. creating a sequence of instructions to enable the computer to do something
translation_zh: n. 节目的计划, 编制程序；[计] 程序设计; 程序编制
example: 这个规划为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: v command against
translation_zh: vt. 禁止, 阻止；[经] 禁止
example: Smoking is prohibited in this area.

meaning: n. a planned undertaking; v. communicate vividly; v. transfer (ideas or principles) from one domain into another; v. project on a screen
translation_zh: n. 计划, 设计, 事业；vt. 计划, 设计, 投掷, 发射, 使凸出, 放映；vi. 凸出
example: 这个项目为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a prediction made by extrapolating from past observations; n. the projection of an image from a film onto a screen; n. any structure that branches out from a central support; n. any solid convex shape that juts out from something
translation_zh: n. 发射, 计划, 突出部分, 设计, 推测；[计] 投影
example: The company's sales projections look promising for next quarter.

meaning: n a formal ball held for a school class toward the end of the academic year
translation_zh: n. (英)音乐会, (美)舞会, 散步道；[计] 可编程序只读存储器
example: 这个正式舞会为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. the state of being prominent: widely known or eminent; n. relative importance
translation_zh: n. 突起, 突出, 显著, 突出物, 凸出；[医] 隆凸, 凸
example: The issue has gained prominence in recent debates.

meaning: n. a cue given to a performer (usually the beginning of the next line to be spoken); n. (computer science) a symbol that appears on the computer screen to indicate that the computer is ready to receive a command; v. serve as the inciting cause of; v. assist (somebody acting or reciting) by suggesting the next words of something forgotten or imperfectly learned
translation_zh: n. 激励, 提示, 提醒物, 提词, 付款期限；a. 迅速的, 敏捷的, 立刻的, 提词员的；vt. 激励, 鼓动, 提示；adv. 准时地；[计] 提示符; DOS内部命令:设定DOS命令行的提示符
example: His question prompted a long discussion.

meaning: r. with little or no delay; r. in a punctual manner; r. at once (usually modifies an undesirable occurrence)
translation_zh: adv. 敏捷地, 迅速地
example: 他ad地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: n a person who pleads for a cause or propounds an idea
translation_zh: n. 建议者, 支持者；[法] 提议者, 辩护者, 支持者
example: 这个支持者为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: v make a proposal, declare a plan for something; v present for consideration, examination, criticism, etc.; v propose or intend; v put forward; nominate for appointment to an office or for an honor or position; v ask (someone) to marry you
translation_zh: a. 被提议的；所推荐的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常被提议的的解释。

meaning: n. ordinary writing as distinguished from verse; n. matter of fact, commonplace, or dull expression
translation_zh: n. 散文；v. 写散文；a. 散文的, 平凡的
example: 这个散文为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: v. conduct a prosecution in a court of law; v. bring a criminal action against (in a trial); v. carry out or participate in an activity; be involved in
translation_zh: vt. 告发, 起诉, 彻底进行, 执行, 从事；vi. 告发, 起诉, 作检察官
example: The state decided to prosecute the suspect.

meaning: n. the possibility of future success; v. search for something desirable; v. explore for useful or valuable things or substances, such as minerals
translation_zh: n. 景色, 展望；vt. 勘探, 勘察；vi. 勘探, 有前途
example: 这个可能性为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: v make steady progress; be at the high point in one's career or reach a high point in historical significance or importance
translation_zh: vi. 繁荣, 兴隆, 成功；vt. 使成功, 使昌盛
example: The business began to prosper after the new marketing campaign.

meaning: r. with pride; in a proud manner
translation_zh: adv. 傲慢地, 自大地, 得意洋洋地
example: 他ad地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: v be shown or be found to be; v establish the validity of something, as by an example, explanation or experiment; v provide evidence for; v prove formally; demonstrate by a mathematical, formal proof; v put to the test, as for its quality, or give experimental use to; v increase in volume; v cause to puff up with a leaven; v take a trial impression of; v obtain probate of; a established beyond doubt
translation_zh: prove的过去分词
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常经过验证或证实的v.证明（ prove的过去分词 ）的解释。

meaning: n. the proper sphere or extent of your activities
translation_zh: n. 省, 地方, 职权, 领域；[法] 省, 地方, 领域
example: Quebec is a large province in Canada.

meaning: n. a stipulated condition; n. the activity of supplying or providing something; n. a store or supply of something (especially of food or clothing or arms); v. supply with provisions
translation_zh: n. (政府提供的)钱和设备, 准备, 供应品, 规定, 条款；vt. 供给...食物及必需品
example: The contract includes a provision for early termination.

meaning: n. the property of being close together; n. the region close around a person or thing; n. a Gestalt principle of organization holding that (other things being equal) objects or events that are near to one another (in space or time) are perceived as belonging together as a unit
translation_zh: n. 接近, 亲近
example: The proximity of the two houses made it easy to visit.

meaning: r. with regard to psychology; r. in terms of psychology
translation_zh: adv. 心理上, 从心理学角度
example: 他心理上地地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: n. the science of mental life
translation_zh: n. 心理学, 心理状态；[医] 心理学
example: He is studying psychology at university.

meaning: n. a copy of a printed work offered for distribution; n. the communication of something to the public; making information generally known; n. the business of issuing printed matter for sale or distribution
translation_zh: n. 出版物, 出版, 公布；[经] 发布
example: The new scientific publication was widely discussed.

meaning: n. the quality of being open to public view
translation_zh: n. 名声, 宣传, 公开场合；[经] 宣传, 广告
example: The new movie generated a lot of publicity.

meaning: n. any of various soft thick unsweetened baked dishes; n. (British) the dessert course of a meal (`pud' is used informally); n. any of various soft sweet desserts thickened usually with flour and baked or boiled or steamed
translation_zh: n. 布丁
example: 这个（一道）甜食为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. the rhythmic contraction and expansion of the arteries with each beat of the heart; n. the rate at which the heart beats; usually measured to obtain a quick evaluation of a person's health; n. edible seeds of various pod-bearing plants (peas or beans or lentils etc.); v. produce or modulate (as electromagnetic waves) in the form of short bursts or pulses or cause an apparatus to produce pulses
translation_zh: n. 脉冲, 脉搏, 情绪, 意向, 拍子, 豆类；vi. 跳动, 脉跳；vt. 使跳动, 用脉冲调制；[计] 脉冲
example: 这个脉搏为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a coarse vine widely cultivated for its large pulpy round orange fruit with firm orange skin and numerous seeds; subspecies of Cucurbita pepo include the summer squashes and a few autumn squashes; n. usually large pulpy deep-yellow round fruit of the squash family maturing in late summer or early autumn
translation_zh: n. 南瓜
example: 这个南瓜为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. (boxing) a blow with the fist; n. an iced mixed drink usually containing alcohol and prepared for multiple servings; normally served in a punch bowl; n. a tool for making holes or indentations; v. deliver a quick blow to
translation_zh: n. 打洞器, 钻孔机, 冲压机, 冲床, 潘趣酒；vt. 以拳重击, 开洞, 冲压；vi. 用拳猛击
example: 这个一拳为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: a. acting or arriving or performed exactly at the time appointed
translation_zh: a. 准时的, 守时的, 点状的, 中肯的；[经] 准时的, 不误期的, 准时
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常准时的的解释。

meaning: n. the quality or habit of adhering to an appointed time
translation_zh: n. 严守时间, 正确
example: Punctuality is important for professional meetings.

meaning: n. the acquisition of something for payment; n. something acquired by purchase; n. a means of exerting influence or gaining advantage
translation_zh: n. 购买, 购买品, 紧握, 绞辘；vt. 购买, 赢得, 努力取得, 用滑轮起(锚等)
example: 这个&lt为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: a. serving as or indicating the existence of a purpose or goal; s. having meaning through having an aim
translation_zh: a. 有目的的；[法] 有意图的, 有目的的, 故意的
example: She walked with a purposeful stride towards the finish line.

meaning: n. the act of pursuing in an effort to overtake or capture; n. a search for an alternative that meets cognitive criteria
translation_zh: n. 追踪, 追求, 追赶, 娱乐, 职业；[法] 追捕, 追求
example: She is dedicated to the pursuit of knowledge.

meaning: v be a mystery or bewildering to; v be uncertain about; think about without fully understanding or being able to decide; s filled with bewilderment
translation_zh: a. 困惑的, 迷惑的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常困惑的的解释。

meaning: n. an attribute that must be met or complied with and that fits a person for something; n. the act of modifying or changing the strength of some idea
translation_zh: n. 资格, 条件, 限制；[计] 限定
example: 这个合格证书资格为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: v. use as a quantifier; v. express as a number or measure or quantity
translation_zh: vt. 定量, 用数量表示, 测量
example: It's difficult to quantify happiness.

meaning: n. enforced isolation of patients suffering from a contagious disease in order to prevent the spread of disease; n. isolation to prevent the spread of infectious disease; v. place into enforced isolation, as for medical reasons
translation_zh: n. 隔离, 封锁交通, 检疫期；vt. 隔离, 排斥
example: The travelers had to go into quarantine for two weeks.

meaning: n. an angry dispute; n. an arrow that is shot from a crossbow; has a head with four edges; v. have a disagreement over something
translation_zh: n. 吵架, 反目, 怨言, 方头凿；vi. 吵架, 争论, 挑剔
example: 这个争吵为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: s. given to quarreling
translation_zh: a. 喜欢吵架的, 好争论的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常quarrelsome（adjective）的解释。

meaning: v. put in a dangerous, disadvantageous, or difficult position
translation_zh: n. 怪人, 同性恋者；a. 奇怪的, 不舒服的, 可疑的；vt. 搞糟
example: He felt a queer sensation in his stomach.

meaning: n an instance of questioning; v pose a question
translation_zh: n. 疑问, 疑问号, 质问, 查询；v. 询问, 质问；[计] 查询
example: The customer had a query about their order.

meaning: v put an end to a state or an activity; v give up or retire from a position; v go away or leave; v turn away from; give up; v give up in the face of defeat of lacking hope; admit defeat
translation_zh: vi. 离开, 辞职, 停止；vt. 离开, 放弃, 使解除, 停止；n. 离开；[计] 结束, 退出
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常离开的解释。

meaning: s. suitable for or worthy of quotation
translation_zh: a. 可引用的, 有引用价值的, 适于引用的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常quotable（adjective）的解释。

meaning: n. a passage or expression that is quoted or cited; n. a statement of the current market price of a security or commodity; n. the practice of quoting from books or plays etc.
translation_zh: n. 引用语, 语录, 牌价, 报价；[化] 报价
example: She ended her speech with a famous quotation.

meaning: v. repeat a passage from; v. name the price of; v. refer to for illustration or proof; v. put quote marks around
translation_zh: n. 引用；vt. 引述, 举证, 报(价)；vi. 引用
example: He likes to quote famous authors.

meaning: n. the prejudice that members of one race are intrinsically superior to members of other races; n. discriminatory or abusive behavior towards members of another race
translation_zh: n. 种族主义, 种族偏见；[法] 种族主义, 种族歧视, 种族歧视主张
example: Racism is a serious social issue.

meaning: n. a person with a prejudiced belief that one race is superior to others; s. based on racial intolerance; s. discriminatory especially on the basis of race or religion
translation_zh: n. 种族主义者；[法] 种族主义的, 种族歧视
example: His comments were widely condemned as racist.

meaning: n. framework for holding objects; n. rib section of a forequarter of veal or pork or especially lamb or mutton; n. an instrument of torture that stretches or disjoints or mutilates victims; n. a support for displaying various articles
translation_zh: n. 架, 行李架, 饲草架, 搁物架, 痛苦, 折磨, 齿条, 行云团；vt. 把...放在架上, 在架上制作, 折磨, 使痛苦, 压榨, 榨取, 猛烈撕拉, 拷问；vi. 变形, 倾斜, (云)随风飘, (马)小步跑；[计] 机架
example: 这个[机] 齿条为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. measuring instrument in which the echo of a pulse of microwave radiation is used to detect and locate distant objects
translation_zh: n. 雷达, 无线电探测器；[计] 雷达图
example: 这个雷达为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: v. send out rays or waves; v. send out real or metaphoric rays; v. extend or spread outward from a center or focus or inward towards a center; v. cause to be seen by emitting light as if in rays
translation_zh: vt. 放射, 散发, 辐射, 传播, 广播；vi. 发光, 辐射, 流露；a. 有射线的, 辐射状的
example: The sun radiates heat and light.

meaning: n. a person who has radical ideas or opinions; n. (mathematics) a quantity expressed as the root of another quantity; n. a character conveying the lexical meaning of a logogram; s. arising from or going to the root or source
translation_zh: n. 激进分子, 词根, 基础, 根式, 根；a. 激进的, 根本的, 基本的, 根的
example: 这个根本的为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: r. in a radical manner
translation_zh: adv. 根本地, 完全地
example: The new policy will radically change the system.

meaning: n. an intensely radioactive metallic element that occurs in minute amounts in uranium ores
translation_zh: n. 镭；[化] 镭Ra
example: 这个[化学] 镭（88号元素符号Ra）为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. one of several parallel sloping beams that support a roof; v. provide (a ceiling) with rafters
translation_zh: n. 椽, 筏夫；vt. 装椽于
example: The old barn had exposed wooden rafters.

meaning: n. a small piece of cloth or paper; n. a week at British universities during which side-shows and processions of floats are organized to raise money for charities; n. a boisterous practical joke (especially by college students); v. play in ragtime
translation_zh: n. 碎布, 抹布, 碎片, 碎屑, 少量, 破旧衣服；vt. 责骂, 揶揄, 戏弄；vi. 喧闹
example: 这个破布为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. an arc of colored light in the sky caused by refraction of the sun's rays by rain; n. an illusory hope
translation_zh: n. 彩虹；a. 五彩缤纷的
example: 这个彩虹为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a storm with rain
translation_zh: n. 雨暴
example: 这个暴风雨为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a large gathering of people intended to arouse enthusiasm; n. the feat of mustering strength for a renewed effort; n. a marked recovery of strength or spirits during an illness; n. an automobile race run over public roads
translation_zh: n. 重振旗鼓, 集合, 群众集会, 跌停回升；v. 重整旗鼓, 集合, 恢复精神, 团结, 挖苦, 嘲笑
example: Thousands attended the political rally.

meaning: n. a tool for driving or forcing something by impact; n. uncastrated adult male sheep; v. strike or drive against with a heavy impact
translation_zh: n. 公羊, 撞锤；vi. 猛击, 撞；vt. 猛击, 填塞, 反复灌输；n. 只读内存, 随机存取内存, 随机存取存储器；[计] 随机存取存储器
example: The ram charged at the fence.

meaning: n. an inclined surface connecting two levels; n. North American perennial having a slender bulb and whitish flowers; n. a movable staircase that passengers use to board or leave an aircraft; v. behave violently, as if in state of a great anger
translation_zh: n. 斜坡, 坡道, 敲诈；vi. 狂跳乱撞, 乱冲, 敲诈, 蔓延；vt. 使有斜面, 敲诈
example: 这个土堤斜坡为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n a member of the Texas state highway patrol; formerly a mounted lawman who maintained order on the frontier; n an official who is responsible for managing and protecting an area of forest; n a member of a military unit trained as shock troops for hit-and-run raids
translation_zh: n. 王室守林人, 骑警, 漫游者
example: 这个护林者为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. Eurasian plant cultivated for its seed and as a forage crop; n. the act of despoiling a country in warfare; n. the crime of forcing a woman to submit to sexual intercourse against her will; v. force (someone) to have sex against their will
translation_zh: n. 抢夺, 掠夺, 强奸, 葡萄渣, 芸苔；vt. 掠夺, 抢夺, 强奸
example: 这个强奸为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. any red eruption of the skin; n. a series of unexpected and unpleasant occurrences; s. imprudently incurring risk
translation_zh: a. 轻率的, 匆忙的, 鲁莽的；n. 皮疹
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常鲁莽的的解释。

meaning: n. a rapid series of short loud sounds (as might be heard with a stethoscope in some types of respiratory disorders); n. a baby's toy that makes percussive noises when shaken; n. loosely connected horny sections at the end of a rattlesnake's tail; v. make short successive sounds
translation_zh: vt. 使嘎嘎响, 喋喋不休地说；vi. 格格响, 喋喋不休；n. 格格声, 拨浪鼓, 喋喋不休的话
example: 这个& vi.（使）发出格格的响声为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. (usually plural) a destructive action
translation_zh: n. 破坏, 蹂躏；v. 毁坏, 破坏, 掠夺
example: 这个毁坏为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. an idea evoked by some experience; n. a bodily process occurring due to the effect of some antecedent stimulus or agent; n. (mechanics) the equal and opposite force that is produced when any force is applied to a body; n. a response that reveals a person's feelings or attitude
translation_zh: n. 反应, 反作用, 反动；[医] 反应
example: 这个反应为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: r. without much difficulty
translation_zh: adv. 迅速地, 轻易地, 乐意地
example: She readily agreed to help.

meaning: n. the back of a military formation or procession; n. the side of an object that is opposite its front; n. the side that goes last or is not normally seen; v. stand up on the hind legs, of quadrupeds
translation_zh: n. 后面, 背后, 后方；a. 后面的, 背面的, 后方的；vt. 养育, 培养, 饲养, 举起, 树立, 栽种；vi. 高耸, 暴跳
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常培养的解释。

meaning: r. to a moderately sufficient extent or degree
translation_zh: adv. 适度地, 相当地
example: The price was reasonably low.

meaning: n. `Johnny' was applied as a nickname for Confederate soldiers by the Federal soldiers in the American Civil War; `greyback' derived from their grey Confederate uniforms; v. take part in a rebellion; renounce a former allegiance; v. break with established customs
translation_zh: n. 叛徒, 反叛者；vi. 造反, 反抗, 抵抗, 反感；a. 造反的, 反抗的
example: The rebels fought for their freedom.

meaning: s. resisting control or authority; s. participating in organized resistance to a constituted government
translation_zh: a. 造反的, 反抗的；[法] 造反的, 反抗的, 反判的
example: The rebellious teenager often argued with his parents.

meaning: n. the state of the economy declines; a widespread decline in the GDP and employment and trade lasting from six months to a year; n. the withdrawal of the clergy and choir from the chancel to the vestry at the end of a church service; n. the act of ceding back
translation_zh: n. 后退, 凹处, 衰退, 归还；[医] 退缩
example: The country is currently experiencing a recession.

meaning: n. directions for making something
translation_zh: n. 食谱, 处方, 秘诀；[医] 取(处方头语), 处方
example: 这个食谱为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: v. take account of
translation_zh: vt. 计算, 总计, 估计, 认为, 猜想；vi. 数, 计算, 估计, 依赖, 料想
example: 我们需要逐步reckon这个方案。

meaning: n. the state or quality of being recognized or acknowledged; n. the process of recognizing something or someone by remembering; n. approval; n. (biology) the ability of one molecule to attach to another molecule that has a complementary shape
translation_zh: n. 赞誉, 认得, 识别, 承认, 认可, 认识；[电] 认识
example: He received recognition for his outstanding work.

meaning: v recall knowledge from memory; have a recollection
translation_zh: vt. 回忆, 回想, 忆起；vi. 回忆
example: I can't quite recollect where I put my keys.

meaning: n. something recalled to the mind
translation_zh: n. 记忆, 回想, 回忆
example: He had no recollection of the accident.

meaning: a. Suitable to be recommended; worthy of praise;; commendable.
translation_zh: a. 可推荐的, 值得推荐的, 得当的, 明智的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常recommendable（adjective）的解释。

meaning: n. something (as a course of action) that is recommended as advisable; n. something that recommends (or expresses commendation of) a person or thing as worthy or desirable; n. any quality or characteristic that gains a person a favorable reception or acceptance or admission
translation_zh: n. 推荐, 介绍, 推荐信, 劝告；[经] 建议书
example: Do you have any recommendations for a good restaurant?

meaning: v. consider again; give new consideration to; usually with a view to changing; v. consider again (a bill) that had been voted upon before, with a view to altering it
translation_zh: v. 再考虑, 重新考虑
example: Please reconsider your decision to leave.

meaning: n an activity that diverts or amuses or stimulates; n activity that refreshes and recreates; activity that renews your health and spirits by enjoyment and relaxation
translation_zh: n. 娱乐, 消遣, 休息, 再创造；[医] 娱乐, 休养
example: 这个娱乐（活动）为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a recently enlisted soldier; n. any new member or supporter (as in the armed forces); v. seek to employ; v. cause to assemble or enlist in the military
translation_zh: n. 新兵, 新手, 新会员, 补给品；vt. 恢复, 补充, 充实, 征募；vi. 征募新兵, 复原, 得到补充
example: The company plans to recruit new staff next month.

meaning: s. having four right angles
translation_zh: a. 成直角的；[化] 矩形的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常<数> 矩形的的解释。

meaning: v make new; v do over, as of (part of) a house
translation_zh: vt. 再做, 重做, 改装；[计] 重做
example: 我们需要逐步redo这个方案。

meaning: s more than is needed, desired, or required; s repetition of same sense in different words
translation_zh: a. 多余的, 过多的, 冗长的；[医] 过多的, 多余的
example: The old system became redundant after the upgrade.

meaning: n. tall woody perennial grasses with hollow slender stems especially of the genera Arundo and Phragmites; n. United States journalist who reported on the October Revolution from Petrograd in 1917; founded the Communist Labor Party in America in 1919; is buried in the Kremlin in Moscow (1887-1920); n. United States physician who proved that yellow fever is transmitted by mosquitoes (1851-1902); n. a vibrator consisting of a thin strip of stiff material that vibrates to produce a tone when air streams over it
translation_zh: n. 芦苇, 芦笛, 簧舌, 纤弱的人；vt. 用芦苇盖, 用小凸嵌线装饰
example: The ducks hid among the tall reeds by the river.

meaning: n. the most direct or specific meaning of a word or expression; the class of objects that an expression refers to; n. the act of referring or consulting; n. a publication (or a passage from a publication) that is referred to; n. the relation between a word or phrase and the object or idea it refers to
translation_zh: n. 参考, 索引, 参照；vt. 给...加上参考资料；vt. 引用；vi. 引用；[计] 引用
example: Please provide a reference for your claims.

meaning: n. something referred to; the object of a reference; n. the first term in a proposition; the term to which other terms relate; n. something that refers; a term that refers to another term
translation_zh: n. 指示物
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常指示物的解释。

meaning: n. an industrial plant for purifying a crude substance
translation_zh: n. 精炼厂；[化] 精炼厂炼糖厂
example: The oil refinery processes crude oil into gasoline.

meaning: a. capable of physically reflecting light or sound; s. devoted to matters of the mind
translation_zh: a. 反射的, 反映的, 沉思的
example: The cyclist wore a reflective vest for safety.

meaning: n. a change for the better as a result of correcting abuses; n. a campaign aimed to correct abuses or malpractices; n. self-improvement in behavior or morals by abandoning some vice; v. make changes for improvement in order to remove abuse and injustices
translation_zh: n. 改革, 改正, 改造；vt. 改革, 改过, 革新, 重整；vi. 革新, 改过
example: The government plans to reform the education system.

meaning: n. the part of a song where a soloist is joined by a group of singers; v. resist doing something
translation_zh: n. 重复的话, 叠句, 副歌；vi. 节制, 避免, 克制
example: Please refrain from talking during the movie.

meaning: v. make (to feel) fresh; v. make fresh again
translation_zh: vt. 使清新, 使恢复, 使生气蓬勃；vi. 提起精神, 恢复精神, 吃点心, 喝饮料；vt. 刷新, 重新整理；vi. 刷新, 重新整理；[计] 刷新, 重新整理
example: 这个使恢复精神为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a shelter from danger or hardship
translation_zh: n. 避难所, 安全地带, 避难, 庇护；vi. 躲避；vt. 给予...庇护
example: The old building served as a refuge during the storm.

meaning: n. an exile who flees for safety
translation_zh: n. 难民, 流亡者；[法] 避难者, 流亡者, 难民
example: The camp provided shelter for thousands of refugees.

meaning: v. overthrow by argument, evidence, or proof; v. prove to be false or incorrect
translation_zh: vt. 反驳, 驳斥；驳倒
example: She tried to refute the accusations made against her.

meaning: n. (usually plural) a polite expression of desire for someone's welfare; n. a feeling of friendship and esteem; v. look at attentively
translation_zh: n. 关心, 注意, 尊敬, 关系, 问候；vt. 视为, 注意, 考虑, 和...有关, 看待；vi. 注视, 注意
example: I regard him as a friend.

meaning: r. in spite of everything; without regard to drawbacks
translation_zh: a. 不管, 不注意, 不顾
example: He decided to go, regardless of the weather.

meaning: n. popular music originating in the West Indies; repetitive bass riffs and regular chords played on the off beat by a guitar
translation_zh: n. 雷盖
example: 这个瑞格舞（西印度群岛的一种舞蹈及舞曲）为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n the organization that is the governing authority of a political unit; n (medicine) a systematic plan for therapy (often including diet)
translation_zh: n. 政权, 当权期间, 政体, 社会制度, 体制, 情态；[医] 制度, 生活制度
example: 这个政治制度为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: v. feel sad about the loss or absence of; v. decline formally or politely; v. express with regret
translation_zh: n. 遗憾, 后悔, 悔恨, 抱歉, 歉意；vt. 为...感到遗憾, 后悔, 惋惜, 懊悔, 抱歉；vi. 感到抱歉
example: 这个遗憾为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: r by bad luck
translation_zh: adv. 抱歉地, 遗憾地,可悲地
example: Regrettably, we have to cancel the event.

meaning: v. fix or adjust the time, amount, degree, or rate of; v. bring into conformity with rules or principles or usage; impose regulations
translation_zh: vt. 管理, 控制, 调节, 调整, 校准；[经] 控制, 管理
example: The government regulates the banking industry.

meaning: n. a practice session in preparation for a public performance (as of a play or speech or concert); n. (psychology) a form of practice; repetition of information (silently or aloud) in order to keep it in short-term memory
translation_zh: n. 预演, 排演, 练习, 叙述, 复述；[法] 详述, 列举事实, 复述
example: 这个排练为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: v. make stronger; v. strengthen and support with rewards
translation_zh: vt. 加强, 增援, 补充；vi. 求援, 得到增援；n. 加固材料
example: The new evidence will reinforce our argument.

meaning: n. information that makes more forcible or convincing
translation_zh: n. 加强, 增援, 补充, 援军, 加固物；[化] 补强; 加强件
example: The bridge needed reinforcement to withstand the strong winds.

meaning: n. the act of rejecting something; n. the state of being rejected; n. (medicine) an immunological response that refuses to accept substances or organisms that are recognized as foreign
translation_zh: n. 拒绝, 抛弃, 驳回, 被抛弃的东西, 呕出物；[化] 报废; 拒收
example: His proposal met with immediate rejection.

meaning: v. join again
translation_zh: vt. 使再结合, 再加入, 回答；vi. 重新聚合, 回答, 第二次答辩
example: 我们需要逐步rejoin这个方案。

meaning: a. being connected either logically or causally or by shared characteristics; a. connected by kinship, common origin, or marriage
translation_zh: a. 讲述的, 叙述的；有关系的, 有关联的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常讲述的的解释。

meaning: n. (physics) the theory that space and time are relative concepts rather than absolute concepts; n. the quality of being relative and having significance only in relation to something else
translation_zh: n. 有关系, 相关性, 相对性；[化] 相对性
example: 这个<物>相对论为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. (physiology) the gradual lengthening of inactive muscle or muscle fibers; n. (physics) the exponential return of a system to equilibrium after a disturbance; n. an occurrence of control or strength weakening
translation_zh: n. 松弛, 放松, 减轻, 缓和, 休息, 休养；[化] 松弛; 驰豫
example: 这个消遣为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. the act of passing something along from one person or group to another; n. a crew of workers who relieve another crew; n. a fresh team to relieve weary draft animals; n. a race between teams; each member runs or swims part of the distance
translation_zh: n. 驿马, 替班, 中继, 接力；vt. 分程传递, 转播, 使接替；vi. 接力传送, 转播
example: The 4x100 meter relay team won the gold medal.

meaning: a. having a bearing on or connection with the subject at issue
translation_zh: a. 有关联的, 有关系的, 适当的, 相应的；[法] 有关的, 相关的
example: Your comments are not relevant to the discussion.

meaning: n. an antiquity that has survived from the distant past
translation_zh: n. 遗物, 遗迹, 纪念物, 遗风, 残留物
example: The old sword was a relic from ancient times.

meaning: n. the feeling that comes when something burdensome is removed or reduced; n. the condition of being comfortable or relieved (especially after being relieved of distress); n. (law) redress awarded by a court; n. assistance in time of difficulty
translation_zh: n. 减轻, 解除, 救济, 安慰, 调剂, 浮雕, 换班, (地势的)起伏；[医] 缓减, 减轻, 浮雕(绘画中)
example: It was a great relief to finish the exam.

meaning: v. provide physical relief, as from pain; v. free from a burden, evil, or distress; v. take by stealing; v. alleviate or remove (pressure or stress) or make less oppressive
translation_zh: vt. 减轻, 救济, 解除, 使免除, 换...的班, 使得到调剂, 使不单调, 衬托, 使显著；vi. 救济, 当替补投手, 呈鲜明突出
example: The medicine will relieve your headache.

meaning: v provide physical relief, as from pain; v free someone temporarily from his or her obligations; v grant relief or an exemption from a rule or requirement to; v lessen the intensity of or calm; v save from ruin, destruction, or harm; v relieve oneself of troubling information; v provide relief for; v free from a burden, evil, or distress; v take by stealing; v grant exemption or release to; v alleviate or remove (pressure or stress) or make less oppressive; s (of pain or sorrow) made easier to bear; s extending out above or beyond a surface or boundary
translation_zh: a. 宽慰的, 解除的, 减轻的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常放心的的解释。

meaning: s. disinclined to become involved; s. not eager
translation_zh: a. 不情愿的, 勉强的；[法] 不愿的, 勉强的, 难以处理的
example: He was reluctant to admit his mistake.

meaning: v stay the same; remain in a certain state; v continue in a place, position, or situation; v be left; of persons, questions, problems, results, evidence, etc.; v stay behind; s not used up
translation_zh: [电] 剩余的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常剩余的的解释。

meaning: n. any object that is left unused or still extant
translation_zh: n. 剩余物, 废墟, 残余；[法] 遗体, 尸体, 遗骸
example: 这个遗骨为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a statement that expresses a personal opinion or belief or adds information; n. explicit notice
translation_zh: n. 评论, 注意；vt. 评论, 注意；vi. 评论, 谈论；[计] 注释
example: He made a positive remark about her work.

meaning: r to a remarkable degree or extent; r in a signal manner
translation_zh: adv. 显著地, 引人注目地, 非常地
example: 他ad地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: n. a message that helps you remember something; n. an experience that causes you to remember something
translation_zh: n. 提醒的人, 暗示；[经] 催单
example: 这个令人回忆起…的东西为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. the act of paying for the use of something (as an apartment or house or car); a. available to rent or lease; a. of or relating to rent
translation_zh: n. 租费, 租金收入；a. 租赁的, 收取租金的
example: 这个租赁为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: v. paint again; v. paint again
translation_zh: v. 重漆, 重画；[计] 重新绘制
example: 这个再次（重新）油漆为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a collection of works (plays, songs, operas, ballets) that an artist or company can perform and do perform for short intervals on a regular schedule
translation_zh: n. 全部剧目, 全部技能, 全部节目, 全部作品
example: 这个全部节目为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. the act of doing or performing again; n. the repeated use of the same word or word pattern as a rhetorical device
translation_zh: n. 重复, 背诵, 循环, 复制品, 副本；[机] 重复, 反复
example: 这个重复为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. the act of furnishing an equivalent person or thing in the place of another
translation_zh: n. 归还, 更换, 代替者；[医] 复位, 置换
example: 这个代替为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. copy that is not the original; something that has been copied
translation_zh: n. 复制品；[计] 目录分区复制
example: The museum displayed a perfect replica of the ancient vase.

meaning: v. put down by force or intimidation; v. block the action of
translation_zh: vt. 镇压, 抑制, 压制；vi. 压制
example: He tried to repress his anger.

meaning: n. a state of forcible subjugation; n. (psychiatry) the classical defense mechanism that protects you from impulses or ideas that would cause anxiety by preventing them from becoming conscious; n. the act of repressing; control by holding down
translation_zh: n. 抑制, 压抑, 制止；[医] 压抑, 抑制
example: 这个压抑为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: v. print anew
translation_zh: n. 再版, 翻版, 重印；vt. 再版, 翻版
example: The publisher decided to reprint the popular novel.

meaning: v take to task
translation_zh: vt. 责备, 责骂, 非难；[法] 共和国, 共和政体, 社团; 责骂, 谴责, 指责
example: 我们需要逐步reprove这个方案。

meaning: n. any address at which you dwell more than temporarily; n. the official house or establishment of an important person (as a sovereign or president)
translation_zh: n. 住宅, 居留, 驻扎, 居住期间；[医] 住房
example: The official residence of the President is the White House.

meaning: v. accept as inevitable
translation_zh: vt. 辞职, 放弃, 使顺从；vi. 辞职, 屈从
example: She decided to resign from her position as CEO.

meaning: n. acceptance of despair; n. the act of giving up (a claim or office or possession etc.); n. a formal document giving notice of your intention to resign
translation_zh: n. 辞职, 辞呈, 听从；[经] 辞职
example: His resignation came as a surprise to everyone.

meaning: n. the action of opposing something that you disapprove or disagree with; n. any mechanical force that tends to retard or oppose motion; n. the military action of resisting the enemy's advance; n. the capacity of an organism to defend itself against harmful environmental agents
translation_zh: n. 抵抗力, 反抗, 耐力, 阻力, 电阻；[化] 抵抗; 抗性; 阻力; 抗药性; 电阻
example: The material has high resistance to heat.

meaning: n. a formal expression by a meeting; agreed to by a vote; n. finding a solution to a problem; n. analysis into clear-cut components; n. (computer science) the number of pixels per square inch on a computer-generated display; the greater the resolution, the better the picture
translation_zh: n. 解析, 决心, 坚定, 决定, 决议, 消除, 解答, 分解；n. 图形分辨率；[计] 图形分辨率
example: He made a New Year's resolution to exercise more.

meaning: s. characterized by resonance
translation_zh: a. 共鸣的, 反响的, 洪亮的, 共振的；[医] 反响的, 叩响的, 共鸣的, 共振的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常洪亮的的解释。

meaning: r. to a tolerably worthy extent; r. in a decent and morally reputable manner
translation_zh: adv. 高尚地, 可观地, 相当地
example: 他respectably（adverb）地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: s. receiving deferential regard
translation_zh: a. 受尊敬的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常尊重（ respect的过去式和过去分词 ）的解释。

meaning: n. the metabolic processes whereby certain organisms obtain energy from organic molecules; processes that take place in the cells and tissues during which energy is released and carbon dioxide is produced and absorbed by the blood to be transported to the lungs; n. a single complete act of breathing in and out
translation_zh: n. 呼吸, 一口气, 呼吸作用；[化] 呼吸
example: The doctor checked the patient's respiration rate.

meaning: a. pertaining to respiration
translation_zh: a. 呼吸的；[医] 呼吸的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常呼吸的的解释。

meaning: n. a principle that limits the extent of something; n. the act of keeping something within specified bounds (by force if necessary)
translation_zh: n. 限制, 限定, 约束；[计] 限定
example: There are new restrictions on travel.

meaning: v. take up or begin anew; v. return to a previous location or condition; v. assume anew
translation_zh: vt. 重新开始, 取回, 恢复；vi. 再开始；n. 摘要, 个人简历；[计] 继续执行
example: 我们需要逐步resume这个方案。

meaning: n. a merchant who sells goods at retail
translation_zh: n. 零售商人, 传播的人；[经] 零售商
example: The online retailer offers free shipping on all orders.

meaning: v. cause to move more slowly or operate at a slower rate; v. be delayed
translation_zh: n. 阻止, 延迟；vt. 妨碍, 延迟, 使减速；vi. 减速, 延迟
example: 我们需要逐步retard这个方案。

meaning: n. the innermost light-sensitive membrane covering the back wall of the eyeball; it is continuous with the optic nerve
translation_zh: n. 视网膜；[医] 视网膜
example: Light-sensitive cells in the retina convert images into electrical signals.

meaning: n. the state of being retired from one's business or occupation; n. withdrawal from your position or occupation; n. withdrawal for prayer and study and meditation
translation_zh: n. 退休, 隐居, 撤退；[经] 退休, 退股, (固定资产)报废
example: 这个退休为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. (military) withdrawal of troops to a more favorable position to escape the enemy's superior forces or after a defeat; n. a place of privacy; a place affording peace and quiet; n. (military) a signal to begin a withdrawal from a dangerous position; n. (military) a bugle call signaling the lowering of the flag at sunset
translation_zh: n. 休息寓所, 撤退, 隐居, 退避；vi. 撤退, 隐退, 向后倾；vt. 退(棋)
example: The army ordered a strategic retreat.

meaning: v. go for and bring back; v. run after, pick up, and bring to the master
translation_zh: vt. 取回, 挽回, 弥补, 恢复, 补偿, 回忆, 检索；vi. 找回猎物；n. 取回, 恢复, 救险球；[计] 检索
example: Can you retrieve my keys from the car?

meaning: n. an enlightening or astonishing disclosure; n. communication of knowledge to man by a divine or supernatural agency; n. the last book of the New Testament; contains visionary descriptions of heaven and of conflicts between good and evil and of the end of the world; attributed to Saint John the Apostle
translation_zh: n. 揭露, 泄露, 发觉, 默示, 启示
example: 这个被揭示的真相为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: v. take revenge for a perceived wrong
translation_zh: n. 报仇, 复仇, 报复；vt. 报仇, 报复
example: He sought revenge for the injustice.

meaning: n the entire amount of income before any deductions are made; n government income due to taxation
translation_zh: n. 收入, 岁入, 税收, 税务局；[经] 岁入, 税收, 税务局
example: The company's revenue increased significantly last quarter.

meaning: n. a reverent mental attitude; n. an act showing respect (especially a bow or curtsy); v. regard with feelings of respect and reverence; consider hallowed or exalted or be in awe of
translation_zh: n. 尊敬, 敬重, 敬礼, 尊严, 威望；vt. 崇敬, 敬畏, 尊敬
example: The students showed great reverence for their wise teacher.

meaning: n. a relation of direct opposition; n. the gears by which the motion of a machine can be reversed; n. an unfortunate happening that hinders or impedes; something that is thwarting or frustrating; n. the side of a coin or medal that does not bear the principal design
translation_zh: n. 相反, 背面, 倒退, 挫折, 失败；a. 反面的, 相反的, 反向的, 颠倒的；vt. 使颠倒, 使逆转, 使倒退, 使反向；vi. 倒退, 反向, 倒转, 反转；[计] 反转
example: He put the car in reverse.

meaning: n. bringing again into activity and prominence; n. an evangelistic meeting intended to reawaken interest in religion
translation_zh: n. 复兴, 复活, 恢复精神, 苏醒；[医] 复苏, 回生, 精神重振
example: The city is experiencing an economic revival.

meaning: v. be brought back to life, consciousness, or strength; v. restore from a depressed, inactive, or unused state
translation_zh: vt. 使苏醒, 使复兴, 使振奋, 回想起, 重播；vi. 苏醒, 复活, 复兴, 恢复精神
example: The paramedics tried to revive the unconscious man.

meaning: n. a drastic and far-reaching change in ways of thinking and behaving; n. the overthrow of a government by those who are governed
translation_zh: n. 革命, 大变革, 旋转, 转数, 循环；[化] 回转
example: The industrial revolution changed society dramatically.

meaning: s. markedly new or introducing radical change; a. relating to or having the nature of a revolution; a. advocating or engaged in revolution
translation_zh: n. 革命者, 革命党人；a. 革命的, 革命性的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常革命的革命性的的解释。

meaning: v. turn on or around an axis or a center
translation_zh: v. (使)旋转, 反复考虑, 循环出现
example: 我们需要逐步revolve这个方案。

meaning: n. massive powerful herbivorous odd-toed ungulate of southeast Asia and Africa having very thick skin and one or two horns on the snout
translation_zh: n. 犀牛
example: 这个犀为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. correspondence in the sounds of two or more lines (especially final sounds); v. compose rhymes; v. be similar in sound, especially with respect to the last syllable
translation_zh: n. 韵, 押韵, 韵文；vi. 押韵；vt. 使押韵, 用韵诗表达
example: 我们需要逐步rhyme这个方案。

meaning: a recurring with measured regularity
translation_zh: a. 有韵律的, 有节奏的
example: The dancer moved with rhythmic grace.

meaning: n. support resembling the rib of an animal; n. any of the 12 pairs of curved arches of bone extending from the spine to or toward the sternum in humans (and similar bones in most vertebrates); n. cut of meat including one or more ribs; n. a teasing remark
translation_zh: n. 肋骨, 肋状物, 笑话；vt. 装肋状物于, 戏弄
example: 这个肋骨为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a difficult problem; n. a coarse sieve (as for gravel); v. pierce with many holes; v. set a difficult problem or riddle
translation_zh: n. 谜, 谜语, 粗筛；vt. 解谜, 给...出谜, 筛, 寻根究底地检验, 充满于；vi. 出谜
example: 这个谜语为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a traveler who actively rides an animal (as a horse or camel); n. a clause that is appended to a legislative bill; n. a traveler who actively rides a vehicle (as a bicycle or motorcycle)
translation_zh: n. 骑手, (文件后的)附件, 扶手；[化] 游码
example: 这个骑手为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a long narrow natural elevation or striation; n. any long raised strip; n. a long narrow natural elevation on the floor of the ocean; n. a long narrow range of hills
translation_zh: n. 脊, 山脊, 山脉；[医] 嵴, 脊, 棱线
example: We hiked along the mountain ridge, enjoying the views.

meaning: n. adhering to moral principles
translation_zh: n. 正义, 公正, 正直
example: 这个正直为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: r. with honesty
translation_zh: adv. 合适地, 正当地, 正确地
example: 他ad地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: n. the shape of a raised edge of a more or less circular object; n. (basketball) the hoop from which the net is suspended; n. the outer part of a wheel to which the tire is attached; v. run around the rim of
translation_zh: n. 边, 轮缘, 框；vt. 镶边, 为...装边；vi. 形成边缘
example: 这个（圆形物体的）边沿为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. an opening made forcibly as by pulling apart; n. a stretch of turbulent water in a river or the sea caused by one current flowing into or across another current; v. move precipitously or violently; v. cut (wood) along the grain
translation_zh: n. 裂痕, 破绽, 拉裂, 浪子, 巨浪；vi. 被拉开, 裂开, 猛冲；vt. 撕, 扯, 劈
example: There was a small rip in his jacket.

meaning: s involving risk or danger; s not financially safe or secure
translation_zh: a. 危险的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常危险的的解释。

meaning: n. an established ceremony prescribed by a religion
translation_zh: n. 仪式, 典礼, 惯例, 礼拜式
example: The wedding was a beautiful rite of passage.

meaning: n. any customary observance or practice; n. the prescribed procedure for conducting religious ceremonies; n. stereotyped behavior; a. of or relating to or characteristic of religious rituals
translation_zh: n. 仪式, 典礼, 宗教仪式；a. 仪式的, 依仪式进行的
example: The ancient ritual was performed at dawn.

meaning: n. the contestant you hope to defeat; v. be the rival of, be in competition with
translation_zh: n. 对手, 竞争者；a. 竞争的
example: He faced his main rival in the final match.

meaning: v move about aimlessly or without any destination, often in search of food or employment
translation_zh: v. 漫游, 闲逛, 徜徉；n. 漫步, 漫游
example: 这个漫步为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. the sound made by a lion; v. make a loud noise, as of wind, water, or vehicles; v. act or proceed in a riotous, turbulent, or disorderly way; v. laugh unrestrainedly and heartily
translation_zh: n. 吼, 咆哮, 轰鸣；vi. 吼, 大声说出, 叫喊, 喧闹；vt. 呼喊, 使轰鸣
example: 我们需要逐步roar这个方案。

meaning: n. a piece of meat roasted or for roasting and of a size for slicing into more than one portion; v. cook with dry heat, usually in an oven; s. (meat) cooked by dry heat in an oven
translation_zh: n. 烤肉, 烘烤, 嘲笑；a. 烘烤的, 烤过的；vt. 烤, 炙, 烘焙, 嘲笑；vi. 烤, 炙, 烘焙
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常& vi.烤的解释。

meaning: n. any vehicle self-propelled by a rocket engine; n. a jet engine containing its own propellant and driven by reaction propulsion; n. erect European annual often grown as a salad crop to be harvested when young and tender; n. propels bright light high in the sky, or used to propel a lifesaving line or harpoon
translation_zh: n. 火箭, 烟火；vi. 急升, 猛涨, 飞驰；vt. 用火箭运载
example: 这个火箭斥责为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: s. abounding in rocks or stones; s. liable to rock; s. full of hardship or trials
translation_zh: a. 岩石的, 多石的, 像岩石的, 无情的, 摇动的, 摇晃的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常岩石的的解释。

meaning: n. an associate who shares a room with you
translation_zh: n. 住在同室的人
example: 这个<英>室友为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: s reflecting optimism; s having the pinkish flush of health; s of blush color; s presaging good fortune
translation_zh: a. 蔷薇色的, 玫瑰红色的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常蔷薇色的的解释。

meaning: v. send documents or materials to appropriate destinations; v. send via a specific route; v. divert in a specified direction
translation_zh: n. 路径, 途径, 路线；vt. 确定路线, 按规定路线发送；[计] 传递, 路由设定程序
example: 这个路为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. payment to the holder of a patent or copyright or resource for the right to use their property; n. royal persons collectively
translation_zh: n. 皇室, 王族成员, 王权, 特权阶层, 庄严；[经] 特许权, 使用费, 使用税
example: The queen is a member of the British royalty.

meaning: n. the act of rubbing or wiping; v. move over something with pressure; v. cause friction; v. scrape or rub as if to relieve itching
translation_zh: n. 摩擦, 困难, 障碍, 磨损处；vt. 擦, 搓, 摩擦, 惹怒；vi. 摩擦, 擦破
example: 我们需要逐步rub这个方案。

meaning: n the remains of something that has been destroyed or broken up
translation_zh: n. 粗石, 碎砖, 粗石堆
example: After the earthquake, the streets were filled with rubble.

meaning: n. floor covering consisting of a piece of thick heavy fabric (usually with nap or pile)
translation_zh: n. 小块地毯, 揭露某人
example: 这个小地毯为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: s extremely harmful; bringing physical or financial ruin; s causing injury or blight; especially affecting with sudden violence or plague or ruin
translation_zh: a. 破坏性的, 招致毁灭的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常破坏性的的解释。

meaning: a. living in or characteristic of farming or country life; a. of or relating to the countryside as opposed to the city
translation_zh: a. 乡下的, 田园的, 乡村风味的；[法] 农村的, 乡村的, 有关农业的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常乡下的的解释。

meaning: s. covered with or consisting of rust
translation_zh: a. 生锈的, 腐蚀的, 生疏的, 顽固的, 腐烂的；[医] 锈色的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常生锈的的解释。

meaning: n. a bag made of paper or plastic for holding customer's purchases; n. the quantity contained in a sack; n. any of various light dry strong white wine from Spain and Canary Islands (including sherry); n. a woman's full loose hiplength jacket
translation_zh: n. 麻布袋, 洗劫；vt. 把...装入袋, 洗劫
example: 我们需要逐步sack这个方案。

meaning: n. a shape that sags; v. droop, sink, or settle from or as if from pressure or loss of tautness; v. cause to sag
translation_zh: vi. 下垂, 倾斜, 萎靡, 萧条, 变得乏味；vt. 使下垂；n. 下垂, 倾斜, 萧条；[计] 系统分析组, 语法分析生成程序, 电压下降
example: The old shelf began to sag under the weight of the books.

meaning: n. a mentor in spiritual and philosophical topics who is renowned for profound wisdom; n. aromatic fresh or dried grey-green leaves used widely as seasoning for meats and fowl and game etc; n. any of various plants of the genus Salvia; a cosmopolitan herb; s. having wisdom that comes with age and experience
translation_zh: n. 圣人, 哲人, 鼠尾草属植物；a. 贤明的, 明智的
example: 这个圣人为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a large piece of fabric (usually canvas fabric) by means of which wind is used to propel a sailing vessel; n. any structure that resembles a sail; v. traverse or travel on (a body of water); v. travel on water propelled by wind

example: 我们需要逐步sketch这个方案。

meaning: a. having or showing or requiring special skill
translation_zh: a. 熟练的；[经] 熟练的, 有技能的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常熟练的的解释。

meaning: n. a thin layer covering the surface of a liquid; n. reading or glancing through quickly; v. cause to skip over a surface; v. coat (a liquid) with a layer
translation_zh: vt. 撇取浮沫, 略读, 掠过；vi. 擦过, 浏览；n. 脱脂乳, 擦过, 表层物；a. 撇去浮沫的
example: 我们需要逐步skim这个方案。

meaning: n. a gait in which steps and hops alternate; v. bound off one point after another
translation_zh: n. 跳跃, 跳读；vi. 跳越, 跳读, 跳绳, 遗漏, 跳级；vt. 跳过, 遗漏；[计] 跳过
example: 我们需要逐步skip这个方案。

meaning: n. brown-speckled European lark noted for singing while hovering at a great height
translation_zh: n. 云雀；vi. 嘻闹, 闲荡
example: 这个skylark（noun）为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: r. toward the sky
translation_zh: adv. 向着天空, 向上；a. 向着天空的, 向上的
example: The rocket launched skyward with a roar.

meaning: n. winning all or all but one of the tricks in bridge; n. the noise made by the forceful impact of two objects; n. a forceful impact that makes a loud noise; v. close violently
translation_zh: n. 砰然声, 猛然, 猛烈的抨击；vt. 猛然关上, 砰地关上, 猛烈抨击；vi. 砰地关上, 猛攻
example: The door closed with a loud slam.

meaning: n. informal language consisting of words and expressions that are not considered appropriate for formal occasions; often vituperative or vulgar; n. a characteristic language of a particular group (as among thieves); v. use slang or vulgar language; v. abuse with coarse language
translation_zh: n. 俚语；v. 辱骂, 用俚语说
example: It's hard to understand all the local slang.

meaning: n. a blow from a flat object (as an open hand); v. hit with something flat, like a paddle or the open hand
translation_zh: n. 掴, 掌击, 侮辱, 拍击声；v. 拍击, 惩罚；adv. 正面地, 直接地, 突然地
example: 这个（用手掌）打为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. an open tract of land in a forest that is strewn with debris from logging (or fire or wind); n. a strong sweeping cut made with a sharp instrument; v. cut with sweeping strokes; as with an ax or machete; v. cut open
translation_zh: v. 猛砍, 乱砍；n. 猛砍, 乱砍, 删减；[计] 斜线
example: 这个& vi. 挥砍为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. the killing of animals (as for food); n. the savage and excessive killing of many people
translation_zh: n. 残杀, 屠杀, 杀戮；vt. 残杀, 屠杀, 亏本出售
example: The slaughter of innocent people was condemned.

meaning: v. pay no attention to, disrespect
translation_zh: n. 轻蔑, 怠慢；a. 轻微的, 纤细的, 脆弱的, 苗条的；vt. 轻视, 忽略, 怠慢
example: There was a slight delay due to traffic.

meaning: v. divide into slivers or splinters; v. form into slivers
translation_zh: n. 裂片, 薄片, 梳毛；vt. 切成长片；vi. 剖开, 分裂
example: He got a tiny sliver of wood stuck under his fingernail.

meaning: s. lacking neatness or order; s. wet or smeared with a spilled liquid or moist material
translation_zh: a. 泥泞的, 潮湿的, 粗心的
example: His work was sloppy and full of errors.

meaning: n. a serious collision (especially of motor vehicles); v. hit hard; v. break into pieces, as by striking or knocking over; v. hit violently
translation_zh: n. 打碎, 粉碎, 打碎时哗啦声, 猛击, 扣球, 杀球, 经营失败, 破产, 硬币, 假硬币；a. 非常轰动的, 了不起的；vt. 打碎, 粉碎, 击溃, 使破产, 使裂变, 使用假硬币；vi. 碎裂, 猛撞, 破产, 扣球, 杀球；adv. 轰隆一声, 哗啦一声
example: 我们需要逐步smash这个方案。

meaning: n. a large tall chimney through which combustion gases and smoke can be evacuated
translation_zh: n. 烟囱；[机] 烟堆
example: 这个烟囱为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a spell of cold weather; n. the noise produced by the rapid movement of a finger from the tip to the base of the thumb on the same hand; n. a sudden breaking; n. a fastener used on clothing; fastens with a snapping sound
translation_zh: vt. 使突然中断, 猛咬, 争夺, 拉断, 使有啪啪声, 厉声说, 突然射击, 用快照拍摄；vi. 咬, 扑, 抓, 折断, 劈啪地响, 厉声说, 砰然关上；n. 猛咬, 猛扑, 劈啪声, 申斥, 快照, 活力, 一般时期的寒冷天气, 揿钮；a. 突然的, 装搭扣的；adv. 猛地；[计] 子网访问协议
example: 我们需要逐步snap这个方案。

meaning: n. a person who is regarded as underhanded and furtive and contemptible; v. to go stealthily or furtively; v. put, bring, or take in a secretive or furtive manner
translation_zh: vi. 鬼鬼祟祟做事；vt. 偷偷地做；n. 鬼鬼祟祟的人, 偷偷摸摸的行为, 帆布胶底运动鞋；a. 暗中进行的
example: 我们需要逐步sneak这个方案。

meaning: n. a facial expression of contempt or scorn; the upper lip curls; n. a contemptuous or scornful remark; v. express through a scornful smile; v. smile contemptuously
translation_zh: n. 冷笑, 嘲笑；vi. 嘲笑, 冷笑；vt. 嘲笑着说, 嘲笑得使
example: He couldn't help but sneer at their foolishness.

meaning: n. sensing an odor by inhaling through the nose; v. perceive by inhaling through the nose; v. inhale audibly through the nose
translation_zh: n. 以鼻吸气, 嗅, 气息；vi. 嗅, 蔑视, 嗤之以鼻；vt. 闻, 用力吸, 发觉
example: 我们需要逐步sniff这个方案。

meaning: n. the rattling noise produced when snoring; n. the act of snoring or producing a snoring sound; v. breathe noisily during one's sleep
translation_zh: n. 鼾声, 打鼾；vi. 打鼾；vt. 打鼾度过
example: 这个打呼噜为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. plant having heads of fragrant white trumpet-shaped flowers; grows in sandy arid regions; n. ball of ice cream covered with coconut and usually chocolate sauce; n. ball of crushed ice with fruit syrup; n. snow pressed into a ball for throwing (playfully)
translation_zh: n. 雪球, 果味冰霜卷, 滚雪球式的募捐法；vt. 向...丢雪球, 使滚雪球般增长；vi. 打雪仗, 滚雪球般增长
example: 这个雪球为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. the process of becoming softened and saturated as a consequence of being immersed in water (or other liquid); n. washing something by allowing it to soak; v. submerge in a liquid; v. beat severely
translation_zh: n. 浸, 湿透, 大雨；vt. 使上下湿透, 浸, 吸入, 吸收, 浸洗掉；vi. 浸泡, 渗透
example: 这个吸收为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: v submerge in a liquid; v rip off; ask an unreasonable price; v cover with liquid; pour liquid onto; v leave as a guarantee in return for money; v beat severely; v make drunk (with alcoholic drinks); v become drunk or drink excessively; v fill, soak, or imbue totally; v heat a metal prior to working it; s very drunk
translation_zh: a. 湿透的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常被湿透的的解释。

meaning: r. extremely wet
translation_zh: a. 湿透的, 使人湿透的；adv. 湿透地；n. 浸, 渍, 泡
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常吸收的解释。

meaning: n. the act of rising upward into the air; v. rise rapidly; v. fly upwards or high in the sky; v. go or move upward
translation_zh: n. 高扬, 翱翔；vi. 往上飞舞, 高耸, 翱翔
example: The eagle began to soar above the mountains.

meaning: n. convulsive gasp made while weeping; v. weep convulsively
translation_zh: vi. 啜泣, 呜咽；vt. 哭诉, 哭得使；n. 啜泣, 呜咽
example: 我们需要逐步sob这个方案。

meaning: n. a party of people assembled to promote sociability and communal activity; a. inclined to or conducive to companionship with others; s. friendly and pleasant
translation_zh: a. 好交际的, 社交的, 过社会生活的；n. 联谊会
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常好交际的的解释。

meaning: n. the property of giving little resistance to pressure and being easily cut or molded; n. a state of declining economic condition; n. a sound property that is free from loudness or stridency
translation_zh: n. 柔和, 温柔
example: 这个柔和为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. the part of the earth's surface consisting of humus and disintegrated rock
translation_zh: n. 土壤, 土地, 国家, 国土, 温床, 污物, 粪便, 水池；vt. 弄脏, 污辱；vi. 变脏
example: 这个泥土为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: a. relating to or derived from the sun or utilizing the energies of the sun
translation_zh: a. 太阳的, 日光的, 源自太阳的；[医] 太阳的; 腹腔丛的
example: Many homes now use solar panels to generate electricity.

meaning: n. the consistency of a solid; n. state of having the interior filled with matter; n. the quality of being solid and reliable financially or factually or morally
translation_zh: n. 固体性, 坚硬, 坚固, 稳健, 体积
example: The bridge's solidity was tested by the heavy traffic.

meaning: n. speech you make to yourself; n. a (usually long) dramatic speech intended to give the illusion of unspoken reflections
translation_zh: n. 自言自语, 独白
example: 这个（尤指自言自语的）独白为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. any activity that is performed alone without assistance; n. a musical composition for one voice or instrument (with or without accompaniment); n. a flight in which the aircraft pilot is unaccompanied; v. fly alone, without a co-pilot or passengers
translation_zh: n. 独奏, 独唱, 单独表演；a. 单独的, 独奏的, 独唱的；vi. 放单飞
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常独奏曲的解释。

meaning: n. a liquid substance capable of dissolving other substances; a. capable of meeting financial obligations
translation_zh: n. 溶剂；a. 有偿付能力的, 有溶解力的
example: The company remained solvent despite the economic downturn.

meaning: r to a small degree or extent; r to a moderately sufficient extent or degree
translation_zh: n. 某物, 几分；adv. 多少, 几分
example: I'm somewhat tired after the long journey.

meaning: n. a verse form consisting of 14 lines with a fixed rhyme scheme; v. praise in a sonnet; v. compose a sonnet
translation_zh: n. 十四行诗
example: Shakespeare wrote many famous sonnets.

meaning: a. having or appealing to those having worldly knowledge and refinement and savoir-faire; s. intellectually appealing
translation_zh: a. 复杂的, 久经世故的；[法] 尖端的, 高级的, 非常有经验的
example: The new software has a very sophisticated interface.

meaning: n. the particular auditory effect produced by a given cause; n. the subjective sensation of hearing something; n. mechanical vibrations transmitted by an elastic medium; n. the sudden occurrence of an audible event
translation_zh: n. 声音, 语音, 吵闹, 声调, 听力范围, 探条, 海峡；a. 健全的, 可靠的, 合理的, 健康的, 彻底的, 资金充实的；adv. 彻底地, 充分地；vi. 发出声音, 回响, 测深, 试探, 听起来；vt. 使发声, 宣告, 听诊, 测...深, 试探；[计] 声音
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常使发声的解释。

meaning: n. sound recording on a narrow strip of a motion picture film
translation_zh: n. 声迹, 声槽, 声带
example: 这个声道为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n the cardinal compass point that is at 180 degrees; s moving toward the south; r toward the south
translation_zh: n. 朝南的方向(或地点、地区)；a. 在南方的, 往南方的；adv. 往南
example: 他向南的地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: n. an elected governmental council in a communist country (especially one that is a member of the Union of Soviet Socialist Republics); a. of or relating to or characteristic of the former Soviet Union or its people
translation_zh: n. 代表会议, 苏维埃, 苏联；a. 苏维埃的, 苏联的
example: The Soviet Union dissolved in 1991.

meaning: n a source of oil; used for forage and soil improvement and as food; n erect bushy hairy annual herb having trifoliate leaves and purple to pink flowers; extensively cultivated for food and forage and soil improvement but especially for its nutritious oil-rich seeds; native to Asia; n the most highly proteinaceous vegetable known; the fruit of the soybean plant is used in a variety of foods and as fodder (especially as a replacement for animal protein)
translation_zh: n. 大豆；[化] 大豆
example: 这个大豆为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n a health resort near a spring or at the seaside; n a fashionable hotel usually in a resort area; n a place of business with equipment and facilities for exercising and improving physical fitness
translation_zh: n. 矿泉, 温泉浴场, 矿泉治疗地；[计] 软件出版者协会
example: 这个休闲健身中心为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. the complete duration of something; n. the distance or interval between two points; n. a unit of length based on the width of the expanded human hand (usually taken as 9 inches)
translation_zh: n. 指距, 全长, 跨距, 一段时间, 小范围；vt. 以手指测量, 跨越, 架设, 持续
example: The bridge spans the river.

meaning: n. a score in tenpins; knocking down all ten after rolling two balls; v. refrain from harming; v. save or relieve from an experience or action; v. give up what is not strictly needed
translation_zh: n. 剩余, 备用品, 备件, 备用零件, 备用轮胎；a. 多余的, 备用的, 空闲的, 节约的, 瘦的；vi. 节约, 省掉, 宽恕；vt. 节约, 省用, 剩下, 饶恕, 赦免
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常备用的的解释。

meaning: n. a cut of pork ribs with much of the meat trimmed off
translation_zh: n. 排骨
example: 这个sparerib（noun）为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a small but noticeable trace of some quality that might become stronger; n. Scottish writer of satirical novels (born in 1918); n. a small fragment of a burning substance thrown out by burning material or by friction; v. emit or produce sparks
translation_zh: n. 火花, 火星, 闪光, 无线电报务员, 瞬间放电, 活力, 朝气, 花花公子, 情郎；vi. 闪光, 发火花, 求婚；vt. 发动, 鼓舞, 使有朝气, 求婚
example: A tiny spark flew from the bonfire.

meaning: s. shining with brilliant points of light like stars; a. used of wines and waters; charged naturally or artificially with carbon dioxide
translation_zh: a. 闪闪发光的, 闪烁的, 闪烁着才华的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常发火花的的解释。

meaning: n. any of several small dull-colored singing birds feeding on seeds or insects
translation_zh: n. 麻雀
example: 这个麻雀为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n an asset of special worth or utility; n a distinguishing trait; n the special line of work you have adopted as your career
translation_zh: n. 专业, 专长, 特产, 特制品, 特性, 特点；a. 专门的, 独立的
example: Italian food is their specialty.

meaning: n. (biology) taxonomic group whose members can interbreed; n. a specific kind of something
translation_zh: n. 种, 类, 外形；[医] 茶剂; 种
example: Pandas are an endangered species.

meaning: r. in distinction from others
translation_zh: adv. 特定地, 明确地, 按特性
example: He asked specifically for your help.

meaning: v. decide upon or fix definitely; v. determine the essential quality of; v. be specific about
translation_zh: vt. 详列, 指定, 说明；[计] 指定
example: Please specify your preferred delivery date.

meaning: n. something or someone seen (especially a notable or unusual sight); n. an elaborate and remarkable display on a lavish scale; n. a blunder that makes you look ridiculous; used in the phrase `make a spectacle of' yourself
translation_zh: n. 引人羡慕的东西, 景象, 眼镜, 场面, 公开展示
example: The fireworks display was a magnificent spectacle.

meaning: n. a driver who exceeds the safe speed limit
translation_zh: n. 调速装置, 超速驾车者；[化] 增速装置
example: 这个加速为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: v to render motionless, as with a fixed stare or by arousing terror or awe; v attract strongly, as if with a magnet; v put into a trance; s having your attention fixated as though by a spell
translation_zh: a. 被咒语所镇住的, 被迷住的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常spellbound（adjective）的解释。

meaning: n. a swift whirling motion (usually of a missile); n. the act of rotating rapidly; n. a short drive in a car; n. a distinctive interpretation (especially as used by politicians to sway public opinion)
translation_zh: n. 旋转, 自旋, 疾驰, 情绪低落；vt. 纺织, 纺, 使旋转, 编造；vi. 纺纱, 吐丝, 作茧, 结网, 旋转, 自旋, 疾驰
example: 我们需要逐步spin这个方案。

meaning: n feeling a need to see others suffer; n malevolence by virtue of being malicious or spiteful or nasty; v hurt the feelings of
translation_zh: n. 恶意, 怨恨, 使人烦恼的事物；vt. 故意刁难, 欺侮
example: He broke the toy out of spite.

meaning: n. the sound like water splashing; n. a patch of bright color; n. the act of scattering water about haphazardly; v. mark or overlay with patches of contrasting color or texture; cause to appear splashed or spattered
translation_zh: n. 飞溅, 污点, 一点儿, 溅泼声, 色斑；vi. 溅湿, 溅开, 飞溅；vt. 溅, 泼, 使溅起水, 洒, 使成斑驳状
example: 这个（液体）稀里哗啦地溅落为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n the noise of something spattering or sputtering explosively; n a small quantity of something moist or liquid; v cause or allow (a liquid substance) to run or flow from a container; v dash a liquid upon or against
translation_zh: vt. 使水等飞溅, 结结巴巴地讲；vi. 发溅泼声, 说话结巴；n. 飞溅
example: There was a splatter of mud on the car door.

meaning: n. a male spokesperson
translation_zh: n. 发言人, 代言者
example: The company spokesman issued a statement to the press.

meaning: n. a female spokesperson
translation_zh: n. 女发言人, 女代言人
example: The spokeswoman announced the company's new policy.
