meaning: n. the remains (or an impression) of a plant or animal that existed in a past geological age and that has been excavated from the soil; a. characteristic of a fossil
translation_zh: n. 化石, 古物；a. 化石的, 陈腐的, 守旧的
example: 这个化石为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: a. of or relating to or based on geology
translation_zh: a. 地质学的, 地质的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常地质的的解释。

meaning: r. with respect to geology
translation_zh: adv. 从地质上来说
example: 他地质的地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: n. an example regarded as typical of its class; n. a bit of tissue or blood or urine that is taken for diagnostic purposes
translation_zh: n. 样品, 标本, 试料；[化] 试样
example: The scientist collected a rare plant specimen.

meaning: r. extremely
translation_zh: adv. 非常地, 巨大地
example: 他巨大地地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: n. art highly prized for its beauty or perfection; n. a crystalline rock that can be cut and polished for jewelry
translation_zh: n. 珠宝, 宝石, 珍贵之物；vt. 饰以宝石
example: 这个（尤指切割、抛光或镶嵌过的）宝石为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: s. serving or intended to explain or make clear
translation_zh: a. 说明的, 解释的, 辩明的；[法] 解释的, 说明的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常解释的的解释。

meaning: n. something that is oriented vertically; a. at right angles to the plane of the horizon or a base line; a. relating to or involving all stages of a business from production to distribution; s. of or relating to different levels in a hierarchy (as levels of social class or income group)
translation_zh: a. 垂直的, 直立的；[医] 垂直的, 顶的, 头顶的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常垂直的的解释。

meaning: s. alert and fully informed
translation_zh: a. 聪明的, 有知识的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常博学的的解释。

meaning: r under normal conditions
translation_zh: adv. 通常, 普通, 一般地
example: 他平常地地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: v. prepare according to a formula
translation_zh: vt. 用公式表示, 明确叙述, 制订；[机] 公式化, 公式表示
example: 我们需要逐步formulate这个方案。

meaning: n. any of a class of solid or semisolid viscous substances obtained either as exudations from certain plants or prepared by polymerization of simple molecules
translation_zh: n. 树脂；vt. 涂树脂于
example: 这个树脂为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. personnel that are sacrificed (e.g., surrendered or lost in order to gain an objective); n. a loss entailed by giving up or selling something at less than its value; n. the act of killing (an animal or person) in order to propitiate a deity; n. (baseball) an out that advances the base runners
translation_zh: n. 牺牲, 供奉, 祭品；vt. 牺牲, 祭祀, 贱卖；vi. 献祭
example: 这个牺牲为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: s. habitually clean; r. in a manner that minimizes dirt and pollution; r. without difficulty or distortion
translation_zh: a. 爱清洁的, 干净的, 清洁的；adv. 干净地, 利索地, 熟练地
example: 他整齐地地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: n. a promotional statement (as found on the dust jackets of books); n. a signature that validates something; n. the act of endorsing
translation_zh: n. 支持, 认可, 背书；[经] 背书, 担保, 保证
example: 这个背书为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. act of expanding by lengthening or widening
translation_zh: [机] 伸展作业, 锻伸作业
example: 这个（使）变大为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. uninterrupted connection or union; n. a detailed script used in making a film in order to avoid discontinuities from shot to shot; n. the property of a continuous and connected period of time
translation_zh: n. 连续性；[化] 连续性
example: There was a lack of continuity in the film's plot.

meaning: n. a condition of great disorder
translation_zh: n. 肉店, 屠宰场, 混乱, 废墟
example: 这个<口>混乱为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: s. uncomfortably closed or hemmed in; s. suffering from claustrophobia; abnormally afraid of closed-in places
translation_zh: a. (患)幽闭恐怖症的,导致幽闭恐怖症的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常（患）幽闭恐怖症的的解释。

meaning: n. a morbid fear of being closed in a confined space
translation_zh: n. 幽闭恐怖症；[医] 幽闭恐怖
example: 这个[心理] 幽闭恐怖症为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: s habitually disposed to disobedience and opposition
translation_zh: a. 顽固的, 刚愎的, 任性的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常任性的的解释。

meaning: n. consideration in dealing with others and avoiding giving offense
translation_zh: n. 机智, 手法, 老练；[经] (自动加工线的)生产节拍
example: 这个机智为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: a. having or showing a sense of what is fitting and considerate in dealing with others; s. showing skill and sensitivity in dealing with people
translation_zh: a. 机智的, 老练的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常机智的的解释。

meaning: r. showing tact or tactfulness; in a tactful manner
translation_zh: adv. 言行得体地, 不得罪人地, 能赢得好感地
example: 他机智的地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: n. a flaw on a surface resulting when an applied substance does not adhere (as an air bubble in a coat of paint); n. (botany) a swelling on a plant similar to that on the skin; n. (pathology) an elevation of the skin filled with serous fluid; v. get blistered
translation_zh: n. 水疱；[化] 砂眼
example: 这个水疱为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. the act of sponsoring (either officially or financially)
translation_zh: n. 发起, 倡议, 主办, 保证人的地位, 教父的地位, 教母的地位
example: The event received generous sponsorship from local businesses.

meaning: n. an inflated feeling of pride in your superiority to others; n. (psychoanalysis) the conscious mind
translation_zh: n. 自我；[医] 自我
example: His large ego made him difficult to work with.

meaning: n a room or establishment where alcoholic drinks are served over a counter; n tavern consisting of a building with a bar and public rooms; often provides light meals; n a car that is closed and that has front and rear seats and two or four doors
translation_zh: n. 大厅, 沙龙, 酒吧, 会客室
example: 这个酒吧为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: s being ahead of time or need; r ahead of time; in anticipation
translation_zh: adv. 预先
example: 他事先地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: n. a coarse obnoxious person
translation_zh: n. 泥, 软泥, 粗俗平庸的人
example: 这个slob（noun）为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. the total amount and type of insurance carried; n. the extent to which something is covered; n. the news as presented by reporters for newspapers or radio or television
translation_zh: n. 覆盖的范围, 保险总额, 新闻报导；[化] 可达范围; 覆盖度
example: 这个范围为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: v. pull the plug of (electrical appliances) and render inoperable
translation_zh: vt. 拔开...的塞子, 拔去...的插头, 除掉...的障碍物
example: 我们需要逐步unplug这个方案。

meaning: n a device or control that is very useful for a particular job
translation_zh: n. 小配件, 小玩意, 诡计
example: 这个小玩意儿 (n.) - 小工具为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: v. discover again
translation_zh: vt. 重新发现
example: 我们需要逐步rediscover这个方案。

meaning: r. in a subtle manner
translation_zh: adv. 敏锐地, 巧妙地, 精细地
example: 他精细地地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: v. persuade completely, often through coercion; v. submit to brainwashing; indoctrinate forcibly
translation_zh: n. 洗脑；vt. 对人洗脑
example: 我们需要逐步brainwash这个方案。

meaning: n. forcible indoctrination into a new set of attitudes and beliefs
translation_zh: n. 洗脑
example: 这个<贬>对…进行洗脑为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: v. bring into intimate and incriminating connection
translation_zh: vt. 涉及, 含意, 暗示, 牵连；n. 包含的东西
example: The evidence seemed to implicate him in the robbery.

meaning: n. a failure to function normally; v. fail to function or function improperly
translation_zh: n. 故障, 失灵, 疾病；vi. 发生故障, 不起作用；[计] 故障
example: 我们需要逐步malfunction这个方案。

meaning: n. edge of a way or road or path
translation_zh: n. 路旁；a. 路旁的
example: 这个路边adj.路边的为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: v lose validity; v pass from physical life and lose all bodily attributes and functions necessary to sustain life; v expel air
translation_zh: vi. 期满, 呼气, 断气；vt. 呼出
example: 我们需要逐步expire这个方案。

meaning: n. an argument opposed to a proposal; r. in opposition to a proposition, opinion, etc.
translation_zh: vt. 精读, 仔细研究, 默记；adv. 反面地, 从反面；a. 欺诈的；n. 反对者, 反对票, 肺结核；[计] 控制台
example: 我们需要逐步con这个方案。

meaning: r. in a damp manner
translation_zh: adv. 潮湿地, 衰减地
example: 他使潮湿地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: s resembling or characteristic of a phantom
translation_zh: a. 幽灵的, 影子似的, 精神的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常鬼似的的解释。

meaning: n. someone whose employment involves carrying something; n. a self-propelled wheeled vehicle designed specifically to carry something; n. an inactive substance that is a vehicle for a radioactive tracer of the same substance and that assists in its recovery after some chemical reaction; n. a person or firm in the business of transporting people or goods or messages
translation_zh: n. 运送者, 邮递员, 带菌者；[计] 载波
example: 这个[化学] 载体为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a tub in which clothes or linens can be washed
translation_zh: n. 洗衣盆
example: 这个washtub（noun）为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: s. (usually followed by `to') naturally disposed toward; s. at risk of or subject to experiencing something usually unpleasant; s. mentally quick and resourceful
translation_zh: a. 有...倾向的, 易于的, 恰当的, 聪明的；[计] 自动数控语言, 自动图象传输, 自动程序控制, 自动程序设计工具
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常恰当的的解释。

meaning: n. a small light typewriter; usually with a case in which it can be carried; a. easily or conveniently transported; s. of a motor designed to be attached to the outside of a boat's hull
translation_zh: a. 可携带的, 可搬运的, 可移动的；[计] 可移植的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常便携式的的解释。

meaning: n. any plant grown for its beauty or ornamental value
translation_zh: n. 装饰物, 观赏植物；a. 装饰性的, 装饰的, 观赏用的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常装饰的的解释。

meaning: s. (of a body of water) free from disturbance by heavy waves
translation_zh: a. 平静的, 温和的, 沉着的, 平稳的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常平和的的解释。

meaning: r. in a quiet and tranquil manner; r. in a placid and good-natured manner
translation_zh: adv. 平稳地, 平静地
example: 他平和的地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: a. hard to control
translation_zh: a. 难管理的, 难处理的, 难操纵的, 处理不了的；[化] 难以加工的; 难以控制的; 难以管理的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常不…的解释。

meaning: n. a device or control that is very useful for a particular job; n. durable goods for home or office use
translation_zh: n. 器械, 用具, 应用；[医] 矫正器; 器
example: 这个器具为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: v part with a possession or right; v do without or cease to hold or adhere to; v turn away from; give up; v release, as from one's grip
translation_zh: vt. 放弃, 撤回, 停止, 松开, 让与；[法] 让与, 把...交给, 放弃
example: He was forced to relinquish control of the company.

meaning: s so lacking in interest as to cause mental weariness; s using or containing too many words
translation_zh: a. 沉闷的, 冗长乏味的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常单调沉闷的的解释。

meaning: n the feeling of being bored by something tedious; n dullness owing to length or slowness
translation_zh: n. 单调乏味, 沉闷
example: 这个沉闷为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: v. put to use; v. make a great effort at a mental or physical task
translation_zh: vt. 发挥, 运用, 施以影响；[法] 施加, 产生, 行使
example: 我们需要逐步exert这个方案。

meaning: n. an exorbitant charge; n. unjust exaction (as by the misuse of authority); n. the felonious act of extorting money (as by threats of violence)
translation_zh: n. 勒索, 敲诈, 强取；[经] 勒索, 强夺
example: He was charged with extortion.

meaning: v provide physical relief, as from pain; v make easier
translation_zh: vt. 减轻, 使缓和
example: The new medicine helped to alleviate her pain.

meaning: v. add details, as to an account or idea; clarify the meaning of and discourse in a learned way, usually in writing; v. produce from basic elements or sources; change into a more developed product; v. work out in detail; s. marked by complexity and richness of detail
translation_zh: a. 精细的, 详尽的, 精心计划(或制作)的；vt. 详细地说明, 用心地制作, 发挥；vi. 变复杂, 作详细说明
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常详尽说明的解释。

meaning: n. developing in intricate and painstaking detail
translation_zh: n. 苦心经营, 精巧；[计] 确立
example: 这个精心制作（或计划）为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: v dislike intensely; feel antipathy or aversion towards
translation_zh: vt. 厌恶, 憎恨
example: 我们需要逐步detest这个方案。

meaning: s offensive to the mind; s unequivocally detestable
translation_zh: a. 可憎的, 可恶的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常detestable（adjective）的解释。

meaning: n. a dysphemism for beer (especially for lager that effervesces); v. wash in suds
translation_zh: n. 肥皂水, 泡沫；vt. 用肥皂水洗；vi. 形成起泡肥皂水
example: 这个suds（noun）为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: a. conforming to your own liking or feelings or nature; s. prepared to agree or consent
translation_zh: a. 令人愉快的, 同意的；[医] 佳适的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常令人愉快的的解释。

meaning: n. the act of prowling (walking about in a stealthy manner); v. move about in or as if in a predatory manner; v. loiter about, with no apparent aim
translation_zh: n. 潜行, 徘徊, 悄悄踱步；vi. 潜行以觅食, 徘徊；vt. 徘徊
example: 我们需要逐步prowl这个方案。

meaning: v. to believe especially on uncertain or tentative grounds; v. talk over conjecturally, or review in an idle or casual way and with an element of doubt or without sufficient reason to reach a conclusion; v. invest at a risk
translation_zh: vi. 深思, 推测, 投机；[经] 投机
example: 我们需要逐步speculate这个方案。

meaning: n. a hypothesis that has been formed by speculating or conjecturing (usually with little hard evidence); n. an investment that is very risky but could yield great profits
translation_zh: n. 沉思, 推测, 投机；[经] 投机交易, 买空卖空
example: 这个思考为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: s not financially safe or secure; s not based on fact or investigation; s showing curiosity
translation_zh: a. 思索性的, 投机的, 推测的；[经] 投机的, 冒险的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常投机的的解释。

meaning: n. European butterfly having reddish-brown wings each marked with a purple eyespot; n. male peafowl; having a crested head and very large fanlike tail marked with iridescent eyes or spots
translation_zh: n. 孔雀, 好炫耀的人；vi. 炫耀, 神气活现地行走
example: 这个（雄）孔雀为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n lack of respect accompanied by a feeling of intense dislike; n a communication that indicates lack of respect by patronizing the recipient; v look down on with disdain; v reject with contempt
translation_zh: n. 蔑视；vt. 蔑视, 鄙弃
example: She looked at him with utter disdain.

meaning: v. enact or perform again; v. enact again
translation_zh: vt. 重新制定, 再扮演；[法] 重新制定, 再用法律规定, 使再度生效
example: 我们需要逐步reenact这个方案。

meaning: v. torment emotionally or mentally; v. treat cruelly
translation_zh: n. 使人痛苦的东西, 折磨者, 苦痛；vt. 使苦恼, 纠缠, 歪曲, 拷问
example: He endured years of torment.

meaning: n. the quality of exceeding the appropriate limits of decorum or probability or truth; n. the trait of spending extravagantly; n. excessive spending
translation_zh: n. 奢侈, 浪费, 放肆的言行
example: 这个奢侈为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. the act of making some area of land or water more profitable or productive or useful; n. an act that exploits or victimizes someone (treats them unfairly)
translation_zh: n. 开发, 开采, 剥削；[经] 开发, 剥削, 宜传
example: The report highlighted the exploitation of child labor.

meaning: n. the atomic process that occurs during a chemical reaction; n. the technical aspects of doing something; n. a natural object resembling a machine in structure or function; n. (philosophy) the philosophical theory that all phenomena can be explained in terms of physical or biological causes
translation_zh: n. 机械, 机构, 结构, 机理, 技巧；[化] 机理; 历程; 机构
example: 这个生机制为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: r. from this place; r. from this time
translation_zh: adv. 因此, 从此
example: 他因此地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: n. the immediate descendants of a person; n. something that comes into existence as a result
translation_zh: n. 子孙, 后代, 产物；[法] 后辈, 子孙, 后裔
example: The lioness protected her offspring fiercely.

meaning: v. bind by an obligation; cause to be indebted; v. provide a service or favor for someone
translation_zh: vt. 强制, 施恩惠于, 使感激；vi. 施恩惠, 帮忙
example: We were obliged to follow the rules.

meaning: v. work together on a common enterprise of project; v. cooperate as a traitor
translation_zh: vi. 合作, 勾结；[法] 合作, 合著, 通敌
example: 我们需要逐步collaborate这个方案。

meaning: n. someone who collaborates with an enemy occupying force; n. an associate in an activity or endeavor or sphere of common interest
translation_zh: n. 合干者, 合作者, 通敌者；[法] 合作者, 协助者, 勾结者
example: 这个协作者为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. act of working jointly; n. act of cooperating traitorously with an enemy that is occupying your country
translation_zh: n. 合作, 勾结；[法] 通敌卖国者, 奸细
example: 这个合作为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: s. accomplished by collaboration
translation_zh: a. 合作的, 协作的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常合作的的解释。

meaning: s. displaying brilliance and virtuosity
translation_zh: a. 艳丽的, 炫耀的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常引人注目的的解释。

meaning: v. herd and care for
translation_zh: vi. 争论, 口角；vt. 辩驳, 放牧；n. 口角, 吵嘴
example: They spent hours trying to wrangle the cattle.

meaning: n. a statement that is assumed to be true and from which a conclusion can be drawn; v. set forth beforehand, often as an explanation; v. take something as preexisting and given
translation_zh: n. 前提, 房屋连地基, 上述各项；vt. 预先提出, 引出, 作为...的前提；vi. 作出前提
example: The argument was based on a false premise.

meaning: a. giving an advantage; s. appropriate for achieving a particular end; implies a lack of concern for fairness
translation_zh: a. 有利的, 有益的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常有利的的解释。

meaning: n. an animal or plant that lives in or on a host (another animal or plant); it obtains nourishment from the host without benefiting or killing the host
translation_zh: n. 寄生生物, 寄生虫, 食客；[医] 寄生物; 寄生胎
example: 这个寄生植物（或动物）为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: s. indulging in or influenced by fancy; s. not based on fact; unreal; s. having a curiously intricate quality
translation_zh: a. 奇怪的, 稀奇的, 想像的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常（指人）富于幻想的的解释。

meaning: n. a cgs unit of dynamic viscosity equal to one dyne-second per square centimeter; the viscosity of a fluid in which a force of one dyne per square centimeter maintains a velocity of 1 centimeter per second; n. a state of being balanced in a stable equilibrium; v. be motionless, in suspension
translation_zh: n. 平衡, 均衡, 姿势, 镇静, 安静, 砝码；vt. 使平衡, 使悬着, 保持...姿势；vi. 平衡, 悬着, 准备好
example: 这个沉着为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: s. in accordance with convention or custom
translation_zh: a. 习惯的, 惯常的；[经] 通常的, 习惯的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常习惯的的解释。

meaning: s. exhibiting insight or clear and deep perception
translation_zh: a. 有深刻见解的, 富有洞察力的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常富有洞察力的的解释。

meaning: n a celebrity who is an inspiration to others; s worthy of notice; s widely known and esteemed
translation_zh: n. 著名人士, 值得注意之事物；a. 值得注意的, 显著的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常值得注意的的解释。

meaning: s (of persons or their actions) able or disposed to inflict pain or suffering; s having the nature of vice; s bringing or deserving severe rebuke or censure; s marked by deep ill will; deliberately harmful
translation_zh: a. 邪恶的, 堕落的, 品性不端的, 恶毒的, 恶性的, 有错误的；[医] 缺点的, 恶的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常恶毒的的解释。

meaning: r. in a vicious manner
translation_zh: adv. 邪恶地；敌意地
example: 他邪恶地地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: v pull back or move away or backward; v withdraw from active participation; v release from something that holds fast, connects, or entangles; v cause to be returned; v take back what one has said; v keep away from others; v break from a meeting or gathering; v retire gracefully; v remove (a commodity) from (a supply source); v lose interest; v make a retreat from an earlier commitment or activity; v remove something concrete, as by lifting, pushing, or taking off, or remove something abstract; s withdrawn from society; seeking solitude; s tending to reserve or introspection
translation_zh: withdraw的过去分词
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常withdrawn（adjective）的解释。

meaning: s extremely painful
translation_zh: a. 折磨人的, 极端痛苦的
example: The climb up the mountain was a torturous experience.

meaning: v show in, or as in, a picture; v give a description of; v make a portrait of
translation_zh: vt. 描述, 描写
example: 我们需要逐步depict这个方案。

meaning: n. representation by drawing or painting etc
translation_zh: n. 描写, 叙述
example: 这个描写为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. (geology) a rise of land to a higher elevation (as in the process of mountain building)
translation_zh: n. 举起, 隆起, 大变动, 剧变
example: The political upheaval led to widespread protests.

meaning: v. put someone or something on a short list
translation_zh: n. <英>供最后挑选(或考虑)用的候选人名单
example: 我们需要逐步shortlist这个方案。

meaning: a. marked by no noteworthy or significant events
translation_zh: a. 太平无事的, 平静无事的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常不…的解释。

meaning: s. having precise or logical relevance to the matter at hand
translation_zh: a. 相关的, 中肯的, 切题的；[法] 恰当的, 有关的
example: Please provide all pertinent information.

meaning: v. have dreamlike musings or fantasies while awake
translation_zh: n. 白日梦；vi. 做白日梦
example: 这个白日梦为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. the principal character in a work of fiction
translation_zh: n. 主人公, 主角, 领导者
example: 这个（戏剧的）主角为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. the quality of being simple or uncompounded; n. a lack of penetration or subtlety; n. absence of affectation or pretense
translation_zh: n. 单纯, 简朴, 朴素, 坦率, 天真；[计] 简明性
example: 这个简单为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a large bomb used to demolish extensive areas (as a city block); n. an unusually successful hit with widespread popularity and huge sales (especially a movie or play or recording or novel)
translation_zh: n. 巨型炸弹
example: 这个重磅炸弹为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: v. sound with resonance; v. be received or understood
translation_zh: v. (使)共鸣, (使)共振
example: 我们需要逐步resonate这个方案。

meaning: n. something that follows something else; n. a part added to a book or play that continues and extends it
translation_zh: n. 继续, 续集, 后果；[计] 结构的英语查询语言
example: 这个继续为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. incongruity between what might be expected and what actually occurs; n. a trope that involves incongruity between what is expected and what occurs
translation_zh: n. 反语, 讽刺, 具有讽刺意味的事
example: The irony of the situation was that the fire station burned down.

meaning: a. being or containing an acid; of a solution having an excess of hydrogen atoms (having a pH of less than 7); s. being sour to the taste
translation_zh: a. 成酸的, 尖刻的, 酸性的；[机] 酸性
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常（味）酸的的解释。

meaning: v. place in a line or arrange so as to be parallel or straight; v. be or come into adjustment with; v. align oneself with a group or a way of thinking; v. bring (components or parts) into proper or desirable coordination correlation
translation_zh: vi. 排列, 排成一行, 结盟；vt. 使结盟, 使成一行, 校正
example: 我们需要逐步align这个方案。

meaning: n. the spatial property possessed by an arrangement or position of things in a straight line or in parallel lines; n. the act of adjusting or aligning the parts of a device in relation to each other
translation_zh: n. 队列, 结盟, 校正；[计] 校准; 对齐; 对准
example: 这个队列为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. exerting shrewd or devious influence especially for one's own advantage
translation_zh: n. 操作, 处理；[化] (用手)操作; 使用
example: 这个(熟练的)操作为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a man who courts a woman
translation_zh: n. 起诉者, 请愿者, 求婚者；[法] 起诉人, 原告, 求婚者
example: She had many suitors vying for her attention.

meaning: n the quality of being fraudulent; n a misleading falsehood; n the act of deceiving
translation_zh: n. 欺骗, 谎言；[经] 诈骗, 欺骗
example: 这个欺骗为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: v. make withdrawn or isolated or emotionally dissociated
translation_zh: vt. 使疏远, 离间, 转让；[法] 转让, 让与, 疏远
example: 我们需要逐步alienate这个方案。

meaning: r. in a persuasive manner
translation_zh: adv. 口才好地；令人信服地
example: 他有说服力的地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: n. the act of restraining of a person's liberty by confining them; n. the state of being confined
translation_zh: n. 限制, 被禁闭, 分娩；[医] 分娩, 生产
example: 这个监禁为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n a small or minor detail
translation_zh: n. 微小；不重要的细节（minutia的复数）
example: 这个次要的细节为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a country person; n. one of a (chiefly European) class of agricultural laborers; n. a crude uncouth ill-bred person lacking culture or refinement
translation_zh: n. 农夫, 乡下人
example: 这个农民为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: a. incapable of being explained or accounted for
translation_zh: a. 不能说明的, 不能解释的, 费解的
example: There was an inexplicable delay in the flight.

meaning: adv. In an inexplicable manner.
translation_zh: adv. 说不清
example: The lights went out inexplicably.

meaning: n. wild and domesticated birds having a heavy body and short legs
translation_zh: n. 鸽子, 易上当受骗的人, 年轻女子
example: 这个鸽子 n. (Pigeon)人名为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: v. annoy continually or chronically; v. exhaust by attacking repeatedly
translation_zh: vt. 使困扰, 使烦恼, 折磨
example: 我们需要逐步harass这个方案。

meaning: n. a feeling of intense annoyance caused by being tormented; n. the act of tormenting by continued persistent attacks and criticism
translation_zh: n. 困扰, 烦扰, 烦恼；[法] 折磨, 骚扰, 侵扰
example: The company has a strict policy against harassment.

meaning: r. in a believable manner
translation_zh: adv. believable的变形
example: 他believably（adverb）地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: s easily deciphered
translation_zh: a. 值得一读的, 易读的, 读起来津津有味的；[电] 可读的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常可读的的解释。

meaning: n the power of creative imagination; n intelligence as manifested in being quick and witty; n the property of being ingenious
translation_zh: n. 机灵；聪明
example: 这个cleverness（noun）为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: v. cause to suffer
translation_zh: vt. 迫害, 虐待, 困扰, 同...捣乱；[法] 迫害, 虐待, 烦扰
example: Historically, many groups have been persecuted for their religious beliefs.

meaning: n. the act of persecuting (especially on the basis of race or religion)
translation_zh: n. 虐待, 迫害运动, 迫害, 烦扰；[法] 迫害, 虐待, 困扰
example: Many refugees fled their country due to political persecution.

meaning: s. marked by excessive complacency or self-satisfaction
translation_zh: a. 自以为是的, 自鸣得意的, 整洁的；n. 书呆子, 自命不凡的家伙
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常自鸣得意的的解释。

meaning: r. in a smug manner
translation_zh: adv. 沾沾自喜地；自鸣得意地
example: 他自鸣得意的地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: s. marked by extreme and violent energy
translation_zh: a. 残忍的, 凶猛的, 可怕的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常凶猛的的解释。

meaning: r. in a physically fierce manner
translation_zh: adv. 野蛮地, 残忍地
example: 他凶猛的地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: n. troops belonging to the enemy's military forces; a. characterized by enmity or ill will; a. not belonging to your own country's forces or those of an ally; s. impossible to bring into friendly accord
translation_zh: a. 敌人的, 怀敌意的, 敌对的；n. 敌对分子
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常敌对的的解释。

meaning: n. a hostile (very unfriendly) disposition; n. a state of deep-seated ill-will; n. the feeling of a hostile person
translation_zh: n. 敌意, 敌对, 反对
example: 这个敌意为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: v. fill with apprehension or alarm; cause to be unpleasantly surprised
translation_zh: n. 沮丧；vt. 使惊愕, 使气馁
example: 我们需要逐步dismay这个方案。

meaning: s. characterized by method and orderliness
translation_zh: a. 有方法的, 有系统的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常有方法的的解释。

meaning: s without mercy or pity
translation_zh: a. 无情的, 残忍的, 毫不留情的, 彻底的；[法] 无情的, 残忍的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常无情的的解释。

meaning: n mercilessness characterized by a lack of pity; n feelings of extreme heartlessness
translation_zh: n. 无情；冷酷；残忍
example: 这个ruthlessness（noun）为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n group of people related by blood or marriage
translation_zh: n. 氏族, 宗族, 集团；[医] 支
example: 这个宗族为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: a. blessed with privileges; s. not subject to usual rules or penalties
translation_zh: a. 有特权的, 有特别恩典的；[法] 特许的, 有特权的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常享有特权的的解释。

meaning: v. fall apart; v. break or fall apart into fragments
translation_zh: v. (使)粉碎, (使)成为碎屑, 瓦解, 崩溃, 败落
example: 我们需要逐步crumble这个方案。

meaning: n. a very small quantity of something; n. small piece of e.g. bread or cake; v. coat with bread crumbs; v. break into crumbs
translation_zh: n. 碎屑, 面包屑, 少许；vt. 捏碎, 弄碎
example: 这个碎屑（尤指面包屑或糕饼屑）为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a feeling of being intimate and belonging together; n. characterized by a lack of openness (especially about one's actions or purposes)
translation_zh: [建] 密闭, 紧密
example: 这个亲密为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. noteworthy scarcity; n. a rarified quality
translation_zh: n. 稀罕, 罕有, 珍奇, 稀薄
example: 这个稀有为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: v call forth (emotions, feelings, and responses); v evoke or provoke to appear or occur; v deduce (a principle) or construe (a meaning); v summon into action or bring into existence, often as if by magic; v call to mind
translation_zh: vt. 唤起, 引起, 召(魂)；[法] 提审, 移送
example: 我们需要逐步evoke这个方案。

meaning: v. cause to move back by force or influence; v. be repellent to; cause aversion in; v. force or drive back
translation_zh: vt. 逐退, 抵制, 使厌恶, 抗御；vi. 使厌恶, 相互排斥
example: 我们需要逐步repel这个方案。

meaning: n a compound with which fabrics are treated to repel water; n a chemical substance that repels animals; n the power to repel; s serving or tending to repel; s highly offensive; arousing aversion or disgust
translation_zh: a. & n.<主英>=repellent
example: 这个repellant（noun）为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n a shade of blue tinged with green
translation_zh: [医] 水, 水剂
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常aqua（adjective）的解释。

meaning: n. a tank or pool or bowl filled with water for keeping live fish and underwater animals
translation_zh: n. 水族馆, 养鱼池, 水草缸；[医] 培养缸
example: 这个水族馆为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: insightfully
translation_zh: 富于洞察力地；有见识地；有眼光地
example: 他富有洞察力的地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: n. a transition (in literary or theatrical works or films) to an earlier event or scene that interrupts the normal chronological development of the story; n. an unexpected but vivid recurrence of a past experience (especially a recurrence of the effects of an hallucinogenic drug taken much earlier)
translation_zh: n. 倒叙, 火舌回闪；[机] 回闪
example: 这个闪回为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: v. cause to agonize; v. suffer agony or anguish
translation_zh: vt. 使极度痛苦, 折磨；vi. 感到痛苦
example: 我们需要逐步agonize这个方案。

meaning: n a short note recognizing a source of information or of a quoted passage; v make reference to; v commend; v refer to; v repeat a passage from; v refer to for illustration or proof; v advance evidence for; v call in an official matter, such as to attend court
translation_zh: vt. 引用, 引证, 表彰；[建] 引证, 指引
example: You must cite your sources in academic writing.

meaning: n. an official award (as for bravery or service) usually given as formal public statement; n. (law) the act of citing (as of spoken words or written passages or legal precedents etc.); n. a short note recognizing a source of information or of a quoted passage; n. a summons that commands the appearance of a party at a proceeding
translation_zh: n. 引用, 引证, 引用文；[建] 引证, 指引
example: 这个引用为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: r. in an ecstatic manner
translation_zh: adv. 心醉神迷地, 入神地
example: 他ecstatically（adverb）地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: s affording satisfaction or pleasure
translation_zh: a. 快乐的, 愉快的, 舒适的, 心情舒畅的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常令人快乐的的解释。

meaning: r. in a strong substantial way
translation_zh: adv. 实质上, 本质上, 大体上
example: The cost has increased substantially.

meaning: n. the condition or result of being changeable
translation_zh: n. 差异, 多样性；[化] 多样性
example: 这个多样化为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. someone who believes in rule by an elite group
translation_zh: n. 优秀人材, 杰出人材；a. 优秀人材的, 杰出人材的
example: His elitist attitude made him unpopular with his colleagues.

meaning: n. a complaint uttered in a low and indistinct tone; v. to utter or emit low dull rumbling sounds
translation_zh: n. 怨言, 满腹牢骚；vi. 抱怨, 发牢骚, 发隆隆声；vt. 抱怨
example: 我们需要逐步grumble这个方案。

meaning: n. a loud low dull continuous noise; n. a servant's seat (or luggage compartment) in the rear of a carriage; n. a fight between rival gangs of adolescents; v. make a low noise
translation_zh: n. 隆隆声, 辘辘声；vi. 发隆隆声, 辘辘响；vt. 使隆隆响, 低沉地说
example: 我们需要逐步rumble这个方案。

meaning: s not showing due care or attention; s failing in what duty requires
translation_zh: a. 不小心的, 疏忽的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常疏忽的的解释。

meaning: n. the activity of gathering livestock together so that they can be counted or branded or sold; n. a summary list; as in e.g. "a news roundup"; n. the systematic gathering up of suspects by the police
translation_zh: n. 驱集, 集拢, 综述
example: 这个综述为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: s. characterized by extreme care and great effort; a. guided by or in accordance with conscience or sense of right and wrong
translation_zh: a. 有责任心的, 负责的, 本着良心的；[法] 凭良心做的, 有道德感的
example: She is a very conscientious student.

meaning: r with extreme conscientiousness
translation_zh: adv. 认真, 凭良心做, 尽心尽责, 谨慎, 诚心诚意
example: 他良心上地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: a. vague or not clearly defined or stated; s. not decided or not known
translation_zh: a. 模糊的, 不确定的, 无限的；[法] 不确定的, 无限制的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常无限期的的解释。

meaning: r. to an indefinite extent; for an indefinite time
translation_zh: adv. 无期限地
example: 他无限期地地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: a. relating to or located in the atmosphere
translation_zh: a. 大气的；[医] 大气的; 大气压的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常大气的的解释。

meaning: n. an electrical device that can interrupt the flow of electrical current when it is overloaded; n. any igniter that is used to initiate the burning of a propellant; v. become plastic or fluid or liquefied from heat; v. equip with a fuse; provide with a fuse
translation_zh: n. 保险丝, 导火线；v. 熔化, 融合
example: 我们需要逐步fuse这个方案。

meaning: n. an occurrence that involves the production of a union; n. the merging of adjacent sounds or syllables or words; n. a nuclear reaction in which nuclei combine to form more massive nuclei with the simultaneous release of energy; n. the combining of images from the two eyes to form a single visual percept
translation_zh: n. 熔合物, 结合, 熔合；[化] 熔融; 熔化; 聚变
example: The restaurant serves a delicious fusion of Asian and European cuisine.

meaning: a. sturdy and strong in form, constitution, or construction; s. strong enough to withstand or overcome intellectual challenges or adversity; s. rough and crude
translation_zh: a. 健康的, 强健的, 要用力气的, 坚定的, 粗野的；[计] 健壮性
example: The company has a robust economy.

meaning: r. in a robust manner
translation_zh: adv. 要用体力地, 粗鲁地
example: 他强健的地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: s causing dejection
translation_zh: a. 阴沉的, 凄凉的, 令人忧郁的；n. 低落的情绪, 沼泽
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常阴沉的的解释。

meaning: r. in a cheerless manner; r. in a dreadful manner
translation_zh: adv. 沉闷地；阴暗地
example: 他阴沉的地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: v. have a craving, appetite, or great desire for; v. plead or ask for earnestly
translation_zh: v. 渴望, 热望, 恳求
example: 我们需要逐步crave这个方案。

meaning: n. an intense desire for some particular thing
translation_zh: n. 渴望, 热望；[医] 瘾, 癖, 嗜欲
example: 这个渴望为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: a. of or concerned with or related to the future
translation_zh: a. 预期的, 将来的；[经] 预期的, 未来的
example: We interviewed several prospective candidates for the job.

meaning: v. move (a piece of a program) into memory, in computer science
translation_zh: n. 以货易货；v. 交换, 替换, 交易；[计] 交换
example: 我们需要逐步swap这个方案。

meaning: r. in a remote manner; r. to a remote degree
translation_zh: adv. 极小地, 极细微地
example: 他遥远地地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: n. any of numerous low-growing violas with small flowers; n. a variable color that lies beyond blue in the spectrum
translation_zh: n. 堇菜, 紫罗兰；a. 堇菜科的, 紫罗兰色的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常紫罗兰的解释。

meaning: s. full of or showing high spirits
translation_zh: a. 多泡的, 起泡的；n. 香槟酒
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常起泡的的解释。

meaning: r. in a wild and confused manner; r. in a manner suggestive of chaos
translation_zh: adv. 混乱地
example: 他chaotically（adverb）地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: s. quick to understand; s. mentally upset over possible misfortune or danger etc; s. in fear or dread of possible evil or harm
translation_zh: a. 惴惴不安的, 敏悟的, 知晓的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常知晓的的解释。

meaning: n. a small sofa
translation_zh: n. 长靠背椅
example: 这个长靠椅为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. gymnastic apparatus consisting of a strong canvas sheet attached with springs to a metal frame; used for tumbling
translation_zh: n. 蹦床
example: 这个trampoline（noun）为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. enduring strength and energy
translation_zh: n. 精力, 活力, 耐力, 雄蕊；[医] 耐力, 精力; 雄蕊
example: 这个体力为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a maneuver in a game or conversation
translation_zh: n. 手段, 活动, 玩乐
example: 这个策略为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. an excited state of agitation; v. act nervously; be undecided; be uncertain; v. make a fuss; be agitated
translation_zh: n. 发抖, 兴奋；vi. 发抖
example: 我们需要逐步dither这个方案。

meaning: n (usually plural) work clothing consisting of denim trousers (usually with a bib and shoulder straps); n a loose protective coverall or smock worn over ordinary clothing for dirty work
translation_zh: n. 工装裤；[机] 工作服, 工装
example: 这个总的为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. corresponding exactly; n. occurring together or simultaneously; n. (music) two or more sounds or tones at the same pitch or in octaves
translation_zh: n. 调和, 和谐, 一致, 齐唱, 齐奏；a. 共同做的, 同声的
example: 这个一致为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. freshwater or marine or terrestrial gastropod mollusk usually having an external enclosing spiral shell; v. gather snails
translation_zh: n. 蜗牛, 行动迟缓的人, 脑筋迟钝的人, 蜗形凸轮；vt. (蜗牛般)缓慢地打发(时间)；vi. 缓慢移动
example: 这个蜗牛为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a state of extreme happiness
translation_zh: n. 福佑, 天赐的福；[计] 实现系统软件的基本语言
example: 这个极乐为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: s. that cannot be entirely consumed or used up; a. incapable of being entirely consumed or used up
translation_zh: a. 用不完的, 无穷尽的, 不知疲倦的
example: Her energy seemed inexhaustible.

meaning: n. a unit of area (4840 square yards) used in English-speaking countries; n. a territory of western Brazil bordering on Bolivia and Peru; n. a town and port in northwestern Israel in the eastern Mediterranean
translation_zh: n. 英亩
example: 这个英亩为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. young cow
translation_zh: n. 小母牛
example: 这个小母牛为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a member of a people living in southern Benin and Togo and southeastern Ghana; n. a Kwa language spoken by the Ewe in Ghana and Togo and Benin; n. female sheep
translation_zh: n. 母羊
example: 这个[畜牧] 母羊为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. someone who offers opposition
translation_zh: n. 敌手, 对手；a. 敌手的, 敌对的
example: 这个对手为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: s. having won
translation_zh: a. 胜利的, 得胜的, 战胜的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常胜利的的解释。

meaning: r. in a victorious manner
translation_zh: adv. 获胜地, 胜利地
example: 他胜利的地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: a. showing intellectual penetration or emotional depth; s. of the greatest intensity; complete; s. coming from deep within one; s. situated at or extending to great depth; too deep to have been sounded or plumbed
translation_zh: a. 极深的, 深厚的, 深刻的, 渊博的
example: His speech had a profound impact on the audience.

meaning: r. to a great depth psychologically
translation_zh: adv. 深深地, 深切地
example: 他极大地地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: r. in a bald manner
translation_zh: adv. 率直地, 露骨地, 无掩饰地
example: 他秃顶的地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: s. having hair on the cheeks and chin; s. having a growth of hairlike awns
translation_zh: a. 有须的, 有胡子的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常（男子）有胡须的的解释。

meaning: n. the expertness characteristic of a professional person
translation_zh: n. 职业特性, 专业技巧, 职业行为, 职业作风, (褒)专业人员的特质, 职业化；[经] 职业特性, 职业作风, 职业化
example: Her professionalism was evident in every aspect of her work.

meaning: r. in an artistic manner
translation_zh: adv. 富有艺术地, 在艺术上
example: 他ad地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: n. an interpretation that easily understandable and acceptable; n. the act of making something attractive to the general public
translation_zh: n. 通俗化, 平易化, 普及
example: 这个popularization（noun）为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. an apparatus consisting of an object mounted so that it swings freely under the influence of gravity
translation_zh: n. 钟摆, 摇锤, 摇摆不定的事态(或局面)；[化] 摆
example: 这个摆为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. one who precedes you in time (as in holding a position or office)
translation_zh: n. 前任, 先辈, 前身；[医] 初牙, 前辈, 祖先
example: My predecessor left big shoes to fill.

meaning: n. a break or intermission in the occurrence of something; v. end, at least for a long time; v. drop to a lower level, as in one's morals or standards; v. let slip
translation_zh: n. 过失, 流逝, 失效；vi. 犯错, 堕落, 减退, 消失, 流逝；vt. 使失效
example: 这个小错为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: s. uninterrupted in time and indefinitely long continuing
translation_zh: a. 不停的, 不断的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常不断的的解释。

meaning: r with unflagging resolve
translation_zh: adv. 不停地, 不断地
example: 他不断的地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: n. the highest point of anything conceived of as growing or developing or unfolding; n. the decisive moment in a novel or play; n. the most severe stage of a disease; n. arrangement of clauses in ascending order of forcefulness
translation_zh: n. 高潮, 极点, 层进法；v. (使)达到顶点, (使)达到高潮
example: 这个高潮为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: a. consisting of or causing a climax
translation_zh: a. 顶点的, 高潮的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常高潮的的解释。

meaning: a. of or relating to a sudden change from an impressive to a ludicrous style; a. coming after the climax especially of a dramatic or narrative plot
translation_zh: a. 突降法的, 虎头蛇尾的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常anticlimactic（adjective）的解释。

meaning: n. something that is lost or surrendered as a penalty;; n. a penalty for a fault or mistake that involves losing or giving up something; n. the act of losing or surrendering something as a penalty for a mistake or fault or failure to perform etc.; v. lose (s.th.) or lose the right to (s.th.) by some error, offense, or crime
translation_zh: n. 没收物, 罚金, 丧失；vt. 没收, 丧失；a. 丧失了的
example: 我们需要逐步forfeit这个方案。

meaning: n. a sudden muscle spasm; especially one caused by a nervous condition; v. make an uncontrolled, short, jerky motion; v. move or pull with a sudden motion
translation_zh: vi. 急拉, 抽搐, 阵痛；vt. 急拉, 攫取, 抽动；n. 急拉, 抽搐, 阵痛
example: 我们需要逐步twitch这个方案。

meaning: n knowledge and intellectual ability; n the capacity for rational thought or inference or discrimination; n a person who uses the mind creatively
translation_zh: n. 智力, 出众的才华, 知识分子；[医] 智力, 才智
example: 这个智力为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a movement downward; n. the act of changing your location in a downward direction; n. the kinship relation between an individual and the individual's progenitors; n. a downward slope or bend
translation_zh: n. 降落, 家系, 侵袭, 血统；[医] 下降, 世代, 血统
example: 这个下降为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a journey by a large group to escape from a hostile environment; n. the second book of the Old Testament: tells of the departure of the Israelites out of slavery in Egypt led by Moses; God gave them the Ten Commandments and the rest of Mosaic law on Mount Sinai during the Exodus
translation_zh: n. 大批的离去；[法] 退出, 大批离去, 成一外出
example: There was a mass exodus from the city before the storm.

meaning: v. make famous forever
translation_zh: vt. 使不灭, 使名垂千古
example: The artist hoped to immortalize the beauty of the landscape in his painting.

meaning: n. the ordering of genes in a haploid set of chromosomes of a particular organism; the full DNA sequence of an organism
translation_zh: [化] 基因组；[医] 染色体组
example: Scientists are working to map the human genome.

meaning: n. a component of a mixture that has been separated by a fractional process; n. a small part or item forming a piece of a whole; n. the quotient of two rational numbers
translation_zh: n. 小部分, 破片, 分数；[医] 部分, 成分, 分散
example: 这个分数为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a dissenting clique
translation_zh: n. 小派系, 内讧；[法] 宗派, 派别, 小集团
example: The party was split into several warring factions.

meaning: n. constitution of the human body
translation_zh: n. 体格, 体形；[医] 体格
example: 这个体格为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. an implement for practical use (especially in a household)
translation_zh: n. 器皿, 用具
example: 这个器具为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. the fur of an otter; n. freshwater carnivorous mammal having webbed and clawed feet and dark brown fur
translation_zh: n. 水獭, 水獭皮
example: 这个（水）獭为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: s. unpleasantly cool and humid
translation_zh: a. 湿粘的, 病态的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常clammy（adjective）的解释。

meaning: v. grant a dispensation; grant an exemption
translation_zh: vt. 分发, 分配；vi. 特许, 豁免
example: 我们需要逐步dispense这个方案。

meaning: n. clinic where medicine and medical supplies are dispensed
translation_zh: n. (尤指医院的)药房, 诊疗所；[医] 医务所, 防治所, 药房
example: 这个药房为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: v. move or draw apart; v. have no limits as a mathematical series; v. extend in a different direction
translation_zh: vi. 分歧, 岔开；vt. 使岔开
example: The two paths diverge at the old oak tree.

meaning: n. the act of moving away in different direction from a common point; n. an infinite series that has no limit
translation_zh: n. 分歧；[计] 分散度
example: There was a clear divergence of opinion between the two parties.

meaning: s. diverging from another or from a standard; a. tending to move apart in different directions
translation_zh: a. 有分歧的；[医] 散开的, 偏斜的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常不同的的解释。

meaning: a. concerned with or comprehending only what is apparent or obvious; not deep or penetrating emotionally or intellectually; a. of, affecting, or being on or near the surface; s. of little substance or significance
translation_zh: n. 表面, 外表；a. 表面的, 肤浅的, 面积的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常粗浅的的解释。

meaning: r. in a superficial manner
translation_zh: adv. 表面, 表面性, 浅层, 不深, 表皮, (贬)肤浅, 一知半解, 浅薄, 平方, 浮面
example: 他浅薄地地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: n. (philosophy) a philosophical theory as to what is beautiful; a. relating to or dealing with the subject of aesthetics; a. concerning or characterized by an appreciation of beauty or good taste; s. aesthetically pleasing
translation_zh: a. 美学的, 审美的, 有美感的
example: The painting had great aesthetic appeal.

meaning: r. in a tasteful way
translation_zh: adv. 美学观点上地；审美地
example: 他审美地地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: n. a prolonged intense look
translation_zh: n. 细看, 仔细检查, 监视, 选票检查；[经] 复查, 评核, 仔细检查
example: The new policy came under close scrutiny.

meaning: n a witty saying; n witty remark; v make jokes or quips
translation_zh: n. 妙语, 遁辞, 讽刺；v. 说讽刺话, 嘲弄
example: He delivered a witty quip that made everyone laugh.

meaning: v. seek someone's favor; v. make amorous advances towards
translation_zh: vt. 追求, 向...求爱, 恳求；vi. 求爱, 央求
example: The company is trying to woo new customers with special offers.

meaning: n a basis for comparison; a reference point against which other things can be evaluated; n the ideal in terms of which something can be judged
translation_zh: pl. 标准；[计] 条件
example: 这个（批评、判断等的）标准为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: a. apparently reasonable and valid, and truthful; s. given to or characterized by presenting specious arguments
translation_zh: a. 貌似真实的, 貌似合理的, 说得煞有其事的；[法] 花言巧语的, 似乎有理的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常似乎是真的的解释。

meaning: n. apparent validity
translation_zh: n. 似有道理, 貌似可信；[法] 花言巧语, 似乎有理
example: 这个plausibility（noun）为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: r easy to believe on the basis of available evidence
translation_zh: adv. 似真地
example: He argued his case quite plausibly, despite the lack of concrete evidence.

meaning: s unthinking; prompted by (or as if by) instinct
translation_zh: a. 本能的, 天生的, 直觉的；[医] 本能的
example: His reaction was purely instinctive.

meaning: r. as a matter of instinct
translation_zh: adv. 本能地, 直觉地
example: 他本能地地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: s. of or relating to style (especially in the use of language)
translation_zh: a. 格式上的, 体裁上的
example: The painting has unique stylistic elements.

meaning: r. in a rhetorically stylistic manner
translation_zh: adv. 在文体上
example: 他stylistically（adverb）地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: n. hereditary succession to a title or an office or property; n. that which is inherited; a title or property or estate that passes by law to the heir on the death of the owner; n. (genetics) attributes acquired via biological heredity from the parents; n. any attribute or immaterial possession that is inherited from ancestors
translation_zh: n. 遗传, 遗产；[医] 遗传
example: 这个继承为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: s existing as an essential constituent or characteristic; s in the nature of something though not readily apparent
translation_zh: a. 固有的, 与生俱来的；[医] 固有的, 生来的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常内在的的解释。

meaning: r. in an inherent manner
translation_zh: adv. 内在地, 生来地, 固有地；[计] 固有的
example: 他内在地地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: a. happening or arising without apparent external cause
translation_zh: a. 自然的, 自发的, 未经琢磨的；[医] 自发的, 特发的, 自生的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常自发的的解释。

meaning: r. in a spontaneous manner
translation_zh: adv. 自发, 一时冲动, 出自自然, 不依赖人工, 自然产生, 本能, 自动, 自然而优雅
example: 他自然地地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: n. the cry of a goose (or any sound resembling this); v. make a loud noise; v. use the horn of a car
translation_zh: n. 雁鸣, 汽车的喇叭声；vi. 雁鸣叫, 按汽车喇叭；vt. 揿(喇叭)
example: 我们需要逐步honk这个方案。

meaning: n. web-footed long-necked typically gregarious migratory aquatic birds usually larger and less aquatic than ducks; n. flesh of a goose (domestic or wild); v. pinch in the buttocks; v. prod into action
translation_zh: n. 鹅, 雌鹅, 鹅肉, 弯把熨斗；vt. 与...性交, 突然加大油门, 使生色, 喝倒彩
example: 这个鹅为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: v bring something new to an environment
translation_zh: vi. 改革, 创新
example: 我们需要逐步innovate这个方案。

meaning: n. an expert able to appreciate a field; especially in the fine arts
translation_zh: n. 鉴赏家, 鉴定家, 内行
example: He is a true connoisseur of fine wines.

meaning: n. a concept or idea not associated with any specific instance; n. the act of withdrawing or removing something; n. the process of formulating general concepts by abstracting common properties of instances; n. an abstract painting
translation_zh: n. 抽象化, 心不在焉, 空想, 提炼, 抽象派作品；[化] 提取; 抽取; 夺取; 夺取反应; 除去
example: The concept of time is an abstraction.

meaning: n a display of bad temper
translation_zh: n. 发脾气, 发怒；[医] 暴怒, 发脾气
example: 这个突然发怒为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. anything that is cast aside or discarded; n. (cards) the act of throwing out a useless card or of failing to follow suit; n. getting rid something that is regarded as useless or undesirable; v. throw or cast away
translation_zh: vt. 丢弃, 抛弃；vi. 垫牌；n. 垫牌, 抛弃
example: 我们需要逐步discard这个方案。

meaning: n. a death resulting from an accident or a disaster; n. the quality of being able to cause death or fatal disasters
translation_zh: n. 不幸, 厄运, 致命性, 死亡者, 厄运, 天命
example: 这个灾祸为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: v. become stiff or stiffer; v. make stiff or stiffer; v. restrict
translation_zh: vt. 使变硬, 使僵硬, 使顽强, 使严厉；vi. 变粘, 变硬, 变强烈
example: 我们需要逐步stiffen这个方案。

meaning: a. covered with growing trees and bushes etc
translation_zh: a. 树木繁茂的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常多树木的的解释。

meaning: v. praise somewhat dishonestly
translation_zh: vt. 奉承, 阿谀, 使高兴；[机] 平面锤
example: 我们需要逐步flatter这个方案。

meaning: n. excessive or insincere praise
translation_zh: n. 谄媚, 阿谀, 巴结
example: 这个奉承（话）为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: s. continually changing especially as from one abode or occupation to another
translation_zh: a. 无目的的, 没有目标的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常没有目标的的解释。

meaning: r. without aim; in an aimless manner
translation_zh: adv. 漫无目的地, 无目标地
example: 他漫无目的地地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: a. having no meaning or direction or purpose
translation_zh: a. 无意义的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常无意义的的解释。

meaning: meaninglessly
translation_zh: adv. 无意义地；无目的地；无道理地
example: 他无意义的地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: s. informal or natural; especially caught off guard or unprepared; s. openly straightforward and direct without reserve or secretiveness
translation_zh: a. 坦白的, 率直的, 公正的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常公正的的解释。

meaning: r (used as intensives reflecting the speaker's attitude) it is sincerely the case that
translation_zh: adv. 率直地, 坦白地
example: 他耿直地地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: n. an energetic style
translation_zh: n. 活力, 生命力；[医] 生机, 活力, 生活
example: The old man still possessed remarkable vitality.

meaning: v. evoke or provoke to appear or occur; v. provide the needed stimulus for
translation_zh: vt. 激怒, 惹起, 诱导；[法] 刺激, 煽动, 激怒
example: 我们需要逐步provoke这个方案。

meaning: a. serving or tending to provoke, excite, or stimulate; stimulating discussion or exciting controversy; s. exciting sexual desire
translation_zh: a. 激发感情的, 挑拨的, 刺激的；n. 刺激物, 挑拨物, 兴奋剂
example: His provocative comments sparked a heated debate.

meaning: r. in a provocative manner
translation_zh: adv. provocative的变形
example: 他刺激的地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: v. hold in a tight grasp; v. squeeze together tightly
translation_zh: n. 牢牢抓住, 钉紧, 敲弯钉尖；vt. 紧握, 牢牢地抓住, 确定, 敲弯；vi. 握紧, 钉牢
example: 我们需要逐步clench这个方案。

meaning: n. an instance of intense argument (as in bargaining); v. wrangle (over a price, terms of an agreement, etc.)
translation_zh: vi. 争论, 杀价；vt. 乱砍, 乱劈；n. 杀价, 讨论, 争论
example: 我们需要逐步haggle这个方案。

meaning: n lack of respect accompanied by a feeling of intense dislike; n open disrespect for a person or thing; v look down on with disdain; v reject with contempt
translation_zh: n. 轻蔑, 藐视, 嘲笑, 被嘲弄的人；vt. 轻蔑, 不屑做
example: 这个鄙视为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: s expressing extreme contempt
translation_zh: a. 轻蔑的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常轻蔑的的解释。

meaning: r without respect; in a disdainful manner
translation_zh: adv. 鄙视地, 轻蔑地
example: 他轻蔑的地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: r. in an animated manner
translation_zh: adv. 精力旺盛地；活生生地
example: 他活生生的地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: v. make less visible or unclear; v. make obscure or unclear; v. reduce a vowel to a neutral one, such as a schwa; v. make undecipherable or imperceptible by obscuring or concealing
translation_zh: a. 模糊的, 昏暗的, 难解的, 晦涩的, 偏僻的, 微贱的, 无名的；vt. 使变暗, 隐藏, 使变模糊, 使难解
example: His early life remains obscure.

meaning: r. in an obscure manner
translation_zh: adv. 费解地, 晦涩地；隐匿地
example: 他难以说清楚的地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: v give a promotion to or assign to a higher position; v raise from a lower to a higher position; v raise in rank or condition
translation_zh: vt. 举起, 提拔, 鼓舞
example: 我们需要逐步elevate这个方案。

meaning: n. the event of something being raised upward; n. angular distance above the horizon (especially of a celestial object); n. distance of something above a reference point (such as sea level)
translation_zh: n. 海拔, 提高, 仰角；[计] 仰角
example: 这个高度为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: r in a tedious manner
translation_zh: adv. 沉闷地, 长而乏味地
example: 他单调沉闷的地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: n. a group of people or things arranged or following in order; n. the action of following in order; n. (ecology) the gradual and orderly process of change in an ecosystem brought about by the progressive replacement of one community by another until a stable climax is established; n. acquisition of property by descent or by will
translation_zh: n. 连续, 继承权, 继位, 演替, 地层次序；[法] 继承, 继承权, 继位
example: There has been a succession of bad weather days.

meaning: n. a requirement of etiquette or custom; n. a manner that strictly observes all forms and ceremonies; n. compliance with formal rules
translation_zh: n. 礼节, 拘谨, 正式手续；[化] 克式浓度
example: 这个礼节为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. someone who climbs mountains; v. climb mountains for pleasure as a sport
translation_zh: n. 登山家, 山地人；vi. 登山
example: 这个mountaineer（noun）为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. someone who helps to open up a new line of research or technology or art; n. one the first colonists or settlers in a new territory; v. open up an area or prepare a way; v. open up and explore a new area
translation_zh: n. 先锋, 拓荒者, 创始人；vt. 提倡, 开辟, 开创, 倡导；vi. 作先驱, 开路；a. 最早的, 开拓的, 先驱的, 有开拓者特点的
example: 我们需要逐步pioneer这个方案。

meaning: n. the act of searching for something; v. make a search (for); v. search the trail of (game); v. seek alms, as for religious purposes
translation_zh: n. 探索, 寻求, 调查；v. 寻找, 找, 追寻猎物
example: 这个追求为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: a. crossing the Atlantic Ocean
translation_zh: a. 横渡大西洋的, 大西洋彼岸的, 美国的
example: She booked a transatlantic flight to London.

meaning: n a statement of fundamental facts or principles; n the elementary stages of any subject (usually plural); n the remains of a body part that was functional at an earlier stage of life
translation_zh: n. 基础, 初步, 基本原理, 入门, 雏形, 萌芽
example: 这个rudiments（noun）为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: s. being in the earliest stages of development
translation_zh: a. 基本的, 起码的, 初步的, 发展不完全的, 残留的, 退化的；[医] 原基的, 未成熟的; 残遗的, 已退化的
example: He has only a rudimentary understanding of the subject.

meaning: s unusually great in size or amount or degree or especially extent or scope
translation_zh: a. 极广大的, 无边的, 非常好的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常极大的的解释。

meaning: r to an exceedingly great extent or degree
translation_zh: adv. 无限地, 广大地, 庞大地
example: 他极大地地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: n. an announcement that usually advises or warns the public of some threat; s. giving advice
translation_zh: a. 顾问的, 咨询的, 劝告的；[法] 劝告的, 忠告的, 咨询的
example: The committee has an advisory role.

meaning: s. hard to endure
translation_zh: a. 难受的, 难堪的；[法] 裁决, 审判, 审理; 使人痛苦的, 难堪的, 难处的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常令人厌烦的的解释。

meaning: n a catecholamine secreted by the adrenal medulla in response to stress (trade name Adrenalin); stimulates autonomic nerve action
translation_zh: n. 肾上腺素；[化] 肾上腺素
example: 这个<生化>肾上腺素为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a person who enjoys fixing and experimenting with machines and their parts; n. formerly a person (traditionally a Gypsy) who traveled from place to place mending pots and kettles and other metal utensils as a way to earn a living; v. work as a tinker or tinkerer; v. try to fix or mend
translation_zh: n. 补锅匠, 会做各种修补活计的人；vi. 做焊锅匠, 笨拙的修补；vt. 修补
example: 我们需要逐步tinker这个方案。

meaning: n a room or building equipped with one or more toilets; n a bathroom sink that is permanently installed and connected to a water supply and drainpipe; where you can wash your hands and face; n a toilet that is cleaned of waste by the flow of water through it
translation_zh: n. 洗脸盆, 厕所
example: 这个盥洗室 (n.) - 洗手间为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. (architecture) a slender upright spire at the top of a buttress of tower; n. a lofty peak; v. surmount with a pinnacle; v. raise on or as if on a pinnacle
translation_zh: n. 小尖塔, 尖峰, 高峰, 极点；vt. 造小尖塔, 置于尖顶上
example: 这个顶峰为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: a. not firm or firmly fixed; likely to fail or give way; a. lacking in security or safety; a. lacking self-confidence or assurance; s. not safe from attack
translation_zh: a. 不安全的, 不牢靠的, 不坚固的, 不稳定的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常无安全的的解释。

meaning: r. in a tentative and self-conscious manner; r. in a manner involving risk
translation_zh: adv. 不安全地；不可靠地
example: 他无安全的地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: v. cause to feel sure; give reassurance to; v. give or restore confidence in; cause to feel sure or certain
translation_zh: vt. 使...安心, 向...再保证；[法] 重新保证, 再保险, 使清除疑虑
example: 我们需要逐步reassure这个方案。

meaning: n. the act of reassuring; restoring someone's confidence
translation_zh: n. 安心, 放心, 再保证
example: 这个使安心为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: a. not responsive to physical stimuli; a. deficient in human sensibility; not mentally or morally sensitive
translation_zh: a. 对...没有感觉的, 感觉迟钝的；[医] 感觉迟钝的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常感觉迟钝的的解释。

meaning: r. in an insensitive manner
translation_zh: a. 特别迟钝的, 特别麻木的, 特别不敏感的
example: 他感觉迟钝的地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: v. practice as a profession, teach, or claim to be knowledgeable about; v. confess one's faith in, or allegiance to; v. state freely; v. receive into a religious order or congregation
translation_zh: vt. 声称, 以...为业, 伪称, 讲授；vi. 表白, 承认, 当教授
example: 我们需要逐步profess这个方案。

meaning: n. the quality of being a hindrance
translation_zh: n. 缺点, 退税；[法] 退款, 退税
example: 这个缺点为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: v. watch and direct
translation_zh: vt. 向下看, 了望, 监督, 偷看到；[法] 监察, 监督, 俯瞰
example: 我们需要逐步oversee这个方案。

meaning: n. a person who directs and manages an organization
translation_zh: n. 监督, 工头；[经] 管理人, 监督, 盘工
example: 这个监工为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n a document appraising the value of something (as for insurance or taxation); n the respect with which a person is held; n an approximate calculation of quantity or degree or worth; n a judgment of the qualities of something or somebody
translation_zh: n. 判断, 估计, 尊重；[化] 估计; 估定; 测定; 估值
example: 这个估计为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a channel for communication between groups
translation_zh: n. 联络
example: She acts as a liaison between the two departments.

meaning: stressfully
translation_zh: [网络] 紧张地
example: 他紧张的地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: n. a textile machine for weaving yarn into a textile; v. come into view indistinctly, often threateningly; v. appear very large or occupy a commanding position; v. weave on a loom
translation_zh: n. 织布机, 若隐若现的景象；vi. 朦胧地出现, 隐约可见, 可怕地出现
example: 我们需要逐步loom这个方案。

meaning: r despite anything to the contrary (usually following a concession)
translation_zh: adv. 虽然, 尽管；prep. 尽管；conj. 虽然
example: Notwithstanding the bad weather, the event was a success.

meaning: r. with respect to structure
translation_zh: [计] 结构地
example: 他在结构上地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: a. relating to or caused by structure, especially political or economic structure; a. relating to or having or characterized by structure; s. affecting or involved in structure or construction; not ornamental elements"; s. concerned with systematic structure in a particular field of study
translation_zh: a. 结构的, 建筑的；[医] 结构的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常结构(上)的的解释。

meaning: n. A table stove or small furnace, usually a cylindrical box; of sheet iron, with a grate at the bottom, and an open top.
translation_zh: n. 小型轻便炉
example: 这个chauffer（noun）为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: s. requiring sitting or little activity
translation_zh: a. 久坐的, 坐惯的, 定栖的；[医] 静坐的; 坐式的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常坐着的的解释。

meaning: n. a relationship of mutual understanding or trust and agreement between people
translation_zh: n. 关系, 融洽, 一致；[医] 关系, 协调(病人与医师间), 感通(唯心的灵交术时)
example: 这个友好关系为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a conference (usually with someone important); n. a conference between two or more people to consider a particular question
translation_zh: n. 请教, 咨询, 磋商会；[医] 会诊
example: 这个商议为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. the practice of giving expert advice within a particular field
translation_zh: n. 商量, 协商, 磋商, 会诊, 与...商量, 咨询, 请教, 找(医生)看病, 查阅, 考虑；[经] 咨询业务, 咨询服务
example: 这个咨询公司为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. the act of retaining something
translation_zh: n. 保持, 留置, 保留, 保持力, 保留物, 记忆, 停滞, 固位；[计] 保贸, 保持
example: The company has a high employee retention rate.

meaning: v. extract (something such as stones) from or as if from a quarry
translation_zh: n. 采石场, 方形石, 猎物, 被追求物, 来源；vt. 挖出, 努力挖掘；vi. 费力地找
example: 这个采石场为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a detailed description of design criteria for a piece of work; n. naming explicitly; n. (patent law) a document drawn up by the applicant for a patent of invention that provides an explicit and detailed description of the nature and use of an invention
translation_zh: n. 规格, 详述, 详细说明书；[计] 规范; 形式说明; 说明; 说明书; 规格
example: 这个说明书为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. someone (a person or firm) who contracts to build things; n. the bridge player in contract bridge who wins the bidding and can declare which suit is to be trumps; n. (law) a party to a contract
translation_zh: n. 立契约的人, 承包商；[化] 承包者; 承包工厂
example: 这个(建筑、监造中的)承包人为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n a person who owns something
translation_zh: n. 持有人, 所有人；[法] 拥有的, 所有者, 持有人
example: 这个possessor（noun）为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. coldness due to a cold environment; n. a sensation of cold that often marks the start of an infection and the development of a fever; n. a sudden numbing dread; v. depress or discourage
translation_zh: n. 寒冷, 寒意, 失意；a. 寒冷的, 冷漠的；vt. 使寒心, 冷冻；vi. 变冷
example: 我们需要逐步chill这个方案。

meaning: s. not characterized by emotion; s. appreciably or disagreeably cold; s. lacking warmth of feeling
translation_zh: a. 寒冷的, 冷淡的, 不友好的；[建] 番椒, 冷
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常阴冷的的解释。

meaning: s. covered with frost
translation_zh: a. 霜冻的, 严寒的, 冷淡的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常寒冷的的解释。

meaning: r. without warmth or enthusiasm
translation_zh: adv. 寒冷地, 冷漠地; 冷峻地
example: 他寒冷的地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: a. lacking a crew
translation_zh: a. 无人的, 无人操纵的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常被阉割的的解释。

meaning: a. not relating to or responsive to individual persons; s. having no personal preference
translation_zh: a. 客观的, 和个人无关的, 没有人情味的, 非人称的；n. 非人称动词(或代词)
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常没有人情味的的解释。

meaning: r. without warmth; r. in an impersonal manner
translation_zh: adv. 与个人无关地
example: 他没有人情味的地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: v. assume or act the character of; v. represent another person with comic intentions
translation_zh: vt. 模仿, 扮演, 体现, 使人格化；[法] 体现, 模仿, 拟人
example: He tried to impersonate his boss to get information.

meaning: n. someone who (fraudulently) assumes the appearance of another
translation_zh: n. 演员；模拟艺人
example: 这个impersonator（noun）为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. imitating the mannerisms of another person
translation_zh: n. 扮演, 装扮, 模仿；[计] 模仿
example: 这个impersonation（noun）为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a signaling device that makes a buzzing sound
translation_zh: n. 嗡嗡作声的东西, 蜂音器；[化] 蜂鸣器; 磨轮; 砂轮
example: 这个蜂鸣器为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. withdrawing support or help despite allegiance or responsibility
translation_zh: n. 丢掉, 遗弃, 逃亡；[法] 长期分居, 开小差, 遗弃
example: 这个desertion（noun）为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: a. not held or filled or in use; a. not seized and controlled; s. not leased to or occupied by a tenant
translation_zh: a. 空着的, 没人占的, 未被占领的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常空的的解释。

meaning: s. affected with a sensation of stoppage or obstruction
translation_zh: a. 闷热的, 窒息的, 乏味的, 固步自封的, 自以为是的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常（房间或建筑物）闷的的解释。

meaning: r in a stuffy manner
translation_zh: 不通气地
example: 他（房间或建筑物）闷的地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: n. state of obstruction or stoppage or air in the nose or throat; n. the quality of being close and poorly ventilated
translation_zh: n. 闷热；不通风；自负
example: 这个stuffiness（noun）为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. an expression of openmouthed astonishment; n. a stare of amazement (usually with the mouth open); v. be wide open
translation_zh: n. 裂口, 张嘴, 打哈欠；vi. 裂开, 张嘴, 打哈欠
example: 我们需要逐步gape这个方案。

meaning: n. the state of being held in high esteem and honor
translation_zh: n. 名望, 名气, 声望；vt. 认为, 以为
example: He is reputed to be the best doctor in the city.

meaning: n enduring strength and energy; n the property of being big and strong; n the elasticity and hardness of a metal object; its ability to absorb considerable energy before cracking; n impressive difficulty
translation_zh: n. 有粘性, 强硬, 强健；[化] 韧性
example: 这个韧性为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. utility consisting of the pipes and fixtures for the distribution of water or gas in a building and for the disposal of sewage; n. the occupation of a plumber (installing and repairing pipes and fixtures for water or gas or sewage in a building)
translation_zh: n. 测深, 管子工行业, 管道设备
example: 这个水管装置为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: s. moody and melancholic
translation_zh: a. 愁闷的, 阴沉的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常阴沉的的解释。

meaning: r in a sullen manner
translation_zh: adv. 忧郁地, 闷闷不乐地; 阴郁地
example: 他阴沉的地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: r. in a plucky manner
translation_zh: adv. 不屈地, 勇敢地
example: 他游戏地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: v. cut open or cut apart
translation_zh: v. 解剖, 切开
example: 我们需要逐步dissect这个方案。

meaning: n. cutting so as to separate into pieces; n. a minute and critical analysis; n. detailed critical analysis or examination one part at a time (as of a literary work)
translation_zh: n. 解剖, 切开；[化] 解剖
example: The biology class performed a dissection of a frog.

meaning: v. express approval of; v. present as worthy of regard, kindness, or confidence; v. give to in charge; v. express a good opinion of
translation_zh: vt. 嘉奖, 委托给, 推荐
example: 我们需要逐步commend这个方案。

meaning: n an official award (as for bravery or service) usually given as formal public statement; n a message expressing a favorable opinion
translation_zh: n. 赞赏, 嘉奖, 推荐
example: 这个推荐为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: r. by that means or because of that
translation_zh: adv. 因此
example: He failed the exam, thereby losing his scholarship.

meaning: n. a light sharp contact (usually with something flexible); n. a short stroke; v. look through a book or other written material; v. twitch or flutter
translation_zh: n. 快速的轻打, 轻打声, 弹开；v. 轻弹, 轻轻拂去, 忽然摇动
example: 我们需要逐步flick这个方案。

meaning: n. a momentary flash of light; n. North American woodpecker; v. move back and forth very rapidly; v. shine unsteadily
translation_zh: n. 闪烁, 闪光, 颤动；vi. 闪动, 闪烁, 摇动, 扑动翅膀；vt. 使摇曳, 使闪烁
example: 这个闪烁为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: s. so undesirable as to be incapable of arousing envy
translation_zh: a. 不值得羡慕的, 尴尬的, 不会引起嫉妒的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常不…的解释。

meaning: unenviably
translation_zh: adv. 不值得羡慕地
example: 他unenviably（adverb）地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: v. report or maintain
translation_zh: vt. 宣称, 主张, 提出, 断言；[法] 断言, 指称, 指证
example: The police allege that he committed the crime.

meaning: n. payment made to a person in a position of trust to corrupt his judgment; v. make illegal payments to in exchange for favors or influence
translation_zh: n. 贿赂；vt. 贿赂, 收买；vi. 行贿
example: 我们需要逐步bribe这个方案。

meaning: n. the practice of offering something (usually money) in order to gain an illicit advantage
translation_zh: n. 贿赂行为, 行贿, 受贿；[经] 行贿, 受贿
example: 这个[法] 贿赂为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. the state of being included; n. the relation of comprising something; n. the act of including
translation_zh: n. 包含, 内含物；[计] 蕴含
example: The school promotes the inclusion of all students.

meaning: a. including much or everything; and especially including stated limits
translation_zh: a. 包含的, 包括的
example: The school promotes an inclusive environment.

meaning: adv. In an inclusive manner.
translation_zh: adv. 包含地；在内地
example: 他包括的地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: a. not convincing
translation_zh: a. 不足以令人相信的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常不…的解释。

meaning: r. in an unconvincing manner
translation_zh: 缺乏说服力地；无法令人信服地
example: 他不…地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: v. load anew; v. charge anew
translation_zh: vt. 再充电, 再装填, 再控告, 再袭击；vi. 再袭击；n. 再袭击, 再装填
example: 我们需要逐步recharge这个方案。

meaning: n. the condition of being made easy (or easier); n. (neurophysiology) phenomenon that occurs when two or more neural impulses that alone are not enough to trigger a response in a neuron combine to trigger an action potential; n. act of assisting or making easier the progress or improvement of something
translation_zh: [医] 容易化, 助长, 接通[作用]
example: 这个facilitation（noun）为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: s. qualified by reservations; a. imposing or depending on or containing a condition
translation_zh: a. 有条件的, 有前提的；[电] 有条件的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常视…而定的的解释。

meaning: r. subject to a condition
translation_zh: adv. 有条件地
example: 他视…而定的地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: v. make pliant and flexible
translation_zh: a. 柔软的, 逢迎的, 顺从的；vt. 使柔软, 使顺从
example: The dancer's body was incredibly supple.

meaning: n. professional care for the hands and fingernails; v. trim carefully and neatly; v. care for (one's hand) by cutting and shaping the nails, etc.
translation_zh: n. 修指甲术, 修指甲, 修指甲师；vt. 修指甲, 修剪
example: 这个修指甲vt.修剪…的指甲为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. professional care for the feet and toenails; v. care for one's feet by cutting and shaping the nails, etc.
translation_zh: n. 脚治疗, 脚治疗医师, 修趾甲术；vt. 修脚, 医脚
example: 这个pedicure（noun）为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. cranial nerve that supplies facial muscles; n. care for the face that usually involves cleansing and massage and the application of cosmetic creams; a. of or concerning the face; a. of or pertaining to the outside surface of an object
translation_zh: n. 美颜, 脸部按摩；a. 脸的, 表面的, 脸部用的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常面部的的解释。

meaning: n. an arrangement of flowers that is usually given as a present; n. a pleasingly sweet olfactory property
translation_zh: n. 花束；[医] 丛, 酒香, 末梢分极
example: 这个花束为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: v. make brighter and prettier
translation_zh: vt. 再磨光, 刷新
example: 我们需要逐步refurbish这个方案。

meaning: n the state of being restored to its former good condition
translation_zh: n. 整修; 翻新; 重新磨亮
example: 这个refurbishment（noun）为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a tract of land cleared for some special purposes (recreation or burial etc.); n. dregs consisting of solid particles (especially of coffee) that form a residue
translation_zh: n. 场地, 庭院, 理由, 渣滓, 沉淀物
example: 这个地面为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a state of comatose torpor (as found in sleeping sickness)
translation_zh: n. 昏睡, 瞌睡, 无力气；[医] 昏睡, 嗜眠
example: The heat caused a feeling of lethargy throughout the afternoon.

meaning: a. deficient in alertness or activity
translation_zh: a. 昏睡的, 无生气的, 泠漠的, 冷淡的；[医] 昏睡的, 嗜眠的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常没精打采的的解释。

meaning: r. without energy; in a lethargic manner
translation_zh: adv. 昏睡地；迟钝地
example: 他lethargically（adverb）地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: s. of size and dignity suggestive of a statue
translation_zh: a. 庄严的, 宏伟的
example: The old mansion had a stately appearance.

meaning: n. fruit preserved by cooking with sugar; v. keep constant through physical or chemical reactions or evolutionary change; v. keep in safety and protect from harm, decay, loss, or destruction; v. use cautiously and frugally
translation_zh: n. 蜜饯, 果酱；vt. 保存, 使(能量等)守恒
example: 我们需要逐步conserve这个方案。

meaning: n. the faculty and students of a school specializing in one of the fine arts; n. a schoolhouse with special facilities for fine arts; n. a greenhouse in which plants are arranged in a pleasing manner
translation_zh: a. 保存性的, 有保存力的；n. 温室, 音乐学校
example: 这个（培植植物的）温室为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: s. causing mental discomfort
translation_zh: a. 使不安的, 使焦虑的, 使不平静的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常disquieting（adjective）的解释。

meaning: r. in an emotionally fierce manner
translation_zh: adv. 猛烈地, 厉害地
example: 他凶猛地地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: n. citrus tree bearing large round edible fruit having a thick yellow rind and juicy somewhat acid pulp; n. large yellow fruit with somewhat acid juicy pulp; usual serving consists of a half
translation_zh: n. 葡萄轴
example: 这个葡萄柚为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: exotically
translation_zh: 外来地；奇异地；异乎寻常地；极不稳定地
example: 他exotically（adverb）地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: n. bottle that has a narrow neck; n. the quantity a flask will hold
translation_zh: n. 细颈瓶, 烧瓶, 小水瓶；[化] 瓶; 烧瓶
example: 这个[分化] 烧瓶为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: s very large in expanse or scope; s (of buildings and rooms) having ample space
translation_zh: a. 广大的, 宽广的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常（房间或建筑物）宽敞的的解释。

meaning: n a person devoted to refined sensuous enjoyment (especially good food and drink)
translation_zh: n. 美食家
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常美食家的解释。

meaning: v summon into action or bring into existence, often as if by magic; v ask for or request earnestly; v engage in plotting or enter into a conspiracy, swear together
translation_zh: vt. 念咒文召唤, 变戏法, 想象；vi. 变戏法, 施魔法
example: The magician promised to conjure a rabbit from his hat.

meaning: s. of the color of cream; s. thick like cream
translation_zh: a. 含乳脂的, 乳脂状的, 奶油色的；[建] 含乳油的, 似乳油的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常多乳脂的或似乳脂的的解释。

meaning: n. a Finnish steam bath; steam is produced by pouring water over heated rocks
translation_zh: n. 桑拿浴
example: 这个桑拿浴室为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: s. tending or intended to rectify or improve
translation_zh: a. 治疗的, 补救的, 矫正的；[医] 治疗的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常治疗的的解释。

meaning: n the arrangement of the body and its limbs; n characteristic way of bearing one's body; n a rationalized mental attitude; n capability in terms of personnel and materiel that affect the capacity to fight a war; v behave affectedly or unnaturally in order to impress others; v assume a posture as for artistic purposes
translation_zh: n. 姿势, 态度, 情形, 形势；vt. 作...的姿势；vi. 作姿势
example: 这个（坐或立的）姿势为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: v. cause to be calm or quiet as by administering a sedative to; s. characterized by dignity and propriety
translation_zh: a. 沉着的, 镇静的, 安静的；vt. 给...服镇静剂
example: 我们需要逐步sedate这个方案。

meaning: r. in a sedate manner
translation_zh: adv. 镇静地, 安详地
example: 他安静的地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: n. a tense critical situation; n. a number of birds hatched at the same time; n. a pedal or lever that engages or disengages a rotating shaft and a driving mechanism; n. a coupling that connects or disconnects driving and driven parts of a driving mechanism
translation_zh: n. 抓紧, 掌握, 离合器, 一窝小鸡；vt. 抓住, 踩汽车离合器踏板；vi. 抓；[计] 联轴器; 离合器
example: 我们需要逐步clutch这个方案。

meaning: v walk as if unable to control one's movements; v walk with great difficulty; v to arrange in a systematic order; v astound or overwhelm, as with shock; s so surprisingly impressive as to stun or overwhelm
translation_zh: a. 蹒跚的, 巨大的, 惊人的；[电] 参差
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常难以置信的的解释。

meaning: s. willingly obedient out of a sense of duty and respect;
translation_zh: a. 尽职的, 忠实的, 顺从的, 守本分的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常尽职的的解释。

meaning: r. out of a sense of duty; in a dutiful manner
translation_zh: adv. 忠实地；忠贞地
example: 他忠实地地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: n. a unit of heat equal to the amount of heat required to raise the temperature of one kilogram of water by one degree at one atmosphere pressure; used by nutritionists to characterize the energy-producing potential in food; n. unit of heat defined as the quantity of heat required to raise the temperature of 1 gram of water by 1 degree centigrade at atmospheric pressure
translation_zh: n. 卡路里（热量单位）
example: 这个卡（路里）（热量单位）为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: r. exceedingly; extremely
translation_zh: adv. 非常(富有的/伟大的)
example: 他难以置信的地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: n. land and the buildings on it
translation_zh: n. 房屋, 上述各点, 上述房屋；[经] 房屋, 店铺, 契约前言
example: 这个前提为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. someone who selects according to the eclectic method; s. selecting what seems best of various styles or ideas
translation_zh: n. 折衷主义者；a. 选择的, 折衷的
example: Her musical taste is very eclectic, ranging from classical to rock.

meaning: adv. In an eclectic manner; by an eclectic method.
translation_zh: adv. 折衷地
example: 他eclectically（adverb）地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: n. American silversmith remembered for his midnight ride (celebrated in a poem by Longfellow) to warn the colonists in Lexington and Concord that British troops were coming (1735-1818)
translation_zh: vt. 崇敬, 敬畏, 尊敬
example: Many people revere him as a national hero.

meaning: n. (baseball) a ballplayer who is batting; n. a liquid or semiliquid mixture, as of flour, eggs, and milk, used in cooking
translation_zh: v. 连续猛打（尤其指妇女），猛击；n. 面糊（食物），击球员，打击手
example: 我们需要逐步batter这个方案。

meaning: r in an unfaithful undependable unreliable manner
translation_zh: adv. unreliable的变形
example: 他不…地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: n. the area of a city (such as a harbor or dockyard) alongside a body of water
translation_zh: n. 水边, 滨水区, 滩, 海滨, 江边
example: 这个海滨为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: r. to an ample degree or in an ample manner; r. sufficiently; more than adequately
translation_zh: adv. 充足地, 充裕地
example: 他充足地地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: n. addition of extra material or illustration or clarifying detail; n. the amount of increase in signal power or voltage or current expressed as the ratio of output to input; n. (electronics) the act of increasing voltage or power or current
translation_zh: n. 扩大, 放大；[化] 放大; 放大作用
example: 这个扩大为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: s. damaged by blows or hard usage; s. damaged especially by hard usage; s. exhibiting symptoms resulting from repeated physical and emotional injury
translation_zh: a. 磨损的；弄垮的；破旧的；受到虐待的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常连续猛击的解释。

meaning: v. act in accordance with someone's rules, commands, or wishes
translation_zh: vi. 顺从, 依从；[法] 遵守, 承诺, 照做
example: 我们需要逐步comply这个方案。

meaning: n acting according to certain accepted standards; n a disposition or tendency to yield to the will of others; n the act of submitting; usually surrendering power to another
translation_zh: n. 遵从, 顺从, 屈从；[化] 柔顺; 顺应
example: The company must ensure compliance with regulations.

meaning: a. disposed or willing to comply
translation_zh: a. 顺从的, 屈从的；[电] 适用于, 配合...使用
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常遵从的的解释。

meaning: adv. In a compliant manner.
translation_zh: adv. 顺从地, 应允地
example: 他遵从的地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: n. the state of being blank; void; emptiness
translation_zh: n. 空白, 空虚, 单调
example: 这个blankness（noun）为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: s. produced or growing in extreme abundance
translation_zh: a. 繁茂的, 丰富的, 生气勃勃的；[医] 生成过多的, 高度增生的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常生气勃勃的的解释。

meaning: n. joyful enthusiasm; n. overflowing with eager enjoyment or approval
translation_zh: n. 茂盛, 茂盛的生长物, 丰富
example: 这个繁茂为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: r. in an exuberant manner
translation_zh: adv. 兴高采烈地, 活跃地, 愉快地
example: 他生气勃勃的地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: a. designating or involving an equation whose terms are of the first degree; a. of or in or along or relating to a line; involving a single dimension; s. (of a leaf shape) long and narrow; s. measured lengthwise
translation_zh: a. 线的, 直线的, 线状的；[计] 线性
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常直线的的解释。

meaning: r. in a linear manner
translation_zh: adv. 线, 长条形, 线状, 线性, 直线, 长度
example: 他直线的地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: n. a showy gesture; n. an ornamental embellishment in writing; n. a display of ornamental speech or language; n. the act of waving
translation_zh: vi. 繁荣, 茂盛, 活跃, 手舞足蹈；vt. 挥舞, 夸耀；n. 挥舞, 炫耀, 茂盛, 兴旺, 华丽词藻
example: 这个繁荣为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: v fix firmly and stably; v secure a vessel with an anchor
translation_zh: a. 固定的；抛锚的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常锚给人安全感的物(或人)的解释。

meaning: n. social control by dominating; n. power to dominate or defeat
translation_zh: n. 支配, 控制, 管辖
example: The team's domination of the league was clear.

meaning: n. (music) the fifth note of the diatonic scale; a. exercising influence or control; a. (of genes) producing the same phenotype whether its allele is identical or dissimilar
translation_zh: a. 占优势的, 支配的；[医] 优性的, 显性的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常占优势的的解释。

meaning: dominantly
translation_zh: 有统治权地, 占优势地
example: 他占优势的地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: v. to insert between other elements
translation_zh: vt. 插嘴, 突然插入
example: 我们需要逐步interject这个方案。

meaning: n. the action of interjecting or interposing an action or remark that interrupts
translation_zh: n. 感叹词, 插入语
example: 这个[语] 感叹词为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n a sudden rapid flow (as of water); n an unrestrained expression of emotion; v gush forth in a sudden stream or jet; v praise enthusiastically; v issue in a jet; come out in a jet; stream or spring forth
translation_zh: n. 涌出, 滔滔不绝地讲话；v. 涌出, 迸出, 滔滔不绝的讲话
example: 我们需要逐步gush这个方案。

meaning: s. flowing profusely
translation_zh: a. 迸出的, 涌出的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常涌出的解释。

meaning: adv. In a gushing manner; copiously.; adv. Weakly; sentimentally; effusively.
translation_zh: adv. gushing的变形
example: 他gushingly（adverb）地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: s excessively greedy and grasping; s devouring or craving food in great quantities
translation_zh: a. 贪吃的, 狼吞虎咽的, 贪婪的
