meaning: a. incapable of being retracted or revoked
translation_zh: a. 不能挽回的, 不能取消的, 不能变更的；[经] 不能撤销的, 不能恢复的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常不可改变的的解释。

meaning: v. to pass or move unobtrusively or smoothly
translation_zh: vi. 不稳地滑动；vt. 使滑动
example: 我们需要逐步slither这个方案。

meaning: v disturb the composure of
translation_zh: vt. 使失去勇气, 使胆怯, 使不能自制；[医] 除神经
example: 我们需要逐步unnerve这个方案。

meaning: v disturb the composure of; s inspiring fear
translation_zh: [医] 除神经法
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常使失去勇气的解释。

meaning: unnervingly
translation_zh: adv. 令人胆怯地；使人紧张不安地
example: 他unnervingly（adverb）地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: v extend out or project in space; v bulge outward; v swell or protrude outwards
translation_zh: vi. 伸出, 突出；vt. 使伸出, 使突出
example: 我们需要逐步protrude这个方案。

meaning: n. the act of projecting out from something
translation_zh: n. 突出, 突出部, 露出；[医] 前突, 突出
example: 这个protrusion（noun）为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: a. involving distinctions based on qualities; a. relating to or involving comparisons based on qualities
translation_zh: a. 性质的, 质的, 定性的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常定性的的解释。

meaning: a. of or relating to procedure
translation_zh: a. 程序上的；[经] 程序上的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常程序的的解释。

meaning: v. make less mysterious or remove the mystery from
translation_zh: vt. 使非神秘化
example: 我们需要逐步demystify这个方案。

meaning: demystification
translation_zh: n. 非神秘化启蒙,启发
example: 这个demystification（noun）为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: a. protected by trademark or patent or copyright; made or produced or distributed by one having exclusive rights
translation_zh: a. 所有者的, 所有权的, 私有的；n. 所有者, 业主, 所有权
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常专有的的解释。

meaning: a. Of or pertaining to ownership; proprietary; as,; proprietorial rights.
translation_zh: a. 所有的, 所有权的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常proprietorial（adjective）的解释。

meaning: n. something that restrains a flood or outpouring; n. regulator consisting of a valve or gate that controls the rate of water flow through a sluice
translation_zh: n. （江河或湖泊的）防洪闸（门）, （泄）水闸门( floodgate的复数形式 )
example: 这个水闸为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: a. impossible or difficult to perceive by the mind or senses
translation_zh: a. 不能感知的, 微细的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常感觉不到的的解释。

meaning: r. in an imperceptible manner or to an imperceptible degree
translation_zh: adv. 不感觉地, 微细地, 极微地
example: 他imperceptibly（adverb）地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: s. deserving or inciting pity
translation_zh: a. 倒霉的, 不幸的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常倒霉的的解释。

meaning: r. with unfortunate consequences
translation_zh: 灾难性地
example: 他catastrophically（adverb）地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: s resistant to guidance or discipline
translation_zh: a. 任性的, 难以捉摸的, 不稳定的, 刚愎的；[法] 顽强的, 任性的, 不规则的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常任性的的解释。

meaning: n a promotional statement (as found on the dust jackets of books)
translation_zh: n. 推荐广告；vt. 推荐吹捧
example: 这个大肆宣传为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. (Roman Catholic Church) an official in charge of an ecclesiastical province acting under the superior general of a religious order; a. of or associated with a province; a. characteristic of the provinces or their people
translation_zh: n. 外地人, 粗野的人；a. 省的, 外地的, 偏狭的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常省的的解释。

meaning: s. (of tumors, e.g.) slow to heal or develop and usually painless
translation_zh: a. 懒惰的, 无痛的；[医] 无痛的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常懒惰的的解释。

meaning: r. in an indolent manner
translation_zh: adv. 怠惰地, 不痛地
example: 他懒惰的地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: n. inactivity resulting from a dislike of work
translation_zh: n. 怠惰, 无痛；[医] 无痛
example: 这个indolence（noun）为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n a person whose behavior deviates from what is acceptable especially in sexual behavior; s markedly different from an accepted norm
translation_zh: a. 不正常的；n. 不正常的人(或物)
example: 这个不正常的人为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: deviantly
translation_zh: n.不正常的人，异常的人adj.不正常的，异常的,离经叛道的（…地，副词）
example: 他不正常的人地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: v. call forth
translation_zh: vt. 产生, 引起；vi. 发生, 形成
example: 我们需要逐步engender这个方案。

meaning: n. compensation received by virtue of holding an office or having employment (usually in the form of wages or fees)
translation_zh: n. 薪水, 报酬
example: The CEO's emoluments included a large bonus and stock options.

meaning: n. liberality in bestowing gifts; extremely liberal and generous of spirit
translation_zh: n. 丰厚, 慷慨给与
example: 这个munificence（noun）为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. all future generations
translation_zh: n. 子孙, 后裔；[法] 子嗣, 后代, 后裔
example: 这个后代为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: s extremely poisonous or injurious; producing venom; s marked by deep ill will; deliberately harmful
translation_zh: a. 有毒的, 恶毒的, 分泌毒液的, 有毒腺的；[医] 毒的, 有毒的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常有毒的的解释。

meaning: r in a very malevolent manner
translation_zh: adv. 狠毒地, 充满恶意地
example: 他有毒的地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: n. the representation of dancing by symbols as music is represented by notes; n. a notation used by choreographers
translation_zh: n. 舞蹈艺术, 舞台舞蹈
example: 这个编舞艺术为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: choreographical
translation_zh: [网络] 编舞
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常choreographical（adjective）的解释。

meaning: n something that serves as a model or a basis for making copies
translation_zh: n. 原型
example: 这个典型为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: s. representing or constituting an original type after which other similar things are patterned
translation_zh: a. 原型的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常原型的的解释。

meaning: n disagreement among those expected to cooperate; n a conflict of people's opinions or actions or characters
translation_zh: n. 意见不合, 纠纷, 争吵；[法] 异议, 纷争
example: 这个纠纷为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: s. of high moral or intellectual value; elevated in nature or style
translation_zh: a. 高尚的, 尊贵的, 高位的, 兴奋的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常高贵的的解释。

meaning: exaltedly
translation_zh: adv. 得意忘形地
example: 他高贵的地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: s. having or showing knowledge and skill and aptitude
translation_zh: a. 熟练的, 老练的, 巧妙的；n. 能手, 内行
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常熟练的的解释。

meaning: r used in negative statement to describe a situation that has existed up to this point or up to the present time
translation_zh: adv. 迄今, 至今
example: 他迄今为止地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: n. an acute but unspecific feeling of anxiety; usually reserved for philosophical anxiety about the world or about personal freedom
translation_zh: n. 焦虑, 疑惧；[医] 恐怖
example: 这个焦虑为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: angsty
translation_zh: adj. 忧虑的；焦虑的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常angsty（adjective）的解释。

meaning: n having a drab or dowdy quality; lacking stylishness or elegance
translation_zh: n. 乏味, 单调
example: 这个drabness（noun）为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: a. containing or constituting or characterized by pleasing melody
translation_zh: a. 旋律美妙的, 旋律优美的, 有乐曲的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常melodious（adjective）的解释。

meaning: r in a melodious manner
translation_zh: adv. 悦耳地, 旋律优美地
example: 他melodiously（adverb）地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: n. long-tailed black-and-white crow that utters a raucous chattering call; n. someone who collects things that have been discarded by others
translation_zh: n. 鹊, 珍种家鸽, 饶舌的人；a. 鹊的, 有收集癖的
example: 这个鹊为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a feeling of thoughtful sadness; n. a constitutional tendency to be gloomy and depressed; s. characterized by or causing or expressing sadness
translation_zh: n. 忧郁, 悲哀, 愁思；a. 忧郁的, 使人悲伤的, 愁思的
example: 这个忧郁为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. predicting what the weather will be; n. the earth science dealing with phenomena of the atmosphere (especially weather)
translation_zh: n. 气象学, 气象状态；[医] 气象学
example: 这个气象状态为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: a of or pertaining to atmospheric phenomena, especially weather and weather conditions
translation_zh: a. 气象的, 气象学的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常气象的的解释。

meaning: n. a region marking a boundary; n. the edge of a steep place
translation_zh: n. 边缘, 陡岸
example: 这个（峭壁的）边缘 n. (Brink)人名为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: s not capable of being improved on
translation_zh: a. 未被超越的, 非常卓越的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常非常卓越的的解释。

meaning: v. be about
translation_zh: v. 闲荡, 虚度, 徘徊
example: 我们需要逐步loiter这个方案。

meaning: v. cause to topple or tumble by pushing
translation_zh: vt. 推翻, 颠覆；vi. 倒塌, 摇摇欲坠
example: 我们需要逐步topple这个方案。

meaning: a. belonging to a thing by its very nature; s. situated within or belonging solely to the organ or body part on which it acts
translation_zh: a. 本质的, 原有的, 真正的；[医] 内部的, 内在的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常固有的的解释。

meaning: r. with respect to its inherent nature
translation_zh: [计] 本质的
example: 他本质地地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: n. any admirable quality or attribute
translation_zh: n. 优点, 功绩, 价值, 功过, 真相；vt. 值得；vi. 应受
example: 这个优秀品质为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: promotable
translation_zh: a. promote（促进；增进）的变形
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常promotable（adjective）的解释。

meaning: n. (boxing) the act of one boxer holding onto the other to avoid being hit and to rest momentarily; n. a small slip noose made with seizing; n. the flattened part of a nail or bolt or rivet; v. secure or fasten by flattening the ends of nails or bolts
translation_zh: n. 钉牢；v. 敲弯, 用臂钳住
example: 我们需要逐步clinch这个方案。

meaning: n. the state of being anonymous
translation_zh: n. 匿名, 姓氏不明；[计] 匿名信件
example: 这个匿名为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a small thin sharp bit or wood or glass or metal; v. break up into splinters or slivers
translation_zh: n. 碎片, 尖片, 分裂出来的小派别, 微小的东西；v. 使分裂, (使)破裂
example: 我们需要逐步splinter这个方案。

meaning: n. a mild rebuke or criticism; n. disgrace or shame; v. express criticism towards
translation_zh: n. 责备, 耻辱；vt. 责备, 申斥, 使丢脸
example: 我们需要逐步reproach这个方案。

meaning: v cause to become widely known
translation_zh: vt. 散播, 传播, 宣传；vi. 广为传播
example: 我们需要逐步disseminate这个方案。

meaning: n. the opening of a subject to widespread discussion and debate; n. the property of being diffused or dispersed
translation_zh: n. 散播, 传播, 普及；[医] 散布, 播散
example: 这个散播为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: v. hide under a false appearance; v. behave unnaturally or affectedly
translation_zh: v. 掩饰, 假装不知道
example: 我们需要逐步dissemble这个方案。

meaning: n. clothes dryer for drying and ironing laundry by passing it between two heavy heated rollers; v. press with a mangle; v. alter so as to make unrecognizable
translation_zh: vt. 乱砍, 损坏, 轧布；n. 轧布机
example: 我们需要逐步mangle这个方案。

meaning: s. unhappy in love; suffering from unrequited love
translation_zh: a. 缺少的, 丧失的, 失去亲人的；bereave的过去式和过去分词
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常被剥夺的的解释。

meaning: bereftly
translation_zh: adj.被剥夺的,丧失的,失去亲人的vt.失去…的(bereave的过去式)（…地，副词）
example: 他被剥夺的地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: n. (philosophy) the philosophical theory that the self is all that you know to exist
translation_zh: n. 唯我论；[医] 唯我论
example: 这个solipsism（noun）为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: v talk to oneself
translation_zh: v. 自言自语, 独白
example: 我们需要逐步soliloquize这个方案。

meaning: s. disposed to or in a state of mutiny; s. consisting of or characterized by or inciting to mutiny
translation_zh: a. 暴动的, 反抗的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常mutinous（adjective）的解释。

meaning: mutinously
translation_zh: adv. 反抗地, 叛变地
example: 他mutinously（adverb）地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: s exaggeratedly proper; s excessively fastidious and easily disgusted
translation_zh: a. 谨小慎微的, 大惊小怪的, 为小事挂虑的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常prissy（adjective）的解释。

meaning: a. of or relating to the class Reptilia
translation_zh: a. 爬虫类的, 像爬虫的, 卑鄙的；n. 爬行动物
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常reptilian（adjective）的解释。

meaning: v. lessen the authority, dignity, or reputation of
translation_zh: v. (使)减少, (使)变小
example: 我们需要逐步diminish这个方案。

meaning: undiminishing
translation_zh: [网络] 不减少
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常不…的解释。

meaning: n. the communication of an attitude or emotional state among a number of people
translation_zh: n. 触染, 触染病, 蔓延, 歪风；[医] 接触传染; 接触染物
example: 这个传染为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. the home and adjacent grounds occupied by a family; n. land acquired from the United States public lands by filing a record and living on and cultivating it under the homestead law; n. dwelling that is usually a farmhouse and adjoining land; v. settle land given by the government and occupy it as a homestead
translation_zh: n. 家园, 田产；[法] 宅基地, 住宅
example: 这个家宅为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. the official who holds an office; s. lying or leaning on something else; s. necessary (for someone) as a duty or responsibility; morally binding; s. currently holding an office
translation_zh: a. 现任的, 依靠的, 负有义务的；n. 领圣俸者, 在职者
example: 这个在职的为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: s lying down; in a position of comfort or rest
translation_zh: a. 斜靠着的, 躺着的, 不活泼的, 休息着的；[医] 斜卧的, 躺着的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常躺着的的解释。

meaning: s marked by blithe unconcern
translation_zh: a. 不关心的, 冷淡的, 无动于衷的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常冷淡的的解释。

meaning: r in a composed and unconcerned manner; r in an unconcerned manner
translation_zh: adv. 漠不关心地, 无动于衷地
example: 他冷淡的地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: s attracting and holding interest as if by a spell
translation_zh: a. 催眠术的；[医] 催眠术的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常令人着迷的的解释。

meaning: v. prove to be of unsound mind or demonstrate someone's incompetence; v. cause to appear foolish
translation_zh: vt. 使显得愚笨, 使变无效
example: 我们需要逐步stultify这个方案。

meaning: stultifyingly
translation_zh: adv. stultify的变形
example: 他stultifyingly（adverb）地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: n. a puddle where animals go to wallow; n. an indolent or clumsy rolling about; v. devote oneself entirely to something; indulge in to an immoderate degree, usually with pleasure; v. roll around, "pigs were wallowing in the mud"
translation_zh: vi. 打滚, 沉迷, 颠簸；n. 打滚, 泥坑, 堕落
example: 我们需要逐步wallow这个方案。

meaning: s. having great mass and weight and unwieldiness; s. labored and dull
translation_zh: a. 沉重的, 笨重的, 毫无趣味的, 生硬的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常笨重的的解释。

meaning: r. in an uninterestingly ponderous manner; r. in a heavy ponderous manner
translation_zh: adv. 笨重地；生硬地
example: 他笨重的地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: n a state of comatose torpor (as found in sleeping sickness); n a feeling of lack of interest or energy; n weakness characterized by a lack of vitality or energy
translation_zh: n. 疲倦, 疲乏, 无精神；[医] 倦怠
example: 这个乏力为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a surrounding or nearby region
translation_zh: n. 附近, 邻近, 附近地区, 近处；[法] 附近, 邻近, 附近地区
example: 这个附近为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a gradual decline (in size or strength or power or number); n. the outward flow of the tide; v. flow back or recede
translation_zh: n. 退潮, 衰退；vi. 潮退, 衰退
example: 我们需要逐步ebb这个方案。

meaning: v. become smaller; v. decrease in phase
translation_zh: n. 减少, 衰微, 败落, 亏缺, 月亏；vi. 变小, 亏缺, 衰落, 消逝, 退潮
example: 我们需要逐步wane这个方案。

meaning: n. any of the early patriarchs who lived prior to the Noachian deluge; a. of or relating to the period before the biblical flood; s. so extremely old as seeming to belong to an earlier period
translation_zh: a. 大洪水前的, 陈旧的, 过时的；n. 大洪水以前的人, 老迈的人
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常非常古老的的解释。

meaning: s. represented or appearing as such; pretended
translation_zh: a. 表面的, 假装的, 看得出的；[经] 表面的, 诡称的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常表面上的的解释。

meaning: r from appearances alone
translation_zh: adv. 可公开, 显然, 表面, 外表, 诡称, 假装
example: 他表面上地地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: n contact by fitting together; n the act of interlocking or meshing; v coordinate in such a way that all parts work together effectively; v hold in a locking position; v become engaged or intermeshed with one another; s linked or locked closely together as by dovetailing
translation_zh: a. 连锁的；[化] 咬合; 咬合作用
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常联锁的v.<计>互锁设备( interlock的现在分词 )的解释。

meaning: a. not given to open expression of emotion
translation_zh: a. 不露声色的, 矜持寡言的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常不…的解释。

meaning: undemonstratively
translation_zh: adv. undemonstrative的变形
example: 他undemonstratively（adverb）地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: n. something that is a source of danger; n. a threat or the act of threatening; v. express a threat either by an utterance or a gesture; v. act in a threatening manner
translation_zh: n. 威胁, 胁迫；v. 威吓, 胁迫
example: 这个威胁为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: v pose a threat to; present a danger to; v express a threat either by an utterance or a gesture; v act in a threatening manner; s threatening or foreshadowing evil or tragic developments
translation_zh: a. 恐吓的, 威胁的；[法] 威胁的, 恐吓的, 险恶的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常威胁的的解释。

meaning: r. in a menacing manner
translation_zh: adv. 威胁地, 恐吓地
example: 他威胁的地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: n. an event resulting in great loss and misfortune

example: 她在演讲中给出了非常白话的的解释。

meaning: n. an academic meeting or seminar usually led by a different lecturer and on a different topic at each meeting; n. an address to an academic meeting or seminar
translation_zh: n. 讨论会
example: 这个colloquium（noun）为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: r. with the use of colloquial expressions
translation_zh: adv. 用口语, 用通俗语
example: 他白话的地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: n. passing reference or indirect mention
translation_zh: n. 提及, 暗指
example: 这个暗指为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: v. make a more or less disguised reference to
translation_zh: vi. 暗指, 提及
example: 我们需要逐步allude这个方案。

meaning: v. express a negative opinion of
translation_zh: vt. 蔑视, 贬损；[法] 轻视, 贬低, 诽谤
example: 我们需要逐步disparage这个方案。

meaning: v express a negative opinion of; s expressive of low opinion
translation_zh: a. 蔑视的, 轻视的, 毁谤的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常&lt的解释。

meaning: r. in a disparaging manner
translation_zh: adv. 以贬抑的口吻, 以轻视的态度
example: 他disparagingly（adverb）地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: n. a communication that belittles somebody or something; n. the act of speaking contemptuously of
translation_zh: n. 轻视, 说...坏话, 毁谤, 贬低, 轻蔑；[法] 诽谤, 不相称
example: 这个disparagement（noun）为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. (informal) a quick private conference; n. a disorganized and densely packed crowd; v. crowd or draw together; v. crouch or curl up
translation_zh: n. 杂乱一团, 混乱, 拥挤；vt. 把...挤在一起, 乱堆, 草率了事, 蜷曲；vi. 挤作一团, 蜷缩
example: 我们需要逐步huddle这个方案。

meaning: n. the configuration of a surface and the relations among its man-made and natural features; n. precise detailed study of the surface features of a region
translation_zh: n. 地志, 地形学, 地势, 局部解剖学；[医] 局部解剖, 局部记载
example: 这个地形学为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: a. concerned with topography
translation_zh: a. 地形的, 地形学的, 地形测量的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常topographical（adjective）的解释。

meaning: r. with regard to topography
translation_zh: adv. 从地形上；在地形构造方面
example: 他topographically（adverb）地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: v. unconsciously replace fact with fantasy in one's memory
translation_zh: vi. 交谈, 闲谈, 谈话
example: 我们需要逐步confabulate这个方案。

meaning: n. (psychiatry) a plausible but imagined memory that fills in gaps in what is remembered
translation_zh: n. 交谈, 闲谈；[医] 虚谈症, 虚构症
example: 这个confabulation（noun）为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. an artist who is a member of the movement called surrealism
translation_zh: n. 超现实主义者
example: 这个超现实主义者为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a 20th century movement of artists and writers (developing out of dadaism) who used fantastic images and incongruous juxtapositions in order to represent unconscious thoughts and dreams
translation_zh: n. 超现实主义；[法] 超现实主义
example: 这个surrealism（noun）为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: v make or work out a plan for; devise; v come up with (an idea, plan, explanation, theory, or principle) after a mental effort; v put or send forth
translation_zh: v. 发明, 设计, 图谋
example: 我们需要逐步contrive这个方案。

meaning: n. feeling a need to see others suffer
translation_zh: n. 恶意, 蓄意害人, 怨恨；[法] 预谋, 蓄意, 恶意
example: 这个恶意为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: a. having the nature of or resulting from malice
translation_zh: a. 怀恶意的, 恶毒的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常恶意的的解释。

meaning: r. with malice; in a malicious manner
translation_zh: adv. 有敌意地, 恶意地
example: 他恶意的地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: n the act of making a film
translation_zh: n. 电影制片术；[医] [外科手术]电影照相术
example: 这个cinematography（noun）为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n a photographer who operates a movie camera
translation_zh: n. 电影摄影技师, 放映技师
example: 这个cinematographer（noun）为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. someone who exhibits great independence in thought and action; n. an unbranded range animal (especially a stray calf); belongs to the first person who puts a brand on it
translation_zh: n. 未烙饲主印记的小牛, 持不同意见的人；vi. 迷路
example: 这个没打烙印的动物为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: r. with diligence; in a diligent manner
translation_zh: adv. 勤奋地；勤勉地
example: 他勤勉地地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: n. a small tower extending above a building
translation_zh: n. 塔楼, 角楼, 攻城用仰冲车；[机] 转塔, 多角刀架
example: 这个炮塔为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: a. of or relating to or based on an impression rather than on facts or reasoning
translation_zh: a. 印象主义的, 印象派的, 仅凭印象的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常impressionistic（adjective）的解释。

meaning: impressionistically
translation_zh: 仅凭印象地, 主观地
example: 他impressionistically（adverb）地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: n. the trait of condescending to those of lower social status
translation_zh: n. 谄上欺下, 势利
example: 这个势利为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: a. relating to or supported by or located in a parish
translation_zh: a. 教区的, 地方性的, 目光偏狭的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常教区的的解释。

meaning: v. move toward; v. be attracted to; v. move due to the pull of gravitation
translation_zh: vi. 被重力吸引, 沉下, 下降；vt. 使受重力吸引
example: 我们需要逐步gravitate这个方案。

meaning: a. of or relating to or caused by gravitation
translation_zh: a. 重力的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常万有引力的的解释。

meaning: r. with respect to gravitation
translation_zh: adv. gravitational（万有引力的）的变形
example: 他万有引力的地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: n fear resulting from the awareness of danger
translation_zh: n. 惊愕, 恐怖, 惊惶失措
example: 这个惊愕为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: s having or showing arrogant superiority to and disdain of those one views as unworthy
translation_zh: a. 傲慢的, 骄傲的, 崇高的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常傲慢的的解释。

meaning: r. in a haughty manner
translation_zh: adv. 傲慢地, 骄傲地
example: 他傲慢的地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: n. (logic) a proposition that is not susceptible of proof or disproof; its truth is assumed to be self-evident
translation_zh: n. 自明之理, 公理, 原理, 格言；[法] 公理, 原理, 原则
example: It is an axiom that a straight line is the shortest distance between two points.

meaning: s. evident without proof or argument; a. containing aphorisms or maxims; a. of or relating to or derived from axioms
translation_zh: a. 自明的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常不言自明的的解释。

meaning: n. sorrow for sin arising from fear of damnation; n. a wearing down to weaken or destroy; n. the act of rubbing together; wearing something down by friction
translation_zh: n. 摩擦, 磨损；[医] 擦除术; 磨耗
example: 这个消耗为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: r. in an enduring manner
translation_zh: adv. 耐久地, 永久地
example: 他持久的地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: n. a publication (such as a book) that is reprinted without changes or editing and offered again for sale; v. issue (a new version of)
translation_zh: vt. 再发给, 重新发行；vi. 再发给；n. 重新发行, 再版物
example: 我们需要逐步reissue这个方案。

meaning: v. treat with sulphur in order to preserve
translation_zh: n. 硫, 硫磺；[化] 硫
example: 这个硫磺为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: a. of or relating to or containing sulfur
translation_zh: a. 硫的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常sulphuric（adjective）的解释。

meaning: n. one of the Muslim people of north Africa; of mixed Arab and Berber descent; converted to Islam in the 8th century; conqueror of Spain in the 8th century; n. open land usually with peaty soil covered with heather and bracken and moss; v. secure in or as if in a berth or dock; v. come into or dock at a wharf
translation_zh: n.荒野；旷野；Moor: 摩尔人.；v.系住；停泊
example: 这个荒野为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n confinement of a prisoner in isolation from other prisoners; n one who lives in solitude; s characterized by or preferring solitude; s of plants and animals; not growing or living in groups or colonies; s lacking companions or companionship; s being the only one; single and isolated from others; s devoid of creatures
translation_zh: n. 独居者；a. 孤独的, 独居的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常独自的的解释。

meaning: n. Condition of being solitary.
translation_zh: n. 隐居；单独
example: 这个solitariness（noun）为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a state of social isolation; n. the state or situation of being alone; n. a solitary place
translation_zh: n. 孤独, 单独, 孤寂
example: 这个单独为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: v. be compatible or in accordance with; v. follow through or carry out a plan without deviation; v. be a devoted follower or supporter; v. stick to firmly
translation_zh: vi. 依附, 粘着, 坚持, 追随, 拥护；vt. 使粘附
example: 我们需要逐步adhere这个方案。

meaning: n. abnormal union of bodily tissues; most common in the abdomen; n. a fibrous band of scar tissue that binds together normally separate anatomical structures
translation_zh: n. 附着, 粘着, 支持, 追随；[化] 粘合; 粘附; 附着; 粘合力; 粘附力; 附着力
example: 这个adhesion（noun）为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: v command against
translation_zh: vt. 剥夺...的公民权, 使失去法律保护, 把...充军, 把...放逐, 排斥, 禁止
example: 我们需要逐步proscribe这个方案。

meaning: n a decree that prohibits something; n rejection by means of an act of banishing or proscribing someone
translation_zh: n. 剥夺人权, 放逐；[法] 剥夺, 剥夺公权, 禁止
example: 这个proscription（noun）为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n a close friend who accompanies his buddies in their activities
translation_zh: n. 密友, 亲密伙伴, 好朋友
example: 这个密友为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. the propulsion of a ball by repeated taps or kicks; v. let or cause to fall in drops; v. propel, "Carry the ball"
translation_zh: vi. 流口水, 滴下；vt. 使滴下, 运球；n. 点滴, 口水, 少量
example: 我们需要逐步dribble这个方案。

meaning: n. a person who shows no gratitude
translation_zh: n. 忘恩者；a. 不知恩的, 忘恩的
example: 这个ingrate（noun）为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: v to move or force, especially in an effort to get something open; v make an uninvited or presumptuous inquiry; v regard highly; think much of
translation_zh: vt. 撬, 撬开, 撬动
example: 我们需要逐步prise这个方案。

meaning: s. inclined to shake as from weakness or defect; s. affected with, suffering from, or characteristic of rickets
translation_zh: a. 患佝偻病的, 虚弱的, 摇摆的；[医] 佝偻病的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常连接处不牢固的的解释。

meaning: v. commit forever; commit irrevocably; v. give over to another for care or safekeeping; v. send to an address
translation_zh: vt. 交付, 储蓄, 委托, 寄存；[经] 托卖, 寄存, 寄销
example: 我们需要逐步consign这个方案。

meaning: n. the delivery of goods for sale or disposal
translation_zh: n. 委托；[经] 委托, 寄销, 寄销品
example: 这个委托为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. an elaborate party (often outdoors)
translation_zh: n. 庆祝, 祭祀, 节日；vt. 宴请, 招待
example: 这个祭祀为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: s rich and superior in quality
translation_zh: a. 富裕的, 豪华的, 奢侈的, 丰富的, 大量的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常富裕的的解释。

meaning: n wealth as evidenced by sumptuous living
translation_zh: n. 富裕, 丰富, 大量
example: 这个富裕为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: r in a sumptuous and opulent manner
translation_zh: adv. 富裕地; 豪华地; 丰裕地
example: 他富裕的地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: n. someone who exercises power by virtue of wealth
translation_zh: n. 富豪, 财阀
example: 这个plutocrat（noun）为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: s (usually followed by `to') strongly opposed
translation_zh: a. 不愿意的, 反对的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常反对的的解释。

meaning: v make understand
translation_zh: vt. 启迪, 熏陶, 教诲
example: 我们需要逐步edify这个方案。

meaning: n. uplifting enlightenment
translation_zh: n. 启迪, 熏陶
example: 这个edification（noun）为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. the state of being unable to produce offspring; in a woman it is an inability to conceive; in a man it is an inability to impregnate
translation_zh: n. 不毛, 不孕, 内容贫乏；[医] 不育, 不孕; 无菌
example: 这个[泌尿] 不育为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. using language effectively to please or persuade; n. study of the technique and rules for using language effectively (especially in public speaking)
translation_zh: n. 修辞, 修辞学, 雄辩(术)
example: 这个修辞为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: a. of or relating to rhetoric; a. given to rhetoric, emphasizing style at the expense of thought
translation_zh: a. 修辞学的, 符合修辞学的, 修辞的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常修辞的的解释。

meaning: r. in a rhetorical manner
translation_zh: adv. 在修辞学上, 讲究修辞地
example: 他在修辞学上地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: s. guided by whim and fancy
translation_zh: a. 轻浮的, 轻狂的, 心情浮动的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常轻浮的的解释。

meaning: n. the trait of acting unpredictably and more from whim or caprice than from reason or judgment
translation_zh: n. 轻浮, 疯狂
example: 这个flightiness（noun）为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. an old name for sulfur
translation_zh: n. 硫磺；[化] 硫黄
example: 这个brimstone（noun）为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: s. not capable of sin
translation_zh: a. 无懈可击的, 勿容置疑的, 无瑕疵的, 不会做坏事的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常无缺点的的解释。

meaning: r. flawlessly
translation_zh: 完美地; 毋庸置疑地; 无瑕疵地
example: 他完美地地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: v. run easily and fairly fast; v. win easily
translation_zh: n. 喧闹游玩, 顽皮女孩；vi. 喧闹玩耍, 轻快奔跑
example: 我们需要逐步romp这个方案。

meaning: n. a person who romps or frolics; n. a one-piece garment for children to wear at play; the lower part is shaped like bloomers
translation_zh: n. 喧闹的嬉戏者, 连衫裤
example: 这个romper（noun）为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: s. marked by precise accordance with details; s. marked by extreme care in treatment of details
translation_zh: a. 一丝不苟的, 精确的, 过细的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常谨小慎微的的解释。

meaning: r. in a meticulous manner
translation_zh: adv. 过细地, 细致地
example: 他过细地地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: v. gain favor with somebody by deliberate efforts
translation_zh: vt. 使迎合, 使讨好
example: 我们需要逐步ingratiate这个方案。

meaning: s. capable of winning favor; s. calculated to please or gain favor
translation_zh: a. 逢迎的, 迎合的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常讨人喜欢的的解释。

meaning: r. in a flattering and ingratiating manner
translation_zh: adv. 讨好地；奉承地
example: 他讨人喜欢的地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: n. a weak and tremulous light; v. shine with a weak or fitful light; v. give off a shimmering reflection, as of silk
translation_zh: n. 微光, 闪光；vi. 闪烁；vt. 使闪烁
example: 我们需要逐步shimmer这个方案。

meaning: n. dry outer covering of a fruit or seed or nut; n. persistent enlarged calyx at base of e.g. a strawberry or raspberry; n. United States naval officer who commanded the `Constitution' during the War of 1812 and won a series of brilliant victories against the British (1773-1843); n. United States diplomat who did the groundwork for creating the United Nations (1871-1955)
translation_zh: n. 壳, 皮, 船体；vt. 去壳
example: 这个果皮为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. the person or thing that is rejected or set aside as inferior in quality; v. remove something that has been rejected
translation_zh: vt. 采, 摘, 拣；n. 拣出的等外品, 被剔出的动物
example: 我们需要逐步cull这个方案。

meaning: n. a coupling (as in a chain) that has one end that turns on a headed pin
translation_zh: n. 转环, 旋转轴承, 转椅座架；v. (使)旋转
example: 我们需要逐步swivel这个方案。

meaning: n. case for holding arrows; v. shake with fast, tremulous movements
translation_zh: n. 震动, 颤抖, 箭袋；vi. 颤抖, 振动；vt. 使颤动；a. 敏捷的
example: 我们需要逐步quiver这个方案。

meaning: imp. & p. p. of Sandwich
translation_zh: v. 插入( sandwich的过去式和过去分词 ); 把…夹在…之间; 挤在…中间; 把…夹在面包片中
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常三明治的解释。

meaning: v mark with spots or blotches of different color or shades of color as if stained; v colour with streaks or blotches of different shades; s having spots or patches of color
translation_zh: a. 杂色的, 斑驳的；[医] 斑色的, 斑状的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常杂色的的解释。

meaning: n. a thermosetting resin; used chiefly in strong adhesives and coatings and laminates; v. glue with epoxy
translation_zh: a. 环氧的；[化] 环氧; 表氧; 桥氧
example: 这个epoxy（noun）为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: a. measured by an angle or by the rate of change of an angle; a. having angles or an angular shape
translation_zh: a. 有角的, 消瘦的, 有尖角的, 生硬的；[医] 角的, 角形的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常有角的的解释。

meaning: n. the property possessed by a shape that has angles
translation_zh: n. 有角, 角状, 生硬；[机] 倾斜度
example: 这个angularity（noun）为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: v. reduce the amplitude (of oscillations or waves); v. make vague or obscure or make (an image) less visible; v. check; keep in check (a fire); v. lessen in force or effect
translation_zh: vt. 弄湿, 使沮丧；vi. 变湿, 丧气
example: 我们需要逐步dampen这个方案。

meaning: v. live like a buccaneer
translation_zh: n. 海盗；vi. 做海盗
example: 我们需要逐步buccaneer这个方案。

meaning: n. a group of diverse companies under common ownership and run as a single organization; s. composed of heterogeneous elements gathered into a mass
translation_zh: a. 聚成球形的, 砾岩性的；n. 集成物, 混合体, 砾岩；v. (使)凝聚成团
example: 这个联合大企业为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n a coral reef off the southern coast of Florida
translation_zh: n. 沙礁, 珊瑚礁, 沙洲
example: 这个cay（noun）为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: v. burn superficially or lightly
translation_zh: v. 烧焦, 烤焦
example: 我们需要逐步singe这个方案。

meaning: n. a series of sentinels or of military posts enclosing or guarding some place or thing; n. cord or ribbon worn as an insignia of honor or rank; n. adornment consisting of an ornamental ribbon or cord
translation_zh: n. 哨兵线, 非常警戒线, 饰带；vt. 用警戒线围住
